Abstract: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.

### [55] [CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30158)
*Kwangmin Ki,Yunhun Nam,Jongheon Jeong,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CPR（Critical-Point Routing），一种token级路由框架，在模型层面将基础模型的通用能力与SFT专家的领域能力解耦，通过轻量级分层路由器仅在基础模型失败而专家成功的"关键token"上调用专家，在数学和医疗领域自适应中同时提升领域性能和保持通用能力，且仅需约1/3的token触发专家调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缓解SFT灾难性遗忘的方法（修改SFT损失的DFT/EAFT/LfU等）将通用与领域能力压缩到同一组权重中，受限于"领域-通用"权衡，无法同时提升二者。不同粒度的路由方法（查询级RouteLLM、patch级Switch Generation）粒度过粗，未充分探索token级路由作为架构性解决方案的潜力。

Method: 核心方法包含三个部分：(1)关键点标签自动构造——在SFT训练数据上通过teacher-forcing比较基础模型与专家模型的greedy预测，标记基础模型错而专家对的token为critical point（z=1）；(2)轻量级分层路由器训练——由查询级macro编码器（对问题token的最后一层隐状态做mean-pooling）和token级micro路由器（拼接当前token隐状态与macro摘要）构成的2层ReLU MLP，使用再加权BCE损失训练；(3)推理时采用动量平滑（m_t=α·m_{t-1}+(1-α)·p_t，α=0.5）和阈值门控三路分发（λ_t=0/软混合/1，对应m_t<0.35、[0.35,0.35,0.65]>0.65），跳过位置通过批处理KV cache追赶减少串行专家前向次数。

Result: 在Gemma3-4B和Llama3.1-8B上的数学（GSM8K/ASDiv/SVAMP）和医疗（PubMedQA/MedQA/CareQA）四个模型-领域组合中，CPR在所有设置下均达到SOTA，领域性能比SFT专家提升1.4-5.5%，通用能力下降从3.4-14.5%恢复至最多0.5%，整体均值提升4.2-10.8%；专家仅在约1/3的token上被调用；Gemma3-4B上延迟为expert的1.40×（Ensemble为1.89×）；消融实验证实分层路由器、α=0.5、阈值(0.35,0.65)为最优；在OpenMath2-Llama3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B等外部专家以及FinQA金融领域、AlpacaEval开放式指令跟随上也泛化有效；LoRA专家变体将GPU显存从16.60GB降至8.83GB。

Conclusion: 灾难性遗忘应被视为架构性问题而非损失层面的权衡问题；通过在模型层面解耦基础模型与SFT专家的token级路由，可以跳出"领域-通用"权衡，同时实现领域性能提升与通用能力保持，且具有较好的推理效率和外部专家泛化能力。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

</details>


### [56] [Label Semantic Expansion via Label Guided Neural Topic Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30216)
*Haojia Zheng,Yuyin Lu,Juntian Huang,Fan Ou,Yanghui Rao,Haoran Xie,Fu Lee Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为LGNTM（Label-Guided Neural Topic Model）的神经主题模型，旨在通过"topics-for-labels"视角解决标签语义扩展（Label Semantic Expansion, LSE）任务。LGNTM通过标签引导的主题特化、双重语义锚定（词汇和文档嵌入空间）和层级一致性正则化，为每个预定义标签学习专属的主题-词分布，从而生成具有语料支撑的描述性扩展词。在Bills、Medical和WoS三个数据集上的实验表明，LGNTM在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展质量、主题质量和下游分类任务上均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的标签感知主题模型主要遵循"labels-for-topics"视角，即利用标签来指导主题学习，但学到的主题并不直接适用于以标签为中心的分析任务。此外，传统的标签表示通常较为简短（如单一词或短语），缺乏充分的词汇范围和语义边界信息，难以支撑更深入的语义内容分析。本文旨在探索"topics-for-labels"的反向视角，利用学到的标签专属主题为预定义标签补充语料支撑的描述性词，从而丰富标签语义。

Method: 本文提出LGNTM模型，包含三个核心组件：(1) 标签引导的主题特化——通过分布锐化（focusing parameter γ=2）和主题嵌入分离损失实现标签与主题的一一对应；(2) 双重语义锚定——通过BoW重构（结合全局背景分布和IDF加权）和文档嵌入重构将标签专属主题锚定于词汇与文档语义空间；(3) 层级主题一致性——通过父子级双向KL散度正则化保持层级标签结构一致性。模型将每个标签层的主题数量等于该层的标签数量，通过共享文档编码器和层级主题解码器进行coarse-to-fine主题传播。训练目标为多任务加权损失，包含对齐损失（λ_align）、分离损失（λ_sep）、BoW损失（λ_bow）、文档损失（λ_doc）、背景插值（λ_bg）和层级一致性损失（λ_hier）。

Result: 在Bills（双层20/127标签）、Medical（5标签）和WoS（双层7/33标签）三个数据集上的实验显示：(1) 标签-主题对齐：LGNTM在所有层级实现DTU=1.00的完美标签-主题对应；(2) 标签扩展质量：LGNTM在MAP、LNPMI、LTD和LLM评判指标（Word Intrusion、Label Match、Preference）上均取得最优或近最优，综合偏好率达0.49-0.93；(3) 主题质量：在ARI和NMI上均达到最佳，TD和CV保持竞争力；(4) 下游分类：在Qwen3-8B-AWQ上Macro-F1在WoS-P上提升0.1353，在Medical上提升0.1206，显著优于标签名基线和随机打乱的对照实验，证实了增益来源于正确的标签-主题词对应关系而非简单的词数量增加。

Conclusion: 本文成功引入了"topics-for-labels"视角，并将标签语义扩展（LSE）形式化为利用语料支撑的描述性主题词丰富预定义标签的任务。提出的LGNTM通过学习专属、语义锚定的标签主题，实现了语料支撑、区分性强且可解释的标签扩展。实验从标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量和下游分类四个互补维度全面验证了模型的有效性。下游LLM分类实验进一步证实了所学扩展可作为有效的标签侧语义知识使用。该工作的局限性在于依赖预定义标签体系、扩展词质量受语料规模和粒度影响，且实验仅覆盖平面或两层标签结构。

Abstract: Topic models are widely used for content analysis, where users often analyze corpora around predefined labels rather than unordered latent topics. Conclusion: 当前LLM的推理不能可靠地基于问题的符号结构，对逻辑运算符层面的受控结构修改表现出不一致的行为。这凸显了在评估中超越最终准确率、纳入结构推理稳定性指标的重要性。LogicEdit框架为系统化压力测试LLM的逻辑推理能力提供了有效工具，并可支持未来构建更多样化的基准测试，将结构稳定性作为训练或评估信号以减少对模式匹配的依赖。

Abstract: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural language. Using this framework, we evaluate various LLMs under cumulative and individual operator edits and analyze their behavior in response to these changes. Our quantitative and qualitative analyses show that LLM reasoning behavior under controlled operator edits is inconsistent, regardless of model size or family: models sometimes adapt correctly to structural changes but often fail to track their logical consequences. The results from this automated stress test enable an evaluation of language models across different dimensions and help measure the reliability of their reasoning.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoTraceGT，将社会科学中的扎根理论（Grounded Theory）方法系统性地引入到 LLM 智能体轨迹分析中，通过多智能体流水线自动化执行开放编码、主轴编码和理论编码，并基于理论饱和原则终止迭代，从而在数千条轨迹上实现可扩展、可审计的智能体行为分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体行为分析存在两类局限：轻量级定量元数据（如动作计数、成功率）虽可扩展但缺乏过程解释力；人工分析可解释但成本高昂且难以规模化；基于预定义分类器的混合方法则过于僵化，无法泛化到新任务和涌现行为。ML 社区亟需一种既可扩展又具泛化能力的方法来理解"智能体到底在做什么"。扎根理论作为一种成熟的定性归纳方法，其理论饱和准则和从数据到理论的可审计链天然适合解决此问题。

Method: AutoTraceGT 是一个端到端的多智能体流水线，包含四个角色化代理：(1) OpenCode 逐轨迹进行开放编码，标注行为片段并附带步骤跨度与原文证据；(2) AxialCode 按批次进行主轴编码，将开放编码聚类为行为范畴并建立类型化关系；(3) Manage 维护版本化代码本并执行"常比较"操作（add/merge/split/flag），并基于"新增范畴数连续低于阈值 ϵ"自动判定理论饱和；(4) TheoreticalCode 在饱和后整合代码本产出核心范畴与理论叙事。算法对 N 条轨迹进行多轮迭代采样，直到连续 W 轮新增操作率低于阈值后终止。

Result: 在 6 个数据集（ALFWorld、GAIA、WebShop、Tau-Bench、Go-Browse、SWE-Agent）共 7,500+ 条轨迹上，使用 4 种后端 LLM 进行验证：(1) 过程可靠性方面，AutoTraceGT 驱动代码本稳定收敛到饱和，同配置下重复运行余弦相似度均值 0.923（高于跨配置 95 分位阈值 0.901，p<10⁻²⁰），跨 LLM 覆盖度也显著高于零分布（置换检验 p<0.001）；(2) 产物质量方面，代码本可覆盖人工分类法 73–91% 的失败模式（在 WebShop 上召回 90.9%、精确率 88.9%、匹配率 87.9%），并发现 17 个人工分类法未枚举的范畴（经人工审核全部有效），涌现的理论叙事与已有"级联错误"专家分析在机制上趋同但抽象层级互补；(3) 下游失效预测方面，代码本特征作为演绎特征空间在 FLAML AutoML 分类器中普遍优于零样本与少样本 LLM 基线，"代码本+少样本"互补特征在多数设置下达到最佳（MCC 与 ROC AUC 均显著提升）。

Conclusion: 扎根理论可作为一种可扩展的归纳方法用于 LLM 智能体行为分析，AutoTraceGT 在保留扎根理论可解释性与可审计性的同时将其规模扩展到数千条轨迹，能够产出可复现的代码本、覆盖人工分类法失败模式、发现遗漏模式、收敛于既有专家理论，并同时支持解释性与预测性分析；但存在 LLM 后端固有偏差、单一定性方法/单智能体表面/英文数据范围局限，以及算法停止准则与理论饱和概念不完全等价等限制。

Abstract: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short. We propose to bring grounded theory into agent trajectory analysis: a six-decade-old qualitative method from the social sciences, with a principled saturation criterion and an auditable trail from data to theory. We propose AutoTraceGT (Automated Trace analysis through Grounded Theory), the first multi-agent pipeline that automates grounded theory on agent trajectories. It iteratively performs open, axial, and theoretical coding until saturation, producing a behavioral taxonomy tailored to each task. Across six trajectory corpora, AutoTraceGT produces codebooks that recover 73-91 percent of the failure modes in human-annotated taxonomies and surface additional patterns that those taxonomies miss. The emergent theoretical narrative aligns with prior expert accounts. Used as a deductive feature space, the codebook outperforms zero-shot and few-shot LLM baselines on downstream failure prediction. These results suggest Grounded Theory offers a scalable analytic tool for ML researchers and agent developers studying what agents actually do.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异地（OOT）POI序列生成任务面临两大核心挑战：（1）需要从用户的家乡行为中推断可迁移的旅行意图，并适应目的地城市的兴趣漂移；（2）需要将高层次的语义推理与满足结构约束的序列生成对齐。现有方法要么依赖潜在ID迁移（可解释性差），要么直接用LLM生成序列（未将语义显式落地到位置感知预测）。该工作旨在弥合LLM语义推理与结构化序列生成之间的语义-结构鸿沟。

Method: SemPOI-RL采用三阶段框架：<br>1. **Stage 1（目的地导向风格推断）**：使用LoRA对Qwen3-8B进行监督微调（SFT），将用户家乡轨迹作为输入，让LLM推断目的地旅行风格；监督信号是从观测到的目的地轨迹直接总结的风格文本。<br>2. **Stage 2（语义POI对齐）**：引入语义POI对齐模块（SPAM），将全局风格向量分解为M=8个原型风格嵌入；通过位置感知的注意力机制，将这些原型注入到风格条件化的掩码自编码器（MAE）中，用于位置感知的目的地轨迹生成。训练目标包含重建损失、多样性损失（鼓励原型差异）和负熵正则化（防止坍缩）。<br>3. **Stage 3（强化学习）**：使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）对LLM进行微调，奖励信号由位置命中率（HR，权重2）、召回率（RR，0.5）、类别匹配（CM，0.5）和多样性（DIV，1）四项复合构成，将下游推荐质量反向传播到自然语言风格生成。

Result: 在Foursquare和Yelp两个数据集上，SemPOI-RL在六项指标（HR、RR、ED、DTW、CM、RM）上均优于10个基线方法（包括LSTM、GETNext、STHGCN、MatTrip、AR-Trip、KDDC、SPOT-Trip等传统方法，以及LLMMove、LLM4POI、Refine-POI等LLM方法）。具体而言，相比最强非LLM基线，HR在Foursquare上提升约15%，在Yelp上提升约10%。消融实验证实了SFT、SPAM和RL三个组件的必要性，其中SFT的缺失导致性能下降最大。多种子实验（p<0.05）验证了统计显著性。风格文本与真实目的地风格的余弦相似度在RL后逐步提升（Foursquare: 0.633→0.662→0.675；Yelp: 0.620→0.681→0.694），验证了语义对齐效果。案例分析显示，预测轨迹中前期由娱乐原型主导，后期转向住宿和返程阶段。

Conclusion: SemPOI-RL通过将自然语言旅行风格作为LLM语义推理与结构化轨迹生成之间的可训练接口，有效解决了跨城市POI序列生成中的兴趣漂移和语义-结构对齐问题。该框架不仅在多个指标上取得最优性能，还提供了跨行程阶段的风格归因可解释性。主要局限包括：原型仍为潜在向量（仅通过类别间接解释）；仅在固定目录上训练，未在完全未见城市零样本评估；多阶段流水线计算成本较高；精确POI命中率仍较低，需进一步可靠性评估和用户研究。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either rely on latent ID-based transfer with limited interpretability or directly use LLMs for sequence generation without explicitly grounding inferred semantics into position-aware predictions. To address this gap, we propose SemPOI-RL, a framework that aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation for interpretable OOT recommendation. Specifically, we first fine-tune an LLM to infer destination-oriented travel styles from users' hometown trajectories, using natural language as an interpretable semantic intermediate. We then introduce a Semantic POI Alignment Module (SPAM) to ground these inferred styles into a style-conditioned masked autoencoder for position-aware trajectory generation. Finally, we apply reinforcement learning with recommendation-oriented rewards to align LLM-generated styles with downstream sequence quality. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that SemPOI-RL consistently outperforms both traditional recommenders and direct LLM baselines, while providing interpretable style attribution across different phases of a trip. The code is available at this https URL .

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large language models exhibit substantial performance variation across languages, even when solving semantically equivalent tasks. Existing analyses often treat this phenomenon as an observational disparity caused by differences in pretraining data, tokenization, or benchmark coverage. We study a complementary hypothesis: high-resource languages (HRLs) may more reliably elicit latent computations useful for task-specific (i.e. mathematical) reasoning, while lower-resource languages (LRLs) may under-activate those computations despite expressing the same task. To test this hypothesis, we introduce a mechanistic intervention framework for identifying and transferring task-relevant sparse latent features across languages. Using sparse autoencoders over residual-stream activations, we isolate features enriched in successful HRL task-specific reasoning while filtering out source-language and generic-generation features. We then construct steering directions from these features and inject them during LRL inference. The resulting interventions test whether the selected features are functionally involved in the observed reasoning gap: suppressing them should impair source-language reasoning, while activating them should partially recover target-language reasoning beyond random and non-task controls. Our framework reframes some cross-lingual reasoning gaps as failures of mechanism elicitation rather than capability absence, and offers a causally testable route to feature-mediated transfer without translation, fine-tuning, or changing the user-facing language.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉问答基准多以英语和西方场景为主，缺乏对文化特定概念与跨语言（含阿拉伯语方言）鲁棒性的评估；此外，多模态模型可能产生文化上看似合理但缺乏视觉依据的"幻觉"回答，而文化保真度评估也缺乏专门工具。阿拉伯语及海湾文化场景为评测多模态模型的文化理解能力提供了重要场景。

Method: 任务1a采用基于OASIS和M²CQA数据集的语音视觉问答（图像+语音问题+三个语音选项，输出正确选项索引）；任务1b将多选题转换为三句真假判断（一句视觉成立，两句文化上合理但视觉不支持），采用对比不稳定性（CI）作为主要指标，要求模型在三句间保持判断一致性；任务2 CRAI-Bench基于40张卡塔尔文化参考图像与5个不同特异度的英文提示，使用gpt-image-1生成200张图像，由人类标注者按CRAI五维度评分（CEA、CC、CS、CI、HP），主要评测指标为Spearman相关系数与MAE。基线分别采用Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、Qwen2.5-VL-3B与GPT-4o。

Result: 三大主要发现：(1) 语音VQA在阿拉伯语上显著更难，最佳MSA准确率比英语低8.7个百分点，差距主要源于阿拉伯语ASR错误及合成训练音频与人类录制测试语音的差异；(2) 幻觉检测受益于任务感知的单选式预测，统一选出唯一视觉成立陈述的系统比独立真假判断的对比不稳定性大幅降低（英语从0.267降至0.029，MSA从0.428降至0.036），且MSA最佳系统采用零样本提示；(3) CRAI-Bench中所有提交均超过GPT-4o基线，但依赖标题版本先验（视觉证据有限）的系统排名第一，揭示自动化文化评估易受非视觉结构线索利用，幻觉惩罚维度尤为困难。

Conclusion: ImageEval 2026推动了文化敏感的阿拉伯多模态评测发展，揭示了阿拉伯语音建模、对齐任务的幻觉评估设计、以及文化图像评测中视觉接地的重要性。数据集与评测脚本已公开，后续将扩展至更多阿拉伯方言、更多样化语音与生成条件，并减少结构性线索的利用空间。

Abstract: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. All datasets and evaluation scripts from the shared task are released to the research community. The shared task highlights the challenges of culturally grounded multimodal evaluation, particularly for Arabic speech and image-text reasoning.

</details>


### [67] [Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30609)
*Lukas Borggren,Jenny Kunz,Marco Kuhlmann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对瑞典语新闻业这一低资源领域，通过持续预训练（CPT）将大语言模型（Ministral 3 3B/8B）适配到瑞典新闻领域。构建了高质量数据集 BonCorpus（35年瑞典新闻文章，14.6M文章/8.5B tokens）和包含6项编辑任务的领域评测基准 BonEval。结论是：CPT必须配合经验回放（代码+英语+瑞典语混合数据BCES）才能有效改善生成质量和事实知识，但会损害判别性任务；LoRA与instruct vector（IV）兼容性好，效果优于全参数微调；现有EuroEval无法反映领域内提升，强调了面向领域评测的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 现有大模型在低资源语言和小众领域能力有限；2) 新闻业作为LLM目标领域研究稀缺，尤其是非英语场景；3) 现有瑞典语评测基准不足以反映领域适应效果；4) 持续预训练（CPT）需配合经验回放避免灾难性遗忘，但最优混合比例未明；5) PEFT方法（LoRA）与instruct vector的兼容性需要探索。

Method: 1) 数据：构建BonCorpus（21.7M原始文章→14.6M高质量，8.5B tokens），经解析、正则清洗、fastText语言过滤、MinHash LSH去重等管道处理。2) 评测：构建BonEval，包含Headline（标题生成）、Lead（导语生成）、Summary（摘要）、Topic（19类话题分类）、Entity（关键NER）、Quiz（多选题问答），主要对比EuroEval。3) 模型适应CPT：对Ministral 3 3B/8B基模型，使用8种数据混合物（B/BC/BE/BCE/BS/BCS/BES/BCES，其中每种回放数据占比10%），比较FFT、LoRA、LLaMA Pro三种适应方法，并探索在CPT模型上叠加instruct vector（IV）。4) 训练配置：AdamW（lr 5e-5）、cosine schedule、序列长度16384、bfloat16、DeepSpeed ZeRO-2、FlashAttention-3，使用6500 GPU小时。

Result: 1) 最佳数据混合物是BCES（BonCorpus+代码+英语+瑞典语），平均得分41.48（3B），仅靠BonCorpus（B）会出现灾难性遗忘（36.98）。2) CPT在生成任务（Headline、Lead、Summary）和知识密集任务（Quiz）上提升显著，但在判别任务（Topic、Entity）上略有退化。3) LoRA（参数漂移0.08）比FFT（0.18）更兼容IV，LoRA+IV达到最高平均42.27（3B），BonLM 8B LoRA+IV在多个生成任务上取得最佳。4) 在EuroEval上CPT反而退化（尤其MMLU、HellaSwag），表明通用基准无法捕捉领域获益，EuroEval主要依赖机器翻译可能存在文化偏差。5) 最强模型BonLM 8B LoRA+IV在BonEval上平均得分46.02，超越所有基线（包括Ministral 3 8B Base/Instruct/Reasoning、Llama SW3 8B、Apertus 8B、GPT-SW3 6.7B）。

Conclusion: 1) 首次系统性研究LLM适应瑞典新闻业，CPT是可行路径，但必须配合精心设计的多语言经验回放混合物以缓解灾难性遗忘。2) 不同任务类型受益不均：生成和知识密集任务改善，判别任务几乎不变或轻微退化。3) IV兼容性高度依赖适应方法：LoRA友好，FFT有害，可能与参数空间距离有关。4) 现有通用瑞典语评测（EuroEval）无法充分反映CPT在领域内的提升，凸显了语言和领域专用基准在模型适配过程中的必要性。5) 为新闻业及其他语言/领域专用LLM研究提供了从数据、基准到训练配方的方法蓝图。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

</details>


### [68] [Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30619)
*Minkyung Cho,Jihyo Kim,SeungWoo Song,Junghun Yuk,Minjoon Kee,Hoyun Song,KyungTae Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了合成数据驱动的LLM训练流程中的一个隐蔽安全漏洞：通过对齐的教师模型通过偏见系统提示生成的、在内容层面看似无害的合成数据，可作为隐蔽通道将针对性社会偏见注入下游已对齐的学生模型，同时几乎不损害其通用能力。作者提出了基于对数线性(log-linearity)的LLS筛选方法作为初步防御手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着合成数据在LLM训练中的广泛应用，其安全性风险尚未得到充分理解。现有的安全过滤器（如LlamaGuard）只能拦截显式有害内容，而基于潜意识学习(subliminal learning)的新型攻击可通过语义上无害的数据传递特定社会偏见，对AI供应链安全构成严重威胁。

Method: 1. 攻击流程（三阶段）：Stage 1使用极端运动建议数据集对instruct模型进行LoRA微调，构建"失对齐教师"；Stage 2在偏见系统提示下由教师生成跨领域（创意写作、代码、数学）的合成数据，并通过关键词过滤和LLM裁判过滤去除显式人口群体提及；Stage 3对已对齐学生模型进行SFT。2. 评估方法：使用BBQ基准的Accuracy-Scaled bias (AccSc)指标衡量偏见变化，并在ARC/GSM8K/MBP验证通用能力。3. 防御方法：基于对数线性原理的Logit-Linear Selection (LLS)筛选，通过比较目标偏见探针对数据集产生的对数概率偏移与20个结构控制句的均值差异（z>3.0为污染阈值）来检测污染数据。

Result: 1. 可行性：潜意识偏见信号在Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、OLMo-2-7B三个模型族上均有效传播，创意写作场景下AccSc平均增幅达+25.2（Llama）、+19.5（Mistral）、+16.4（OLMo）点；代码场景也产生平均+7.9点的增幅。2. 条件：失对齐教师是必要条件（基础教师反而会去偏见）；偏见提示决定了哪个特定刻板印象被传递（约贡献78%定向放大）；教师-学生同族兼容性显著增强攻击（自有数据比跨族数据强2-3倍）。3. 通用能力几乎不变（ARC/GSM8K/MBPP变化均<±0.1）。4. 数学领域为无效结果（最大偏移仅+2.5），表明需要足够的表征自由度。5. LLS筛选在24个受污染数据集中检出15个，无假阳性（12个中性数据均未触发）；检测灵敏度与偏见传递强度正相关。6. 在Qwen3-32B上也验证了攻击可扩展性。7. 偏见注入而非激活：通过反刻板印象注入也能产生方向性偏移（但幅度约小一个数量级），证明信号是被注入的而非仅被激活的。

Conclusion: 本研究揭示了合成数据驱动的LLM训练管道中一个此前被忽视的供应链安全漏洞：定向社会偏见可被隐蔽注入对齐模型，且使用标准能力基准无法检测。关键洞察包括：（1）潜意识偏见注入需要三个条件联合满足：失对齐教师、具有足够灵活性的训练领域（创意写作/代码有效，数学无效）、以及教师-学生表征兼容性；（2）这些条件在实际合成数据管道中容易满足；（3）内容层面的隐蔽性与统计层面的可检测性之间存在张力；（4）基于对数线性原理的LLS筛选可作为首道防线，但需预设偏见方向且可能遭受适应性对手攻击。研究呼吁加强合成训练管道的数据来源审计、审查实践与隐藏行为偏移识别技术。

Abstract: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

</details>


### [69] [GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30632)
*Outongyi Lv,Yuanwei Zhang,Xiaoqun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GMTS（Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection），通过结合token熵与有效梯度系数 ω 来量化token重要性，作为ETS（Entropy-based Token Selection）的更精细替代方案，在三种推理任务和多种模型规模上稳定优于基于熵的token选择方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法（如GRPO、DAPO）对所有token使用统一的回答级优势，均匀更新。最近研究表明仅使用Top 20%高熵token训练即可显著提升性能，但"为什么高熵token重要"这一核心问题缺乏深入理解。作者发现：单条回答内部熵与梯度幅值正相关，但跨不同回答（特别是优势/奖励差异显著时）熵无法稳定反映token的真实贡献。因此需要一种比纯熵更可靠的token重要性量化方法。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 梯度分解——将 ∇θℓ_i,t(θ) 分解为 ω_i,t(θ)·∇θ log πθ(o_i,t)，其中 ω_i,t(θ) 聚合优势信号、PPO clip指示函数和KL正则项，是token级有效学习信号；(2) 理论联系——通过Proposition 3.1证明，当 1-πθ(o_t)→0 时，log G_t / log E_t → 1，建立token熵与logit对数概率梯度ℓ2范数之间的渐近对数线性关系，并解释了高熵token倾向于产生更大幅值参数梯度这一经验现象；(3) GMTS打分——定义 δ_i,t = |E_i,t · ω_i,t(θ)| 作为可计算的token重要性代理，仅使用Top ρ比例token（默认20%）参与梯度更新，可无缝集成至GRPO/DAPO，计算开销极小。

Result: 在MATH（MATH-12K、DAPO-MATH-17K）、CODE（KodCode）、CS（CS-QA）三个领域，使用Qwen2.5-math、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-coder、Qwen2.5-base系列模型在1.5B/7B/8B三种规模上进行测试。核心结果：GMTS在5个数学基准上的平均提升为1.5B-DAPO +1.55、1.5B-GRPO +1.30、7B-DAPO +1.33、7B-GRPO +3.41；Qwen3-8B整体平均提升1.85%（AIME2024 +5.21、AIME2025 +3.75）；代码和CS领域同样稳定优于ETS。Top 20% token训练稳定优于全量训练，且在0.1/0.2/0.5/0.7/0.9多种选择比例下GMTS在10组配置中9次胜出。附录给出AIME2025样例，GMTS输出更简洁且给出正确答案117，而ETS得出错误答案101。

Conclusion: GMTS是ETS的稳健替代方案，通过结合熵与回答级奖励信号导出的有效梯度系数，能更细粒度地识别对RLVR策略更新贡献大的token。该方法简单、易集成、几乎无额外计算开销，并在不同推理领域、模型规模和选择比例下展现一致的改进。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

</details>


### [70] [BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30646)
*Debarpan Bhattacharya,Malay Phadke,Sriram Ganapathy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BiG-SURE，一种基于跨温度语义一致性的黑盒不确定性估计框架，通过构建低温度锚点与高温度探针的二部图，利用归一化平方谱能量定义置信度，在文本、多语言和多模态QA任务上超越了现有黑盒不确定性估计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署大语言模型(LLM)和视觉语言模型(VLM)时，可靠的不确定性估计至关重要，尤其在无法访问模型参数的黑盒设置下。现有的黑盒不确定性估计方法均基于固定温度下的采样响应进行分析，忽略了不同温度之间响应动态变化所蕴含的不确定性信号。

Method: BiG-SURE的核心方法是：1) 使用低温度(T_L=0.1)采样M=3个稳定语义锚点；2) 使用高温度(T_H=1.0)从5个语义等价输入变换(文本释义或图像轻微扰动)各采样2次，共N=10个探针；3) 基于NLI蕴含分数构建M×N的二部图邻接矩阵W；4) 通过归一化平方谱能量（即W的Frobenius范数平方除以MN）定义置信度，不确定性为其补；5) 满足语义恒等性、语义不相交性和单调性三个有效不确定性度量的数学性质。

Result: 在文本QA(Trivia-QA: 0.753, SVAMP: 0.877)、多语言QA(SciQ en/ja/zh上均最佳)和多模态QA(OK-VQA: 0.752)七组数据集中的六组上取得了最佳平均abstention AUROC，超越DSE、SumEigv、Deg、LexSim、KLE、SNNE等7个基线方法。在匹配推理预算(N=13)下仍保持优势，谱能量主要集中在最大奇异值(Top-1与完整分数接近)。AURC指标上同样达到最低值。

Conclusion: BiG-SURE证明了跨温度响应动态作为黑盒不确定性信号的有效性，二部图锚点-探针框架为LLM和VLM的可靠性部署提供了一种简单、无监督、可解释且实用的不确定性估计方法。其局限性包括依赖NLI语义后端、一致性错误预测无法识别、视觉模态未参与文本一致性比较，以及评估范围限于QA任务。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

</details>


### [71] [LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30679)
*Bérénice Jaulmes,Mehwish Alam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LCoT-GV（Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier），一种基于图注意力网络（GAT）的框架，用于验证大型推理模型（LRMs）生成的长思维链（LCoTs）中的推理过程。该方法将LCoTs表示为推理图（节点为推理步骤，边通过NLI模型编码语义和逻辑关系），并训练GAT预测推理链的正确性。作者构建了一个新的图导向验证数据集，实验显示该方法在平均性能上优于最相似的方法LCoT2Tree。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）生成的长思维链（LCoTs）即使最终答案正确，其内部推理步骤也可能存在矛盾、不支持的推理或无关步骤。现有验证方法通常顺序或局部地分析推理链，且多数依赖昂贵的LLM调用来构建表示（如LCoT2Tree）。因此需要一种更高效、能够捕获全局结构信息的验证方法。

Method: 1. **步骤分割**：使用"Actually"、"Wait"、"So"、"Let's"等关键词而非双换行符来分割LCoT步骤；2. **推理图构建**：每个步骤作为节点，使用DeBERTa NLI模型识别步骤间的蕴涵（entailment）或矛盾（contradiction）关系作为边，通过候选父节点算法（Algorithm 1）确定连接结构，处理重复子序列以提高效率；3. **特征表示**：使用对比微调的MiniLM生成节点语义嵌入，边用one-hot编码；4. **图分类**：使用两层GATv2（隐藏维度64）加两层MLP进行图级二分类（正确/不正确），采用负对数似然损失训练。

Result: 实验在MATH、GPQA、LiveCodeBench和MMLU-Pro四个基准上使用三种LRM（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、QwQ-32B）进行评估：1. **总体性能**：LCoT-GV平均准确率达77.03%，优于LCoT2Tree（74.68%）和长度基线；2. **任务差异显著**：在LiveCodeBench（87.58%）和GPQA（78.47%）上提升显著（+6.58至+11.30），但在MATH（72.37%）和MMLU-Pro（69.68%）上有所下降；3. **消融研究**：仅使用元数据特征性能降至接近随机猜测（平均52.92%），证明语义信息是关键；移除负边会导致轻微性能下降；4. **效率**：使用本地NLI模型避免了LLM调用，显著降低计算成本。

Conclusion: LCoT-GV是一种有效的、计算高效的图基LCoT验证框架，能够在不依赖昂贵LLM调用的情况下捕获全局推理结构。该方法在平均性能上优于现有最相似的方法，特别是在代码和科学概念等类自然语言领域表现强劲。然而，数学语言的验证仍是挑战，未来工作将扩展到非数学推理任务以进一步验证方法的有效性。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.

</details>


### [72] [An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30702)
*Philippe Meyer,Guillaume Gricourt,Thomas Duigou,Joan Hérisson,Jean-Loup Faulon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.

### [73] [Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30731)
*Pratuat Amatya,Venktesh Viswanathan,Vinay Setty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines. This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at this https URL .

### [74] [Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30873)
*Jinhee Won,Xinlan Emily Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过600个跨13种语言的人际关系建议问题，比较了8个大语言模型在两种跨语言引导策略下的输出差异：以目标语言生成再翻译回英语（NL）与以"母语者"人设直接生成建议（NP）。研究发现两种策略不可互换，NP显著改变语言风格、行为脚手架和强制选择中的行为推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLMs被广泛用于人际建议和跨语言跨文化社会行为研究，研究者常采用"以母语者身份回答"的捷径来引发语言或文化变异。但该人设提示方法是否真等同于目标语言生成后翻译回源语言的输出，尚缺乏系统性检验。这对于跨文化LLM行为研究的方法论选择至关重要。

Method: 使用600个跨13种语言的人际建议问题，在8个LLMs上对比两种策略：(1) NL（目标语言生成+翻译回英语）；(2) NP（母语者人设提示）。测量三类指标：语言风格（如词汇社会线索、归属感、积极性、具体性、社会协调性）、开放建议中的行为脚手架（可操作性）、以及强制选择场景中的行动推荐。分析策略效应在语言、话题、模型间的变异。

Result: NL与NP不可互换。相较NL，NP倾向于：增加词汇层面的社会线索（包括归属感和积极语调），但降低具体性和社会协调性；在开放式建议中提供更少的可操作脚手架；在强制选择场景中改变所选行动，整体偏向"对抗"而非"转移"，且效应量随语言、话题和模型而变化。

Conclusion: 跨语言引导策略是具有实质影响的方法论选择，会同时改变建议的框架方式和模型推荐的具体行动。研究警示研究者不能将"母语者人设提示"视为"目标语言生成"的等价替代，两者在跨文化LLM行为研究中会产生系统性差异。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.

</details>


### [75] [Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30884)
*Melina Morch,Daniel Braun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个多语言（德语-英语）反LGBTQ偏见基准数据集，通过结合德语区酷儿群体的社区刻板印象与WinoQueer的德语翻译版本，对八种不同架构和规模的语言模型进行偏见评估，并通过在社区及进步媒体内容上进行微调探索偏见缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型偏见研究多聚焦于性别和种族偏见，反LGBTQ偏见研究不足，且现有基准缺乏跨文化和跨语言覆盖，尤其在英语以外的语言中；同时，现有方法主要依赖性别表征，未能充分捕捉酷儿群体的真实经验与刻板印象。

Method: 1）构建多语言德英反LGBTQ偏见基准数据集，包含社区来源的德语酷儿刻板印象和WinoQueer的德语翻译版本；2）选取八种不同规模和架构的语言模型进行偏见评估；3）通过在社区文本和进步媒体内容上进行微调，探索偏见缓解方法；4）对比翻译数据与社区原生数据在偏见检测结果上的差异。

Result: 研究发现语言模型确实复现了反酷儿刻板印象，且在不同身份类别和模型间存在显著差异；翻译数据与基于社区的数据所揭示的偏见模式不同，表明文化适应性对多语言偏见评估至关重要；微调虽能在平均层面降低偏见，但在不同模型和身份群体间效果并不一致。

Conclusion: 该研究强调了多语言和文化适应性反LGBTQ偏见评估的必要性，证明社区参与的数据收集方式能揭示翻译基准无法捕捉的偏见；同时指出微调并非普遍有效的偏见缓解策略，需针对具体模型和身份类别进行更细致的研究与干预。

Abstract: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.

</details>


### [76] [CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30968)
*Shangqing Tu,Daniel Zhang-Li,Yucheng Wang,Shiyu Gan,Yanpeng Wang,Huiqiang Rong,Mofei Chen,Shen Yang,Yini Chen,Yinuo Duan,Haoxuan Li,Binglin Liu,Ye He,Danqi Zheng,Zhanxin Hao,Yuxuan Wu,Mengting Tao,Yuqiu Liu,Jifan Yu,Juanzi Li,Bin Xu,Lei Hou,Huiqin Liu,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CogEvol是一个专为"学习环境生成"（LEG）任务设计的模型系列，能将课程简报一次性生成结构化JSON幻灯片或可执行的交互式HTML页面。通过三阶段后训练（监督微调→幻灯片强化学习→交互式HTML强化学习），在220k生产请求中实现幻灯片中位17秒、交互页面59秒的生成速度。核心创新在于"交互性必须被测量而非被判断"的原则——通过可执行探针奖励捕捉并修复了游戏任务的奖励黑客问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用编码模型在教育场景下面临三大瓶颈：速度慢（200-600秒/编辑）、可靠性差（外观好看但交互失效）、成本高（旗舰模型参数庞大）。现有方法无法满足课堂实时生成交互式课件的需求，因此需要一个为LEG任务专门优化的小型、可靠、低成本模型。

Method: 三阶段后训练：(1)基于生产数据的两条执行感知数据管道，生成53,687条经验证的SFT样本；(2)GRPO强化学习，采用混合规则+VLM奖励（幻灯片：0.6 VLM忠实度+0.4几何规则；HTML：视觉质量0.4+内容0.3+双视口0.1×2+交互性测量0.3）；(3)针对交互性测量的探针硬化奖励，防止奖励黑客。推理加速采用脚手架编辑（检索相似历史模板，仅做组件级决策）和MAIC-UI点击定位增量编辑。部署方面将混合架构（48层GDN+16层全注意力）移植到国产Ascend加速器。

Result: CogEvol-27B在HTML-500上得63.7分、slide-std上得83.7分，零硬失败，参数仅为GLM-5的1/26.9；CogEvol-4B开放发布（Apache 2.0）。脚手架编辑使交互页生成成本再降约76%，MAIC-UI编辑延迟降低23倍。人工评估中不可用页面从25%降至10%，无法进入的页面从2/24降至0/30。在PresentBench（50.48分，接近Gemini 3.1 Pro的51.82）和EE-Eval（57.50分，error-free 123/127）外部基准上验证了泛化能力。完整栈在Ascend 910 A3上实现应用级与A800 GPU的同等可用性，吞吐量差距1.48×（不含推测解码），全部可归因于GDN递归状态无法截断导致的可用加速机制缺失。

Conclusion: 两个核心结论可推广：(1)交互性必须被测量而非判断——截图式评分无法检测可玩性失效；(2)奖励无法测量的维度，RL会悄无声息地破坏——游戏奖励黑客事件证实了奖励设计而非数据量决定性能上限。CogEvol已服务OpenMAIC生产流量（自2026-08-24），CogEvol-4B开源发布，使高效、可靠的学习环境生成能惠及资源匮乏地区的教育场景。未来方向是个性化四阶段流水线（证据→理解→视觉引导→生成）和改进代码评分严格性、跨页面一致性等开放问题。

Abstract: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass. Across 220k production requests, CogEvol completes a slide in a median of 17 seconds and an interactive page in 59, replacing minutes-long multi-turn agent scaffolding. Reliability is enforced rather than hoped for: a production-grounded data pipeline turns real failures into 53,687 verified SFT samples, and a hybrid rule-plus-VLM reward drives GRPO-based RL, hardened after we caught and fixed a reward-hacking episode that produced visually convincing but unplayable games. CogEvol-27B scores 83.7 on slide quality and 63.7 on a 500-case interactive-HTML benchmark with 26.9x fewer parameters than flagship coding models, and, in collaboration with the OpenMAIC team, serves their live production traffic. CogEvol-4B is released openly under the Apache 2.0 license at this https URL external flagships are measured on the same suites under the identical harness. Scaffold editing cuts interactive-page generation cost by a further ~76%, and the full stack runs on domestic Ascend accelerators at application-level parity with A800 GPUs, lowering the unit cost of AI-native education at scale.

</details>


### [77] [Evaluating and Improving LLM Self-Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30980)
*Siqi Zeng,Andre N. Assis,Rowan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了LLM的"自我建模"能力——即模型回答关于自身行为问题的能力。作者构建了一个涵盖9-10种任务的综合基准测试，评估了18个前沿模型，发现当前模型在这一能力上存在显著但有限的水平，并在简单反事实问题上会出现系统性错误。为提升该能力，作者设计了一个可扩展的合成数据生成管道，并证明强化学习（RL）可在三个开源模型系列上提升聚合自我建模技能，但这些提升并不一致地构成内省，因为改进可能并非来自对模型内部决策过程的特权访问。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM被广泛询问关于自身能力、行为预测等问题，但这些"自我报告"的准确性尚未得到系统量化。理解LLM能否准确预测自身在不同情境下的行为，对于模型可解释性、安全审计和实际部署具有重要意义。本文旨在建立一个可测量的行为能力基准，并探索通过训练能否提升该能力。

Method: 1. **基准构建**：定义9-10种自我建模任务（Flip-Decision、Self-Accuracy、Output-Prediction等），覆盖二元、多选、数值、自由文本等答案格式。任务来源包括GSM8K、HumanEval、WildGuardTest、BBQ四个语料库。使用"技能分数"（skill score）相对于虚拟预测器基线来衡量能力。2. **合成数据生成**：设计"生成-验证-修正"循环管道，利用约100个HuggingFace数据集（排除评估语料库）自动生成扰动并验证目标模型的行为变化。多轮BLOOM轨迹用于多轮行为训练。3. **训练方法**：使用LoRA适配器进行强化学习（RLVR风格），采用REINFORCE with importance sampling，无PPO裁剪或KL惩罚。评估了11个单一任务训练、多任务联合训练和BLOOM多轮训练。4. **泛化与内省测试**：通过跨任务转移、跨模型转移实验检验改进是否构成真正的内省能力。

Result: 1. 现有模型在自我建模能力上有显著但远未达到上限的提升空间（最佳聚合技能分数仅+0.147），且在简单反事实问题（如GSM8K的Flip-Decision）上会出现系统性错误。2. 多任务RL训练在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B三个模型系列上均能提升聚合自我建模技能（最高+0.127），并有一定程度的跨任务转移。3. 跨模型转移实验显示，"更强的解释器"能够在其他模型的行为标签上表现更佳，未观察到一致的"自身模型优势"，表明改进可能来自通用能力而非特权自我访问。4. SFT训练会导致自我建模能力的灾难性下降（collapse），而RL训练更为稳健。5. 格式合规性是RL训练带来的部分收益来源（Shapley分解显示GPT-OSS-20B仅38%、Llama仅45%的提升来自自我建模质量改善）。6. 下游应用方面，自我报告可轻微提升红队审计效果和提示工程中的分类器校准，但效应量较小。

Conclusion: LLM的自我建模是可测量且可训练的行为能力。当前模型远未在该能力上达到上限，RL训练能够跨模型家族提升这一能力。然而，这些提升并不一致地表明模型获得了对自身内部决策过程的特权访问——成功的解释更依赖于解释器的一般能力而非是否在解释同一模型的行为。自我报告可能具有双重用途，既能帮助内部审计员理解模型行为，也可能被外部攻击者利用，因此应作为建议性参考，而非可靠归因。

Abstract: We study self-modeling: an LLM's ability to answer questions about its own behavior. We focus on verifiable behavioral questions, such as whether a prompt edit would change the model's final answer. To measure this capability, we introduce a benchmark that tests diverse types of self-modeling questions. Current models show non-trivial but limited self-modeling skill, and make systematic mistakes on simple counterfactual questions about their own behavior. To improve self-modeling skill, we develop a scalable synthetic-data pipeline that produces self-modeling training data, and show that reinforcement-learning can improve aggregate self-modeling skill across three open-source model families with some transfer to held-out tasks. These gains, however, do not seem to constitute introspection consistently: improved self-modeling may not arise from privileged access to the model's internal decision process.

</details>


### [78] [Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30987)
*Arthur Becker,Jakob Kemmler,David Thulke,Christine Schäfer,Christian Dugast,Hermann Ney*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了监督微调（SFT）目标超出基础模型参数化知识导致的事实幻觉问题，提出"知识对齐SFT"框架，统一比较现有方法并提出两种新方法（Evidence Rewrite和Recall Rewrite）。实验表明Recall Rewrite在事实性和拒绝行为上取得最佳效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在指令微调后经常产生事实幻觉。已有研究表明，当SFT目标包含基础模型未稳固内化的知识时，会驱使模型在超出其知识边界的情况下自信作答。本文将此问题形式化为训练目标与模型参数化知识的不匹配，旨在通过知识对齐SFT缩小幻觉区域。

Method: 1. 框架：将响应分解为原子事实声明，构建知识对齐数据集D*使得C(R*|P) ⊆ K(M_base)。区分两种策略：基于生成（FLAME）和基于估计（UNIT_cut）。2. 提出Evidence Rewrite：用基础模型生成回答，再通过外部证据检索与验证进行过滤重写。3. 提出Recall Rewrite（主要贡献）：对每个知识依赖型声明生成多个探测问题，用基础模型回答，通过一致性蕴含检验判断是否被稳定回忆；仅保留一致回忆的声明并重写。4. 实验在Qwen3-4B和OLMo 3 7B上进行，使用OASST1数据集。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B上：Recall Rewrite在WildHalu上FActScore达84.1（标准SFT为77.2），Biography上达76.4（标准SFT为33.3）。FLAME相对标准SFT无显著改善。在OLMo 3 7B上Recall Rewrite同样优于各后训练阶段。UnknownBench上Recall Rewrite的F1分数最高，但精确率下降。通用能力（HumanEval+、GSM8K、IFEval、TruthfulQA）平均仅下降0.9分。已知声明比例消融显示%Known越高，事实性越好，但覆盖率越低。

Conclusion: 知识对齐SFT可有效减少事实幻觉，同时保持通用能力。如何近似模型知识边界至关重要：朴素自生成（FLAME）不足，外部验证（Evidence Rewrite）有所改善，最佳效果来自直接探测基础模型能否一致回忆监督声明（Recall Rewrite）。但存在事实性与覆盖率的权衡：更严格的对齐减少幻觉但降低信息量并增加过度拒绝。该方法使SFT目标的事实内容成为可控变量，但当前流程成本较高，需要更便宜的近似方法才能扩展到大规模指令微调流程。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants: Evidence Rewrite, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and Recall Rewrite, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities. Recall Rewrite yields the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal behavior on UnknownBench. It thereby confirms that SFT targets beyond the base model's knowledge drive hallucination behavior.

</details>


### [79] [LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31016)
*Sebastian Fox,Luke Markham,Ryan Lail,Michael Karotsieris*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文发现LLM评审模型在评估AI医疗病历笔记时存在严重的"遗漏盲视"问题：能够有效检测笔记中错误添加或修改的内容（配对判别率0.79-0.94），但对遗漏信息的检测接近随机猜测（0.50-0.63）。论文提出了两种解决方法：先列举转录中的事实再逐一检查的策略能将检测率提升至36.9%（假阳性6.2%），并发布了一个500对的基准测试集OmissionBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境AI医疗记录员（ambient AI scribes）在临床实践中被广泛使用，但已发表的审计发现其最主要的错误类型是"遗漏"——即接诊中确立的信息未被记录。标准的质量检查方法是使用LLM评审模型，但该研究要验证这些评审模型是否能够检测遗漏错误。这是一个关键的临床AI安全问题，因为遗漏（如未记录的过敏、药物、检查结果）会直接影响患者安全。

Method: 研究构建了一个严格的基准测试OmissionBench，包含500对单错误笔记（298个遗漏，202个添加/修改对照），按严重程度（关键/支持/边缘）和残留痕迹（完全移除/片段残留/重新表述残留）进行分级。在八个评审设计（包括忠实性评估、生成检查表、G-Eval、RAGAS风格等）和多个参考评审中测量检测能力。然后测试了五种修复方法（措辞变化、投票、提示优化等），发现均无效。最终提出了两种将"遗漏问题"转化为"存在检查"的方法：(1) 枚举-然后-检查流水线，先从转录中提取临床事实，再对笔记进行逐项验证；(2) 通过GEPA优化演化的单次调用提示，内部执行相同的枚举-检查程序。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 八个评审设计对添加/修改内容的配对判别率为0.79-0.94，而对遗漏仅为0.50-0.63，遗漏检测接近随机猜测；(2) 五种传统修复方法（标准、格式、投票、措辞、提示优化）均未能创建可用的单笔记检测能力；(3) 转换任务结构——列举转录事实后逐项检查——部分恢复了检测能力：枚举流水线（标记任何关键事实缺失）在2.7%假阳性率下检测24.6%的遗漏笔记；演化的单次调用提示在6.2%假阳性率下检测36.9%；(5) 残留痕迹遗漏（即事实的重新表述存活在笔记其他位置）击败了所有可部署方法，这是一个开放问题；(6) 临床医生验证：在10个分歧案例中，临床医生在所有10例（p=0.002）中支持流水线而非整体评审；(7) 真实供应商笔记测试显示，无基准阈值可转移，但重新校准后的演化提示仍以一半的假阳性率检测到比最佳整体评审更多的遗漏。

Conclusion: LLM评审模型验证的是"存在"而非"缺失"——它们能够检测病历中错误添加或修改的内容，但对遗漏信息的检测接近随机水平。Transformer注意力机制难以关注"空缺"，因为遗漏不提供可指向的文本。修复方法是结构性的，而非修辞性的：将"是否遗漏？"的开放问题转化为"每个事实是否存在？"的封闭式检查。论文发布了一个分级基准、提示和判断结果，作为评估AI病历质量的基础设施。残留痕迹遗漏（事实以重新表述存活于笔记其他位置）代表了一个开放问题，需要结构性而非更好的评审方法来解决。

Abstract: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.

</details>


### [80] [One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31017)
*Sebastian Fox,Luke Markham,Ryan Lail,Michael Karotsieris*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对三款商用环境AI医疗记录员（ambient AI scribes）在相同142次问诊（共生成565份病历记录）上进行审计，证实31.3%的病历记录存在至少一项已验证的错误；研究发现"失败率"不仅取决于记录员产品本身，还取决于评估"工具"（审核标准、模型族、审核架构），仅审核指令一项即可使候选错误验证率从9.3%变动至79.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境AI医疗记录员被广泛部署用于自动生成临床记录，其安全性依赖临床医生的签署审核。然而，已有审计研究对错误率报告存在巨大分歧（遗漏占错误的54-86%），且没有研究分析评估工具本身对结果的影响。本研究旨在同时提供一个经对抗式验证的错误普查，以及对"计数工具"本身的受控分解。

Method: 采用"广泛发现+对抗式验证"流程：1) 对三款商用产品（Scribe A/B/C）的565份病历进行12轮发现性扫描，提出13,678个候选错误；2) 通过重要性筛选后保留5,898个候选；3) 由两个不同模型族的对抗性审核员（Claude Opus 5严厉派 + GPT-5.5温和派）独立反驳，意见分歧时由GPT-5.4裁决；4) 通过分层抽样在1,295个候选上进行四重审核标准对照实验（严厉派单独、温和派单独、完整委员会、宽松指令）；5) 两名临床医生对不相交样本进行盲法裁定。

Result: 618个错误经验证存活，31.3% [27.0, 35.6]的病历至少含一项已验证错误；错误集中在五个领域：过敏与用药信息遗漏（111例）、虚构患者身份（93例）、口头诊断被遗漏（Scribe A独有，53例）、相对时间被转为虚构日历日期（44例）、电话问诊无查体却被记录为查体结果（42例）。去除身份与日期两类假设上可由病历预填的类别后，比率降为24.8%。审核指令可使同一模型在同一证据上将验证率从9.3%变动至79.0%（差距69.7个百分点），机器学习模型族使严厉指令下的笔记标记率从27.8%变动至54.8%，而审核委员会架构本身仅带来1个百分点的变化。已发布审计研究的错误构成差异（54-86%遗漏）可由工具差异单独解释。临床医生裁定：医生作者盲审支持20/21项，独立临床医生支持12/12项。

Conclusion: AI医疗记录员的错误率是记录员与计数工具的联合属性，因此报告错误率时必须同时报告所用工具（审核标准、模型族、发现流程）。本研究发布全部618项发现的证据、所有提示词、模型版本及可重跑流程，便于任何人在任何产品上重复相同标准。"签署临床医生"作为最后防线在四个关键位置承担主要责任：过敏与用药状态、检查的来源记录、患者身份、口头诊断以及"计划"被记为"已执行"。依赖签署审核作为唯一质量保障并不可靠。

Abstract: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes under the reassurance that a clinician signs every note. We audited three commercial AI scribes on the same 142 consultations: 565 notes from recorded UK primary-care and US ambulatory encounters plus authored scenarios. Twelve discovery passes proposed 13,678 candidate errors; the 5,898 clearing an importance filter went to an adversarial panel of two models from different families, each told to refute what it could, and 618 survived. One note in three (31.3% [27.0, 35.6]) carries a verified failure, concentrated in allergy and medication information, invented patient identity, and history written up as examination on telephone consultations that can contain none. No product was given a patient record; setting aside the two classes a record would have prefilled, invented identity and dates, the rate is 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]. One failure mode did not fit our scheme, drawn from published scribe-error taxonomies: a treatment the clinician retracts, recorded as delivered care. Two clinicians adjudicated blind, disjoint samples: a physician author upheld 20 of 21 findings (95.2% [77.3, 99.2]) and an independent clinician, not an author, 12 of 12 ([75.8, 100]); both judged every sampled refusal genuine. A failure rate depends on the instrument as much as the scribes. With model, evidence and settings fixed, the review instruction alone moves the share of candidates verified from 9.3% to 79.0%, and the reviewing family moves it too: alone at that instruction the gentler flags 54.8% of notes against 27.8%. Between 28% and 97% of sampled notes carry a failure depending on the standard. Published audits disagree among themselves by a margin instrument differences alone can produce: omission is 54-86% of their errors against our 23.1%. We release all 618 findings with transcript-side evidence, every prompt and model version, and the re-runnable pipeline.

</details>


### [81] [Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31076)
*Xuehai Wang,Haowei Qin,Tongxin Liu,Junkai Li,Buqiang Xu,Jintian Zhang,Yijun Chen,Zirui Xue,Shumin Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: this https URL ).

### [82] [A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29831)
*Doyeon Kim,Suyoung Bae,Yumin Lee,Jee-Hyong Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code regions with an action-level advantage estimation scheme that isolates each action's credit by grouping turns sharing the same exploration context. Extensive evaluations show that our method improves the average F1 over the state-of-the-art (SOTA) by 1.58% on SWE-Bench Verified and 8.55% on SWE-Bench Pro, with our 4B model outperforming baselines up to 8x larger. Our code is available at this https URL .

### [83] [ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30197)
*Hoejoon Kwon,Byeonggeuk Lim,Kahyeon Kim,YoungBin Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mechanisms can be unstable across domains and refusal-oriented steering often yields rigid refusals rather than constructive safe guidance. To address these limitations, we propose ALTSTEER, an inference-time framework that couples selective intervention with refusal-anchored constructive redirection within a single inference pass. ALTSTEER uses an internal refusal-relevant signal to decide when to steer, and applies staged steering to shift generation from refusal-oriented control toward constructive alternatives. Evaluations on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 show that ALTSTEER preserves benign utility while improving constructive safe-completion behavior, especially on models that otherwise tend to produce short refusals for harmful requests.

### [84] [WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30530)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Yaxin Du,Wei Zhang,Haowen Wang,Junhang Cheng,Yuxuan Zhang,Tuney Zheng,Xianglong Liu,Ming Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the interface that lets a VLM prior interact with this browser-as-world-model autonomously and decides which interactions become supervision. Each round, the VLM emits a critique that the planner compiles into a typed interaction contract; the browser re-executes the candidate and issues an acceptance certificate only when both target progress and preservation of every previously verified capability hold; certified transitions accumulate as a quality ratchet that is the only thing the SFT export ever sees. Under matched training, WebWorld-27B improves Raw-27B by 5.3 points on HTMLBench-400 and 14.9 points on MiniAppBench-Val, and reaches the level of strong frontier systems such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4 on interactive HTML generation. Equal-size ablations show that browser-backed admission carries the gain: without the certificate, the matched 9B lift nearly disappears.

### [85] [Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28926)
*Galo Castillo-López,Alexis Lombard,Gaël de Chalendar,Nasredine Semmar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.

### [86] [Item-Mean Surrogates: Why Richer Persona Data Fail to Improve LLMs as Human Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29455)
*Daehwan Ahn,Chengfeng Mao,Dokyun Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLMs are increasingly used as human surrogates, often on the premise that richer persona data could make them substitutes or exploratory tools for specific individuals. We test this premise across four datasets covering more than 400,000 participants and more than 6,000 survey items and experimental outcomes. LLMs perform well at the aggregate level: their average responses closely align with average human responses to the same items. But this success largely reflects predicting each item's average human response. Once each item's human mean is removed, LLM predictions explain only 3.05% of the remaining respondent-specific variation, far below the 53.6% human test-retest benchmark. Richer personas, model variants, and fine-tuning do not close this gap. In variance analyses, once item means are removed, the reliable remaining signal is person-by-item. It captures how a respondent departs from the mean on a particular item and is about 8.9x larger than the stable person effect. Persona data encode the respondent, but not this item-specific deviation. LLM responses also compress human response distributions, using less spread, fewer response categories, and distorted distributional shapes. We call this pattern item-mean surrogacy. Current LLM surrogates can approximate item averages, but not the distributions or respondent-specific deviations needed to replace individual humans. We propose four empirical tests for LLM-based human-surrogate claims.

### [87] [LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29539)
*Yuqi Pan,Zheng Li,Bohao Tang,Zhen Qin,Guoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

### [88] [TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29564)
*Shiliang Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose \OURS{}, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, \OURS{} augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that \OURS{} consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

### [89] [Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29613)
*Jieying Xue,Phuong Minh Nguyen,Minh Le Nguyen,Shogo Okada*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. Across diverse cross-lingual settings, applying FVs substantially improves performance, suggesting that FVs capture language-agnostic, task-relevant signals rather than purely language-specific lexical patterns, and highlighting their potential as a lightweight and transferable mechanism for multilingual task adaptation. We observe that each LLM exhibits a relatively stable optimal range of attention heads for constructing effective FVs, and the pattern remains consistent across languages. In addition, FVs can partially replicate the task-steering effects of standard few-shot in-context learning while avoiding the computational overhead of processing multiple demonstrations, making them effective for large-scale practical applications. Our code is available at this https URL .

### [90] [Influence-Directed Distillation: Solving the Diversity Bottleneck in Sampled-Token On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29846)
*Run Yang,Runpeng Dai,Jie Sun,Jielei Zhang,Fan Zhou,Hongtu Zhu,Peiyi Li,Longwen Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Sampled-token on-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from teacher to student using student-generated tokens, requiring teacher probabilities only for sampled tokens. Yet it frequently suffers from diversity distillation failure: the student's pass@1 improves while its pass@$k$ plateaus, failing to inherit the teacher's diversity. To explain this, we introduce First-Order Local Entropy Influence, a signed first-order proxy that decouples each update's entropy effect into the teacher--student log-probability gap and the student's local probability structure, and empirically links entropy contraction to negative-influence positions. Motivated by this, we propose Influence-Directed Adaptive On-Policy Distillation (IDA-OPD): rather than relying on costly full-vocabulary Forward-KL objectives, it preserves entropy-expanding updates while replacing entropy-contracting ones with divergence-adaptive advantage shrinkage, using only the teacher's sampled-token log-probability. Experiments on reasoning-oriented distillation show IDA-OPD consistently improves pass@$k$, inheriting the teacher's diversity through distillation, matches the strongest teacher-informed methods at strictly lower cost, and broadly maintains vanilla OPD's pass@1, all without full-vocabulary teacher information.

### [91] [Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29934)
*Mohammadali Khodabandehlou,Bhaskar Krishnamachari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.

### [92] [When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29936)
*Apoorva Upadhyaya,Sandipan Sikdar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.

### [93] [Evolutionary Soups: Evolving Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29978)
*Lingxiao Kong,Steffen Staab,Cong Yang,Oya Beyan,Zeyd Boukhers*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models are increasingly required to generate responses that satisfy multiple competing objectives. Since optimal trade-offs depend on both user preferences and input prompts, controllable multi-objective generation must dynamically adapt models at inference time without retraining. To address this, we propose Evolutionary Soups, a mixture-of-experts framework for fine-grained generation control, with gating networks trained via an evolutionary algorithm. The per-layer gating networks dynamically produce expert-merging coefficients from hidden-state representations, while the evolutionary algorithm incorporates greedy hypervolume contribution for effective evolution of these gating networks, achieving consistent improvements on large and noisy training datasets and broader coverage of the non-convex Pareto front. Experiments across three tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of Evolutionary Soups over baselines: it achieves the best hypervolume, linear utility, and Tchebyshev utility (~20% improvement) among controllable methods on all tasks.

### [94] [When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30086)
*Rishi Datta,Lavanya Prahallad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

</details>


### [95] [Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30376)
*George Fountzoulas*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82% one-shot recall at 4x the training length, where the bare trunk scores ~4% and a parameter-matched attention head scores 100% inside its training length and 0% beyond it. Addressing is length-invariant by construction; the untrained memory alone recalls at 90% accuracy identically at 512, 2048 and 4096 bytes. Because the store is a linear superposition, two capabilities follow from arithmetic alone: selective unlearning (one subtraction erases one fact to chance, retained facts unharmed) and per-token attribution (counterfactual erasure names the source fact of every correct byte, 100% provenance). (2) Real text: on WikiText-2 bytes the notebook improves prediction of repeated rare words by +0.15-0.27 bits/byte, the gain growing with the distance between mentions and holding zero-shot at 4x training length; write-triggered forgetting eliminates memory pollution at 8x length (first-mention cost +0.33 -> -0.004). (3) Scope and scale: a parameter-matched attention head does generalize on natural-text repetition, so the notebook's claim is exact recall at O(L); on a WikiText-103 ladder (8 to 512 MB) the zero-shot repeat gain rises monotonically. All experiments are pre-registered, seeds reported, and reproducible on a single free-tier GPU.

### [96] [Ceiling-Clipped Acceptance Histograms Indicate Stranded Speed-up in Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30427)
*Ephrem Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Speculative decoding speeds up generation with an efficient draft model (drafter) that proposes tokens for a target model to verify in one pass, preserving the target's output distribution. High-acceptance block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DFlare fill an entire block in one parallel pass. In many cycles, the target accepts the whole block, so the drafter exhausts its trained block horizon before verification fails. We call this unrealized acceptance stranded speed-up. A mean committed length, per prompt or per cycle, hides it, whereas the acceptance histogram exposes it as a spike in the ceiling bin, the fraction of cycles that accept the entire block. We recommend the histogram as a preflight check before spending training compute. Naively widening the block at inference does not recover the speed-up, because once the block outgrows its training size, the drafter's bidirectional attention shifts its distribution even at early positions and erodes front-of-block verification. Instead, we post-train the drafter on a longer block with a short curriculum that emphasizes the newly exposed positions, a method we call DBloom. Expanding the pretrained DFlash and DFlare drafters from block size 16 to 24 across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B targets raises the per-prompt committed length on the high-ceiling benchmarks by a median of +0.8 tokens (up to +1.1). Once continuation fine-tuning precedes expansion, the increase reaches 1.37 tokens. The same expansion also lifts committed length on all seven benchmarks for Gemma-4-12B-IT, a different model family, by a median of +0.41 tokens (Arm A), and the full continuation-then-expand pipeline (Arm B) adds +0.29 to +0.98 tokens over the same B16 drafter. In a prompt-matched comparison against JetSpec, a contemporary tree-based drafter not used in our design, DBloom commits more tokens on every benchmark at tree budgets up to 64 nodes.
