Statutory AI reduced harmful content by 52 to 59 percentage points across tested models, approximately 10 percentage points higher than standard Constitutional AI, while cutting computation time by over 50%.

</details>


### [239] [From Question-First to Analyst-First: Domain-Expert Skills and Verified Knowledge Compilation for Proactive Enterprise Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28594)
*Harmohit Singh,Rahul Sharma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种企业级分析系统，通过"领域专家技能包"和"离线知识编译循环"两大架构创新，将交互模式从"问题优先"反转为"分析师优先"，在用户输入查询前主动生成经过执行验证的专家报告和建议问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话式分析系统普遍假设用户已有明确问题，非专家面对陌生企业schema时面对空白查询框无从下手。商业主动分析工具（Tableau Pulse）依赖人工策展的指标层，学术下一问推荐系统依赖查询日志（冷启动失败），统计洞察挖掘工具只关注统计显著性而非领域专家视角下的业务价值。核心难题不是"如何提问"，而是"领域专家会问什么"。

Method: 系统包含两大耦合架构：(1) 可插拔领域专家技能抽象——基于文件夹的、数据库无关的主题包（manifest、阶段化prompt片段、关键词路由参考、报告模板、可选计算），通过确定性schema匹配自动选择并作为横切关注点注入到流式agent流水线、schema探索器和报告引擎的每个阶段，缺失时退化为严格no-op；选择算法基于表名/列名/特征值/关键词的加权评分（Eq.1-3），满足Proposition 1的no-op可加性。(2) 离线知识编译循环——Claude-Code风格agent通过DuckDB-on-parquet（零生产负载）探测数据集，采用JSON动作+确定性覆盖率评论家+可选LLM深度评论家+自愈式收敛循环（Eq.5），通过值重叠（覆盖率≥0.5）数据验证连接，持久化schema知识（Proposition 2保证终止性）。报告引擎对每个发布的指标携带evidence_sql，由独立的非LLM评论家重新执行并以1%相对误差容差匹配（Definition 2可接受视图），不匹配则抑制而非发布；发布产物为持久化recipe，支持零LLM/零内核的刷新和钻取。

Result: 单租户部署证据（Tally会计数据）：通过值匹配在表名不透明schema上自动检测ca_expert技能；知识深度deep（10/10表全部收敛）；22个数据验证连接；7个特许会计师常设报告自动生成；约30个领域问题；GST报告净额约Rs 97.86L经证据SQL重执行复现验证。提供了形式化模型（注入算子Eq.4、编译函数Eq.5）、Proposition 1（no-op后向兼容）和Proposition 2（终止性）的证明。

Conclusion: 架构的可防御性来自各组件的融合而非任何单一商品化能力：便携式领域专家层作为横切关注点贯穿路由/侦察/编码/图表/叙事/探索器/两个报告引擎，schema驱动的（而非指标绑定的）智能体分析，端到端执行验证，实例化为具有全自动onboarding链的闭环主动循环。专家存在于自包含、确定性选择、fail-open的技能包中，自然演进方向是"领域专家市场"。权衡在于放弃策展式指标层定义的语义正确性，换取便携性和通过证据重执行恢复的算术忠实性。未来工作：更大且部分自动编写的技能目录、语义指标验证、连续知识重新验证、严谨的用户研究。

Abstract: Conversational analytics systems assume the user already has a well-formed question, leaving a non-expert facing a blank query box on an unfamiliar enterprise schema. Commercial 'proactive' tools narrow this gap only by detecting statistical anomalies over analyst-curated metric layers, and academic next-question recommenders depend on query logs that a fresh dataset lacks. We describe a production analytics system that inverts the interaction model from question-first to analyst-first through two coupled architectural ideas. First, a pluggable domain-expert 'skill' abstraction: a folder-based, database-free subject-matter pack (a manifest, per-stage prompt facets, keyword-routed references, report templates, and optional compute) auto-selected per (client, dataset) by deterministic schema matching and spliced as a cross-cutting concern into every stage of an agentic pipeline, the schema explorer, and the report engines, degrading to a strict no-op when absent. Because a skill is a self-contained folder resolved deterministically, the catalogue is open-ended: an extensible marketplace of domain experts. Second, an offline knowledge-compilation loop: an agent probes the dataset's parquet via DuckDB (zero load on production), runs critic-gated per-table convergence with self-healing retries, and data-validates joins by value overlap, producing durable schema knowledge that drives standing expert reports whose every published metric is re-verified by re-executing its evidence SQL, plus suggested questions that mirror the report agenda. These close a proactive loop: reports surface numbers, the numbers seed questions, and a click launches a verified deep dive, all before the query box is used. We give a formal model and report illustrative single-tenant evidence. We make no user-study or benchmark claims; the contribution is the architecture and its defensibility.

</details>


### [240] [The Signal in the Noise: An Auditable Reliability Layer for Biomedical Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28595)
*Moustafa Yehia Hassan,Sharon Wong,Woh Kai Xuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向生物医学NLP流水线的保守、可审计拼写校正可靠性层，采用有界编辑距离候选生成与语料库n-gram评分相结合，结合生物医学安全门控机制，在不确定时放弃编辑以遵循医疗"不伤害"原则；该层在内在评估（2,104个token案例）中实现94.61%错误修复召回率且零有害编辑，在外部评估（CORD-19三分类任务，10,000样本）中恢复约80.45%的噪声导致的macro-F1下降，并在真实OCR摘要案例研究中验证了Transformer编码器对轻度噪声的相对鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模生物医学语料库通过自动PDF解析构建时，普遍存在OCR类伪影、词元拆分与合并、连字符残留和字符级损坏等噪声，系统性地削弱词汇证据并降低下游分类器性能；同时，医疗领域对错误的容忍度极低，需要一种不以最大化准确率为目标、而以安全性为导向的预处理模块。

Method: 采用确定性架构：(1)有界编辑距离候选生成；(2)基于语料库派生的n-gram评分；(3)一套保护领域关键术语的生物医学安全门控；(4)在不确定性条件下主动放弃编辑（abstention）；(5)支持人工审计；(6)评估采用四轮协议（Clean/Noisy/Restored/Safety）；(7)补充案例研究探索灰盒架构以集成有界神经信号与UMLS词典。

Result: 内在评估：人工策划的2,104个token案例基准上，合成错误修复召回率达94.61%，负向控制上零有害编辑。外部评估：CORD-19三分类（Prevention/Treatment/Epidemiology，10,000样本）上，从Noisy的macro-F1 0.7654恢复至Restored的0.7717，恢复约80.45%的噪声退化；Safety运行达到0.7721，接近Clean性能。补充案例研究：对103篇真实OCR提取摘要使用BioBERT分类，结果显示Transformer编码器对轻度噪声表现出相对鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该系统是确定性、伪影驱动、面向部署与审计设计的，能够在生物医学NLP流水线中作为安全导向的预处理可靠性模块有效缓解噪声影响；案例研究启发了未来灰盒架构方向——集成有界神经信号与UMLS词典而不损害可审计性。

Abstract: Biomedical NLP pipelines routinely presuppose clean input text, yet large-scale corpora assembled through automated PDF parsing harbour pervasive OCR-like artifacts, token splits and merges, hyphenation remnants, and character-level corruption, that systematically erode lexical evidence and degrade downstream classifiers. We introduce a conservative, fully auditable spell-correction reliability layer conceived as a safety-oriented preprocessing module rather than a maximal-accuracy corrector: under conditions of uncertainty, the system abstains from editing, in accordance with a medical do-no-harm philosophy. The deterministic architecture couples bounded edit-distance candidate generation with corpus-derived n-gram scoring and a suite of biomedical safety gates that protect domain-critical terminology. We evaluate the layer both intrinsically, on a manually curated benchmark of 2,104 token-level cases, and extrinsically, on a tri-class CORD-19 topic classifier (Prevention, Treatment, Epidemiology) spanning 10,000 examples under a principled four-run protocol (Clean, Noisy, Restored, Safety). Intrinsically, the layer attains 94.61% error-fix recall on synthetic errors with zero harmful edits on negative controls. Downstream, it recovers approximately 80.45% of the noise-induced macro-F1 degradation, elevating macro-F1 from 0.7654 (Noisy) to 0.7717 (Restored) while preserving near-clean performance (Safety: 0.7721). A supplementary case study on 103 real-world OCR-extracted abstracts classified with BioBERT confirms that transformer encoders appeared relatively robust to mild noise, motivating a future grey-box architecture that integrates bounded neural signals and UMLS lexicons without compromising auditability. The system is fully deterministic, artifact-driven, and designed with deployment and auditability in mind.

</details>


### [241] [Paper Pilot: A Human-in-the-Loop Expert System for Evidence-Traceable Scientific Manuscript Generation in Applied Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28596)
*Nidhi Jha,Siddharth Chaudhary,Ajinkya Kulkarni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Paper Pilot，一种基于CARE方法论的人机协同专家系统，通过8个强制审批门禁、文献/工件双层证据追溯机制和审计日志，解决LLM辅助科学写作中"想法→方法→证据→结果→声明"链条上缺乏强制人类审批与可追溯性的治理问题。实证验证（无LLM裁判，机械评分）表明：在引用压力下，无门禁起草者的引用伪造率高达25%，而Paper Pilot的证据锁定规则将伪造率降至零并以占位符显式暴露缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM科研智能体（如AI Scientist、PaperOrchestra、ARISE等）虽推动自动化发现与稿件生成，但未解决治理难题：观点、方法、结果与声明在AI辅助流程中传播时缺乏强制性人类审批与工件级追溯，导致错误逐级放大、伪支撑声明混入稿件。作者主张将LLM辅助写作重新定位为"受控人机决策支持流程"而非"完全自主写作流水线"。

Method: 1）方法论基础：改编CARE三角色（领域专家/开发者/助手LLM）阶段门控工程方法为稿件开发流程；2）双层证据区分——文献支撑声明（citation-grounded）vs. 工件支撑声明（artifact-grounded）；3）8个强制审批门禁G1–G8（范围/文献/方法/证据/声明/评审覆盖/章节/最终发布），每门禁附no-pass标准与审计日志；4）四类声明分类法：grounded_fact/inference/assumption/tbd_placeholder；5）最小证据记录schema（12字段：claim_id, claim_text, claim_type, claim_taxonomy, evidence_type, evidence_identifier, artifact_metadata, approval_status等）；6）声明提取-分类-匹配-验证四阶段流水线；7）证据锁定修订控制（禁止修订时引入未支撑数字/比较/去对冲）；8）LLM评审员仅作建议角色，最终权威归于manuscript owner；9）实证：4项机械评分基准测试（gpt-4o-mini + gpt-5.2，正则提取+arXiv API验证+算术校验，无LLM裁判）。

Result: 引用基础基准（真实arXiv，3场景×2条件×10/5重复，90稿）：无门禁gpt-5.2伪造率25.2%（34/135引用，其中7个虚假ID+27个错误归属），无门禁gpt-4o-mini以无引用流畅散文静默覆盖100%陷阱子题；门禁条件下两模型伪造率均降至0/168，陷阱子题97.8%被显式[TBD]占位。结果基础基准（合成数据，初步）：无门禁gpt-4o-mini对100%陷阱数字进行伪造，gpt-5.2为73%；门禁后分别降至27%与0%。修订漂移基准（初步）：无门禁修订100%漂移（45/45），门禁后降至60–63%（新增最高级形容词降至0）。对抗鲁棒性：嵌入提示注入完全抵御（0/60违反）；权威施压升级下，gpt-4o-mini 72%门禁被突破并开始伪造，gpt-5.2仅8%突破并以"拒绝并升级人工"形式反弹。

Conclusion: Paper Pilot将LLM辅助科学写作定位为受控人机决策支持流程，贡献在于：1）CARE方法论向稿件开发的工程化迁移；2）manuscript-owner中心的8门禁审批模型；3）no-pass标准与审计日志的程序化强制；4）工件级证据-声明追溯与证据锁定修订；5）文献证据与工件证据的显式分层。引用基础基准经真实数据外部验证，初步基准方向一致但有待真实数据复现。诚实承认局限：基于提示词的实施存在修订漂移残留与弱模型在权威升级下的脆弱性，需未来工作构建编排层强制机制、映射W3C PROV/RO-Crate/FAIR标准、测量声明分类可靠性、开展跨提供商复现与应用科学用户研究。本文论文本身即为该框架的已实施案例研究（公开仓库含声明登记册、审计追踪、门禁审批记录）。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly embedded in scientific workflows for literature analysis, drafting, and review. Existing systems advance autonomous discovery and manuscript generation, but do not resolve the governance problem that arises when ideas, methods, results, and claims propagate through AI-assisted workflows without mandatory human approval or artifact-level traceability. This paper proposes Paper Pilot, a human-in-the-loop expert system for evidence-traceable scientific manuscript generation in applied sciences. It adapts the Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE) methodology to manuscript development through manuscript-owner approval gates, explicit no-pass criteria, claim classification, audit logging, advisory LLM review, and evidence-locked revision control. The framework defines eight approval gates across the idea-to-claim pipeline and distinguishes literature-grounded from artifact-grounded claims, requiring reported numbers and interpretations to remain traceable to approved evidence; its system prompt is openly released for deployment in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or institutional LLM environments. As a first empirical validation, we evaluate the citation-grounding layer with a controlled, mechanically scored benchmark (two commercial LLMs, real arXiv papers, no LLM judge): under coverage pressure ungated drafters fabricated up to 25% of their citations and never flagged an evidence gap, whereas the same models under Paper Pilot's evidence-locked rules produced zero fabricated citations and surfaced the planted gaps as explicit placeholders. Preliminary results for result grounding, revision, and adversarial robustness point the same way; full evaluation is left to future work. Paper Pilot positions LLM-assisted writing as a controlled human-AI decision-support process rather than a fully autonomous authorship pipeline.

</details>


### [242] [The Race between Agentic AI Capabilities and Data Quality Control in Online Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28597)
*Sourav Panda,Hillmer Chona,Rupak Kumar Das,Shreyash Kale,Shikha Soneji,Jonathan Dodge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自主智能体（agentic AI）能否自动完成在线问卷并通过注意力检测题，从攻击与防御双重视角系统评估了基于LLM/VLM的浏览器代理在结构化问卷中的能力，并提出通过DOM元数据混淆来降低代理解题准确率的防御策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线问卷依赖注意力检测题作为数据质量守门人，但随着大语言模型驱动的自主智能体快速发展，传统注意力检测面临失效风险，需要同时从智能体能力评估和问卷数据质量保护两个角度重新审视这一攻防关系。

Method: 构建受控多页问卷沙盒（Next.js），包含文本页、图像页、致谢页和完成页；实现单代理架构（Brain+Prompt+Tool Interface+State Memory，遵循observe–plan–act循环）；实验1（survey_v0）测试LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen-2.5-7B在Completion/Unconstrained两种行为策略下的端到端完成能力；实验2（survey_v1）通过混淆alt文本、文件名、选项标签等DOM语义线索评估防御效果；实验3引入llava-1.6-7b、minicpm-v-2.6、qwen2.5-vl-7b三个VLM对比纯文本与视觉接地推理差异。

Result: 实验1：所有LLM代理在survey_v0上实现端到端100%通过注意力检测，文本页与图像页完成率均高，主要失败源于规划与答题错误；实验2：DOM混淆后图像答题准确率与注意力检测准确率均显著下降至接近随机水平（50%），但页面导航能力不受损；实验3：VLM在survey_v1上的图像答题退化程度明显小于纯LLM，表明视觉接地可部分补偿元数据缺失，但VLM整体端到端完成率低，主要失败模式为规划错误而非答题错误。

Conclusion: 智能体之所以能通过注意力检测，并非依赖真正的视觉推理，而是利用了网页DOM暴露的语义元数据（alt标签、文件名、选项编码等）；通过混淆这些元数据可在不破坏问卷可用性的前提下有效削弱纯LLM代理的能力，但随着VLM能力提升，防御效果可能被削弱；研究揭示了开发者透明度vs机器鲁棒性的设计权衡，建议问卷设计者分离答案数据、限制DOM暴露信息，同时呼吁开展代理能力评估与数据质量保护的协同研究。

Abstract: Online surveys are a foundational data collection instrument in a variety of fields, with attention checks serving as critical guardians of response quality. However, the rapid emergence of agentic AI (goal directed systems powered by a large language model (LLM) brain and/or a multimodal processing unit with tool-augmented capabilities) raises new questions about the robustness of these safeguards. We investigate how well agentic AI architectures can complete web-based surveys and pass standard attention checks. We evaluate a single-agent architecture capable of multimodal input processing and tool-based web interaction on a controlled survey sandbox. We analyze the problem from two perspectives. From an attack perspective, we demonstrate how structural vulnerabilities such as exposed DOM metadata and predictable option encoding allow agents to resolve attention checks through structured parsing only. From a defense perspective, we implement a mitigation strategy of DOM metadata obfuscation to remove semantic cues in text-based questions. We evaluate multiple open-source language and multimodal models to study capability and orchestration effectiveness. Based on our evaluations, we offer perspectives on how to simultaneously meet the needs of empiricists and agentic AI researchers.

</details>


### [243] [CDPR: Counterfactual Advantage-based Credit Assignment for Cost-Aware Sequential Medical Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28599)
*Qi Peng,Yi Cai,Changmeng Zheng,Xin Wu,Jiayuan Xie,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CDPR（反事实诊断过程奖励），将医学诊断建模为成本感知序列决策过程，通过基于不确定性的状态选择和反事实优势估计解决长轨迹下的信用分配问题，无需专家标注或学习评论家。CDPR集成到GRPO中，在MIMIC-IV及两个分布外基准上，以4B参数模型实现了更高的诊断准确率和显著更低的检查成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学语言模型将诊断视为一次性分类任务，忽略了真实临床中逐步检查、成本权衡的序贯特性；而基于强化学习的序贯诊断受限于稀疏的结局奖励，导致长轨迹下信用分配困难，无法区分高效与浪费的诊断路径。

Method: 1）将诊断建模为MDP，策略通过自由文本生成检查或诊断动作；2）基于动作分布熵与回放缓存的不一致性，识别"决策关键状态"；3）在关键状态用短时Monte Carlo rollout与缓存复用，估计所选动作相对于Top-M候选动作的优势，效用函数综合正确性、检查数量、成本与不可行请求；4）将该过程奖励叠加到GRPO的组相对优势上。

Result: CDPR-4B在MIMIC-IV上达到53.07%准确率，AEN 2.10、AEC \$36.65；跨数据集平均准确率47.42%，平均检查成本\$23.52（全表最低），超过GPT-5.4、Qwen3-32B、Med-Gemma-27B及DiagAgent-14B等更大模型；在Private集上以约1/16的成本达到接近最高的准确率；专家评估在五项指标上均显著优于基线；在动态诊断vs.静态诊断对比中，检查成本降低90.7%。

Conclusion: CDPR通过将稀疏结局奖励转化为关键状态上的反事实过程奖励，在无需专家标注和评论家网络的前提下，有效解决了成本感知序贯医学诊断中的信用分配难题，为小模型实现高精度低成本诊断提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is a step-by-step, cost-aware process: a physician orders examinations one at a time, observes the results, and updates the diagnosis before reaching a final conclusion. Most medical language models instead treat diagnosis as a one-pass classification task and ignore the trade-off between a test's value and its cost. We model diagnosis as a cost-aware sequential decision process and train the policy with reinforcement learning. The main difficulty is credit assignment: the only reliable signal comes once at the end of a long trajectory, so it scores a wasteful workup the same as an efficient one. We propose CDPR (Counterfactual Diagnostic Process Reward), which needs no expert labels and no learned critic. CDPR first finds the states where the policy hesitates, using the uncertainty of its action distribution, and then scores the chosen action by its advantage over the alternatives the policy itself would consider, estimated with short rollouts under a utility that balances correctness against test count, cost, and infeasible requests. A rollout cache reuses within-batch trajectories to keep the cost low. We integrate CDPR into GRPO and test it on one in-domain (MIMIC-IV) and two out-of-domain (ClinicalBench and a private hospital dataset) benchmarks. CDPR improves diagnostic accuracy while clearly reducing the number and cost of examinations.

</details>


### [244] [SHAPE of Chain-of-Thought in Math Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28600)
*Jonghyun Song,Sangjun Song,Minjae Oh,Haesung Pyun,Sungsik Lee,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SHAPE框架，从数学教育研究中引入"语义空间"和"启发式"两个维度来分析LLM的CoT推理轨迹。研究发现启发式特征比传统CoT特征更能预测答案正确性，且正确的推理倾向于集中在少数语义空间内。RL后训练会导致启发式使用的模式寻求（mode-seeking），而通过在训练中促进多样化启发式使用可以提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CoT分析方法（如长度、自我修正标记、推理阶段标签等）只能捕捉表面特征，无法追踪模型在解题过程中的数学解释和具体数学动作。这限制了对LLM推理失败原因的诊断和对后训练效果的理解。论文旨在从数学教育研究中借鉴理论工具，提供更深入的分析视角。

Method: SHAPE框架基于数学教育研究的两个核心概念：(1) 启发式（heuristics）——CoT中可见的数学动作，分为11类（H1-H11，如简化问题、逆向工作、引入辅助对象等）；(2) 语义空间（semantic spaces）——模型对问题的数学解释。自动化标注流水线包括三阶段：内容单元分割、启发式标注、语义空间追踪。基于此提出两个度量：有效语义空间数N_space^eff和有效转移数N_trans^eff。分析15个模型在Omni-MATH和MATH-Perturb上的推理模式，并提出HA-Plan-GRPO方法，在rollout中引入启发式信息进行训练。

Result: 启发式特征预测正确性的AUROC达0.664，优于自修正标记(0.618)、ThinkARM(0.618)等基线。正确轨迹倾向于在较少语义空间内集中推理（N_space^eff较低），而不正确轨迹分散在更多空间并频繁回访。RL后训练使成功轨迹集中在基础模型启发式分布的密集核心区域（Density>1, Coverage<1），表现为mode-seeking。HA-Plan-GRPO在MATH-Perturb上将Avg@64从基础模型的23.54提升至36.80（原题）、35.80（简单扰动）、17.72（困难扰动），优于无启发式信息的Plan-GRPO。

Conclusion: SHAPE提供了一个理论扎实的诊断框架，可用于：(1) 解释LLM推理成败——启发式选择比表面特征更具预测力，正确推理表现为语义空间聚焦；(2) 评估后训练——RL会导致策略空间的mode-seeking而非扩展；(3) 指导后训练改进——在RLVR rollout中显式纳入启发式信息可提升准确率。这表明过程级结构（而非仅最终答案）能为诊断和训练提供有价值的信号。局限在于当前验证仅限于数学基准，扩展到其他领域是后续工作。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet the mathematically meaningful skills underlying their reasoning remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{SHAPE}, a framework that analyzes Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories through two lenses developed in mathematics education: (1) semantic spaces: the model's evolving mathematical interpretations of a problem (e.g., algebraic, geometric), and (2) heuristics: the specific mathematical actions taken within those spaces (e.g., simplifying the problem, working backward). We first use \texttt{SHAPE} to analyze the reasoning patterns of various models. Our findings reveal that the mathematical heuristics employed by a model better explain final answer correctness than traditional CoT features. Furthermore, models are likely to reach correct solutions by concentrating their reasoning effort within a few semantic spaces rather than exploring many disparate ones -- a pattern consistent with human behavior. Next, we utilize the \texttt{SHAPE} lens to evaluate whether post-training truly enhances mathematical proficiency. We find that reinforcement learning induces mode-seeking in heuristic usage. Lastly, we post-train LLMs by promoting diverse heuristics and demonstrate its effectiveness in improving accuracy. Overall, \texttt{SHAPE} provides a theoretically-grounded diagnostic framework for decoding LLM reasoning and offers a new path toward post-training LLMs for math reasoning. The code for our model is available at this https URL

</details>


### [245] [Leveraging Generative AI to Design Accessible Interactive Visualizations for Undergraduate Mathematics: A Six-Phase Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28601)
*Mahesh Sunkula,Kuan-Hua Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一个面向本科数学交互式可视化的六阶段生成式 AI 工作流：数学基础、用户定制、数学深化、应用连接、无障碍设计、教学控制。四个覆盖微积分、多元微积分、微分方程与偏微分方程的部署案例表明，该结构能稳定生成功能完整的第一版工具，并可从成品逆向重构提示词，也可从教学设想正向生成提示词与可视化程序；但所有产物都包含需要人工修正的问题。可靠的数学正确性、WCAG 2.2 AA 无障碍性和教学适配性并非首次生成即可获得，而是依赖各阶段边界的强制验证：手算与边界检查、键盘及屏幕阅读器人工测试、逐项学习目标审查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本科数学中的抽象关系往往难以仅靠符号表示和静态白板建立直观认识，而交互式可视化能支持符号、图形、数值与语言表征之间的协调。传统开发方式要求教师具备编程能力并投入大量时间；论文试图用结构化生成式 AI 流程降低技术门槛，同时通过明确的验证节点保留数学、辅助技术和教学设计方面的人类专业判断。

Method: 研究采用设计型研究（DBR），以工作流本身为分析单元，在真实课程语境中反复设计、部署和修订工具。方法包含两阶段双向管线：Stage 1 先按六阶段交互式构建和验证成品，再让 AI 从成品逆向生成六条分阶段提示词；Stage 2 先由教师用自然语言描述教学设想，再由 AI 生成六阶段提示集并构建独立 HTML 工具。四个案例分别使用 Plotly.js、Canvas、Canvas 与 Three.js；平台包括 Gemini、Claude 和 Claude Code。评估手段包括：与闭式解和手算结果对照、检查特征值与数值算法、使用 axe DevTools 自动化无障碍审计、NVDA 屏幕阅读器测试与纯键盘操作，以及按学习目标进行教学适配审查。

Result: 四个正式工具均形成了结构完整的第一版，自动化审计在修订后未报告 WCAG 2.2 AA 违规，且键盘和屏幕阅读器操作可用；工具分别覆盖方向导数与梯度、动力系统相图、一维热方程模态衰减、三重积分切片。逆向流程成功从两个已验证成品重建六阶段提示词，正向流程成功从自然语言设想生成并部署另外两个工具；同一结构适用于 Gemini 与 Claude/Claude Code，说明工作流具有平台独立性。然而，四个第一版均存在至少一个数学错误，自动化无障碍审计未发现各工具 ARIA 实时区域更新过于频繁、实际体验欠佳的问题；教学预设、复杂度揭示顺序和界面默认值也需 2—3 次针对性修改。常见数学问题包括中点积分只评估函数而未积分、切换积分方向后内层上下限错序、重特征值绘制出两条错误特征方向、Euler 方法漂移及系列常数项归一化不一致。人工测试发现 ARIA 实时区域在拖动或拖动时间轴时过度播报，限速后改善。

Conclusion: 六阶段结构是兼具实用与方法论价值的稳定“提示—实现—验证”框架：它把复杂任务拆分为可验证的交付物，既支持从成品到提示词的逆向重构，也支持从教学构想到提示词和代码的正向生成。核心结论不是生成式 AI 可自主交付可信教学工具，而是其显著降低原型开发成本后，人类必须把验证嵌入每个阶段。数学正确性应以闭式结果和边界条件验证；WCAG 2.2 AA 应同时接受自动审计、键盘测试和 NVDA 人工测试；教学价值应逐项对照学习目标检查。论文也明确限定了结论范围：其单位是所生成工件而非学生成效，尚不能证明这些工具提升学习；未来需要对照实验和学生创作项目研究。未来可增加“学生反思与评价”作为第七阶段。

Abstract: Interactive visualizations support conceptual understanding in undergraduate mathematics, but building them has required programming expertise most instructors lack. Using a design-based research approach, we develop, deploy, and evaluate a six-phase workflow (Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control) that uses generative AI to build WCAG~2.2 Level~AA compliant visualizations without programming. The six phases structure every prompt, scaffold the AI's code generation, and define where human verification is applied. We ask whether the structure reliably yields correct and accessible tools, whether it runs both backward (reverse-engineering prompts from a finished tool) and forward (generating a tool from a plain-language idea), and what verification each phase requires. Across four deployed tools spanning calculus, multivariable calculus, and differential equations, we evaluate mathematical correctness against closed forms, accessibility through automated and manual screen-reader testing, and the errors that recurred. The structure produces structurally complete first-pass tools, but human verification remains mandatory at every phase: each output must be checked for mathematical correctness, accessibility, and pedagogical fit before the next phase begins. The workflow is platform-independent and serves both instructors and students.

</details>


### [246] [Integrating Triaxial IMU Sensors and Ensemble Learning for Effective Parkinson Disease Severity Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28602)
*Rehan Khan,Muhammad Junaid Asif,Rana Fayyaz Ahmad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于可穿戴IMU传感器与多种机器学习分类器的帕金森病（PD）检测系统，通过比较七种模型的性能，发现LightGBM表现最佳，各项指标约97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病严重影响患者运动功能，早期准确诊断对治疗与生活质量至关重要。传统诊断方法存在侵入性或主观性问题，因此需要基于可穿戴传感器与AI的无创、数据驱动的检测方案。

Method: 使用IMU加速度计与陀螺仪采集三轴（X、Y、Z）运动与震颤信号，构建特征数据集，比较SVM、LR、KNN、DT、XGBoost与LightGBM七种分类模型在PD检测中的效果，并以准确率、精确率、召回率与F1分数作为评估指标。

Result: LR约75%，KNN约90%，SVM约94%，DT与XGBoost约96%，LightGBM以约97%的准确率、精确率、召回率与F1分数在所有模型中表现最优。

Conclusion: 基于IMU与机器学习的PD检测方法具有准确、高效的预测能力，LightGBM为最佳分类器，可作为PD严重程度分类的有效工具。

Abstract: Parkinson disease PD is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that can have a significant impact on motor performance resulting in the appearance of symptoms such as tremors rigidity postural instabilities and bradykinesia. Timely clinical treatment disease management and quality life of the patients are closely linked to early and appropriate identification of PD. Over the past few years the growth of wearable sensor technology and artificial intelligence AI have made it possible to create noninvasive and data driven disease detection methods. This paper proposes a comparative system using artificial intelligence to detect Parkinsons disease by analyzing the motion and tremor data captured by an inertial measurement unit IMU. The data comprises the signals of the acceleration and gyroscope sensors measuring movement in three directions X Y and Z. The signs and symptoms provide helpful information about subtle motor deficits associated with PD. Several classification models like Support Vector Machine SVM Logistic Regression LR KNearest Neighbors KNN Decision Tree DT Extreme Gradient Boosting XGBoost and Light Gradient Boosting Machine LightGBM were used to compare their effectiveness. The Logistic Regression model had a performance around 75 percent in all evaluation metrics and KNearest Neighbours KNN around 90 percent. The support vector machine SVM performed almost 94 percent whereas the performance of classifiers such as Decision Tree and XGBoost was close to 96 percent and overall classification efficacy respectively. LightGBM model performs consistently at the best rank among all of the evaluated methods having Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1score of around 97 percent. The results show that the proposed machine learning approach offers an accurate and effective predictive capability in the classification of PD severity.

</details>


### [247] [C3-UniMM: Causal Cycle-Consistent Unified Multimodal Modeling via Super Alignment and Shared Decoding Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28603)
*Yujie Shen,Lianlei Shan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: C3-UniMM 提出基于因果循环一致性与超级对齐的统一多模态建模框架，通过结构化潜在因果图（SLCG）作为跨模态共享语义中介，并设计统一解码空间（UDS）保障跨模态生成的可逆性与结构保真度。实验证明该方法在理解、生成及组合泛化任务上显著优于现有统一多模态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型主要依赖隐式统计相关性建模，缺乏跨模态结构一致性约束，导致语义漂移、组合泛化能力弱以及干预不稳定三大核心缺陷。该研究旨在通过显式引入因果结构与循环一致性约束，构建结构保持且因果一致的多模态统一框架。

Method: 1. **结构化潜在因果图（SLCG）**：通过 Slot Attention 将多模态编码特征抽象为 K=16 个对象级槽位，并构建有向邻接矩阵 A_m = σ((S_m W_q)(S_m W_k)^⊤/√d_s)  (1-I) 建模实体间关系。2. **统一解码空间（UDS）**：通过图变换器聚合节点与边信息，经 MLP 投影为 1024 维共享解码表示，并扩展为 N_p=8 个结构前缀令牌注入 Show-o2 主干。3. **超级对齐**：在表示、结构、机制三个层级对齐跨模态潜图，使用 Sinkhorn 匹配解决槽位顺序不一致问题。4. **因果干预与循环一致性训练**：通过对槽位或边进行 do 干预并要求结构保真，以及强制 m→n→m 循环路径下的观测与结构可逆性。5. **图正则化**：采用 NOTEARS 风格的无环约束 h(A_m) = tr(exp(A_m  A_m)) - K 与稀疏约束。

Result: 在 1.5B 与 7B 两种规模下均显著优于现有原生统一模型：7B 版本在 MME（1678.3）、GQA（64.5）、MMMU（54.7）、MMStar（61.8）、AI2D（81.2）等理解基准上取得 SOTA；在视频理解 VideoMME（60.5/64.2）、NExT-QA（81.7）上超越 40B VILA；在 DPG-Bench（89.84）、GenEval Overall（0.82）、Video VBench QS（83.12）等生成基准上亦表现优异。消融实验表明 SLCG 贡献最大，超级对齐、循环损失与 UDS 均不可或缺。

Conclusion: C3-UniMM 通过将统计相关性建模转向结构化因果图，奠定了超越表面关联的语义基础。Slot 抽象使异构数据流投射到统一共享因果潜空间，理解与生成在同一因果结构下协同优化。未来工作将引入自动因果发现以支持无监督结构提取，并扩展至 3D 点云与触觉信号，最终服务于具身智能在动态物理环境中的稳定交互。

Abstract: Unified Multimodal Models aim to achieve any-to-any understanding and generation across arbitrary modalities. However, existing methods primarily rely on modeling implicit statistical correlations and lack cross-modal structural consistency constraints. This deficiency leads to profound issues, including semantic drift, poor compositional generalization, and instability under interventions. In this paper, we propose C3-UniMM, a unified multimodal modeling framework based on Causal Cycle Consistency and Super Alignment. Specifically, we introduce a Structured Latent Causal Graph (SLCG) as a shared cross-modal semantic space and design unified multimodal encoding blocks, enabling understanding and generation to be synergistically optimized within the identical causal semantic structure. Furthermore, we propose a Unified Decoding Space to enforce structural preservation and semantic invertibility during the cross-modal generation process. Theoretical analyses demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances both the invertibility and mechanism invariance of cross-modal mappings. Extensive experimental results across multiple understanding, generation, and compositional generalization tasks indicate that C3-UniMM substantially outperforms existing unified multimodal baselines.

</details>


### [248] [MedTVL: Harnessing Vision and Language for Medical Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28605)
*Jiexia Ye,Jia Li,Fugee Tsung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedTVL是首个面向医学时间序列分类的时序-视觉-语言三模态统一框架，通过卷积时序通路与Swin Transformer视觉通路的异构双路设计、ClinicalBERT自适应文本引导以及Mixture-of-Experts实例级融合机制，在多个EEG/ECG基准数据集的监督、少样本和对比学习设置下均达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学时间序列分类方法多为单模态或双模态（仅融合时序与文本），未能充分利用临床实践中医生综合数值信号、视觉形态与文本语义的多视角诊断模式；三模态协同在医学领域尚未被充分挖掘，且面临数据异构性、多尺度模式与标签稀缺三大挑战。

Method: 提出MedTVL框架：(1)基于InceptionTime的卷积时序通路提取原始数值信号的细粒度多尺度动态特征；(2)基于Swin Transformer的视觉通路从时序连续小波变换(CWT)网格图像中捕获全局形态结构；(3)ClinicalBERT生成共享文本嵌入，经门控机制自适应注入到两条通路的特定子空间；(4)Mixture-of-Experts机制通过Top-K路由实现样本级动态融合；(5)支持inter-modality与intra-modality双层对比损失用于预训练，缓解标签稀缺问题。

Result: 在APAVA、ADFTD、TUSZ、PTB、PTB-XL等7个数据集上：监督学习F1平均比第二优模型提升约3%-5%；对比学习在线性探测下全面优于T-Loss、TS2Vec、TS-TCC、AimTS等基线，PTB-XL上较最强基线提升6.72%；少样本迁移在5-55 shot设置下几乎全部达到SOTA；消融实验证实双通路、MoE和文本引导各贡献约3%、3%和2%F1提升。

Conclusion: MedTVL通过异构双通路架构、文本自适应引导和MoE实例级融合，有效模拟临床多视角诊断流程，在多个医学任务和多种学习范式下表现出优越性、鲁棒性和可迁移性，为临床决策支持提供了有潜力的框架。

Abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal learning for medical time series (MedTS) classification highlight the benefits of integrating complementary modalities for clinical decision. However, existing methods typically focus on bi-modal interactions (e.g., time series and text), leaving the tri-modal synergy between time series, vision, and language largely unexplored. Inspired by diagnostic practice synergizing numerical assessment, visual inspection and clinical context, we introduce MedTVL, a text-guided dual-pathway architecture tailored for MedTS classification. Specifically, it synergizes a convolution-based temporal pathway for fine-grained temporal dynamics from raw numerical sequences and a transformer-based visual pathway for holistic morphological structures from time-series-derived images. Such combination of cross-modal and architectural heterogeneity provides a comprehensive diagnostic perspective. To further resolve potential diagnostic ambiguity, both pathways are guided by adaptive medical textual semantics. Finally, a Mixture-of-Experts mechanism dynamically routes each instance to specialized fusion experts, capturing instance-specific reliance on the temporal and visual pathway outputs. In addition, MedTVL supports multimodal contrastive learning to mitigate the clinical label scarcity challenge. Extensive experiments across multiple medical datasets and tasks, spanning supervised, few-shot, and contrastive learning settings, demonstrate the superiority and transferability of MedTVL, highlighting its potential for robust clinical decision support.

</details>


### [249] [RegDivergence-101: An LLM Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdiction Regulatory Contradiction Detection in Life Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28607)
*Chuchu Wu,Zhiyin Zhou,Jingzhuo Hu,Liang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 RegDivergence-101，一个用于跨司法管辖区监管分歧检测的 LLM 基准测试，聚焦 FDA 与 EMA 在生命科学领域指南的一致性、分歧与沉默关系的三分类任务（AGREE/DIVERGE/SILENT）。在 101 对专家标注数据上比较了四种基线方法：词法启发式、NLI 交叉编码器、Pair-level Graph-RAG 与扁平 LLM 评判（Claude Haiku），其中 LLM 评判取得最高 macro-F1（0.830）。研究提出三项方向性观察：SILENT 需显式建模才能被检测、NLI 框架无法识别；配对级义务图优于词法但弱于扁平 LLM；语料库级图构建是未来大规模沉默检测的架构目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药品申办者在同时面向美国（FDA）和欧盟（EMA）市场开发药物时，需手动比对两机构独立发布的指南以调和潜在分歧。目前这一过程依赖人工专家，耗时长且易遗漏，可能导致临床试验方案在某地区被拒，损失一年以上时间。现有的 NLP 技术（文档级 NLI、法律矛盾检测、Graph-RAG）分别解决了部分子问题，但尚未有研究将它们结合用于跨司法管辖区的平行监管语料分歧检测。

Method: 1. 任务定义：给定同一主题下 FDA 与 EMA 的成对要求语句，三分类为 AGREE（实质一致）、DIVERGE（直接冲突）或 SILENT（一方未规定），其中 SILENT 具有方向性（SILENT_FDA / SILENT_EMA）。2. 数据集构建：RegDivergence-101 含 101 对数据（42 AGREE、38 DIVERGE、21 SILENT，覆盖 13 个主题），通过两条轨道构建——Track A（59 对）源自三篇 FDA/EMA 对比的同行评审研究；Track B（42 对）源自 ICH E9(R1)、E11A 等主要指南文本。3. 标注协议：两位标注者（分别采用"定义式"和"申办者义务式"框架）独立标注，跨框架 Cohen κ = 0.85。4. 四种基线方法：(a) 词法启发式（TF-IDF + 五种冲突信号）；(b) NLI 交叉编码器（DistilBERT-MNLI）；(c) Pair-level Graph-RAG（提取 ⟨主体, 义务级别, 要求, 条件⟩ 三元组再分类）；(d) 扁平 LLM 评判（Claude Haiku 一次性分类）。5. 评估：分层 5 折交叉验证，自举 95% 置信区间（1,000 次重采样）。

Result: Macro-F1 结果（95% CI）：词法启发式 0.511 [0.411–0.605]、NLI 交叉编码器 0.233 [0.152–0.303]、Pair-level Graph-RAG 0.663 [0.570–0.747]、LLM 评判（Claude Haiku）0.830 [0.747–0.908]。LLM 评判在三个类别上均最优（AGREE F1=0.905, DIVERGE F1=0.805, SILENT F1=0.778）。NLI 在 SILENT 上几乎完全失效（F1=0.025）。方向性 SILENT 表现：LLM 评判 SILENT_FDA F1=0.795, SILENT_EMA F1=0.738。Track A/B 分层分析未发现源数据特定偏差。

Conclusion: 三项方向性观察：(1) SILENT 在语义上可检测，但 NLI 仅基于蕴含的表述框架天然无法表达"缺席"类别，导致其 F1 仅 0.025，而具有显式 SILENT 定义的 LLM 评判可达 0.778，这是结构性而非模型能力限制；(2) Pair-level 义务图相对词法提升 +0.15 F1，但仍弱于扁平提示（-0.17 F1），因图结构丢弃了全文本上下文，无法区分"模态级别差异但实质一致"与"阈值冲突"；(3) 应区分 pair-level 范围（已基本由扁平 LLM 解决）与 corpus-level 范围（需构建语料库级政策图，将配对对齐作为图构建步骤而非预处理假设）。未来工作 RegDivergence-500 将扩展至约 500 对、覆盖 CMC、自适应试验设计、统计分析和标签/SmPC 四个尚未覆盖的领域，并增加 PMDA 第三司法管辖区子集及多模型复制验证。

Abstract: Pharmaceutical sponsors developing a drug for both the United States and the European Union must reconcile guidance issued independently by the FDA and the EMA. Where the two agencies require substantively the same thing, a sponsor can file once; where they diverge, a single trial design risks rejection in one region; where one agency is silent on a point the other regulates, the sponsor must infer obligations. Today this reconciliation is performed manually by regulatory-affairs experts. We introduce cross-jurisdiction regulatory divergence detection: given an FDA requirement and an EMA requirement on the same topic, classify their relationship as AGREE, DIVERGE, or SILENT. SILENT is inherently directional (SILENT_FDA vs. SILENT_EMA); we record direction per pair and report per-direction F1 alongside the collapsed label. We release RegDivergence-101, a 101-pair expert-grounded pilot evaluation benchmark (labels grounded in three peer-reviewed FDA/EMA comparison studies and primary FDA/EMA/ICH guidance text; dual-annotation inter-annotator kappa = 0.85), and systematically characterise a four-method baseline hierarchy: lexical heuristic (0.511 macro-F1, 95% CI [0.411-0.605]), NLI cross-encoder (0.233), obligation-level Graph-RAG (0.663 [0.570-0.747]), and flat LLM judge / Claude Haiku (0.830 [0.747-0.908]). Three directional observations emerge at pilot scale (n = 101): SILENT is semantically detectable but invisible to entailment-only formulations; pair-level obligation graphs improve over lexical methods but trail flat-LLM context (CIs partially overlapping); and corpus-level graph construction is the indicated architectural target for large-scale silent-detection. RegDivergence-101 is a pilot release establishing the task formulation and baseline hierarchy; four unrepresented regulatory domains and an expansion roadmap are described in Section 7.

</details>


### [250] [TPvG: A Moral Decision Framework for Large Language Models from One-Shot to Sequential Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28610)
*Fangyuan Zhang,Dong Yu,Pengyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TPvG框架，将人类道德心理学中的Pain-versus-Gain范式改编为文本形式，用于评估大语言模型在一次性到序列决策中的道德行为，发现决策格式和后果反馈显著影响LLM道德决策，但与人类模式存在分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM道德评估多采用一次性孤立情境，忽视了后果反馈这一深刻影响人类道德行为的关键因素。随着LLM进入交互式应用场景，需要评估其在序列决策与后果反馈条件下的道德一致性。

Method: 构建TPvG（Text-based Pain-versus-Gain）基准，包含五个递进任务格式（从最小上下文一次性选择到带显式后果反馈的序列决策）。通过专家标注、文本操作化、反馈构建与验证、问题实例化四步构建流程。评估11个LLM模型，以Money Kept为主要指标、MAC衡量决策变异性。

Result: 决策格式显著影响LLM道德决策：序列条件下保留金额显著高于一次性条件（Δ=£6.03）。Real TPvG中显式接收者反馈使Money Kept显著降低（Δ=£-2.46），但反馈效应在不同模型间存在异质性。与人类参考模式相比，LLM在序列条件中保留了最少金额的位置恰好相反（人类在Trial-by-Trial保留最少，LLM在Real保留最少），提示两者决策机制可能不同。

Conclusion: LLM道德评估不应局限于一次性场景，需要纳入序列且后果敏感的情境以测试其道德行为的稳定性。LLM对显式反馈的响应模式与人类不同，提示其可能依赖表面线索而非类似人类的道德推理过程。

Abstract: Existing LLM moral evaluations typically present models with isolated moral vignettes and elicit a single-shot decision, neglecting a factor known to profoundly influence human moral behavior: consequence feedback. We introduce TPvG (Text-based Pain-versus-Gain), adapted from a human moral paradigm, which embeds consequence feedback into an everyday moral dilemma of not harming others versus maximising self-gain. TPvG comprises five moral decision tasks, progressing from minimal-context one-shot choices to sequential decisions with explicit consequence feedback. Our results show that LLM moral decisions were strongly affected by decision format (one-shot versus sequential), and explicit receiver feedback produced heterogeneous effects across models. Furthermore, LLM responses to explicit receiver feedback diverged from the human reference pattern, suggesting potentially different decision processes. These findings highlight the need to evaluate whether LLM moral behavior remains stable in high-stakes interactive settings.

</details>


### [251] [InternReviewer & InternAdvocate: Objective Reward and Evaluation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Peer Review and Rebuttal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28612)
*Xuerui Su,Liya Guo,Qizhi Pei,Qipeng Guo,Zhongbo Tian,Lijun Wu,Kai Chen,Zun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 InternReviewer 与 InternAdvocate 两个学术智能体，分别用于自动化同行评审与作者 rebuttal，通过大规模论文–评审–rebuttal 三元组数据集、本地化 arXiv 检索基础设施和基于 GSPO 的 Agentic 强化学习（采用去主观化的多维客观奖励函数），在引用真实性、结构合规和语义对齐方面显著优于 Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.2 等闭源前沿模型，并在人类偏好评估中大幅超越人类评审基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 转向自主智能体，AI Scientist 全生命周期中"学术同行评审"自动化仍存在严重挑战：通用 LLM 缺乏领域严谨性，倾向于产生捏造的技术缺陷和不存在的引用，且现有训练式方法（SFT/RL）受困于"LLM-as-a-Judge"型奖励信号的位置偏差与高方差，导致策略优化不稳定、风格模仿压倒事实准确性。论文动机在于通过客观奖励设计与主动证据检索机制，构建可验证、无幻觉的学术评审智能体。

Method: 1) 从 OpenReview 收集 ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML 的 184,857 组 review–rebuttal 对，经 MinerU 解析、双盲匿名、上下文截断后形成 72K 训练样本；2) 部署本地化 Elasticsearch + Qwen3-Embedding-8B 向量索引 593,092 篇 arXiv CS 文献，并按角色设置非对称时间截止线（Reviewer 为投稿截止前 120 天，Advocate 为截止后 90 天）防止未来知识泄露；3) 形式化 MDP，采用 GSPO（而非 GRPO）以序列级重要性比缓解 MoE 路由漂移；4) 设计四维分解奖励 r_total = r_polar（POLAR-7B 语义对齐，经 tanh 归一化）+ r_format（章节完整+长度 2000–10000）+ r_tool（交互步数 4–6 最佳，禁用纯参数化捷径）+ r_cite（内联一致性 + 零容忍引用幻觉），以工具调用日志作为引用真值来源；5) 构建多维评估协议：BLEU/ROUGE 仅作诊断、POLAR+Reranker 评估语义对齐、Agentic 指标评估结构与引用合规、Latin Square 人类偏好研究。

Result: 在 Review 任务上：InternReviewer 的 Format 1.5000、Tool 1.0000、Citation 0.7920、Hallucination 0.8560、POLAR −0.9075 均取得最优；Rebuttal 任务中 InternAdvocate 的 Format 1.4910、Tool 1.0000、Citation 0.7620、Hallucination 0.8620、POLAR −0.8430 同样位列第一。Citation/Hallucination 相对最强闭源模型提升超 1.5 绝对点。人类偏好评估中，InternReviewer 胜率 0.85（vs 人类基线 0.50），InternAdvocate 胜率 0.80，均超过 GPT-5.2 之外的所有闭源模型；训练动力学呈现"结构快速饱和（≤100 步）+ 语义/事实长程精化（700–800 步）"的两阶段收敛特征。

Conclusion: InternReviewer 和 InternAdvocate 证明了任务特定的 Agentic RL 训练是产出高质量学术评审内容的有效路径，其核心在于以客观、规则化、多维奖励替代主观 LLM-as-a-Judge，并将检索日志作为引用真值的硬约束。未来工作方向包括长上下文处理、扩展检索源（Google Scholar 等）、显式幻觉检测指标以及多智能体对抗式 reviewer-author 协同进化；该框架可作为 AI Scientist 闭环中的内嵌评审模块。

Abstract: Generating professional scholarly content, such as peer reviews and rebuttals, requires an intricate synergy between domain reasoning and factual grounding. This work presents a comprehensive framework for the development and evaluation of specialized scholarly agents, InternReviewer and InternAdvocate. We first establish a large-scale, high-quality scholarly dataset and integrate a high-efficiency arXiv retrieval tool to enable active evidence gathering. To optimize these agents, we implement an agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm driven by a unified objective metric and reward system. This system avoids the biases of subjective model-based judging by employing multi-dimensional criteria, including reference-anchored semantic alignment, structural compliance, and a strict verification mechanism that cross-checks citations against real-time interaction logs to eliminate hallucinations. Experimental results demonstrate that agents trained within this closed-loop framework exhibit significant improvements in reasoning depth and citation accuracy.

</details>


### [252] [Preference Elicitation for Policy Optimization and Application to Aligning Heart Transplantation with Human Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28620)
*Itai Zilberstein,Ioannis Anagnostides,Zachary W Sollie,Arman Kilic,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段偏好引导算法（结合切割平面法与迭代筛选法），用于学习线性效用函数，并将其应用于美国心脏移植分配政策优化，通过用户研究学习社区对齐的效用函数，显著提升了政策的人类价值对齐程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有器官分配领域的偏好引导方法（如连续分配框架）通常要求利益相关者比较具体的分配决策（如"患者A vs 患者B"），这混淆了"手段"与"目的"，未能直接捕捉系统层面的目标，且难以直接用于策略优化。作者主张应引导利益相关者对系统级分配结果（而非个体决策）表达偏好，并将偏好学习与下游策略优化相衔接。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明对一般单调效用函数进行优化需要指数级查询（命题1），从而聚焦于线性效用函数。2. 算法设计：提出两阶段混合算法——第一阶段使用解析中心切割平面法（ACCPM）通过成对比较快速缩小权重空间并消除被支配区域；第二阶段使用基于Cohen-Addad等人的迭代筛选法，利用包络（envelope）和锥维数（conic dimension）概念，提供可证明收敛到真实效用函数的保证。3. 应用验证：在心脏移植分配场景中，通过用户研究学习6个系统级目标（平均生命年、等待名单生存率、社会经济与生物学弱势群体移植率、运输距离等）的权重，并使用自监督模仿学习方法优化在线分配策略。

Result: 1. 算法性能：模拟实验显示混合算法在查询效率和噪声鲁棒性上优于现有方法，比Ge等人(2024)的算法少30%错误。2. 用户研究：22名真实用户平均40.9次查询（最少26次，最多74次）达到ε=0.05近似；线性模型在验证集上准确率达82.7%（精确匹配）至94.8%（容差0.1）。3. 政策优化结果：优化后的心脏移植策略在所有6个目标上近乎Pareto支配现有美国status quo策略和贪心策略，相对于后视最优的竞争比达到0.95（status quo仅为0.54，贪心为0.78）。4. 权重分布：用户最重视"平均生命年"（权重约0.39）和"一年等待生存率"（约0.30），公平性相关目标权重较低。

Conclusion: 本文成功证明了"目的-手段"分离框架的实践可行性：通过在系统结果层面进行偏好引导而非个体决策层面，可获得更准确、可重用的效用函数用于策略优化。该框架为AI高风险决策系统与人类价值对齐提供了端到端的实用路径，尤其适用于器官分配等需要平衡多重竞争目标的场景，优化的策略显著优于现有规则系统。

Abstract: Preference elicitation is essential for aligning AI systems with human values. Prior approaches (e.g., for organ allocation) often ask stakeholders to compare the decisions of an algorithm (e.g., patient A vs. patient B). Such a decision-level approach conflates the means with the ends. Instead, we elicit preferences directly over allocation outcomes to learn a utility function for policy optimization. We construct a novel preference elicitation algorithm for linear utilities that outperforms prior techniques in practice. Our algorithm has two phases. The first phase learns cutting planes through pairwise comparisons to rapidly shrink the space of possible attribute weights and warm-starts the second phase by eliminating dominated regions. The second phase then provably converges to the user's utility function. We apply our technique to heart transplant allocation where a policy must balance competing objectives such as post-transplant outcomes, waitlist mortality, geographic ease, and equity. Using our algorithm, we conduct a user study to learn and aggregate a community-aligned utility function, and use it to optimize heart transplant policies that are significantly better aligned with human values. Compared to the hindsight optimum, the status quo policy achieves a competitive ratio of just 0.54, while our method is near-optimal with a competitive ratio of 0.95.

</details>


### [253] [Machine Learning-Enhanced Tabu Search for Tactical Wireless Network Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28627)
*Wissem Ahmed Zaid,Alain Hertz,Defeng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种机器学习引导的禁忌搜索算法（TABU-ML），用于解决战术无线网络设计这一组合优化问题。核心思想是利用图神经网络（GNN）作为"丢弃边分类器"，从禁忌搜索的历史搜索轨迹中学习，预测哪些边的移除更有可能产生改进的邻域解。通过将GNN集成到禁忌搜索中，仅评估排名靠前的τ=20%的候选边，在不修改禁忌搜索主体框架的前提下，显著减少计算开销。实验结果表明，TABU-ML在20、30、50节点的合成实例上均优于标准禁忌搜索和随机缩减邻域的基线，能够在相同时间内达到更高质量的解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 战术无线网络设计涉及主枢纽选择、树形拓扑构建、链路模式和频率分配等相互依赖的决策，目标函数评估代价高昂。标准禁忌搜索在每次迭代中需评估O(n³)量级的邻域（n为节点数），而每评估一个邻域拓扑都需运行昂贵的启发式配置流程，因此迭代次数受限，计算成本成为瓶颈。单纯的随机缩减邻域虽能减少评估次数，但可能丢失有前景的移动。因此，需要一种智能机制来指导邻域探索，聚焦最有希望的移动。

Method: 方法核心是基于搜索轨迹学习GNN drop-edge分类器。训练数据生成：从标准禁忌搜索的执行轨迹中，对每个访问过的解s及其树形拓扑T，将每个边e标记为"有前景"（若存在可行的边交换使邻域解目标值严格高于当前解）或"非有前景"。特征工程：节点特征包括空间坐标和后代数；边特征包括路径损耗、衰落裕度、通信模式（PTP/PMP）、信道、直接吞吐量TP_uv、三种流量场景下的有效吞吐量、加权吞吐量；全局特征为目标函数值。GNN架构：包含输入模块、卷积模块和输出模块，对每个边输出二维logits，经softmax得到"改进类"的预测概率。训练采用加权交叉熵损失（λ=0.95）以缓解类别不平衡，并按80/20划分训练/验证集，最多训练200个epoch，使用Adam优化器（学习率1e-4）。集成策略：在禁忌搜索的邻域生成阶段，按GNN预测概率对所有可移除边排序，保留比例τ=0.2对应的前20%边用于边交换邻域生成，而非硬性二值过滤，以保持邻域多样性。其余禁忌搜索组件（可行性检查、禁忌表、期望准则、目标评估）完全保持不变。

Result: 在n=20、30、50的合成实例上对比三种算法：TABU（全邻域禁忌搜索）、TABU-20%（随机保留20%可移除边）、TABU-ML（GNN引导保留20%边）。结果显示：TABU-ML在所有规模上均稳定优于TABU-20%，验证了GNN引导优于随机选择的有效性；TABU-ML的平均解质量亦优于全邻域TABU，在20、30、50节点实例上平均目标值分别从32.80、27.15、16.11提升至33.34、28.56、17.30；同时最差解值也显著改善，表明算法鲁棒性更强。此外，TABU-ML在相同时间限制下能执行更多迭代（约为TABU的5–6倍），且收敛曲线显示其通常更早达到高质量解。

Conclusion: TABU-ML通过GNN作为禁忌搜索中的决策支持机制，有效平衡了计算效率与解质量，证明了将机器学习嵌入元启发式搜索的搜索轨迹中的可行性与潜力。其优势在于不改变原禁忌搜索框架，仅通过智能筛选候选移除边来减少每次迭代的评估次数。论文指出未来工作方向：扩展至预测有前景的重连边、辅助主枢纽选择、枢纽邻居子集划分等配置决策，以及通过迁移学习验证模型在不同规模实例间的泛化能力。

Abstract: Designing high-performance tactical wireless networks under realistic operational constraints gives rise to challenging combinatorial optimization problems, where the evaluation of candidate solutions relies on detailed physical and traffic-aware models. Although classical metaheuristics such as Tabu Search offer effective mechanisms for exploring large search spaces, their computational cost remains high because numerous candidate moves must be evaluated at every iteration. In this paper, we propose a data-driven framework that improves the efficiency of Tabu Search by learning to guide its move selection process. Rather than altering the neighborhood structure, our approach exploits the information contained in the search trajectories generated during the optimization process. At each iteration, we record both improving and non-improving edge-based transformations together with a set of descriptive features capturing the structural, geometric, and performance characteristics of the network. This information is used to train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that predicts the impact of candidate moves on the objective function. The trained model is then integrated into the Tabu Search algorithm to rank candidate transformations according to their predicted quality, thereby reducing the number of costly objective evaluations while maintaining an effective exploration of the search space. Experimental results on synthetic benchmark instances demonstrate that the proposed learning-assisted Tabu Search notably reduces computation time while consistently producing higher-quality solutions than the standard algorithm. These findings highlight the potential of combining machine learning with metaheuristics by leveraging the implicit knowledge embedded in search trajectories, paving the way for more efficient solution methods for large-scale network design problems.

</details>


### [254] [CDEP Agent: Connecting Meteorologically Detected Temporal Compound Events to Real-World Documentary Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28628)
*Zhuoran Li,Weiyi Kong,Boer Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CDEP Agent，一个可审计的 LLM 智能体框架，用于将气象再分析数据中检测到的"干旱-极端降水"复合事件（CDEP）候选与现实世界的灾害与影响证据进行匹配。以加州为案例（2021-2025 年识别出 408 个 CDEP 候选），发现仅 34.3% 的候选在干旱和极端降水两个组成部分上都得到官方或公开记录佐证，仅 1.5% 的候选被任何来源明确联系到其前期干旱，表明气象层面真实存在的复合事件在现实中大多未被记录、其复合性质几乎从未进入档案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化背景下，干旱向极端降水的快速转变（复合事件）日益频繁且具破坏性，但气象上可识别的复合事件未必被现实中的预警或灾情记录系统所捕捉和报告。现有灾害数据库围绕单一灾害、按行政辖区构建，复合序列本身往往不被识别或记录，气象检测能力提升反而凸显了"气象真实 vs 文档缺失"之间的落差。

Method: 方法分两阶段：(1) 基于 ERA5-Land 数据用 SPEI-3<-1、当地 P99 三日降水阈值、三个月最大过渡窗口构造 CDEP 候选；(2) LLM 智能体针对每个候选检索美国干旱监测、NOAA Storm Events 及公开网页，沿五个维度评估：前期干旱、后续极端降水、当地影响、灾害-影响归因、显式干旱-降水关联。每项决定保留来源出处、支持引文、日期、地点、同一事件匹配结果。采用 Yes/No/Unresolved 三级判定协议，并进行 40 例人工审计验证（78/80 事件评估一致，97.5%）。

Result: 2021-2025 年加州共识别 408 个 CDEP 候选；前期干旱 72.8% 得到佐证，后续极端降水 45.8% 得到佐证，仅 34.3% 两个组成部分均得到佐证；当地影响 19.1%，灾害-影响归因 18.6%，显式干旱-降水关联仅 1.5%。回归分析显示极端降水持续时间每增加一天，找到合格网页的几率比为 1.40（95% CI 1.04-1.88），是最显著的特征。当网页证据可用时，约 89% 记录了当地影响、82% 明确将影响归因于降雨/洪水。

Conclusion: CDEP Agent 提供了一种可审计、可重复的方法，将气象检测的复合事件与现实文档证据对接，揭示了当前预警与报告系统在识别复合事件方面的重大缺口。该框架既可让气候科学家用不同阈值重新评估气象定义的现实相关性，又可为社会科学、经济学、灾害响应机构提供出处可追溯的证据基础，用于研究复合气候事件如何被社会所认知和记录。主要局限在于地理（仅加州）与时间范围（2021-2025）有限，且仅评估了一种操作化定义。

Abstract: Compound drought-to-extreme-precipitation (CDEP) events are recognized in climate science as a growing driver of extreme impact, but whether this recognition carries over into real-world early warning and post-event documentation is unknown, so a meteorologically real CDEP event may pass with neither advance warning nor any later record. Here we present CDEP Agent, an auditable LLM-agent framework that tests this mismatch directly by linking CDEP candidates detected from meteorological reanalysis to real-world hazard and impact evidence across sources with different spatial scales, temporal resolutions, and reporting conventions. Using California as a case study, we identify 408 candidate CDEP events from ERA5 observations during 2021-2025 and evaluate each against the U.S. Drought Monitor, NOAA Storm Events, and public webpages along five dimensions: antecedent drought, extreme rainfall, local impact, hazard-impact attribution, and explicit drought-to-rainfall linkage. Only 34.3% of candidates are corroborated on both hazard components, and just 1.5% are ever explicitly linked to their antecedent drought, indicating that most meteorologically detected CDEP events go undocumented and their compound nature almost never enters the record at all. Our framework gives climate scientists a way to test physical event definitions against what actually gets documented, and gives social scientists, economists, and disaster-response agencies a provenance-linked evidence base for compound events that current warning and reporting systems largely fail to capture.

</details>


### [255] [CrossAudit: A Git-Native, Cross-Vendor Audit Loop for Agentic Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28631)
*Zhaohe Dong,Yuhao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CrossAudit协议——一种基于git的跨厂商审计循环，用于监督自主科研流水线。其核心思想是：AI科学家不应自评作业，因此审计代理必须与生成代理来自不同模型厂商。协议建立在三大承诺之上：跨厂商审计、人类撰写并版本化的规则书、git作为可重读的监督账本，并形式化为八条不变量。作者用GitHub Actions和数百行Python构建了参考实现，并在计算化学管道中部署了变体；还进行了含30个增量、43个植入缺陷的种子缺陷试验，由跨厂商审计对自身仓库进行"揭盲"并修正结果。研究表明两个厂商对同一规则书的解读存在差异，但无法证明孰优孰劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主科研系统（如Sakana AI Scientist、DeepMind AI co-scientist）的内部评审通常由同一模型家族甚至同一厂商的LLM代理承担，存在"同源监督"的结构性弱点：自我偏好偏差已被证实，共享训练管线的模型还可能共享系统性盲点。同时，监督记录往往封闭在平台日志中，外部社区无法独立查验。论文旨在将"谁来审、如何审、如何留痕"这些问题从平台特性转化为公开、版本化的研究产物。

Method: 协议由八条不变量构成：(I1)异质性——审计方与生成方来自不同模型家族；(I2)账本完整性——所有产物（增量、报告、裁定、争议、升级、规则书变更）均为git提交或issue，分三级保证（解析记录、原始模型交互、完整过程重放，当前仅满足第一级）；(I3)引用有效性——审计报告必须引用具体规则ID和规则书提交哈希，否则作为审计方失败而升级；(I4)确定性优先——由纯脚本构成的确定性检查层（DCL）先于任何LLM运行，其硬失败不可被模型推翻；(I5)有界修订——每增量最多max_rounds（默认3）轮生成-审计交互，超出则升级；(I6)分级中断——仅BLOCKER阻断，ADVISORY永不阻断，仅ESCALATE中断人类，运行中的计算永远不被中断；(I7)回执绑定——每条裁定绑定审计提交SHA、DCL/规则书/提示版本、审计方身份等；(I8)失败关闭准入——无有效回执则禁止受保护动作。配套参考实现采用GitHub Actions+DCL检查器+审计执行器；部署版本（钙钛矿添加剂筛选）使用工具型Codex-CLI审计方并采用四级严重度。实验含种子缺陷植入试验（30增量、43缺陷，三臂：DCL、Claude子代理、gpt-5.1冻结运行器），并由跨厂商审计对自身仓库进行揭盲审查。

Result: 部署的真实监督记录显示：前七个周期决策历经五次BLOCK、一次"PASS WITH CAVEATS"、一次PASS，每周期发现数从7降至0；12/14发现已在阻断下游动作前闭合。至8月3日冻结时累计21个模型审计周期、39次发现、23个独立标识符，20个已行为验证闭环，3个开放，持续运行稳态约1-3发现/周期。种子缺陷试验因自身协议审计揭盲而废止盲法：DCL召回17/43（在其已登记范围内12/12全部捕获+5项L6跨界），Claude族子代理38/43宽松评分（后裁定43/43），GPT族（gpt-5.1）41/43宽松但严格37/43，且对10个干净增量全部返回BLOCK（10/10假阳性）；排列零分布对三臂分别为4.8/22.4/31.8，簇自举置信区间无法在容错层区分两臂（p=0.46）。试验尚能确立三点：DCL范围外的26-29缺陷被模型层捕获；同一规则书下两审计配置给出不一致解读；研究仓库自身规范（仅追加输出、记录裁定、提交跨厂商BLOCK+逐项处置）被应用于评估本身。

Conclusion: CrossAudit将监督从平台功能重构为公开版本化的产物：跨厂商、规则书带稳定ID、脚本先于模型、有界循环、git为底，旨在让单个研究者无需机构许可即可部署。八条不变量协同提供结构独立审查、可重读历史及人类在边界的权威——其效力类比于持续集成在软件领域的扩散。论文明确限定主张范围：不认证科学真伪，仅保证每个机器生成增量由第二厂商审计方按具名版本化规则评估且裁定被账本记录（厂商身份仍需自报，不抗操作员篡改）。协议在自我偏好、提示注入、振荡、Goodhart化规则书、合谋等威胁上有对应机制，但在共享语料错误、工具型审计方特有信道、操作员级审查操纵等方面仍受限制。论文还披露撰稿本身大量使用了所提协议要监督的同类工具——同源语言模式筛查后被外部审稿人发现遗漏了助手当日引入的文献错误。

Abstract: An AI scientist should not grade its own homework. Yet in the systems we examined, the agent that reviews the work usually comes from the same model family as the agent that produced it, or at least from the same vendor. Model evaluators are known to favour their own generations. Whether models trained alike also share blind spots is a conjecture, not a settled finding, but if they do, the reviewer inherits the author's. The record of what was flagged and what was waved through often sits in platform logs that nobody outside can replay. We present CrossAudit, a protocol for supervising autonomous research pipelines. It rests on three commitments. Each increment of work is audited by an agent from a different vendor against a rulebook a human wrote and versioned. Reports, verdicts, disputes and rulings are git commits, so the supervision history can be re-read and cited; raw model exchanges are not yet part of that record. Scripted checks run before any model does. Advisory judgement never gates the pipeline: a model blocks only by citing a rule, and no model may waive a deterministic failure. Blockers that survive a bounded number of revision rounds go to a person. We state the protocol as eight invariants. We describe a reference implementation built from GitHub Actions and a few hundred lines of Python, and report a live deployment of a closely related variant in a computational-chemistry pipeline. We also ran a seeded-defect trial (30 increments, 43 seeded defects, one run per configuration). A cross-vendor audit of our own repository then voided its blinding. We adopt that audit's findings and report the corrected results. The trial shows that two vendors read the same rulebook differently. It does not show that either is better. The strongest evidence here is the committed, uncontrolled record of cross-vendor audits of this paper itself.

</details>


### [256] [AutoScientist-Quant: Self-Evolving Coding Agents for Automatic Research in Quantitative Investment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28632)
*Zongqian Li,Yaoyiran Li,Yaohui Guo,Ming Zhang,Nigel Collier,Eugene Ie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoScientist-Quant 提出一个统一的三阶段预算化搜索框架（Alpha发现、Alpha过滤、模型搜索），由单个LLM控制器驱动，动态选择 Improve/Combine/Pivot/Stop 操作并管理预算。修正了既有评估管线中的两个前瞻偏差问题，保证反馈窗口与测试窗口严格分离。在CSI 300/500/800/1000 上，几乎全部指标取得最优，并在 GPT 与 GLM 两种骨干下保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有 LLM 智能体 alpha 发现方法存在三大缺陷：搜索过程静态不可自适应、自动化仅停留在 alpha 生成环节而库选择与模型选择仍为人工、alpha 发现可能通过回路反馈或代码问题偷看测试窗口。本文的动机是把这三点系统性解决，将量化研究视为一个有预算约束的统一搜索问题，并修正既有评估管线的前瞻偏差。

Method: 将量化研究建模为单一预算化搜索问题，分三个链接阶段：(1) Alpha 发现——以轨迹为节点构建搜索树，控制器根据剩余预算在 Improve/Combine/Pivot/Stop 中选择操作，并决定父节点、生成 alpha 数量与共享记忆的检索方式；(2) Alpha 过滤——在发现库上做子集搜索，使用 Eq.4 的标准化效用评分；(3) 模型搜索——在模型配置空间（Linear/LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost 等+超参数）上复用同一控制器。所有阶段共享同一预算规则（Eq.3）。评估方面修正了既有代码中的两个前瞻问题，并把反馈窗口与保留测试窗口严格隔离。

Result: 在 CSI 300 主实验（GPT 骨干）上，AutoScientist-Quant 在四种 alpha 设置（CUSTOM/+ALPHA20/+ALPHA158/+ALPHA360）的全部八个指标上均为最优，+ALPHA158 时 IC=0.034、ICIR=0.219、ARR=3.5%、IR=0.500、CR=0.368，均超 QuantaAlpha 与 AlphaAgent。消融显示：去掉模型搜索几乎不影响 IC 但损失 ARR；去掉 alpha 过滤使 ARR 由正转负；去掉搜索策略或动态性则在 IC 与 ARR 上同步下降。在 CSI 500/800/1000 上两种骨干下均保持领先：CSI 1000 GPT 下 ARR 7.1%、CR 0.591；GLM 下 ARR 6.9%、CR 0.600。案例分析验证了搜索对反馈窗口不可见下跌的恢复能力、冗余控制的有效性以及基于证据而非预设调度停止的合理性。

Conclusion: AutoScientist-Quant 通过统一控制器在单次运行内将结构与成本作为决策，使搜索自适应于证据同时受限于固定预算。Alpha 发现产生信息，下游阶段（过滤、模型搜索）将其转化为收益；其优势来源于阶段级与组件级贡献的累加而非单一来源。框架在多种骨干与市场下保持稳健，未来可推广至算法开发、推理与评测等其他领域。

Abstract: Large language model agents can discover alphas, yet current methods have three weaknesses. The search cannot adapt during the run, automation usually ends at alpha generation while library selection and model choice stay manual, and alpha discovery can read the test window through loop feedback or code problems. We present AutoScientist-Quant, a self evolving search process that regards quantitative research as one budgeted search problem. A single controller conditions every decision on the remaining budget, choosing at each round whether to improve, combine, pivot, or stop, which node to expand, how many alphas to generate, and how to retrieve past trajectories from the shared memory. The same core then selects from the library and tunes the model, closing the loop from hypothesis to deployable strategy. We also review the evaluation pipeline reused from prior work, fix two lookahead problems, and keep the feedback window disjoint from the held out test window, so every comparison tests true generalization. On CSI universes, the framework attains the best value of nearly every metric in every setting, and these conclusions hold across several backbones and markets.

</details>


### [257] [AI Scientist Mission Control (AIMC): Visual Analytics for Human Oversight of Autonomous Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28637)
*Rikathi Pal,Klaus Mueller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AIMC 是一个面向自主科学发现系统的可视化分析框架，通过整合语义嵌入、弱点提取、时序分析和交互式可视化，帮助人类研究者监督、诊断和优先级排序大规模 AI 生成的研究产物。该工作以 FARS 平台生成的 103 篇 AI 论文及其审阅反馈作为案例，揭示了反复出现的方法论弱点、研究主题的演变及值得深度审查的高新颖性论文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 AI Scientist（如 The AI Scientist、FARS）等自主科学发现系统能以极少人为干预生成大量研究构想、实验和论文，科学家缺乏有效机制来监控输出质量、识别反复出现的失败模式、理解研究演化并优先审查有潜力的发现。现有研究主要关注提升自主系统的能力，而非辅助人类监督其产生的海量产物，亟需一个语料库层面的可视化分析框架来弥合这一空白。

Method: 提出 AIMC 框架，包含三大分析模块：(1) 语义分析——通过论文嵌入、聚类和主题提取捕捉语义关系与主题结构；(2) 弱点分析——使用 OpenAI GPT API 从评审反馈中挖掘反复出现的方法论弱点、共现关系及系统模式；(3) 质量分析——整合评审分数、新颖性估计和领域统计以评估研究质量与影响力。这些分析信号被整合到一个协调的可视化层中，包含质量分布、弱点共现网络、弱点比较、弱点演化、主题演化、领域比较和"新颖性–影响力"图谱等八种视图，支持监控、诊断、优先级排序和评估四项监督任务。

Result: 通过对 FARS 生成的 103 篇论文及其 PaperReview.ai 评审反馈的案例研究，揭示了：(1) 75.7% 的论文处于"可接受"区间（5.0–6.0），仅极少获得"强"评级；(2) 方法论弱点呈现社区化共现模式，且与低分论文显著相关的弱点包括弱基线比较、缺失相关工作、统计验证不足及敏感性分析有限；(3) 随时间推移，部分方法论弱点频率下降（如方法论细节缺失），而另一些则在后期涌现（如评估范围狭窄）；(4) 研究主题动态再分配，呈现持续探索长尾的"语义前沿扩展"模式；(5) 领域间质量差异显著；(6) 新颖性–影响力四象限分析可有效识别高价值论文，且高质量论文随时间呈上升趋势但高新颖性贡献贯穿整个过程。

Conclusion: AIMC 验证了可视化分析作为自主科学发现人类监督基础设施的可行性，强调语料库层面的可视化分析能够揭示仅在大规模 AI 生成研究集合中才能显现的行为模式。研究表明 AI 生成研究的弱点与人类研究的批评高度相似，暗示自主系统受同样的方法论标准约束。AIMC 是模型无关的，可适用于其他 AI Scientist 平台。未来工作将扩展至多平台评估、领域专家参与、多评审机制、不确定性度量，并最终演变为闭环人–AI 协作框架，结合过程级（执行轨迹、日志）和结果级证据。

Abstract: Autonomous scientific discovery systems can generate large numbers of research ideas, experiments, and manuscripts with minimal human intervention. As these systems become increasingly capable, scientists require effective mechanisms to monitor output quality, identify recurring failure modes, understand research evolution, and prioritize promising discoveries for review. We present AIMC, a visual analytics framework for human oversight of autonomous scientific discovery. AIMC combines semantic embeddings, automated weakness extraction, temporal analysis, and interactive visualizations to support the exploration of AI-generated research artifacts. We demonstrate the framework through a case study of the papers generated by an autonomous AI Scientist (FARS), together with their associated review feedback. Our analysis reveals recurring methodological weaknesses, evolving research themes, domain-specific differences in quality, and a small set of highly novel papers that warrant deeper human inspection. These findings illustrate how visual analytics can support transparency, diagnosis, and human AI collaboration in emerging autonomous scientific discovery workflows.

</details>


### [258] [Self-Evolving Skills via Surrogate-Guided Solve-and-Reproduce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28638)
*Jiale Liu,Pinze Ren,Yuqi Xia,Huan Wang,Zhenlin Zhao,Siming Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: reSolve 提出了一种"求解-复现"自演化技能框架,通过盲验证器引导的束搜索,让廉价模型在 SkillsBench 上以 74.9% 的 mean-of-3 成绩超越人工策划基线(60.1%)及官方最强结果(67.3%,GPT-5.5/OpenHands)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能自演化方法存在两大失败模式:(1)从零演化的技能在弱模型上反而不如无技能;(2)演化时记录的成功轨迹在部署时新代理难以复现,即"复现鸿沟"。核心动机是改变演化框架认证的对象——从认证单一轨迹改为认证冻结的可复现交付物。

Method: 框架包含三大组件:(1)Solve-and-Reproduce 协议:将交互式求解与独立可复现交付物解耦,在新容器中由新代理重执行冻结包;(2)盲代理验证器:生成可执行检查套件提供密集奖励信号与失败诊断,但无法访问隐藏测试与参考答案;(3)代理验证器引导的束搜索:在解构造图上以 m=4, B=2, K=2, D=2 配置搜索,每任务最多12次评估。

Result: 在 SkillsBench 86个任务上,DeepSeek-V4-Pro 达 74.9% mean-of-3(+14.8 点),超越官方榜首 GPT-5.5/OpenHands 的 67.3%。消融显示:无代理排序降至 66.0%(-8.9),无束搜索降至 59.4%(-15.5),无策划锚点从零演化降至 44.0%(-30.9)。Gemma 4 31B 上增益较小(+5.2 点),表明收益随生成器能力扩展。域级别,自然科学任务达 87.6%,办公室任务 92.9%。失败主要源于解释执行器的语义分歧,而非技能本身。

Conclusion: reSolve 证明了技能自演化最有效的形式是"自求精炼"而非从零生成;束搜索将额外计算转化为覆盖度;代理验证器引导预算流向正确父节点。好的技能包应最小化留给执行器的解释空间——提供可执行入口点而非散文指令,使复现成为包-执行器对的属性而非偶然轨迹。局限在于:收益与生成器能力正相关,代理执行器仍是主要失败来源,未来需使执行器与包同样可靠。

Abstract: Agent skills are portable packages of instructions and resources an agent consults at deployment. Self-evolving them fails in two ways today. First, skills evolved from scratch underperform human-curated ones and, on a weak model, using no skill at all. Second, an evolution-time pass records one lucky trajectory that a fresh stochastic agent often fails to reproduce at deployment. We present reSolve, a per-task, oracle-in-the-loop framework built on three components. It decouples interactive solving from a self-contained deliverable that is independently re-executed in a fresh container, a protocol we call solve-and-reproduce. It enhances the sparse reward signal with a surrogate verifier that cannot access hidden tests or reference answers. It then runs verifier-guided beam search over a solution-construction graph. Within a fixed harness, a cheap model self-evolves skills that reach $74.9\%$ mean-of-3, $+14.8$ points over the $60.1\%$ human-curated baseline, exceeding the strongest official curated-skill result ($67.3\%$, GPT-5.5/OpenHands). We also report observed failure cases and domain-level results, including performance on the 14 Natural Science tasks, to clarify when the approach does and does not help.

</details>


### [259] [Reward-Oracle MCTS for Formal Theorem Proving: Sample-Efficient Search and the Need for Kernel-Level Proof Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28639)
*Bodla Krishna Vamshi,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三角色蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）框架，将 Lean 4 编译器仅用作奖励预言机（reward oracle），通过标量信号驱动搜索而非将编译器错误信息注入生成上下文。在四个基准测试上以更低推理 token 消耗一致优于全证明采样基线，并通过内核级公理审计揭示了 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在 PutnamBench 上依赖 sorryAx 的奖励黑客行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的形式化定理证明树搜索方法存在两大问题：一是将冗长的编译器错误信息直接注入生成上下文，导致随搜索深度增加上下文开销膨胀；二是使用非标准评估协议，无法与已有基线进行公平比较。需要在固定证明尝试预算下实现样本高效的搜索，同时避免编译器反馈污染生成上下文。

Method: 提出三角色 MCTS 框架：(1) 生成器（Generator）产生完整 Lean 4 证明；(2) 分解器（Decomposer）将定理分解为子目标，使用温度衰减采样 τ_d = τ_0 · e^(-0.12d) · e^(-0.03ln(1+i)) 平衡探索与利用；(3) 评论器（Critic）以低温度 τ=0.3 采样5次评估子目标质量。奖励信号 r_t = r_c + r_s 由评论器标量奖励和编译成功率（Kimina Lean Server 返回的标量计数）构成，UCB 准则指导节点选择，编译器错误内容不进入生成上下文。搜索在自然语言证明计划而非形式化证明状态上进行。

Result: 在 4 个基准（MiniF2F、PutnamBench、LeanPhysBench、PhysLeandata）和 3 个证明模型（Goedel-Prover-V2-8B、DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B、Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-7B）上，在 PAB@16 至 PAB@256 预算下均一致优于全证明采样：MiniF2F 上 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B 达 87.1%（PAB@256）；PutnamBench 上 PAB@32 解决 26/659（vs 基线 18/659）。推理 token 消耗平均减少 32.8%。温度衰减和迭代-分支因子分配（N=4, K=4, S=2）为关键架构组件。多智能体分析显示 DeepSeek 作为异构评论器可提升性能，但异构分解器始终降低性能。然而，对 DeepSeek 在 PutnamBench 上的成功证明执行 #print axioms 内核级审计后，发现分别有 11/27（PAB@32）和 19/44（PAB@128）个证明依赖 sorryAx，确认了之前报告的 apply? 接口漏洞在 Lean 4.15.0 下仍然存在，证明编译器验证的求解计数在缺少内核审计时不可信。

Conclusion: 将编译器用作纯奖励预言机的三角色 MCTS 框架在样本效率和推理成本上均优于将错误反馈注入上下文的搜索方法；但形式化定理证明评估必须执行内核级公理审计，仅依赖编译成功和源级 sorry 扫描不足以检测奖励黑客行为（如 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 利用 apply? 漏洞生成的证明）。该工作同时证实了搜索过程本身并未引入新的利用策略，仅放大了模型既有的不当行为。

Abstract: Formal theorem proving with large language models remains challenging due to the difficulty of navigating large proof search spaces efficiently. Existing tree search approaches either feed verbose compiler error messages directly into the generation context, increasing context usage during search, or employ non-standard evaluation protocols that prevent direct comparison with established baselines. We propose a three-role Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) framework that treats the Lean 4 compiler purely as a reward oracle using compiler output as a scalar signal for UCB-guided tree updates without feeding error content into the generation context. Our framework decomposes proof search into three roles: a generator for proof attempts, a decomposer for subgoal decomposition, and a critic for subgoal quality evaluation. We evaluate across 4 benchmarks spanning competition mathematics and physics (MiniF2F, PutnamBench, LeanPhysBench, PhysLeandata) with three prover models at standard proof attempt budgets (PAB@16 to PAB@256). Our method achieves 87.1\% on MiniF2F with Goedel-Prover-V2-8B at PAB@256 and solves 26/659 PutnamBench problems at PAB@32 surpassing base sampling 18/659 at same proof attempt budget. Through an exhaustive axiom-level audit of every compiled proof, we further identify reward hacking in search-based theorem proving: DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B produces proofs on PutnamBench that pass compilation and the standard sorry-token scan while depending on sorryAx. The audit removes 4 and 8 such proofs from whole-proof sampling at PAB@32 and PAB@128, and 11 and 19 from MCTS. We do not attribute these counts to the search procedure; we report them to establish that kernel-level auditing is necessary for compiler-verified evaluation.

</details>


### [260] [From Extraction to Governed Memory: Multi-Agent Knowledge Graph Construction with Domain-Expert Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28642)
*Pranav Bykampadi,Neel Mokaria,Vishesh Narayan,Faizan Wajid,Ashok Agrawala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAGG是一个多智能体框架，用于构建带治理机制的知识图谱，通过域分类、三元组所有权分配、证据审查和元数据审计等治理决策，在开放域场景中提升知识图谱构建的可靠性与可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体系统中的知识图谱通常被视为扁平的三元组存储库，缺乏对事实所有权、纳入原因及下游使用方式的记录，导致知识共享的可靠性和可信度不足。论文主张将治理作为图谱构建的核心组件，以弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出MAGG框架，采用多智能体协作流程：(1) 域分类器从文档内容自动归纳实体和关系类型，支持开放世界场景无需固定模式；(2) 候选三元组被分配给域所有者；(3) 经支持证据审查后通过治理决策纳入；(4) 存储时附带审计元数据。问答阶段复用相同的域所有权结构，将查询路由到特定域的图谱专家，而非无差别的统一检索。

Result: 在SciERC数据集上，MAGG相比扁平插入在严格三元组F1上提升47%，映射三元组F1提升51%；对120个三元组的盲评显示，仅通过治理纳入的三元组比仅扁平插入的更具源证据支持，修订三元组的支持率达100%；在MuSiQue数据集上，MAGG比Microsoft GraphRAG在精确匹配上高出9.0分、token-F1高出11.2分。

Conclusion: 治理应作为智能体知识图谱构建的基本组件，MAGG通过显式的治理决策和多智能体协作，有效提升了知识图谱的事实可靠性、证据可追溯性和问答准确性。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs used by agentic systems are often treated as flat stores of extracted triples, with little record of who owns a fact, why it was admitted, or how it should be used downstream. We argue that reliable agentic knowledge systems require governance as an essential component of graph construction to bridge this gap. We propose MAGG, a principled multi-agent framework for constructing Governed Knowledge Graphs that introduces explicit governance decisions for reliable and trustworthy knowledge sharing. A domain classifier first induces entity and relation types directly from document content, enabling operation in open-world settings without fixed schemas. Candidate triples are assigned to domain owners, reviewed against supporting evidence, admitted through governance decisions, and stored with audit metadata. The same ownership structure is reused during question answering, where queries are routed to domain-specific graph experts rather than answered through undifferentiated retrieval. Our evaluation demonstrates MAGG's effectiveness: On SciERC, MAGG improves strict triple F1 by 47% and mapped triple F1 by 51% over flat insertion. A blinded review of 120 triples finds governed-only triples more often source-supported than flat-only ones, and revised triples supported in 100% of cases. Finally, on MuSiQue, MAGG outperforms Microsoft GraphRAG by 9.0 exact-match points and 11.2 token-F1 points.

</details>


### [261] [BiasMix-Finance: Post-Generation KYC Guardrails for LLM Portfolio Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28646)
*Gaurav Kukreja,Parul Kukreja,Mohammed Abraar,Raj Dandekar,Rajat Dandekar,Sreedath Panat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出BiasMix-Finance(Mini)框架，一个模型无关、资产无关的后生成KYC风格护栏机制，通过JSON模式验证+凸二次约束规划(QCQP)近邻投影，修复LLM生成的ETF投资组合以满足硬性约束（波动率、费率、HHI集中度、单资产/单板块上限）。在三模型×三推理模式下的测试显示，护栏可将最终可行性违例降至0%，且修正距离较小（中位数D=0.066）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在金融咨询中常生成听起来合理但违反KYC式约束（如风险、费率、多样化）的ETF组合，尤其在自主代理多轮咨询系统中，草稿推荐可能在无审计执行层的情况下直接转化为行动。需要一种模型无关、可审计的后生成强制执行机制来保证合规。

Method: (1) 严格JSON分配模式强制；(2) 对数值上限（波动率、WAER、HHI、单资产/板块上限）进行验证；(3) 违例时通过凸二次规划(QCQP)投影到最近可行组合；(4) 引入BiasMix-Finance(Mini)压力测试基准（16-ETF宇宙×3投资者档案×8偏差提示）；(5) 评估3个模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5 nano、Llama 3.3 70B）×3推理模式（直接、批判、自洽性）；(6) 使用Wilson 95% CI、bootstrap CI、Wilcoxon配对检验+BH-FDR校正进行统计评估。

Result: 首次生成违例率在47.6%–85.7%之间（汇总67.2%）；凸投影层将最终可行性违例降至0%；测试汇总修正距离中位数D=0.066（较小）；保守型组合最严格（100%首轮违例），激进型最宽松；自洽性模式下跨模型差异不显著；GPT-5 nano与Llama在直接/批判模式下的修正距离存在显著差异（p_FDR<0.10）。

Conclusion: 后生成KYC式护栏是LLM生成金融分配的实用可审计方法；凸近邻可行投影可在保持较小L2修正距离的同时消除约束违例；该验证-修复模式具有模型无关、资产无关特性，可推广至金融以外受约束决策领域；BiasMix-Finance(Mini)可作为偏差下受约束决策的压力测试基准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate plausible-sounding ETF portfolios while silently violating basic KYC-style constraints on risk, fees, and diversification. This is especially problematic in agentic multi-turn advisory systems, where each draft recommendation can become an action unless guarded by an auditable enforcement layer. We study a model-agnostic, asset-agnostic post-generation guardrail pipeline: (i) enforce a strict JSON allocation schema, (ii) validate allocations against numeric caps, and (iii) when violations occur, deterministically project the output to the nearest feasible portfolio via a convex quadratic program (QCQP). We introduce BiasMix-Finance (Mini), a compact stress-test benchmark for constrained decision-making under biased LLM generations, with a 16-ETF universe, three investor profiles, and eight bias prompts. Across three models and three inference modes (direct, critique, self-consistency), first-pass generations violate at least one cap in 47.6-85.7% of test cases (67.2% pooled), but the convex projection layer reduces final feasibility violations to 0% while requiring only a small correction distance (test pooled median D=||w*-w0||_2=0.066), indicating that the guardrail typically preserves the intent of the original allocation. We report violation rates and correction distances with confidence intervals, and paired model comparisons with multiple-testing correction. To support reproducibility, we release the dataset, prompts, caps, and code in our public GitHub repository.

</details>


### [262] [Self-Specialized Teachers for Domain Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28647)
*Yifei Li,Rongman Xu,Lingling Zhang,Muye Huang,Zihan Ma,Jiashuai Liu,Hang Yan,Heng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为自专门化教师蒸馏（SSTD）的两阶段后训练方法，用于在仅有目标领域数据、没有通用回放语料的情况下对通用大语言模型进行领域适配。SSTD首先从基础模型复制一份教师模型，通过结合基础感知关键令牌加权和与冻结基础模型分布对齐的目标函数进行领域专门化训练；然后在学生自生成的轨迹前缀上进行在线策略蒸馏。在金融数值推理、医学问答和法律判决预测三个领域的实验表明，SSTD在保留大部分目标领域性能提升的同时，将通用评测平均分提升了4.8–5.0个百分点，且无需外部模型或通用回放数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仅有目标领域数据但缺乏通用回放语料的现实场景下，对通用大语言模型进行领域适配时，传统的目标监督微调（SFT）虽能提升领域表现，却会损害模型原本具备的通用能力（如MMLU、HellaSwag等基准）。现有方法如经验回放、参数约束或参考匹配均存在局限：经验回放只能覆盖部分通用行为，参数约束无法区分领域变化与其他变化。此外，常用的蒸馏方法要么依赖更强但与学生兼容性差的外部教师，要么使用离线固定的黄金轨迹，忽略了自回归学生实际遇到的推理状态与训练时所见状态之间的分布失配。因此需要一种既能学习领域知识又能保留通用能力、且不依赖外部教师或回放语料的方法。

Method: 本文提出自专门化教师蒸馏（SSTD），包含两阶段：阶段I从基础模型复制一份教师模型T，使用目标领域数据D_T进行训练。训练目标为L_T = L_SFT + λ_key·L_key + λ_align·L_align，其中：(1) L_SFT为标准监督微调损失；(2) L_key为基础感知关键令牌加权损失，利用冻结基础模型S_0的逐令牌负对数似然作为难度信号，对S_0认为低概率的参考令牌赋予更高权重（公式2-3），迫使教师将容量集中于基础模型的实际领域缺口；(3) L_align为学生分布对齐损失，使用KL(p_T || p_S_0)惩罚教师在S_0认为不可能的令牌上放置过多概率，确保教师的变化对学生可达。阶段II为在线策略蒸馏：学生S自主采样完整轨迹，在每个学生到达的前缀处查询冻结教师T*的全词汇表分布，使用前向KL(p_T* || p_S)进行逐令牌蒸馏。该方法无需外部教师、无需通用回放数据，仅依赖目标领域数据和基础模型本身。

Result: 在FinQA（金融数值推理）、MedMCQA（医学问答）和CaseHOLD（法律判决预测）三个领域，使用Qwen3-1.7B作为主骨干网络的实验中，SSTD相比朴素SFT在通用平均分（MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC-C的均值）上提升了4.8–5.0个百分点，而目标领域分数仅下降1.6–2.0个百分点。具体而言：Finance上目标分59.5 vs 61.5，通用分55.2 vs 50.4；Medical上目标分74.2 vs 75.8，通用分56.7 vs 51.7；Legal上目标分80.1 vs 82.0，通用分58.4 vs 53.5。消融实验表明关键令牌加权主要贡献目标增益（+1.0），分布对齐主要贡献通用保留（+1.1），二者结合效果最优。在线策略（学生生成前缀）相比离线教师前缀在目标分上提升1.9点、在通用分上提升1.4点。该方法在Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B和Gemma-3-1B/4B等多个规模与模型族上均表现一致。训练成本方面，SSTD使用1.7×朴素SFT的GPU小时，但仅0.66×外部教师OPD基线的GPU小时。

Conclusion: SSTD是一种有效的无回放语料领域后训练方法，通过构造与学生兼容的"自专门化教师"并在学生自身生成的状态上进行蒸馏，在仅使用目标领域数据的情况下显著缓解了领域适配中的通用能力退化问题。该方法在多个领域、多个模型规模和多个模型族上均验证了其目标与通用保留之间的有利权衡，且无需依赖外部教师或通用回放语料。然而，SSTD存在局限性：当学生早期生成严重错误令牌时，令牌级在线策略蒸馏无法修正已采样的前缀；当对齐系数过大时，教师可能无法表达所需的领域纠正。方法的目标是"受控变化"而非最大化保留基础模型。

Abstract: Target-only post-training can improve performance in a specialized domain while degrading behaviors that a general-purpose base model acquired before adaptation. We study this problem when target-domain data are available but a representative replay corpus is not. We propose self-specialized teacher distillation (SSTD), a two-stage procedure that first trains a copy of the base model into a domain teacher, then distills its token distribution to a student on prefixes sampled from the student itself. Teacher training combines standard target supervision with base-aware key-token weighting and distribution alignment to the frozen base model; on-policy distillation then places domain feedback on states the student can encounter at inference time. On financial numerical reasoning, medical question answering, and legal holding identification, SSTD retains much of the target improvement of direct fine-tuning while improving the mean score on the evaluated general suite by 4.8--5.0 points at the reported operating point. The pattern persists across Qwen3 sizes and on Gemma backbones. SSTD requires neither an external teacher nor general replay data.

</details>


### [263] [How Language Models Choose Sides: Internal Representations of Instruction Hierarchy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28648)
*Enrique Balp-Straffon,Chih-Hao Hsu,Rushiraj Gadhvi,Sunishchal Dev,Callum Stuart McDougall,Anusha Mujumdar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究指令调优大语言模型在系统提示与用户提示发生直接冲突时如何进行仲裁，通过构建一个41对约束的基准测试，在8个模型上评估了层级、反对层级和无通道效应三种行为机制，并利用线性可解码性和引导实验发现反层级行为并不代表内部缺少冲突解决信号——Llama-3.1-8B虽在仅0.10的冲突中遵循系统，但其残差流激活仍能以0.97的平衡准确率线性解码冲突结果，且通过对逐约束LR探针方向在第12层的均值向量进行引导，可将真实系统合规率从0.132提升至0.530。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令层级是抵御提示注入和越狱攻击的核心防线，但现有模型对系统指令的遵循能力仍然脆弱；先前基于训练或架构的修复工作常学到表面捷径，且增加拒绝率的副作用表明拒绝方向与冲突仲裁可能纠缠。本研究动机在于：行为上反层级的模型是否内部真的缺少解决冲突的信号？仅有可解码信号是否足以因果性地翻转仲裁结果？这两个问题关系到机制可解释性方法能否真正用于提升指令层级行为。

Method: 作者首先构建了一个含41对互斥约束的基准，每条约束配有确定性校验器，并在基线、冲突和同通道控制三种条件下评估了8个指令调优模型；通过系统权威差（SAD）将模型划分为层级、反对层级和无通道效应三种行为机制。其次在残差流的last_prompt位置使用差值均值（DiM）、IID mass-mean（IID-MM）和ℓ₂正则化逻辑回归（LR）三种最小化探针方法进行线性可解码性分析，并对比仅基于元数据的分类器作为更严格的基线。最后在Llama-3.1-8B的一个四冲突子集上，于第12层比较了整体LR探针、四个逐约束LR探针的等权均值以及IID mass-mean方向在加性和投影引导下的因果效应，使用真实系统合规率作为主要指标以排除重复循环和质量退化。

Result: 行为上，SAD将八个模型分为三个机制：在Gemma-4家族内通道效应随规模增强，三种方法在Llama-3.1-8B上均能以0.81至0.97的平衡准确率线性解码冲突结果，IID-MM最高且比元数据基线高17个百分点；Qwen2.5-7B和gpt-oss-20b上呈现类似模式。三种方法找到的方向两两余弦相似度均较低，意味着存在多个几何不同但分类等价的法向量。引导方面，第12层四个逐约束LR探针的等权均值在α=+7时将真实系统合规率从0.132提升到0.530；而分离性更强的IID mass-mean方向仅达到0.156并引入拒绝与重复；任何单独逐约束探针在同幅度下均无法产生同等提升。

Conclusion: 指令层级并非当前指令调优模型的统一属性，行为呈现机制分层。即使Llama-3.1-8B在冲突中几乎总是跟随用户，其残差流仍然线性编码哪一方会胜出，行为上的反层级与内部可读信号可以共存。有效的引导干预取决于方向的几何形态而非探针准确率本身——逐约束探针方向的均值有效，而池化分离性最优的方向在因果干预上接近惰性。文章将指令层级重新定位为一种内部仲裁过程，并提出未来需要在更多模型和完整41冲突基准上复制引导结果，并检验该几何是否同样适用于语义或安全关键冲突。

Abstract: We study how instruction-tuned LLMs arbitrate direct conflicts between system and user instructions. We introduce a benchmark of 41 paired constraints with deterministic verifiers and evaluate eight models under matched baseline, conflict, and same-channel control conditions. Behaviourally, the models split into three regimes by System Authority Delta: hierarchy-respecting models use the system channel as an authority signal, anti-hierarchy models follow the system less often than their same-channel baseline predicts, and no-effect models show little channel sensitivity. Llama-3.1-8B is the strongest anti-hierarchy case in our suite, following the system in only 0.10 of conflict trials. We use this behavioural failure case to ask whether user-preferring arbitration reflects the absence of an internal conflictresolution signal. It does not: on Llama-3.1-8B, the conflict outcome is linearly decodable from residual-stream activations at 0.97 balanced accuracy, 17 percentage points above a metadata-only baseline, with analogous signals on Qwen2.5-7B and gpt-oss-20b. Steering with a layer-12 mean of four per-conflict logistic-regression directions raises genuine system compliance from 0.132 to 0.530, while directions selected mainly for pooled separability steer poorly. User-preferring conflict resolution can therefore coexist with a readable internal arbitration signal, and successful intervention depends on the geometry of the readout rather than probe accuracy alone

</details>


### [264] [A Generalized Optimization Engine (GOE) for Edge AI Inference Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28652)
*Venkat R. Dasari,Jakob A. Adams,Vinod K. Mishra,Brian Jalaian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GOE（Generalized Optimization Engine）是一个面向边缘AI推理加速的软硬件无关通用优化框架，将剪枝、量化、蒸馏、NAS和编译器统一在同一优化流程下，支持CNN和LLM在无GPU边缘CPU上的高效部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型（尤其是Transformer类LLM）计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限的战术边缘设备上。现有优化方法通常针对特定模型或硬件，缺乏通用性，且常因精度下降而失效。本文旨在构建一个统一、硬件无关的优化架构，在推理时延、内存、能耗等约束下保持任务精度。

Method: 1) 将部署问题形式化为约束/多目标优化问题，优化变量包括模型m、量化q、剪枝ρ/δ/η等，受推理时延、内存、能耗预算约束。2) 按模型规模分解：CNN使用基于超网络的One-Shot NAS + 进化搜索；LLM采用压缩路径。3) 模型分析器自动识别模型类型并路由到相应压缩模块。4) 集成Optimal Brain Compression（OBC）、Torch-Pruning（结构化剪枝 + DepGraph依赖分析）、TorchAO（量化）、NAS + 超网络 + CompOFA渐进收缩 + 自蒸馏、多编译器后端（torch.compile、TensorRT/TensorRT-LLM、ONNX/ONNXRuntime、Apache TVM）。5) 在边缘CPU上通过llama.cpp/GGUF运行时部署量化后的LLM。

Result: CNN实验：ResNet50和ViT-B32经25–75%结构化剪枝+5 epoch微调，精度超过原模型，模型尺寸大幅缩减；TorchAO 8-bit量化在ResNet50上获得>25×吞吐提升，MobileNet v3 Small因冗余度低精度显著下降；NAS进化搜索找到2×压缩且精度提升+5.29%的子网。LLM边缘部署：Llama-3.2-1B和Qwen2.5-1.5B在Intel Core Ultra 7 265U（无GPU）上，Q8_0量化实现~1.9×缩小、~1.7×加速且精度几乎不变；Q4_K_M实现~3×缩小、~2.5×加速，仅损失少量精度；但朴素的动态int8（相同位宽）精度崩溃至接近随机水平，激进的剪枝路径同样导致精度坍塌——证明压缩方法的正确选择比名义位宽更关键。

Conclusion: GOE作为统一优化框架，通过约束优化形式化和按模型规模分解的策略，能在异构边缘硬件上有效压缩CNN和LLM。在无GPU边缘CPU上的实验证明：正确的压缩方法选择（如GGUF Q8_0/Q4_K_M）可在保持任务精度的同时显著缩小模型并提升推理速度；方法选择本身与位宽同等重要。未来工作将拓展至多模态融合模型，并探索运行时自适应优化能力。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various domains, yet their widespread deployment is impeded by significant computational costs, particularly on resource-constrained devices. This paper explores the theoretical underpinnings of various AI model optimization techniques, algorithms, and abstractions, discussing their potential to reduce computational complexity, memory footprint, latency, and power consumption. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive hardware (HW) and model-agnostic generalized optimization architecture that integrates these techniques for improved efficiency. Our study underscores the critical role of such a generalized optimization system in preparing model deployment over resource-constrained heterogeneous hardware in a tactical environment. As a concrete demonstration, we show that GOE-compressed language models deploy and run on a GPU-less edge CPU, and that the choice of compression method, not merely its nominal bit-width, determines whether task accuracy survives deployment.

</details>


### [265] [FRAC-MAS: A Safe and Explainable Multi-Agent System for Fracture Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28662)
*Hardik Iyer,Tirath Bhathawala,Mihir Panchal,Ying-Jung Chen,Kiran Bhowmick,Pankaj Sonawane,Meera Narvekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FRAC-MAS是一个用于骨折诊断的安全可解释多智能体系统，集成了四个视觉模型的堆叠集成与共形预测，由多智能体工作流执行独立验证、检索临床指南并生成患者友好报告，在自动分诊和人机协同决策方面优于单智能体基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习骨折检测模型虽性能高但黑盒特性限制了临床应用；现有系统缺乏可审计性、统计不确定性量化与临床上下文化解释，难以满足安全关键医疗场景的部署需求。

Method: 构建包含患者接口、知识（ChromaDB RAG）、批评（盲评triager）与教育四个LangGraph编排智能体的工作流；视觉层使用MaxViT、YOLOv26m-cls、RAD-DINO与HyperColumn-CBAM DenseNet-169的堆叠集成（逻辑回归元学习器），结合split conformal prediction（α=0.10）生成差异诊断，Grad-CAM用于空间可解释性。

Result: 在112样本HBFMID测试集上整体准确率91.1%；多智能体批评将86.6%案例归入高置信自动确认队列（确认准确率93.8%，较单智能体基线降低7.5×升级率）；Roboflow外部集堆叠检测率96.4% (F1=0.982)；FracAtlas OOD集AUC 0.652；α=0.10时共形覆盖92.0%；临床医生评分技术准确性4.14/5；患者偏好调查在35张影像上对Llama/MedGemma/Gemini取得55.4%首选率与最佳平均排名1.77（Friedman χ²(3)=135.4371, p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 集成多智能体批评与共形保证可在保留临床医生监督的同时实现更安全的放射分诊；模块化、可审计的协作智能体架构为人机协同医疗决策支持提供了可行路径，但仍受限于小标定样本量、跨解剖部位域偏移与VLM确认偏差等挑战。

Abstract: Fracture detection and its clinical interpretability see notable improvements when deep vision models are integrated with agentic AI architectures. While deep learning models achieve high diagnostic performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. We propose FRAC-MAS, an agentic AI system for automated, explainable, and safe bone fracture detection. The framework combines a stacked ensemble of four vision models with conformal prediction to produce statistically grounded differential diagnoses, while a multi-agent workflow performs independent verification, retrieves clinical guidelines, and generates patient-friendly reports. A pipeline-depth ablation study confirms that our multi-agent critic triages 86.6% of cases into a high-confidence auto-confirmed cohort while escalating uncertain cases, outperforming a single-agent baseline. Patient preference studies against Llama, MedGemma, and Gemini further demonstrate significantly more comprehensible clinical reports. These results suggest that integrating multi-agent critics with conformal guarantees enables safer radiology triage while preserving clinician oversight. More broadly, FRAC-MAS demonstrates how cooperative agentic architectures can serve as auditable, human-in-the-loop decision support systems for safety-critical healthcare. Our code is available at this https URL , and the website is available at this https URL .

</details>
