Dataset and code are open-sourced on this https URL .

</details>


### [323] [Extending TotalSegmentator: Predicting Patient and Acquisition Characteristics from CT and MR Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29348)
*Jakob Wasserthal,Joshy Cyriac,Michael Bach,Kimia Mozahheb Yousefi,Minh-Son To,Máté Sik,Cédric Hémon,Thomas Weikert,Martin Segeroth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发并评估了基于3D ResNet-10的多任务集成模型,可直接从CT和MR图像中预测患者特征(体重、身高、年龄、性别)及多种采集参数。模型已开源集成至TotalSegmentator工具包,在内部和外部测试集上均优于基于分割的XGBoost基线,且CPU推理速度快,适用于元数据质量控制和自动化影像处理流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像存档中,患者信息(体重、身高、年龄、性别)和采集元数据(管电压、对比剂期相、视野范围等)常缺失或不可靠,影响临床决策、影像质量控制和自动化研究流程。现有方法多为单一目标预测或依赖特定采集条件/分割流程,缺乏一种统一的、能同时覆盖CT和MR的开源工具。

Method: 为CT和MR各训练一个3D ResNet-10五折集成多任务模型。CT模型预测体重、身高、年龄、性别、对比剂存在、椎体覆盖范围、图像噪声,以及扫描厂商、管电压、管电流、卷积核、注射后时间;MR模型额外预测序列类别。体素重采样至2mm各向同性,CT输入裁剪/填充至240³,MR为210×210×150。采用Huber损失联合优化所有目标,Adam学习率5×10⁻⁴,余弦退火,混合精度,40个epoch。基线方法使用TotalSegmentator分割结果(器官体积、骨骼肌、脂肪等)训练每目标XGBoost集成模型。统计检验采用双侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验和精确McNemar检验,经Holm校正28次比较。

Result: 内部CT测试集(n=501):体重MAE 3.90 kg,身高3.68 cm,年龄4.42年,性别F1=0.990;内部MR(n=636):体重4.34 kg,身高4.62 cm,年龄7.13年,F1=0.970。CNN在两种模态的所有四个核心目标上均显著优于XGBoost基线(Holm校正后P≤0.042)。CT对比剂F1=0.963,MR序列微F1=0.953。外部CT(n=54,全胸腹盆):体重4.45 kg,身高4.05 cm,年龄5.17年,性别F1=0.971。五折CPU推理:CT 20秒/3.8 GB,MR 12秒/1.7 GB。联合多任务模型与独立单目标模型性能无显著差异(校正P≥0.589);但增加扩展目标使CT年龄MAE从4.02增至4.42年(P<0.001)。

Conclusion: 每个模态一个3D多任务集成模型可从异构CT和MR检查中快速恢复广泛的患者和采集特征,支持元数据质量控制和自动化影像处理流程。模型已开源至TotalSegmentator。但存在局限:部分真实标签来自DICOM元数据可能不准确;训练数据中未成年患者代表性不足;外部验证仅限小型CT队列。该工具旨在辅助而非替代临床精确测量,适用于存档管理、队列筛选、协议审查和管线路由等场景。

Abstract: Background: Patient details and acquisition metadata are important for clinical decisions, image quality control, and automated research pipelines, but may be missing or unreliable in imaging archives. Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fast open-source model that predicts patient and acquisition characteristics directly from CT and MR images. Materials and Methods: Separate 3D ResNet-10 ensembles for CT and MR were trained on 57,291 and 43,200 clinical examinations acquired from 2011 to 2025. Both predicted weight, height, age, sex, contrast presence, vertebral coverage, and image noise. The CT model additionally predicted scanner manufacturer, tube voltage, tube current, convolution kernel, and post-injection time; the MR model predicted sequence class. Performance was evaluated on internal CT (n=501) and MR (n=636) test sets and an external CT dataset (n=54). Results: Internal CT MAEs were 3.90 kg, 3.68 cm, and 4.42 years for weight, height, and age, with sex F1=0.990; corresponding MR results were 4.34 kg, 4.62 cm, 7.13 years, and F1=0.970. The CNN outperformed a segmentation-derived XGBoost baseline for all four core targets in both modalities (adjusted P<=.042). F1 scores were 0.963 for CT contrast, 0.953 for MR sequence, and 0.823 for MR contrast. External CT MAEs were 4.45 kg, 4.05 cm, and 5.17 years, with sex F1=0.971. CPU inference required 20 seconds for CT and 12 seconds for MR. Conclusion: One 3D multitask model per modality can rapidly recover patient and acquisition characteristics from heterogeneous CT and MR examinations. Models are available in TotalSegmentator: this https URL

</details>


### [324] [Cross-Relational Preference Learning for Better LLM Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29352)
*Runsheng Li,Kai Sun,Bin Shi,Bo Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CRPL框架，通过显式建模不同指令响应空间的关系（包含、部分重叠、不相交），结合原子约束验证机制，生成多样化高质量偏好数据，以增强复杂指令遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好学习方法在构建偏好对时忽视了不同指令允许响应空间之间的关系（如包含、部分重叠、不相交），导致偏好数据多样性不足，模型难以学习全面的约束变体，限制了对复杂指令的遵循能力。

Method: 1) Cross-Relationship Perturbation：按目标关系类型（包含、部分重叠、不相交）扰动约束，生成三种对应的扰动指令集；2) Cross-Region Pair Sampling：从组合响应空间的不同子区域系统采样正负样本对；3) Atomic Constraint-based Verification：为每个原子约束生成独立验证函数，通过执行测试保证可靠性，确保正样本严格来自指定区域。

Result: 在IFEval、IFBench、Perturbed-IF、FollowBench四个基准上，基于Qwen2.5-7B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B等模型，结合DPO、KTO及在线DPO策略，均显著优于AutoIF、Rejection Sampling、From Complex to Simple、UltraIF、SPAR、VerIF等基线。消融实验表明三种关系类型及跨区域采样均不可或缺，原子约束验证在零误判上优于LLM-as-Judge和指令级验证。

Conclusion: CRPL通过显式建模指令间响应空间的细粒度关系并辅以原子约束验证机制，能够生成高质量、多样化的偏好数据，在多种偏好学习方法与LLM骨干上均取得显著且泛化性强的指令遵循性能提升。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) still exhibit limited capability in following complex instructions. While existing approaches often rely on preference learning to enhance this ability, they typically overlook the relationships between the permissible response spaces of different instructions, which restricts a model to align with subtle and diverse constraint variations. To address this, we propose Cross-Relational Preference Learning (CRPL), a novel framework for constructing preference data that explicitly models inter-instruction relationships through two key techniques: Cross-Relationship Perturbation and Cross-Region Pair Sampling. This enables the generation of more diverse preference data that captures a wide spectrum of constraint variations. Additionally, we introduce an atomic constraint-based verification mechanism to rigorously assess response satisfaction, ensuring high-quality preference pair construction. Extensive experiments across multiple preference learning methods (e.g., DPO, KTO), LLM backbones and four instruction-following benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves substantial improvements over prior baselines and exhibits strong generalization.

</details>


### [325] [APPSolver: Adaptive Patch Partitioning for Point-Wise Ship Flow Prediction on Unstructured Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29355)
*Wenhua Huo,Fenglei Han,Wangyuan Zhao,Xiao Peng,Chunhui Wang,Jialin Wu,Jiayi Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: APPSolver提出了一种基于自适应分块划分(APP)的四叉树分词方法,用于船舶CFD非均匀点集的逐点流场预测。核心贡献是确定性距离细化分块表示,具有显式的精度-效率权衡:在模型前向计算上显著优于Transolver/UPT/GNOT(快4.7-19.2倍),但在一步预测精度上弱于持续性基线和学习型分词器,且未能建立准确的长时域动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 船舶CFD流场数据具有强非均匀性(船体附近精细、远场粗糙),直接在大型点集上使用注意力机制计算成本高昂。需要一种既能保留非均匀空间结构,又能降低计算开销,并能恢复全参考点集的表示方法。

Method: 核心方法为自适应分块划分(APP):基于距离船体参考点的距离细化四叉树,船体附近使用更细粒度patch、远场使用粗粒度patch;通过空间降采样构建定长patch token,经Transformer骨干网络预测后,使用距离加权k-NN插值恢复至全参考点集。支持多种条件编码器(零条件、数值MLP、Fourier MLP、FiLM、冻结Qwen2.5/3.5)。构建了ShipBench数据集(DTC、KCS、KVLCC2三个船型),并采用校正后的评估协议(自然相邻帧配对、复用训练集归一化统计、三个模型种子)。

Result: 在ShipBench上:持续性基线在三个船型上一步MAE均最低;学习型分词器(UPT/PCNO/Transolver)优于APP-Transformer。匹配消融实验中,自适应划分比均匀划分+学习型切片MAE降低16.4-24.9%。在DTC上APP-Transformer仅需1.815 GFLOPs、1.309 ms前向延迟,比Transolver快18.9倍、UPT快4.7倍、GNOT快19.2倍。条件编码器在留一船型评估中提供3-4.5%的MAE改善。50步自回归回滚中,所有学习模型累计MAE均高于持续性基线,无学习模型建立准确长时域动力学。

Conclusion: APP是一种紧凑的空间表示方法,具有显式的精度-效率权衡:计算效率显著优于学习型分词器,但预测精度不具普适优越性。当前绝对下一状态目标不足以建立准确的长时间跨度动力学,需要残差预测、多步训练或动力学感知目标。范围限于固定的非均匀2D水平切片,不包括自由表面、网格连接性或3D体积网格。

Abstract: Large non-uniform point sets make direct attention-based surrogate modeling costly for ship hydrodynamics. We introduce APPSolver, a point-wise flow-prediction framework built around Adaptive Patch Partitioning (APP), a deterministic quadtree representation for fixed two-dimensional horizontal slices extracted from ship CFD simulations. APP assigns finer patches near the hull and coarser patches farther away, downsamples patch contents, and recovers predictions to the full reference point set. Under a corrected protocol that constructs natural $(t,t+1)$ pairs before splitting, reuses training-set normalization statistics, and reports three model seeds, learned tokenizers are more accurate than APP-Transformer, and a persistence baseline has lower one-step MAE on all three ShipBench hulls. The supported benefit of APP is therefore computational rather than universal predictive superiority: on a representative DTC input, APP-Transformer requires 1.815 GFLOPs and 1.309 ms per model forward, while a matched ablation shows that adaptive partitioning reduces MAE by 16.4-24.9\% relative to a uniform partition augmented with learned slicing. Condition encoders provide setting-dependent gains in leave-one-hull-out evaluation, but the current absolute next-state objective does not establish accurate long-horizon dynamics. These results characterize APP as a compact spatial representation with an explicit accuracy--efficiency trade-off. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [326] [Plant-Inspired AI: Plants as Inspiration for Novel Problem Formulations, and Two Case Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29356)
*Deepayan Sanyal,Joel Michelson,Carla E. Cao,Adam B. Roddy,Maithilee Kunda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出从植物智能行为中汲取灵感，构建新型AI问题形式化（PF）的观点，并通过两个案例研究（Boquila trifoliolata的叶片拟态、根-茎协作生长）展示了如何将植物计算原理抽象为现有AI范式（监督学习、树搜索、约束满足等）尚未覆盖的新问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI中许多强大的问题形式化（如强化学习、最短路径、约束满足）均源自对生物智能（人类或动物）的研究。然而，植物作为地球上生物量最大、进化最成功的类群之一，其行为机制与动物截然不同——缺乏中枢神经系统、固着生长、通过分布式生化过程协调资源分配。作者认为，植物为AI提供了尚未被充分探索的、根本不同的感知、通信与决策抽象来源，可能催生新的问题形式化。

Method: 论文采用"植物行为→计算原理抽象→问题形式化→计算任务实例化"的框架：(1) 案例一（叶片拟态）：形式化为细胞图G=(C,E)在目标图T上的相似性最大化问题G*=argmax_G M(G,T)，关键问题特征为基质可塑性（substrate plasticity）和相对定位（relative localization）；以MNIST手写数字作为目标图像，设计细胞群体协同生长并模仿的任务。(2) 案例二（根-茎协作）：形式化为异质细胞群（根细胞与茎细胞）在资源分布环境中获取、存储、转移资源以最大化整体生长的问题O=N/(1+B)；关键问题特征为资源分配（resource allocation）和异质角色（heterogeneous roles）；设计了包含碳、阳光、氮、水四种营养素的网格环境基准任务。

Result: 论文提出了两个新颖的AI问题形式化：(1) 集体拟态PF——细胞通过局部感知和信号传递协同生长以模仿任意目标图像，强调感知与形态不可分离的特性；(2) 根-茎协作PF——异质细胞群通过局部资源感知、存储和交换实现整体最优生长。两个形式化均识别出此前未被现有AI范式显式处理的关键问题特征。同时，将这些形式化与多智能体POMDP、细胞自动机（如Neural CA、Biomaker CA）、自编码器、超分辨率等已有工作进行关联讨论，阐明其新颖之处。论文还列举了若干潜在应用场景（软件工程代码生成、城市设计、通信网络设计、能源系统设计），并指出尚缺乏评估PF质量的标准方法。

Conclusion: 植物启发的AI研究不仅有助于发现新的AI问题形式化，也可能为理解植物行为背后的计算架构提供新视角。两个案例研究表明，植物行为可以启发根本不同于现有AI范式的问题抽象。作者呼吁未来工作探索更多植物现象（如算术分配、模块化防御、荫蔽反应、寄生决策等）以构建更丰富的PF，并从细胞、器官、整株植物乃至植物-环境等多层次组织尺度进行探索。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has long been inspired by studies of biological intelligence. Reinforcement learning, for instance, drew inspiration from studies involving animal learning and is now a powerful paradigm for solving many real-world problems. Recently, plant biologists have uncovered a wide range of complex behaviors in plants that enable them to flexibly adapt to variable environments. Here, we argue that such behavior can motivate new AI frameworks encompassing a range of problems overlooked by existing problem-solving frameworks such as supervised learning, tree search, and constraint satisfaction. We illustrate this idea with two examples of intelligent problem-solving in plants: (1) leaf mimicry in Boquila trifoliolata, a vine capable of altering its leaves' morphology to resemble those of multiple host trees simultaneously; and (2) coordinated root-shoot growth, wherein plants allocate resources across organ systems exploring distinct environments. While leaf mimicry is highly specific to Boquila, coordination of root-shoot growth is shared across most plants. For both examples, we capture underlying computational principles and identify problems fitting these frameworks that are currently unaddressed by AI. Finally, we outline preliminary task formulations and discuss how these formulations may be applied to non-plant problems.

</details>


### [327] [LiteSearch-VL: Small Multimodal Search Agents via Trajectory Distillation and Synthetic Step-DPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29357)
*Saeed Khaki,Nima Safaei,Kamal Ginotra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 LiteSearch-VL：在单台八卡节点上，通过 OpenSearch-VL 轨迹 LoRA 微调，将 Qwen3-VL-2B/4B 改造成低成本多模态搜索代理。核心发现是，完整轨迹 SFT 首先让小模型学会“观察—工具调用—提交答案”的代理协议，使 2B 模型从几乎无法输出有效答案提升到 28.4% 宏平均 Pass@1；GPT-5 生成的局部难负例 DPO 和三工具蒸馏仅带来有限增益。VDR 上将步数从 5 增至 8 虽减少不答题，却主要将 no_answer 转化为 wrong_entity，表明小模型下一步瓶颈是证据交叉验证，而非搜索深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态搜索代理通常依赖闭源前沿模型，或使用大规模开放视觉语言模型、复杂代理数据和强化学习，训练与复现成本很高。论文关注一个更受限的问题：已发布的强代理轨迹究竟向 2B/4B 小模型传递了可复用的搜索知识，还是首先教会其遵循基本代理协议。其现实目标是建立单节点、低参数高效调优的实用方案。

Method: 研究以 Qwen3-VL-2B 和 4B 为骨干，仅训练 LoRA（视觉塔冻结、多模态投影层可训练）。数据来自 SearchVL-SFT-36k，经清理、分层划分及逐步展开，形成 133,439 个逐步样本；比较完整轨迹 SFT、逐步 SFT、三工具 SFT，以及在 SFT 基础上使用 GPT-5 合成难负例的 DPO。难负例覆盖提前作答、错误工具、弱查询、重复查询和忽略图像五类错误。评估覆盖 SimpleVQA、FVQA、LiveVQA、VDR-Bench-testmini，共 12,400 次代理 rollout，以 GPT-5 严格判断 Pass@1、部分得分与错误类型，并进行 VDR 步数预算消融。

Result: 2B 基座几乎不输出可用答案（1,240 次中 1,237 次 no_answer，宏平均 Pass@1 为 0.1%）；完整轨迹 SFT 后达到 28.4%，与 4B 基座的 25.6% 相当。4B SFT+DPO 是最佳配置，宏平均 Pass@1 为 30.8%，部分得分率为 37.1%。DPO 相对 SFT 的平均增益仅约 1.0（2B）和 1.7（4B）个百分点，且效果跨数据集不均。三工具接口在 2B 上降至 19.5%，在 4B 上为 27.2%，说明工具空间压缩存在容量依赖。VDR 步数由 5 增至 8 后，no_answer 明显下降，但各模型 Pass@1 变化不超过 1 个百分点，额外步骤主要产生 wrong_entity。

Conclusion: 在受限计算预算下，开放代理轨迹对 2B 模型最重要的价值不是直接传递事实搜索能力，而是使其学会完整的代理行为契约：调用工具、处理观察、在证据充分时以规定格式终止。DPO 和工具蒸馏是补充性改进，DPO 适合作为 SFT 后的局部行为精调，而非替代 SFT。当前小模型的主要缺陷是从“拒绝作答”转为自信地选错实体；未来应加入二次验证、过程奖励模型、证据一致性检查和真实在线偏好学习。该结论尤其提醒部署方，小型多模态搜索代理生成的内容不能视为已验证事实。

Abstract: Multimodal search agents answer visual questions by interleaving image understanding, web retrieval, tool use, and evidence synthesis. Strong systems exist, but in two expensive regimes: proprietary frontier models such as GPT-5 and Gemini, or large open vision-language backbones trained with substantial agentic data and reinforcement learning. We ask a different question: when released agent trajectories are distilled into much smaller backbones under a single-node budget, what is actually transferred? We study this with LiteSearch-VL, a low-compute recipe for Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B that uses only released OpenSearch-VL trajectories, parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, and synthetic step-level preferences: DPO on GPT-5-generated hard negatives targeting five local failure modes (premature answer, wrong tool, weak query, repeated query, ignored image). Across 12,400 GPT-5-judged rollouts on SimpleVQA, FVQA, LiveVQA, and VDR-Bench-testmini, the dominant effect is behavioral rather than a uniform accuracy lift: full-trajectory supervised fine-tuning transfers the agent contract, taking the 2B model from almost never emitting a usable answer (1,237/1,240 no_answer rollouts) to 28.4% macro Pass@1, matching or slightly exceeding the off-the-shelf 4B base (25.6%). Synthetic preference learning and compact tool distillation act as refinements rather than phase transitions (best 4B configuration: 30.8% macro Pass@1). Finally, a controlled VDR step-budget ablation shows that extra search turns convert abstentions into wrong_entity errors rather than correct answers, identifying answer verification, not search depth, as the next bottleneck for small multimodal agents.

</details>


### [328] [TRACER: Per-Tool Context Retention for LLM Agents via Consequence-Attributed Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29363)
*Ziqi Lin,Ye Wu,Mengying Yang,Xu Liu,Yizhou Liu,Qiang Ke,Qin Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACER 提出了一种面向LLM智能体的逐工具上下文保留强化学习框架，通过REINFORCE策略和反事实信用分配，在保持任务成功率的同时将token消耗降低29–46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业数据智能体在多步工具调用过程中上下文窗口可累积至数十万token，现有压缩策略忽视了下游重调用成本，导致"压缩–后果差距"——激进压缩触发的工具重调用可能抵消初始节省。

Method: 将上下文压缩建模为序列逐工具决策问题：(1) 使用Beta分布参数化的轻量MLP策略网络输出每个工具输出的连续保留比率；(2) 设计后果感知奖励，联合考虑任务成功率、token消耗和压缩后工具重调用惩罚；(3) 引入两通道信用分配（均匀惩罚下限+学习的结果模型反事实归因），通过单工具反事实比较预测后果差，缓解REINFORCE的信用分配问题。

Result: 在生产数据智能体（120个查询，三种压缩器后端）上TRACER减少29–46% token消耗并保持或提升任务成功率；相对工具类型条件静态策略额外节省15–18% token；归因模块使成功率提升2.2–4.8pp；干预性回滚验证信用分数与真实单工具后果相关性Spearman ρ=0.66；策略零样本迁移到GPT-5.5和Qwen-3.7-Max骨架上保留62–87%训练收益；在LOCA-bench五个留出环境上节省18–25% token。

Conclusion: 逐工具、后果感知的上下文保留策略能显著提升长视野语言智能体的效率；信用分配中的反事实归因机制对在保持任务成功率的同时实现压缩至关重要；学习到的保留策略在不同智能体骨架和压缩器架构间具有跨域迁移能力。

Abstract: Enterprise data agents answer business queries by chaining many tool calls over multiple reasoning steps, routinely accumulating hundreds of thousands of context tokens per session. Existing compression strategies typically allocate retention budgets without accounting for the downstream consequences of removing individual tool outputs. Aggressive compression may therefore trigger costly tool re-invocations that offset the initial savings. We call this the compression--consequence gap. To close it, we propose TRACER, which formulates compression as a sequential per-tool decision problem. A lightweight REINFORCE policy assigns query-conditioned retention ratios using only information available at each compression event. Its consequence-aware objective jointly accounts for task success, total token consumption, and post-compression tool re-invocations. To improve credit assignment, TRACER uses a learned outcome model to compare the predicted consequences of the selected retention ratio with those of fully retaining each tool output. On held-out production queries across three compressor backends, TRACER reduces total token consumption by 29--46% relative to keeping all context while maintaining comparable or higher task success. Compared with a tool-type-conditional static policy, TRACER provides an additional 15--18% of token savings. Interventional rollouts show that the learned per-tool credit scores correlate with measured single-tool consequences. The learned policy also yields positive savings when transferred across agent backbones and compressor architectures, and reduces token consumption by 18--25% on five held-out LOCA-bench environments. These results demonstrate the value of consequence-aware, per-tool context retention for improving the efficiency of long-horizon language agents.

</details>


### [329] [Reviving our data foundations is the most disruptive step to data maturity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29368)
*Valentina Carapella,Ernesto Jimenez-Ruiz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 中小型企业迈向AI成熟的最具颠覆性一步，是回归并重塑稳健的知识基础。该文为愿景声明，提出以知识图谱技术为核心、模块化、动态且低侵入性的数据策略，并强调跨职能语义对齐，以最小投入获取最大数据治理收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业在AI浪潮中频繁因忽视数据基础而失败。高层管理者倾向于关注短期ROI，难以推动技术债务式的根基性建设；同时，学术研究与业务KPI之间存在脱节，导致基础数据工作难以获得支持。

Method: 以数据网格（Data Mesh）为框架，结合本体（Ontology）与知识图谱技术，从三个维度提出路径：(1) 面向流程与工作流的本体建模；(2) 模块化、极简的跨部门本体设计；(3) 跨职能的本体对齐。技术上依托语义提升、模块化知识图谱网络及智能体协商对齐机制。

Result: 论文作为愿景声明，未提供实验性结果，但综述了BPMN形式化、生成式AI辅助语义提升、模块化KG及智能体协商对齐等相关研究趋势，论证了所提方向的技术可行性。

Conclusion: 数据成熟度是AI成功落地的基石。对资源有限的成长型企业而言，最大化收益的路径在于：轻量化建模流程与工作流、采用模块化设计、并强化跨职能语义映射。最具颠覆性的行动恰是克制对炒作的追逐，回归数据基础的巩固。

Abstract: The most disruptive step that enterprises of small-medium size and maturity can take to make the most of the latest technological advances in AI is to step back from the hype and focus on establishing or reviving a good knowledge foundation layer. It is a hard message to present to the executive team; therefore, it needs to be backed by evidence, and its implementation needs to be of minimal impact on the existing processes. In this vision statement, we discuss how we need to rethink what evidence speaks to the decision-makers and propose a low-impact data strategy that adapts to the existing and ever-changing data flows and processes across the company. We firmly believe that knowledge graph techniques will increasingly become non-negotiable in the data strategy of an AI-powered enterprise, provided that we approach their design in a modular, dynamic and cross-functional way.

</details>


### [330] [FORESIGHT-9: Prospective and Process-Aware Evaluation of Adaptive Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29372)
*Xiangxin Luo,Chengtian Hong,Haohua Li,Yongyi Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FORESIGHT-9是一个针对自适应交易智能体的前瞻性、过程感知型评估基准，替代传统单路径回测，通过九条从2026年7月共同信息边界分支的反事实压力场景线（涵盖地缘冲突、技术分裂、核升级、主权债务危机、货币秩序混乱、通胀重燃、金融体系脆弱、能源危机、疫情/自动化等），结合时间门控观测泄露、确定性轨迹生成器和统一的智能体保留评估契约，评估两种自适应交易智能体框架（AlphaCrafter和FactorMiner）在两种基础模型骨干（gpt-5.6-terra和deepseek-v4-flash）下的2×2×9=36个长周期运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统回测存在三大缺陷：无法排除历史污染（可能过拟合单一实现路径）、无法揭示对单一市场路径的敏感性、以及无法暴露长周期适应过程中的内部退化。论文动机是构建一个能够同时评估策略结果与适应过程一致性的基准，揭示终端收益所掩盖的智能体状态与执行行为的失效问题。

Method: 方法包括：（1）构建九条从2026-07-15共同信息边界分支的反事实世界线，每条包含4-5个分阶段宏观金融事件和多资产联合锚点；（2）采用种子化布朗桥（Karatzas-Shreve公式）在阶段端点间插值生成确定性轨迹，新闻事件遵循价格领先新闻规则；（3）设计统一评估契约（15个可交易资产+5个仅观测信号、10交易日决策网格、多头完全投资组合、3bps单边成本、迁移门槛e>3τ），同时保留智能体原生搜索和自适应机制；（4）通过五个过程可观测指标（库大小L_t、库变动率C_t、新因子准入率A_t、声明与执行权重偏差D_t、与等权重回退距离F_t）评估研究状态、声明决策状态与执行状态三者的一致性；（5）评估两个框架在两个基础模型下的36次长周期运行至2035-12-31。

Result: 关键结果：（1）智能体排名在不同世界线和模型骨干间大幅变化，FM在terra骨干下均值收益最高（+77.8%）但DS下最低（+29.7%），AC则相反；（2）固定等权重策略EW-15以+71.2%均值收益在36次运行中胜过其中31次，窗口级命中率约47.7%（聚类自举p<10⁻⁴），表明正绝对收益本身并不证明自适应价值；（3）过程遥测揭示AC-DS在WL8运行中活体因子库衰减至零，决策记录仍引用三因子组合，但执行持仓因22%单资产上限约束收敛至精确等权重（1/15），而该世界线EW-15回报+98.2%、该运行+86.3%；（4）交易成本在9.5年内至多仅占初始资本的126bps，无法解释收益分散。

Conclusion: FORESIGHT-9证明应将长周期金融智能体评估为持续决策系统而非仅按终端投资组合得分排名：跨替代市场未来的稳健性与适应状态与执行行为的一致性是回测所压缩的两个关键维度。正收益可与预期自适应机制的失效共存（表现为声明与执行状态的解耦），而简单的等权重基线在多数运行中具有竞争力，这推动了对金融智能体进行前瞻性多场景和过程感知评估的必要性。

Abstract: Retrospective backtests provide a limited test of adaptive trading agents: they cannot rule out historical contamination, expose sensitivity to a single realized market path, or reveal internal degeneration during long-horizon adaptation. We introduce FORESIGHT-9, a prospective and process-aware benchmark built from nine auditable counterfactual stress worldlines branching from a common July 2026 information boundary. Each worldline specifies staged macro-financial events and joint multi-asset anchors; a deterministic generator realizes the trajectories, while observations are disclosed according to in-world time. A common contract standardizes observations and execution while preserving each agent's native adaptation loop. We evaluate two adaptive trading-agent frameworks with two foundation-model backbones across 36 long-horizon runs. Agent rankings vary substantially across worldlines and backbones, and a fixed equal-weight policy outperforms 31 of 36 runs. Process telemetry exposes failures that terminal returns conceal: in one high-return run, the live factor library collapsed while executed holdings converged to the equal-weight fallback, even though decision records continued to report an active factor ensemble. FORESIGHT-9 therefore evaluates not only portfolio outcomes, but whether adaptive agent state and execution remain coherent across alternative futures. We release the worldlines, trajectories, audit traces, and regeneration scripts.

</details>


### [331] [Evaluating Tiny Recursive Models Across Training for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29376)
*Anjani Sirivella,Aanisha Newaz,Glaucia Melo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对自然语言到Python代码生成任务，提出应跨训练轨迹（而非单一checkpoint）联合评估递归模型的"教师强制拟合"与"自由生成"能力。作者比较了约28M参数的自回归Tiny Recursive Model (TRM-AR) 与两个匹配对照（参数匹配的vanilla-2L、深度匹配的vanilla-20L），在tiny-codes语料上追踪40个epoch、3个种子的训练动态。核心发现：(1) 等参数下，TRM-AR在拟合、生成和泛化上均优于vanilla-2L，闭合了约45%验证损失差距和57%生成质量差距，但每步计算成本约为vanilla-2L的175倍；(2) 等有效深度下，vanilla-20L在其验证最优checkpoint上拟合和生成均更优；(3) TRM-AR与vanilla-20L的拟合排名在训练中发生两次反转，表明单一checkpoint比较会产生误导。论文主张递归模型的效率优势来自抗过拟合（隐式正则化），而非更强的建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型代码生成模型成本高昂，在数据有限时尤其需要小模型。递归模型通过权重共享复用单一块来增加深度，是一种有前景的小模型方案。然而现有评估多在单一checkpoint上报告教师强制拟合或任务准确率，而代码生成需要自由生成模式（模型基于自身输出扩展），且模型行为随训练变化。这引发两个未解决的问题：教师强制下的优势能否在自由生成中保持？该优势是否在整个训练过程中成立？因此需要跨训练轨迹联合评估两种指标。

Method: 实验设计为受控的多epoch交叉曲线（crossover-curve）研究，比较三个架构臂：(1) TRM-AR：递归复用2层共享块，实现有效深度20，参数约28M，使用深度监督（3步）；(2) vanilla-2L：2层独立transformer，参数匹配对照；(3) vanilla-20L：20层独立transformer，有效深度匹配对照。数据集为tiny-codes的Python子集，经GPT-2分词、长度≤512过滤、80/10/10划分，共47,649条记录。训练采用AdamW（lr=1e-4）、flat-after-warmup学习率调度、EMA权重平均，batch=48，fp32，40 epoch，3种子（42/65/108）。评估指标包括教师强制拟合（测试困惑度）、自由生成（50条测试提示×5次采样，温度0.8，top-k=40）：AST解析率、BLEU-4、Claude Haiku 4.5 LLM评分（语法/逻辑/相关性，0-10）。在9个epoch checkpoint快照（{1,2,4,8,12,16,20,28,40}）上测量，按验证损失选择报告checkpoint。计算成本报告为测量值而非匹配值：TRM-AR每步约3.0s（175×于vanilla-2L的0.017s，2.4×于vanilla-20L的1.25s）。

Result: 验证选择checkpoint的排序：vanilla-20L > TRM-AR > vanilla-2L（拟合和生成均如此）。等参数对比：TRM-AR在所有9个snapshot的验证损失和测试困惑度上均优于vanilla-2L（9/9种子一致），差距从epoch 1的约1.0缩小到epoch 40的约0.1；生成质量从epoch 4起TRM-AR领先（9/9）；泛化差距TRM-AR最小。等深度对比：拟合排名在epoch 8和epoch 40发生两次反转，epoch 40的反转是vanilla-20L过拟合导致的伪胜；vanilla-20L在其epoch 20最优checkpoint上拟合（val loss 1.154 vs 1.277）和生成（3.12 vs 2.85）均优于TRM-AR。vanilla-20L从epoch 20到40，验证损失从1.15升至1.45，但judge分仅从3.12降至3.01，呈现拟合-生成解耦。TRM-AR训练损失最高但泛化差距最小，呈隐式正则化特征。BLEU-4无稳定方向差异。

Conclusion: 本文得出三方面结论：(1) 评估方法论上，单一checkpoint比较会产生误导，递归模型的架构排名随训练时间变化，应联合报告教师强制拟合和自由生成跨整个训练轨迹；(2) 在等参数预算下，TRM-AR配置（递归深度+深度监督）是更参数高效的设计，拟合、生成和泛化均优于参数匹配对照，但每步计算成本高约175倍；(3) 在等有效深度下，更大的标准transformer在验证最优checkpoint上拟合和生成更优，递归模型的仅存优势是抗过拟合（隐式正则化效应），而非更强的建模能力。实践建议：数据有限且参数预算固定时选递归模型；推理延迟主导时选更大的标准transformer。未来工作包括消融深度监督的独立贡献、扩展至更大模型和pass@k指标、以及检验轨迹依赖排名是否为递归模型的普遍性质。

Abstract: Code generation increasingly relies on large transformer models, whose capability advances with scale. Yet such a scale is costly, creating demand for small models, especially where data is limited. Recursive models address this by reusing a single block to add depth rather than stacking independent layers. Such models are typically evaluated by teacher-forced fit (next-token loss on ground-truth prefixes) or task accuracy, at a single checkpoint, whereas code is produced by free-running generation, where the model extends its own output. Whether a teacher-forced advantage survives free-running generation, and whether it holds across training, remains open. To study both, we compare a ~28M-parameter autoregressive Tiny Recursive Model (TRM-AR) on natural-language-to-Python code generation against parameter-matched and depth-matched controls, tracking fit and generation across 40 epochs and three seeds. The fit ranking between the recursive model and the depth-matched control reverses twice. Selecting each checkpoint by validation loss and examining the trajectory yields a consistent comparison. At equal parameters, TRM-AR fits, generates, and generalizes better than the parameter-matched control while recovering approximately 45% of the validation-loss gap and 57% of the generation-quality gap between the two controls, at roughly 175 times the per-step cost of the parameter-matched control. However, at equal effective depth, the larger transformer fits and generates better at its validation optimum, suggesting TRM-AR's advantage lies in resistance to overfitting, not greater capability. These findings suggest that recursive code generation models should be evaluated jointly on fit and generation across the training trajectory rather than at a single checkpoint.

</details>


### [332] [EvoGenUI-Bench: Evaluating LLMs as Multi-Turn Generative UI Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29387)
*Yue Peng,Lanke Xia,Zihan Wang,Jiahao Ye,Ke Ning,Hongyi Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 EvoGenUI-Bench，一个用于评估大语言模型作为多轮生成式 UI 助手的多轮可执行界面维护基准测试，包含 150 个五轮任务、750 个轮次，涵盖信息呈现、可执行交互和工具支撑的外部状态三大场景。它通过浏览器执行生成产物，结合截图、源代码、DOM、交互轨迹和运行时日志进行多面证据评估，并提出 Turn Pass、TP@5、CPT 以及新指标 Adjacent Pass Retention (APR) 来衡量跨轮保留能力。在八个模型的测试中，最强的模型也仅取得 74.9% 的轮次通过率，而完成全部五轮的任务仅占 37.3%，工具支撑场景下 APR 进一步下降至 52.4%。诊断分析表明，呈现类失败源于信息架构，交互类失败源于派生状态传播与功能绑定，工具支撑类失败额外涉及外部状态对齐与需求分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式 UI 基准测试主要评估单次生成或孤立轮次的质量，无法反映用户需求在多轮对话中逐步演化时，模型是否能在持续修订同一个可执行界面的同时保持其行为、可见状态以及与助手回复的一致性。同时，现有的工具使用与代理评估将界面构建与任务执行分离，难以衡量生成式 UI 在状态、派生视图和外部系统之间的同步可靠性。因此，需要一个能够在多轮累积修订条件下，系统性地测试界面维护可靠性与失败机制的基准。

Method: 1) 构建 150 个五轮任务、750 个轮次、覆盖三种场景（信息呈现、可执行交互、工具支撑）的多轮界面维护基准，分离 generator 可见请求与私有验证合同；2) 在浏览器中实际执行每轮生成的源代码，收集截图、DOM、源码、交互轨迹、工具与运行时日志的多面证据；3) 使用基于模型的评估器对 Presentation、Execution、Alignment 三维度各以 1–5 分打分，三项均≥4 视为该轮通过；4) 提出三级可靠性指标——轮级 Turn Pass (TP)、episode 级 TP@5 与 Consecutive Passed Turns (CPT)、转移级 Adjacent Pass Retention (APR)；5) 对所有执行的未通过调用进行六类诊断失败归因（信息架构、领域表征、需求分解、功能绑定、派生状态传播、外部状态对齐），并通过盲法人类验证。

Result: 在八个模型上，最强模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 总体 TP 为 74.9%、TP@5 仅 37.3%、APR 为 83.6%；模型平均 TP 为 42.7%，TP@5 仅为 11.8%，表明单轮成功并不能可靠地转化为完整 episode 成功。工具支撑场景最难，平均 TP 25.0%、TP@5 5.0%，APR 52.4%。在条件于上一轮通过的情况下，APR 仍呈 呈现(71.1%) > 交互(68.7%) > 工具支撑(52.4%) 的顺序。可靠性在第二轮之后显著下降，第三轮通过率跌至 39.4%，第四轮 35.1%，工具支撑场景下从第二轮的 39.5% 骤降至第三轮的 18.5%。评估器对人类多数票标注的准确率为 86.7%，Cohen's κ=0.73；actor 轨迹是单类证据中最关键的，移除后准确率从 87.5% 降至 55.0%。诊断归因显示：呈现类失败以信息架构为主，交互类以派生状态传播和功能绑定为主，工具支撑类额外涉及外部状态对齐和需求分解。

Conclusion: 本文通过 EvoGenUI-Bench 把生成式 UI 评估从评判孤立输出重新定位为检验界面行为、派生状态、外部状态与助手陈述在产物演化过程中是否保持同步。实验表明，强大的单轮性能并不等同于持续的多轮可靠性，工具支撑场景尤其困难。不同失败机制需要不同证据来诊断：截图揭示视觉与组织缺陷，actor 轨迹与源码差异揭示交互断裂与陈旧派生状态，运行时日志揭示界面与外部系统之间的不一致。因此，生成式 UI 评估应同时结合结果级可靠性指标与机制级诊断。

Abstract: Large language models can generate interactive web interfaces, but reliable generative UI requires maintaining an executable artifact as user requests evolve. We introduce EvoGenUI-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn interface maintenance comprising 150 five-turn tasks and 750 turns across three scenarios: information presentation, executable interaction, and tool-grounded external state. We execute generated artifacts in a browser and evaluate them using screenshots, source and DOM evidence, actor traces, and runtime logs. Beyond turn-level and episode-level success, we measure cross-turn retention with Adjacent Pass Retention. Across eight models, even the strongest achieves 74.9% Turn Pass while completing only 37.3% of five-turn episodes; APR further falls to 52.4% on tool-grounded tasks. Diagnostic analysis shows that presentation failures center on information architecture, interaction failures on derived-state propagation and affordance binding, and tool-grounded failures additionally involve external-state grounding and requirement decomposition. These results reframe generative UI evaluation from judging isolated outputs to testing whether interface behavior, derived state, external state, and assistant claims remain synchronized as the artifact evolves.

</details>


### [333] [Toward Latent Language Model Skills Steering and Optimization: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29459)
*Xunyi Jiang,Junda Wu,Yuxin Xiong,Sheldon Yu,Tong Yu,David Arbour,Ritwik Sinha,Julian McAuley,Hongyi Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一项实证研究，探讨大语言模型(LLM)的过程性技能(procedural skills)是否可以表示为激活空间中的方向，并通过对这些方向进行向量空间操作来表达技能级行为。研究构建了SkillSet-Math和SkillSet-Code两个受控基准，从四个可观察属性——可操控性(steerability)、组合性(composition)、个性化(personalization)和演化(evolution)——系统验证了过程性技能在LLM内部激活空间中具有结构化的潜在向量组织，可通过内部干预直接操控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常将LLM技能视为通过提示或程序显式指定的表层构造，而关于这些过程性能力在模型内部如何表示、以及是否能在潜在空间中作为结构化对象被操控的问题尚未得到解答。激活引导(activation steering)先前工作主要针对风格化或属性级变化（如语气、人物角色、拒绝行为），并未直接控制过程性技能（如任务执行模式）。

Method: 方法核心是将LLM过程性技能形式化为激活空间中的层间干预向量(latent skill direction)，通过在隐藏状态上添加该方向的标量倍数实现技能操控。定义包含有效性(valid direction)、可操控性(steerability)、向量空间组合(composition)、个性化(personalization)和非单调演化(evolution)五个核心概念。提取方法采用两种方案：(1)对数学技能使用单类PCA(从居中隐藏状态提取第一主成分)，(2)对配对的算法策略(如DFS vs BFS)使用对比均值差(contrastive mean-difference)。在推理时，对最后一层50%的层施加加性干预，并在最后一个预填充token和每个生成token处触发。优化阶段使用Reference-free Preference Steering (RePS)进行200步梯度优化。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 可操控性——在Qwen3-0.6B上，PCA提取的技能方向在SkillSet-Math的34个技能中改善了29个，平均提升19.1个百分点；该方向可迁移到GSM8K/MATH500，在10个(模型,数据集)组合中有8个匹配或超过零样本基线。(2) 组合性——向量空间组合在18个复合技能中的13个上取得最高准确率(平均77.1% vs 基线51.9%)，优于基于文本的组合(Txt-C: 75.7%, Txt-CoT: 74.2%)；该结果在Llama-2-7B-chat上复现。(3) 个性化——对比方向使Qwen3-0.6B在三种算法类别(图搜索16.7%→33.3%、动态规划/递归16.7%→41.7%、数据结构/字符串16.7%→45.8%)上的方法匹配率显著提升。(4) 演化——在18个(配对,模型)设置中有14个，最佳方法匹配率出现在第200步之前而非收敛点；早期检查点(如DFS vs BFS在第20步达24%后降至18%)往往优于完全优化的解。

Conclusion: 研究支持对过程性LLM技能采取表征级视角(representation-level view)：这些技能在模型激活中具有潜在向量空间组织，允许通过内部干预直接操控。这将模型控制从表层提示转向表征级技能控制。局限性包括：组合研究仅考虑等权重加性组合，未探索更丰富的向量算术(如v(multi_digit_add) - v(single_digit_add) + v(single_digit_mul))；声明受限于受控的SkillSet基准和Qwen3/Llama-2模型族。

Abstract: Skills, as a useful abstraction for the procedural capabilities of large language models (LLMs), capture how models perform structured, multi-step reasoning and program execution. Existing approaches typically treat skills as explicit, surface-level constructs specified through prompts or programs, leaving open the question of how such procedural capabilities are represented inside the model and whether they can be manipulated as structured objects in latent space. In this empirical study, we investigate whether procedural LLM skills can be represented as directions in activation space and whether vector-space operations over these directions can express skill-level behaviors. We find that procedural skills admit a vector-space representation: individual skill directions can be activated to shift model behavior; independently extracted directions can compose to form higher-level skills. Contrastive directions yield context-conditioned algorithmic personalization and optimization trajectories over skill directions evolve non-monotonically, with intermediate states often surpassing fully optimized solutions. These results support a representation-level view of procedural LLM skills: they admit a latent vector-space organization that allows direct manipulation through internal interventions.

</details>


### [334] [Can escalation channels redirect reward hacking toward defect disclosure?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29460)
*Francesca Gomez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了"升级通道"(escalation channels)作为一种决策环境干预手段,在编码智能体面对缺陷性测试环境时,能否同时减少奖励黑客行为并暴露触发该行为的底层缺陷。通过2×2析因实验,跨8个前沿模型测试了升级工具与反奖励黑客策略的组合效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体在遇到有缺陷的测试基础设施时,可能通过硬编码输出或修改测试文件来通过它们本不应通过的测试——这种"缺陷驱动的规范博弈"模式已在OpenAI/Hugging Face入侵事件中大规模出现。本文认为,智能体检测和利用缺陷的能力同样可以用于报告缺陷,只要决策环境支持这种选择。因此,作者评估升级通道作为推理时干预(无需重训练)的效果。

Method: 采用2×2析因设计,操纵两个变量:(1)升级通道(submit_escalation_report工具);(2)反奖励黑客策略文档。使用EvilGenie基准中9个"模糊"问题(检查器拒绝合法解)作为实验材料,9个"明确"问题作为负对照。在8个前沿模型(涵盖Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、xAI、Moonshot五大家族)上运行,每格45个episode,共1800个析因episode。奖励黑客通过两种结构独立通道检测:GPT-4o代码检查判断器(读取最终提交代码)和工具级审计(检测test.py/test_cases.json修改)。使用混合效应逻辑回归分析结果,并通过GLM-5.2交叉验证解决方案正确性验证器。

Result: 组合干预(策略+升级通道)将奖励黑客率从23.6%降至5.3%(混合效应逻辑OR=9.18,95% CI 5.01-16.83, p<10⁻¹²),6/8模型完全消除黑客行为。解决率无显著变化(A=50.6% vs D=52.5%, p=0.595),成本亦无可检测增加。96.8%的升级事件不伴随黑客行为(接近完全互斥)。在诊断价值上,升级通道在监控基础上额外增加10.1百分点的缺陷检测覆盖率,且触发后诊断准确率达99.4%(vs 监控85.8%)。Gemini系列模型对干预最具抗性,占组合干预下残余黑客的100%。仅靠prompt指令(E条件)效果有限(降至16.9%),且成本更高。

Conclusion: 升级通道通过"重定向"而非"抑制"起作用——升级的智能体不会继续黑客,且无性能或成本损失。然而,仅提供升级通道不足够;只有将其与明确的反黑客策略配对,才能最大化使用率并最小化黑客行为。本文提出"智能体基础设施"应以人为中心的设计类比:关键不在于替代行动是否可用,而在于决策环境是否使其成为智能体选择的行为。与基于遏制的方法不同,升级通道将能力增长转化为更多可重定向的资源,使设计问题从"如何阻止智能体发现漏洞"转变为"如何设计决策环境,使报告成为首选行动"。局限性包括问题集较小(9个)、系统提示在B/D之间未完全交叉、训练倾向可能影响效果、工具集不对称等。

Abstract: When coding agents encounter defective test infrastructure they may reward-hack: hardcoding outputs or editing test files to pass tests they cannot legitimately satisfy, a pattern that has now appeared outside benchmarks, in a coordinated multi-agent intrusion of a major AI platform's production infrastructure. The same capability that lets an agent detect and exploit a defect could let it report one, given the right decision environment. We evaluate escalation channels, structured reporting tools available to the agent at the point of conflict, as a decision-environment intervention that both reduces reward hacking and surfaces the infrastructure defects that trigger it. A $2 \times 2$ factorial separates the contributions of an escalation tool, a standalone anti-reward-hacking policy, and their combination. Across 8 frontier models spanning 5 families, the combined intervention reduces reward hacking from 23.6\% to 5.3\% (mixed-effects logistic OR = 9.2, 95\% CI 5.0--16.8, $p < 10^{-12}$) with no detectable cost or performance overhead, eliminating it entirely for 6 of 8 models. Escalation and hacking are near-perfectly mutually exclusive, with 96.8\% of escalations involving no hacking. Beyond reduction, escalation channels function as diagnostic infrastructure: on top of monitoring, escalation adds +10.1 percentage points of defect detection coverage and is more accurate once it fires (99.4\% vs 85.8\%). Unlike containment-based approaches that risk outpacing growing model capabilities, escalation channels redirect capability toward disclosure rather than exploitation.

</details>


### [335] [Call Neighbours Yourself: Graph Walks with Destination-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29588)
*Yilun Liu,Boyu Luo,Yanran Tang,Ruihong Qiu,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CNY（Call Neighbours Yourself）框架，将大语言模型在文本属性图（TAG）上的推理从"先生成后获取邻居"转变为"边推理边主动探索邻居"的图游走过程。其核心贡献在于目标条件在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）机制，通过在揭示目的节点内容后对游走动作进行回溯评估来提供动作级训练信号，从而解决了图游走中的延迟信用分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based TAG方法在生成前固定邻居集合，导致推理只能基于静态上下文，无法在推理过程中获取缺失证据。对于密集TAG（如WikiCS），40.3%的目标节点的一跳邻域超过32K token窗口，子集预选策略容易遗漏关键证据，邻居选择质量直接决定预测准确性。

Method: 1. 交互式图环境：LLM观测ego节点文本与邻居预览，通过<walk>动作主动揭示邻居全文本并扩展前沿节点
2. 分级奖励设计（0-1.0）：综合正确性、动作格式、有效证据获取与答案完成度
3. GRPO训练基础：组内奖励标准化得到轨迹级优势
4. OPSD自蒸馏机制：在游走揭示目标节点后，构建目标摘要作为教师上下文，重新计分游走动作的log概率差δ_t，将其作为加性信用叠加到walk动作token的GRPO优势上

Result: CNY-7B/14B在Cora、WikiCS、Products、FB15K237、Expla-Graph五个零样本基准上均超越所有基线（包括Graph-R1、TRN-R1-Zero等固定上下文后训练方法）。在WebQSP多跳知识图谱问答上零样本达到58.4% Hits@1（vs 仅看预览的38.5%）。在五个基座模型（Llama-3.2-3B到Qwen-14B）上均稳定提升。OPSD使跨域精度持续高于GRPO消融（β=0），β从0增至0.03使WikiCS精度从69.5%升至75.1%。

Conclusion: CNY证明图推理的效能不仅取决于对证据的解释，还取决于推理过程中的自适应证据获取能力。学习到的游走策略可零样本迁移至未见图和未见的图级任务，为LLM-based图推理提供了一种新的范式。

Abstract: Reasoning over text-attributed graphs (TAGs) requires large language models (LLMs) to combine a node's text with evidence distributed across its neighbourhood. Existing methods fix the set of accessible neighbours before generation, forcing reasoning to operate over a static context and preventing the model from acquiring missing evidence during inference. We argue that neighbour selection should itself be part of the reasoning process. To this end, we propose Call Neighbours Yourself (CNY), a framework that enables LLMs to proactively explore graph neighbourhoods through topology-constrained graph-walk actions. Instead of reasoning over a pre-selected neighbour set, CNY exposes lightweight neighbour previews and learns when to expand candidate neighbours for additional evidence. To address the delayed-credit challenge of neighbour exploration, we introduce destination-conditioned on-policy self-distillation, which retrospectively evaluates a selected neighbour after its content is revealed and converts the resulting change in action preference into an action-level training signal. Experiments on standard TAG reasoning benchmarks under a unified raw-text setting show that CNY consistently outperforms fixed-context post-training baselines. Furthermore, the learned exploration policy transfers to unseen graphs and to a graph-level task not encountered during training. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [336] [Not Safe for All: Auditing the Dialect Penalty in Text-to-Image Safety Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29589)
*Minkyu Kim,Juhwan Choi,YoungBin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统审计了文本到图像（T2I）安全管线对五种非标准英语方言（AAVE、ChcE、CollSgE、IndE、JamE）的公平性差异，提出"方言惩罚"概念：安全过滤器基于语言表面特征而非语义意图进行干预。文本级过滤器呈现方向性失败（NSFW-T和LatentGuard过度标记，OMod检测不足），而像素级生成器基本对方言无感知；通过错字消融和平衡训练分析证实该偏差源于SAE中心化训练数据不平衡，可通过组平衡采样缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前T2I安全防护栏主要针对标准美式英语（SAE）设计，对非标准方言的公平性失效问题尚未被系统研究；现有多模态T2I安全研究缺乏对语言内部方言变体引发的系统性公平性失败的深入探讨。

Method: 构建23,080对配对提示数据集（5种方言×有毒/良性），采用少样本提示（EnDive协议）翻译SAE基础提示；评估三种文本级过滤器（NSFW-T、LatentGuard、OMod）和两种后置防护栏（PromptGuard、SLD）；使用幅度匹配的错字消融（基于CLIP嵌入距离二分搜索）将方言偏差与一般OOD噪声分离；通过ERM、ERM+平衡采样和GroupDRO对比实验分析缓解机制。

Result: 1. 文本级过滤器呈方向性失败：NSFW-T对良性ChcE过度标记（+28.17pp FPR），LatentGuard对毒性AAVE过度标记（+15.12pp TPR），OMod对毒性AAVE检测不足（-3.11pp TPR）；2. 错字消融证实方言惩罚源自方言特征而非一般OOD敏感度（最大偏差差距+28.29pp）；3. 未受防护的Stable Diffusion 1.4生成基本对方言无感知（视觉评估分数偏移<1.89）；4. PromptGuard继承过度审查（OCR偏移高达+29.58pp），SLD表现稳健；5. 100% SAE训练下最差组准确率降至68.17%，组平衡采样可将差距降至接近0；6. GroupDRO的最差组目标贡献微小，主要收益来自平衡采样。

Conclusion: T2I安全管线对非标准方言用户存在系统性公平性失败，这种失败被平均准确率指标所掩盖。方言惩罚进入文本处理层而非图像生成层，因此通过共享文本嵌入空间的上游对齐（如SAFREE或TADA）可在多个防护栏间同时降低该失败。方言鲁棒性应成为继准确率和覆盖范围之后的第三个评估维度。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) safety guardrails fail to generalize equitably to non-standard dialects. Evaluating 23,080 paired prompts across five English dialects, we formalize this failure as the dialect penalty, where filters trigger based on linguistic surface features rather than semantic intent. Text-level filters fail in opposing directions: NSFW-T over-flags benign dialect prompts and LatentGuard over-flags toxic ones (bias gaps up to +28.29 pp), while the OpenAI Moderation API under-detects them. A controlled typo ablation confirms this penalty originates from flagging dialectal features, not generic out-of-distribution sensitivity. The pixel-level generator is largely dialect-agnostic; the penalty enters at text processing and cascades unevenly to post-hoc guardrails. We show this bias tracks training data imbalance and is mitigable via group-balanced retraining, with an ablation attributing the gain to balanced exposure rather than to the worst-group objective of GroupDRO (group distributionally robust optimization). Current pipelines systematically fail dialect speakers, an equity failure masked by mean accuracy benchmarks. Our official code and dataset are publicly available at this https URL . Content Warning: This paper contains offensive, toxic, or disturbing text prompts and generated images.

</details>


### [337] [Towards a Systems Foundation for Agentic Skills: Architecture, Lifecycle, and Security](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29596)
*Sanket Badhe,Deep Shah,Priyanka Tiwari,Nehal Kathrotia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了智能体技能（agentic skills）的统一系统基础与参考架构，将其形式化为外部化程序性知识，通过九阶段生命周期（发现、表示、存储、检索路由、组合编排、执行修复、终身适应、评估、安全治理）系统化梳理了该领域，并分析了市场生态、对抗威胁及防御机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主大语言模型智能体在长时程复杂任务中面临可靠性、上下文消耗、执行稳定性三大瓶颈：单块提示工程和无状态工具调用范式难以扩展，且智能体成功完成任务后无法获得跨会话持久的能力积累。

Method: 将智能体技能形式化为六元组 s=(A, I, C, T, π, E)（激活条件、程序指令、约束、工具接口、执行策略、预期效果），建立"封装模块化+延迟绑定动态调用+程序性状态变换"三重成员判定准则；沿九阶段生命周期对19个发现框架、10个存储架构、8个检索系统等系统化分类与比较；引入能力基权限约束、子图局部修复、可验证预准入等数学形式化机制。

Result: 1）建立了智能体技能与提示词、原子工具、工作流、情景记忆的清晰概念边界；2）合成了九阶段程序性生命周期参考架构，配套十张架构对比表；3）按指令型SOP、工具调用、推理规划、领域执行（元技能）四类功能分类梳理16个代表性系统；4）实证分析34,000+真实技能、98,440注册表技能、49,943 OpenClaw技能，发现描述-实现偏差达80.0%、开放式检索性能严重退化、环境反馈带宽假说（高带宽环境下技能增益为零）等关键负面结果；5）提出跨生命周期威胁分类与四层防御体系。

Conclusion: 智能体技能是可扩展、鲁棒、可验证自主语言智能体的基础范式。未来需突破小模型部署、百万级亚秒检索、图结构局部恢复、零信任市场安全、终身策略-技能协同进化、环境反馈边界与基准真实性六大开放挑战。

Abstract: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents increasingly face reliability, context consumption, and execution stability bottlenecks when deployed on complex, long-horizon tasks. While monolithic prompt engineering and stateless tool-calling paradigms struggle to scale, the field is rapidly converging toward \emph{agentic skills}: modular procedural abstractions that externalize execution knowledge into reusable, executable, and portable artifacts. This paper establishes a unified systems foundation and reference architecture for the agentic skills ecosystem. We formalize skills as externalized procedural knowledge bridging high-level cognitive planning with deterministic execution environments, and systematically delineate the architecture across a nine-stage lifecycle: autonomous discovery, authoring and representation formats, memory storage, dynamic retrieval and routing, composition and orchestration, execution and repair, lifelong adaptation, empirical evaluation, and security governance. We further examine marketplace dynamics, public registries, and emerging adversarial threat vectors, alongside runtime verification and defense mechanisms. Finally, we categorize system implementations across software engineering, operating system navigation, embodied robotics, and scientific discovery, while highlighting critical open challenges in continual learning and benchmark realism. This work establishes agentic skills as a foundational paradigm for building scalable, robust, and verifiable autonomous language agents.

</details>


### [338] [LLMs Interpret, Embeddings Organize, Graphs Emerge: Agent-Driven Compilation of Scientific Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29612)
*Shi-Ju Ran,Kun Zhang,Xi Wu,Liu-Si Yang,Wen-Jun Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"科学知识编译"（scientific knowledge compilation）这一新范式，并实现了系统ASKS。该系统通过LLM解释科学文献、嵌入向量组织语义、图结构自动涌现，将零散的科学记录编译为可追溯、可继承的持久知识库。作者用56篇论文历时纵贯实验，验证系统能自动形成以张量网络方法为核心的研究者学术画像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学研究积累的不只是文献，更是跨时间、跨任务的方法、术语、命题与关联组织。传统检索增强（RAG）仅提供瞬时上下文，无法让后续任务继承结构化知识。文献激增、跨领域交叉加速的背景下，亟需一种能让智能体持续积累、修订、重组先前解读的持久知识基底，以支持后续研究任务的继承与回溯。

Method: ASKS将每次文献摄入建模为可检查的状态转移：LLM对源文献生成可读Wiki视图与机器可读语义槽（subject-predicate-object）；确定性校验将其转化为文档级GraphDelta；嵌入几何相似度与显式图规则（身份判定、成员资格、生命周期）将增量整合进持久图状态。编译公式为 Δt=C_LLM(Dt), G_{t+1}=F(G_t, Δt; E, Θ)，其中 E 为嵌入模型，Θ 包含各类阈值、滞后、容量与谱系约束。系统采用两阶段冻结构建：Phase L 冻结56篇文献的本地LLM编译产物，Phase G 从空状态按出版年顺序融合，并通过哈希绑定、回滚保存点保障可复现性。

Result: 在56篇论文历时纵贯实验中，系统生成57个图快照，全程通过完整性校验。关键指标：分支存活率P_survive=1.000（18次Hub诞生全部存活）、多论文支持出生B_multi=0.889、谱系分支L_branch=0.222、生命周期纯加性A_life=1.000、映射覆盖Q_map=0.893（50/56篇）、平均成员资格变动仅 C̄=0.00467。最终形成的作者研究画像以张量网络方法为稳定主干，向量子多体、TN机器学习、量子-AI方向分支演化，编译轨迹与已知研究轨迹一致。

Conclusion: 本文将科学知识构建形式化为来源到图的可复现、可回滚、可重放的状态转移过程。ASKS作为首个端到端的科学知识编译系统，证明通过LLM局部解释、嵌入组织与图规则，可以在保留源证据链的前提下让高层导航结构从重复编译中涌现。但作者明确指出该工作仅评估"形成"，顺序鲁棒性与科学解释属后续评估层；科学新颖性仍需独立评审。

Abstract: Sustained scientific work requires a knowledge substrate that carries interpretation across tasks and preserves paths to source evidence. We call this process \emph{scientific knowledge compilation} and implement it in ASKS, the \emph{Agent-Driven Scientific Knowledge System}. For each source, an LLM produces a readable Wiki view and machine-facing semantics. Deterministic checks convert the latter into a document-local GraphDelta, and embedding geometry together with explicit graph rules integrates the proposed changes into persistent state. Each ingest is an inspectable state transition over accumulated knowledge, with compiled Wiki and graph views linked to the preserved source record. We examine this process by chronologically compiling 56 published papers from one research program. Branch survival, cross-paper support, lineage, coverage, and churn yield a source-traceable author research portrait centered on tensor-network methods, with branches into quantum many-body research, tensor-network machine learning, and quantum-AI-oriented directions. In this run, higher-level Hub organization remains stable and low-churn. Canonical-node growth is predominantly additive. Graph-level measurements and navigation paths retain links to the source records from which they were compiled.

</details>


### [339] [Detect Before You Attribute: Cascade Failure Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29646)
*Jiayi Zhang,Zexin Wang,Degang Sun,Changhua Pei,Fei Sun,Gaogang Xie,Jingjing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DUOTRACE是一种面向多智能体系统的“检测后归因”故障诊断前端。它先利用双视图语义—结构表示、Tree-LSTM-VAE和正常轨迹数据增强，学习正常执行流形并计算节点异常分数；随后保留得分最高的约20%可疑节点及其结构依赖，供CORRECT、ECHO或通用LLM进行最终根因判断。实验表明，该方法在六种下游归因基线上稳定提升代理级与步骤级准确率，摘要报告平均绝对提升分别为8.7和7.0个百分点，并显著降低上下文长度、Token消耗及推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体执行轨迹通常很长且具有树状依赖，直接交给LLM诊断会触发上下文稀释、Lost-in-the-Middle、Token成本高和推理延迟大；纯结构方法又难以识别幻觉、事实错误等语义异常。因此，作者将异常检测放在LLM归因之前，以压缩候选空间并突出潜在故障起点。

Method: 将轨迹表示为有向层次树。每个节点包含代理身份、算子或工具和文本负载。方法包括：1）用Sentence Transformer分别编码代理与操作语义，并结合邻接结构形成双视图表示；2）用Child-Sum Tree-LSTM作为VAE编码器，建模层次依赖；3）从正常轨迹提取变长前缀链，并仅在训练集上调用LLM生成多样化成功轨迹；4）联合语义重构MSE、Token消耗条件高斯NLL和KL散度训练；5）以重构/NLL形成节点异常分数，用成功轨迹上的均值和标准差进行Z-score标准化，按分数选取Top-K，并沿拓扑保留候选结构。默认K为节点数的20%。

Result: 在Who and When的184个失败实例上，CORRECT+DuoTrace总体代理/步骤准确率达到69.1%/49.0%；相对六类基线，摘要报告平均绝对提升分别为8.7和7.0个百分点。Qwen3.5-plus+DuoTrace在Handcraft子集代理准确率72.4%。消融实验显示，完整模型Top-20%根因召回率为Handcraft 86.21%、Automated 97.62%；去除语义或结构视图后分别有明显下降。Top-20%至25%候选比例整体较优。效率方面，ECHO Token消耗降低41%，Qwen3.5-plus最高降低76%；CORRECT和Qwen3.5-plus推理时间分别降低60%和64%。在20%语义字段遮蔽、非树结构展开、跨基准、多根因排序及跨任务零样本测试中，DuoTrace均持续改善下游归因。

Conclusion: 先检测异常、再调用LLM归因，是处理长而复杂多智能体故障轨迹的有效范式。DUOTRACE的树结构归纳偏置、双视图异常建模和Top-K结构化候选压缩能兼顾语义故障与传播结构，并以即插即用方式改善现有归因系统。需要注意：异常检测只能筛选可疑步骤，不能独立证明因果根因；方法仍假设最终可获得树兼容表示，正常数据质量、训练分布和下游LLM能力会影响结果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown strong potential in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning, yet they remain vulnerable to execution failures. Accurate failure attribution is therefore critical for improving agent reliability. Existing topology- and spectrum-based methods exploit trajectory structures but often overlook fine-grained semantics, while LLM-based attribution methods capture semantic cues but suffer from long-context degradation over lengthy trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose DUOTRACE, a plug-and-play detection filter for LLM-based failure attribution. DUOTRACE follows a detect-before-attribute paradigm: it first detects anomalous executions and then supplies focused trajectory evidence to downstream LLM-based attribution methods. For effective VAE-based anomaly detection on agent trajectories, DUOTRACE integrates dual-view semantic-structural node representations, a Tree-LSTM-based trajectory encoder, and prefix-chain- and LLM-based data augmentation to handle heterogeneous nodes, hierarchical execution structures, and limited failure data. Experiments with six LLM-based attribution baselines show that DUOTRACE improves agent-level and step-level attribution accuracy by 8.7% and 7.0%, respectively.

</details>


### [340] [Ideation Arena: Evaluating LLM Generated Research Ideas with Battle-style Human Expert Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29696)
*Zhiyu Chen,Keyu Zhao,Jigao Fu,Dong Liang,Yanbiao Wu,Jiaoyang Li,Haidong Xue,Xinhua Zeng,Yuanyi Zhen,Fengli Xu,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Ideation Arena，一个基于专家双盲成对比较的"擂台"式平台，用于评估LLM生成的科研构想。通过105位计算机科学研究者、6000余次成对比较，构建Elo排名榜单并发现智能体框架对底座模型的增强效果差异显著；同时发布Ideation Arena-Eval基准，揭示现有LLM评判器与人类专家偏好存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的科研构想缺乏可靠、可扩展且基于人类专家偏好的评估手段。现有arena平台面向通用助手，难以评判科学价值；现有自动评测易被流畅表面掩盖方法论缺陷；研究构想本身无单一标准答案，传统正确性指标失效。

Method: 采用"回顾式构想范式"：基于研究者提交的DOI构建共享文献上下文（含≥10篇参考文献、≥10次引用、近五年、非综述/基准论文），封闭上下文约束下让14个前沿LLM与5种智能体框架（含AI-Researcher、ResearchAgent、SciMON、Virtual Scientists、MOOSE-Chem）成对生成方法型提案；由领域匹配的105位研究者按5维度（新颖性、可行性、意义、具体性、总体质量）双盲成对评判；用Bradley-Terry模型估计Elo分数并用1000次Bootstrap估计置信区间；构建Ideation Arena-Eval元评测基准测试14个LLM评判器。

Result: GPT-5.1（1293.8）、AI-Researcher(DeepSeek V3.2)（1276.5）、Claude 4.5 Opus（1221.2）、Claude 4.5 Sonnet（1220.7）领先；DeepSeek V3.2基础模型仅排第7（1099.5），但封装于AI-Researcher后跃升至第2（+177），其他智能体框架均低于基座；标注者一致性Krippendorff's α≈0.60，50%子采样与留一域验证Spearman相关0.98/0.998；跨域生物学/物理试点趋势一致；LLM评判器最高仅达72.56%软准确率，可行性维度差距最大（仅3个超60%）；长度调整后Spearman相关0.75-0.88。

Conclusion: Ideation Arena为科研构想的提案阶段专家评估建立了可重复、可更新的基础设施。智能体工作流对构想能力的影响高度依赖架构设计而非计算量；当前LLM评判器尚无法可靠替代专家偏好，尤其在可行性判断上差距显著；未来需持续跟踪底座模型与智能体框架迭代，并探索跨学科扩展。

Abstract: Evaluating research ideas generated by LLMs is difficult because their scientific value cannot be fully determined by objective criteria, and no single reference answer specifies what counts as a good idea. To address this challenge, we introduce Ideation Arena, a battle style platform that evaluates research ideas through pairwise human assessment. Ideation Arena evaluates ideas generated by 14 frontier LLMs and 5 research agent architectures built on 2 base models. To ensure a common starting point, Ideation Arena builds shared literature contexts from papers familiar to the participating researchers and provides the same contexts to all LLMs and agents. We collect over 6,000 double blind pairwise comparisons from 105 active computer science researchers and construct an Elo rating leaderboard of proposal-stage expert preferences in computer science under a shared closed-context protocol. We validate the rankings through interrater agreement and robustness analyses, showing that the leaderboard remains stable under changes in annotator composition and domain coverage. Our results show substantial variation in agent effectiveness, with some frameworks improving ideation quality over their backbones and others offering little benefit or even underperforming their base models. We further construct Ideation Arena Eval, a benchmark for assessing whether automated evaluators align with human preferences in research ideation. Experiments with current LLM judges show that they still cannot reliably reproduce expert preferences, with the best judge reaching 72.56% Soft Accuracy on Overall Quality. Our code, data, and leaderboards are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [341] [PAGE-RAG: Provenance-Aware Graph Evidence Promotion for Fixed-Budget Multi-hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29753)
*Haokun Deng,Xunkai Li,Hongchao Qin,Rong-Hua Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PAGE-RAG 提出了一种面向多跳 RAG 的"证据提升"中间层，将图作为查询局部选择工作区而非知识库，通过路径评分与最小充分选择，在固定读者预算下提升支持事实进入最终上下文的比例，可作为完整流水线或即插即用模块使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答中窄检索会丢失必要桥接事实，宽检索又会引入主题性干扰；图基 RAG 中"相连 ≠ 支持"，共享实体/关系会构造看似合理但无支撑的桥接，导致连通性-支持鸿沟。需要一个与知识库格式无关、能利用关系结构过滤候选的查询感知选择层。

Method: 1) 扩展候选检索（如 NV-Embed-v2 拉取 top-20）作为搜索空间；2) 构建查询局部溯源感知图（文档-句-实体三类节点，五类边），每条边存储 src/sent/trig/conf/div/spec/hub 元数据；3) 路径打分结合相关性、可靠性、特异性、枢纽性、噪声与连贯性，将边视为支持假设而非支持本身；4) 最小充分选择按边际支持>边际成本增量累积上下文，含歧容忍续推规则；5) 文档/块级后端将句子级路径回聚到原生粒度输出。

Result: 在 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 上句级 top-5 预算下，相对最强检索器 NV-Embed-v2 加权平均 Sup F1 提升 10.4 点、Ans F1 提升 3.3 点；在 IRCoT、RECOMP、SelfRAG、EfficientRAG、GFM-RAG、LightRAG、KG2RAG、HippoRAG2 等 8 类后端作插件均稳定增益（MuSiQue 上 IRCoT 提升 +14.42 Ans F1/+18.33 Sup F1）；消融表明查询对齐、桥接特异性、路径质量控制、溯源可靠性四组信号互补且均必要；额外注入 5/10/20 篇干扰文档时性能单调下降但仍优于多数基线，具一定噪声鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 多跳 RAG 改进应区分"可达性"与"上下文有用性"：扩展检索增加可达性，但需通过基于图的支持假设打分与最小充分选择，将真正联合支撑答案的紧凑路径提升入读者上下文；PAGE-RAG 作为后端无关的提升层，既可作完整流水线也可作插件，但无法恢复未进入候选池的事实，未来应研究支持提升与自适应候选生成的更紧耦合。

Abstract: Multi-hop question answering in retrieval-augmented gener?ation (RAG) often benefits from retrieving beyond the few candidates that will finally be read: narrow retrieval can miss an indispensable hop, while expanded retrieval introduces topical distractors. This challenge is not tied to a particu?lar knowledge-base format. Candidate pools may come from standalone retrievers, standard RAG backends, or graph-based retrieval pipelines. What is needed is a query-aware selection layer that can use relational structure to filter candidates be?fore generation. PAGE-RAG addresses this setting by using a graph as a temporary selection structure, rather than assum?ing a graph-structured knowledge base. It builds a query-local graph over retrieved candidates, records why candidates are connected, and treats each connection as a support hypothe?sis rather than support itself. We identify the resulting failure mode as a connectivity-support gap: connected candidates do not necessarily support the answer. We propose PAGE-RAG, a Provenance-Aware Graph Evidence promotion method that scores candidate paths with relevance, source-tracing meta?data, specificity, hubness, noise, and coherence signals, and applies minimal sufficient selection to promote supporting facts into a compact reader context. PAGE-RAG can serve as a complete retrieval-to-reading pipeline, and the same promo?tion stage can be inserted after existing retrieval or RAG sys?tems without replacing their upstream retrieval logic. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks under the same final bud?get, PAGE-RAG improves support F1 and answer F1 by 10.4 and 3.3 points on a weighted average over a strong retriever. As a plug-in, PAGE-RAG further improves all reported RAG backends, including reasoning-oriented, compression-based, graph-based, and document/chunk-level systems.

</details>


### [342] [FRAMEWORKERS: A Dynamic Multi-Agent Framework for AI-Generated Video Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29814)
*Zhendong Li,Lei Sun,Letian Shi,Deheng Zhang,Ruibo Ming,Mengshun Hu,Dannong Xu,Jian Wang,Danda Paudel,Luc Van Gool,Jinjin Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FRAMEWORKERS 提出一个面向开放式 AI 视频生产的动态多智能体框架，通过中央 Director 维护动态任务栈、Assistant 管理共享工作空间与子智能体执行，实现描述符驱动的可插拔编排；Director 采用 SFT + GRPO 微调以提升路由可靠性，实验表明其在路由准确率、失败恢复、对未见子智能体的泛化及端到端视频质量上优于固定流水线、单智能体系统及现有 LLM 规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化视频生产系统依赖刚性流水线，难以适应多样化输入与变化的工作流；通用大语言模型在长时序编排和多模态资产路由上也不可靠。需要一种能够动态规划、灵活扩展并可靠协调长链多模态任务的视频生产框架。

Method: 1) 双层多智能体架构：Director（动态任务栈调度）+ Assistant（工作空间执行层）；2) 子智能体通过语义描述符注册，支持即插即用；3) Director 训练：先 SFT 学习描述符条件路由，再用 GRPO 基于有效性、覆盖率和依赖一致性的复合奖励优化；4) 共享 Workspace 包含 file_system、generated_assets、global_memory、logs 四部分，采用"严格输出、松散输入"原则。

Result: 在 DCE/DCH 测试集上，8B Director 链准确率达 91.0%/81.5%，超越 Gemini 3 Pro 等强基线；991 个扰动案例中恢复率 96.7%；Gemini 2.5 Flash 后端执行通过率 100%；两个未见子智能体（ComedyAgent、ScreenwriterAgent）选择率 93.0%/99.2%；端到端视频在 CLIP 与 MLLM 评分上均优于 S-Agent、UniVA、MovieAgent、Anim-Director，人工评估亦领先。

Conclusion: FRAMEWORKERS 通过描述符驱动的动态编排和任务栈编辑，将视频生产从固定流水线转变为可动态组合的工作流，在路由准确性、恢复鲁棒性、可扩展性和端到端质量上均取得显著提升，为开放式 AIGC 视频生产提供了可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Modern video generators excel at synthesizing individual clips, but complete video production requires coordinating a long sequence of interdependent creative steps, including scripting, storyboarding, generation, and editing. It further demands persistent asset management and dynamic task orchestration as intermediate outputs, dependencies, and execution states evolve over time. Existing automated systems typically rely on rigid pipelines that are difficult to adapt to diverse inputs and changing workflows, while general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for long-horizon orchestration and multimodal asset routing. We introduce FRAMEWORKERS, a task-centric and workspace-grounded multi-agent framework for open-ended video production. A central Director formulates video creation as dynamic task management, continuously editing a Task Stack to determine which subtask to execute next and which sub-agent to invoke. An Assistant serves as the execution layer, grounding each selected task in a shared Workspace, retrieving the required assets and context, invoking the assigned sub-agent, and persisting the resulting artifacts. Execution capabilities are exposed through modular sub-agents with registered descriptors, allowing new sub-agents to be integrated without redesigning the orchestration workflow. To improve orchestration reliability, we fine-tune the Director via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for descriptor-conditioned task routing. Experiments show that FRAMEWORKERS outperforms strong LLM planners in routing accuracy, recovers reliably from runtime failures, generalizes to unseen sub-agents without retraining, and achieves higher end-to-end video quality and broader task coverage than fixed pipelines, single-agent systems, and prior multi-agent approaches.

</details>


### [343] [Perceive to Hypothesize, Verify to Ground: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Open-World Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29880)
*Yutian Jiang,Ruijie Li,Sisuo Lyu,Xixuan Hao,Qingxiang Liu,Yongzi Yu,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoPAVE，一个双层智能体推理框架，将开放世界地理定位重新定义为"感知-验证"问题，并发布了配套的PAVED数据集。框架通过单遍感知生成带不确定性标签的假设候选，再通过工具调用（OCR、网络搜索、地图上下文）执行证据验证和假设优化，在多个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在地理定位任务中面临两大核心挑战：(1) 感知捷径——当视觉证据模糊时，模型倾向于将局部线索错误映射到高频地理区域；(2) 验证不一致性——缺乏基于证据的验证机制，开放环境中的工具调用可能引入冗余上下文，破坏推理一致性。本文受GeoGuessr游戏中人类"感知-验证"认知循环启发，将地理定位重新形式化为类人推理问题。

Method: GeoPAVE采用双层智能体架构：(1) 感知模块——在单次推理中生成K∈{1,2,3}个候选假设，每个假设包含坐标、置信度、自然语言推理、不确定性标签集合𝒰和建议的验证动作；通过结构化不确定性标签（如TEXT_UNCLEAR、CONFLICTING_CUES、WATERBODY_DOMINANT等）触发置信度校准。(2) 验证模块——基于规则的不确定性-技能路由策略ϕ:𝒰→𝒮映射到三种验证技能：语言学锚定（OCR脚本/语言线索）、场景验证（搜索引擎证据）、上下文验证（地图/POI证据）。每条证据记录包含支持/反驳/优化三种决策。精化智能体执行第二轮推理以证据池为输入重新评分，最终选择置信度最高的有效候选。此外发布含2,524张街景图和结构化思维链标注的PAVED数据集，采用两阶段审核流程生成轨迹。

Result: 在PAVED、MAPBench-V2和IM2GPS3K三个基准上的实验表明：(1) GeoPAVE使用Gemini-3.0-Flash作为主干在PAVED上Acc@500m达16.87%、Acc@25km达59.96%，超过包括Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.5等所有基线；在MAPBench-V2上Acc@750km比Gemini-3.0-Flash提升20.91个百分点。(2) 鲁棒性实验中使用GPT-4o-mini弱主干，GeoPAVE仍带来稳定增益（PAVED Acc@750km +9.35pp）。(3) 消融实验验证感知与验证互补：仅P降低Acc@500m至12.72%，仅V降至14.22%，删除场景验证技能降至11.87%。(4) 提出COR、CR、LCG三个诊断指标量化候选覆盖与证据驱动修正过程。案例分析展示验证阶段如何基于邻近POI证据拒绝错误候选（如Mexico City）而支持正确候选（如Guadalajara）。失败分析揭示假文本锚定和候选覆盖缺失两类错误模式。

Conclusion: GeoPAVE通过将开放世界地理定位重构为感知-验证双层范式，有效缓解了感知捷径和上下文不一致两大核心问题。基于规则的不确定性-技能路由机制在不依赖策略学习的情况下实现了自适应验证，在精细粒度和粗粒度阈值下均取得竞争性或领先性能。PAVED数据集为评估可验证的智能体地理定位提供了新基准。未来工作将探索基于验证轨迹训练更强大的地理定位智能体，以及在交互式环境中进行智能体强化学习。

Abstract: Open-world geo-localization requires models to reason over ambiguous visual cues through multi-step reasoning and external knowledge grounding. While recent large vision-language models exhibit strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, existing approaches still suffer from perceptual hallucination and context drift due to the lack of explicit evidence-grounded verification. In this work, we reformulate geo-localization as a human-like perceive-then-verify reasoning problem and propose GeoPAVE (Geo-localization Perception-and-Verification-Engine), a bi-level agentic framework that contains perception-based hypothesis generation via single-pass rollouts and verification-based evidence grounding for decision actions: support, refute, and refine. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce PAVED, a novel dataset derived from real-world user check-in data, equipped with comprehensive reasoning trajectories featuring multi-hop queries, multi-round tool invocations, and structured perception-verification traces. The dataset and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [344] [On the Instance Hardness as a Decision Criterion in TinyML Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29913)
*Tobiasz Puslecki,Krzysztof Walkowiak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在TinyML系统中使用基于修剪决策树深度（TDP）的实例硬度（IH）作为决策标准，结合DES-Clustering动态集成选择方法，通过调整IH阈值来权衡分类精度与能耗，实现资源受限设备上的可持续AI推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TinyML设备受限于内存与计算资源，能耗是关键瓶颈。现有基于邻域的动态集成选择方法（如KNORA-U/E）需存储验证集，不适合TinyML。需要一种无需额外内存开销、能根据上下文动态调整精度-能耗权衡的轻量级决策机制。

Method: 使用最小代价复杂度剪枝（ccp=0.005）的决策树作为轻量级分类器，同时利用其归一化叶节点深度（TDP）作为无监督实例硬度度量。TDP≤阈值的样本由决策树直接分类；TDP>阈值的困难样本交由DES-Clustering（基于K-means的动态集成选择）处理。在TinyML中可用推理延迟（通过硬件周期计数器获取）替代叶深度以节省存储。阈值可由模糊推理系统等轻量级控制器根据电池电量、光伏供电等上下文动态调节。

Result: 在Vehicle、Wine、Digits三个数据集上对DES-Clustering、KNORA-U、KNORA-E进行5×2折交叉验证实验。结果显示：随阈值升高，能量代理（送入重模型的样本比例）单调下降，精度总体下降但幅度有限。DES-Clustering的能量代理从1.0平滑过渡至0.0；KNORA方法更快达到最低能耗。Wine数据集在阈值1.0时出现精度与能耗的跳变。总体表明合理阈值选取可显著降低能耗而仅带来有限的分类质量损失。

Conclusion: TDP+DES-Clustering是适用于TinyML的内存与时间高效方案，可在精度与能耗间灵活权衡。未来工作将基于上下文（如电池电量、可再生能源可用性）动态控制阈值，实现实时自适应调节。

Abstract: TinyML includes the implementation of machine learning on devices with limited memory and computing resources. With the development of technology, AI systems continue to scale in terms of size and computational requirements. This forces researchers to adapt methods to be environmentally sustainable by designing techniques for reducing computational costs and energy consumption in inferring AI models, even in small devices. In this work, we present preliminary findings on a novel application of the tree depth prune instance hardness method to the TinyML system. The results indicate that threshold control can change energy consumption with limited classification quality changes. This method allows us to adjust classification accuracy, thereby influencing computational complexity and energy consumption for inference. We present a work in progress with initial results as a proof of concept.

</details>


### [345] [AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29937)
*Yafei Zhang,Nan Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AcrossWAM1.0 是围绕 LaWAM 潜在世界-动作计算构建的模块化、可审计的紧凑机器人策略栈。它将策略适配器、潜在世界解码器和流匹配动作专家解耦，在 LIBERO 上以 14.7 亿参数（比原 2B 模型少 42.4%）实现 97.45% 成功率，与 Qwen3-VL-2B 基线（98.00%）无显著配对差异（McNemar p=0.266）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LaWAM 提出的潜在视觉子目标策略虽性能优越，但其世界模型、多模态骨干与部署检查点在实现层面紧密耦合。这阻碍了：（1）更换骨干网络时的可移植性；（2）紧凑部署；（3）对部署等效性的可审计验证。AcrossWAM1.0 旨在将这些模块边界显式化，提供一个可验证、可扩展的工程栈。

Method: 采用两阶段训练框架：第一阶段用冻结的 DINOv3 编码器和逆动力学 Q-Former 学习 32 维潜在动作 z_t，并训练 AdaLN 调制的世界解码器 D_ω 从当前特征和 z_t 预测未来特征。第二阶段引入骨干适配器，输出分离的转移查询（latent-action queries）和动作查询（flow queries）上下文；交叉注意力映射器将潜在动作查询压缩为 ẑ_t，再经 D_ω 解码为视觉子目标 h^_{t+Δ}。Flow-DiT 专家以流匹配方式在骨干上下文和子目标条件下生成 50 步动作块。训练-推理模块严格分离，导出时移除仅训练用的教师模块并去重别名，逐张量验证部署检查点与源检查点的位级一致性。

Result: 在 2,000 条配对 LIBERO episode 上：Qwen3.5-0.8B 骨干达 97.45% 成功率（1949/2000），Qwen3-VL-2B 为 98.00%（1960/2000），差异 -0.55 个百分点（McNemar 不一致对 46 vs 35，p=0.266），满足预设的两个百分点保留标准。导出后唯一可推理参数为 1,472.6M（比 2B 原始策略少 42.4%），1,078 个保留张量与源检查点位级一致。MiniCPM-V 适配器的前向/反向烟雾测试验证了接口兼容性。语言诊断显示无分类器引导（CFG）变体在左右指令遵循率从 27.4% 提升至 50.3%（p=1e-5），但任务完成率从 1% 的失败升至 10%。

Conclusion: AcrossWAM1.0 贡献在于显式的骨干/世界/动作契约、受控的紧凑骨干评估以及精确的部署导出，而非新的潜在子目标算法。证据支持 Qwen 家族内的紧凑缩放和跨家族适配器执行，但不支持跨任意骨干网络的冻结性能保持传输。研究明确区分了已验证的成果与更强的未来假设。

Abstract: Latent world-action models avoid rendering future pixels by predicting an action-relevant visual subgoal in feature space. LaWAM established this formulation, but its original presentation left the world model, multimodal backbone, and deployment checkpoint tightly coupled. We introduce AcrossWAM1.0, a modularization and scaling study of this latent world-action stack. Rather than presenting latent subgoals as a new algorithm, we make the module boundary explicit: a policy adapter produces latent-action and action-generation contexts; a retained latent world decoder grounds the predicted transition in the current scene;and a flow-matching expert generates continuous action chunks. We further separate training-only teachers from the inference graph and provide a verifiable deployment export. On 2,000 paired LIBERO episodes, replacing a Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with Qwen3.5-0.8B yields 97.45% success versus 98.00% for the 2B model (a-0.55percentage-point difference; exact McNemarp=0.266). This does not prove equivalence, but it meets a prespecified two-point retention criterion. The compact, inference-reachable checkpoint contains 1,472.6M unique parameters, 42.4% fewer than the original 2B policy, while all retained tensors are bitwise identical to the source checkpoint. Cross-family execution is additionally checked with a MiniCPM-V adapter smoke test; closed-loop cross-family transfer remains an open evaluation. AcrossWAM1.0 therefore contributes an auditable software and evaluation boundary for compact latent world-action policies, distinct from LaWAM's original latent-subgoal contribution.

</details>


### [346] [Spatial Matryoshka Training for Multi-Granularity Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29951)
*Trishan Singha Roy,Arkadeep Acharya,Vishwajeet Kumar,Jaydeep Sen,Sachindra Joshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ColSNAP 提出了一种空间池化金字塔训练方法，通过对预训练多向量检索器（ColPali/ColQwen 类）的 patch 网格进行空间平均池化，在单次编码中产出多级嵌套压缩表示（1024→128→16→1），从而在索引时灵活选择精度-存储权衡，压缩比可达 70×–130×，同时保留大部分全分辨率检索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态晚期交互检索器（ColPali、Nemotron ColEmbed 等）以每 patch 一个向量的方式表示页面，检索效果好但存储成本极高（每页数百至上千个向量）。已有压缩方法通常在索引时固定单一压缩级别，限制了部署灵活性。需要一种能在单一模型内提供多级压缩粒度的方法。

Method: 1) 对 32×32 patch 网格进行空间平均池化，构建嵌套四层金字塔 L0(1024)/L1(128)/L2(16)/L3(1)；2) 联合训练所有层级，损失函数包括：Spatial Matryoshka Ranking Loss（各层级 in-batch 对比损失）、Frozen-Teacher 蒸馏（锚定原始预训练模型）、Live Cross-Tier 蒸馏（粗层级对齐自身 L0）；3) 仅使用 LoRA 轻量适配预训练检索器；4) 索引时按存储预算选择层级，单次编码产出全部层级。

Result: 在 Nemotron ColEmbed 4B 上：L1（7.3× 压缩）保留 96.9% 全分辨率质量；L2（34.6×）保留 93.1%；L3（69.2×）保留 92.0%。在 ColPali v1.3 上：L1（7.6×）几乎无损（保留 ~100%）；L2（44.8×）保留 89.4%；L3（128.9×）保留 80.7%（引入困难负样本时）。在 ViDoRe v1/v2/v3 上 L1 层级即可超越多个全分辨率基线。训练收敛快（1-3 epochs），存储从 5314 MB 降至 76.8 MB/1k 页面（Nemotron L3）。

Conclusion: ColSNAP 证明了利用 patch 网格的天然空间层级构建嵌套多粒度表示是可行的，无需改变编码器架构；该方法在不同规模 backbone 上均有效，并能通过轻量 LoRA 适配快速应用于预训练检索器；压缩级别在索引时选择而非训练时固定，使单一模型服务多种部署场景成为可能。

Abstract: Multi-modal late-interaction retrievers achieve strong retrieval on visually rich documents by representing each page as per patch embeddings and matching at the token level. However, this approach incurs high storage costs. Existing compression methods typically fix a single compression level at indexing time, limiting flexibility. We present ColSNAP (Spatial Nested Average Pooling)1, a training method that generates a nested hierarchy of compression levels directly from a backbone's patch grid. By spatially pooling patch embeddings into pro- gressively coarser tiers and training all tiers simultaneously, a single model learns to support retrieval at multiple compression levels without architectural changes. Crucially, a single encoding pass yields every tier, enabling the accuracy-storage trade-off to be configured at indexing time to match avail- able storage budgets, rather than being fixed during training. We demonstrate that models trained using ColSNAP maintain near full-resolution retrieval performance under substantial compression and that ColSNAP transfers effectively across multiple late-interaction backbones, and achieves most of its improvements via a lightweight adaptation stage applied to a pre-trained retriever.

</details>


### [347] [SearchWiki: Learning to Build and Navigate Knowledge Wikis for Active Information Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29953)
*Guransh Singh,Vishwajeet Kumar,Arkadeep Acharya,Adnan Qidwai,Jaydeep Sen,Sachindra Joshi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SearchWiki提出了一种将非结构化语料自动编译为三层可导航知识库(文档概览、跨文档主题页、页面级源记录)的框架,并通过在线强化学习训练出WikiResearcher-9B智能体,使其能够通过多轮工具调用主动导航语料库而非依赖单次扁平检索。该9B模型在ViDoRe v3上以71.35%的准确率超越44倍参数量的基线模型,并在FinanceBench及多个记忆基准上展现出良好的跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扁平检索增强生成(RAG)将语料视为独立文本块的集合,丢弃了文档层级结构和跨文档关联,缺乏检索失败时的恢复能力,无法支持多步结构化推理。论文提出"主动语料导航"范式替代"被动扁平检索",借鉴人类研究者通过目录层级和交叉引用导航知识的方式。

Method: SearchWiki采用两阶段框架:(1)Wiki编译——通过布局感知解析、TOC抽取与分层结构化、联合维基编译,将原始语料自动组织为documents/(文档概览)、topics/(跨文档主题页)、sources/(页面级JSON记录)三层结构,配备七种工具(search_wiki、grep_search、read_file、read_page、list_files、glob_file_search、update_scratchpad);(2)导航策略学习——基于Qwen3.5-9B初始化WikiResearcher-9B,使用DAPO目标(非对称裁剪+动态采样)进行在策略强化学习,采用Retrieved Token Masking(RTM)将梯度限制在模型生成token上,设计多组件奖励函数(正确性、Read-F1/NDCG检索质量、结构合规、并行工具奖励等),并经过两阶段训练(全奖励→仅答案token梯度)。训练数据为通过四阶段过滤从ViDoRe生成的1800条合成查询。

Result: 在ViDoRe v3八个领域上,WikiResearcher-9B以71.35%严格QA准确率领先,超越未训练的Qwen3.6-27B(70.94%)和Qwen3.5-397B(69.51%),较同尺寸Qwen3.5-9B基线提升7.4点;页面级nDCG@5达53.22%,超越所有基线。在FinanceBench上达到83.33%,接近Oracle上界85.33%。在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、PersonaMem-v2等记忆基准上,无需记忆专项训练即可与记忆专项策略NapMem竞争。消融实验验证了分层层级和多轮交互各自独立贡献,密集RAG和BM25 RAG均显著落后。

Conclusion: SearchWiki与WikiResearcher-9B证明了结构化语料上的习得导航优于扁平检索,以9B参数量实现甚至超越44倍规模模型的性能,并展现出良好的跨域泛化能力,为信息检索从"查询后寄希望于结果"转向"主动迭代探索"提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Flat retrieval-augmented generation treats a corpus as a bag of chunks, discarding document hierarchy and cross document structure. We introduce SearchWiki, a harness framework that synthesizes a corpus into a hierarchical, typed, navigable wiki and trains an agent, WikiResearcher-9B, to retrieve information through multi-turn tool use. The wiki organizes knowledge into three layers - document overviews, cross- document topic pages, and page-level source records; enabling progressive refinement of retrieval when initial lookup misses. We optimize the agent's navigation policy with on-policy reinforcement learning with a multi-component reward function balancing answer correctness, retrieval quality and trajectory efficiency. Evaluation on ViDoRe-V3 (8 domains), FinanceBench, and memory benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, PersonaMem-v2) shows that WikiResearcher- 9B which is our RL-tuned Qwen 9B model, significantly outperforms same-size untrained baselines and exceeds or matches larger external models. SearchWiki paired with WikiResearcher-9B demonstrates that learned navigation over structured corpora is a superior alternative to flat retrieval.

</details>


### [348] [Review Before Trust: Source-Grounded Integrity Gates for AI-Assisted Personal Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29965)
*Nora Girda,Adrian Groza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"证据门控信任提升"模型，通过独立的确定性监控器对LLM生成的医疗数据进行源头验证，仅当源文档中存在唯一支持性引用、相关字段位于同一实验行且保留出处时，才允许候选数据进入纵向健康记录的下游使用。生成器无法自我审批，证据缺失或模糊将被拒绝但保留供人工审核。作者在Medical DataCloud应用中实现该模型，22项一致性及突变测试全部通过，对9份历史检验报告（102个手动标注行）的97个数值候选进行策略重放：模式验证全部接受，早期数据包级检查接受94，强化后的引用-行级策略接受72并将25个保留待审核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可将医疗文档转化为结构化数据，但其输出即使看似合理也可能缺乏源文档支撑。若将此类未经验证的数据持久化到纵向健康记录中，将构成完整性风险：未核实数据可能影响后续摘要、趋势分析或预防性医疗计算。现有置信度评分、引用标注或人工审核均无法单独解决"生成内容是否被授权进入受保护记录功能"这一系统级决策问题。

Method: 核心方法是"证据门控信任提升模型"（evidence-gated trust-promotion model）。形式化定义：源提取χ: S→X，候选c∈C，目的p∈P；Kp检查结构合规性，Ep独立检查源支持，准入谓词Vp=Kp(c)∧Ep(x,c)。路由函数Tp根据Vp决定admit（投影到观察记录）或review（保留为待审核事实）。定义五项完整性属性：(P1)中介化提升——每个AI衍生观察都须通过受监控转换；(P2)非自我认证——生成器控制的元数据（置信度、自我验证标志）无法改变权威决策；(P3)出处保留——准入时输出包含源与决策的可检查谱系；(P4)失败关闭准入——证据缺失、不匹配、重复或不一致时路由至审核；(P5)不确定性保留——拒绝不抹除候选而是保留为待审核项。威胁模型假设生成器潜在故障或对抗性；可信计算基础包含源代码包派生、证据验证、路由、投影及数据库写入代码。在Medical DataCloud中实现：六阶段实验室路径——上传校验、生成文本包、LLM返回模式约束对象、服务器代码丢弃verified字段并重新计算证据状态（要求非空有界引用、唯一源匹配、行内字段共现、数值作为完整token匹配）、映射为source-linked事实、仅verified候选投影到观察草稿、观察库写入前再次校验verification标志（纵深防御）。

Result: 评估包含22项开发者编写的合规与突变测试（17项证据验证、3项实验室任务、2项仓库边界），覆盖精确与归一化匹配、缺失/错源/重复/过大证据、分析物/值/单位/范围不一致、数值子串、相邻行借用、伪造验证标志、已验证投影及未验证持久化尝试——全部通过。策略重放使用OpenRouter（openai/gpt-4o-mini，温度0，prompt版本medical-extraction:v1）保存的输出：97个数值候选中，模式验证接受97（100%），原数据包级检查接受94（96.9%），强化引用-行级门控接受72（74.2%）并将25个保留待审核。在80个可与标注配对的行上：单位一致性100%（80/80），下限94.6%（70/74），上限93.8%（75/80），解读86.3%（69/80），有效日期85.0%（68/80）。提取器对102个标注行覆盖78.4%（80/102）。

Conclusion: 研究证明在狭义完整性边界（Medical DataCloud实验室路径）内，证据门控信任提升在技术上是可行的：确定性源检查、仅验证映射及仓库断言可阻止选定的不支持候选进入观察历史，同时保留待审核。22项测试展示已测试接口的合规性，固定输出重放表明更强的源局部性降低了自动准入率并增加审核需求。然而该研究明确划定其范围：评估的是系统完整性而非临床正确性或临床安全性，不建立临床真实性、临床安全性、可接受工作流负担或医疗系统范围内的完全中介（complete mediation）。残留局限包括：词法验证器无法确认文档真实性、患者身份、OCR正确性、临床含义或医学正确性；标注缺乏临床医生裁定与评分者间一致性；测试缺乏独立安全评估；出处保留在原型中部分满足（未将事实不可变绑定到具体提取运行、验证器版本与策略版本）。未来工作需要：多受试者多中心报告、完全双标注、预声明假准入与假审核指标、计时的审核任务、对抗性文档、渗透测试及遵循DECIDE-AI的前瞻性工作流评估。

Abstract: Large language models can convert medical documents into structured data, but plausible output may still be unsupported by the source. Persisting such output in a longitudinal health record, a record that accumulates patient information over time, therefore creates an integrity risk: unverified data may influence later summaries, trends, or preventive-care computations. We introduce an evidence-gated trust-promotion model that keeps generated data provisional until a deterministic monitor verifies it against the source document. The monitor admits a candidate for a specified downstream use only when the source contains a unique supporting quotation, the relevant fields occur within the same laboratory row, and the required provenance is preserved. The generator cannot approve its own output, missing or ambiguous evidence causes refusal, and refused candidates remain available for human review rather than being silently discarded. We implement the model in Medical DataCloud, a personal health-record application, and evaluate it through automated tests and a replay of saved extraction outputs. All 22 conformance and mutation tests pass. The replay covers nine historical laboratory PDF reports containing 102 manually labelled rows. The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review. The study evaluates system integrity rather than clinical correctness or clinical safety. The results demonstrate the technical feasibility of an enforceable boundary that prevents generated claims from authorizing their own reuse in a longitudinal health record.

</details>


### [349] [EDGE: Engine for Deterministic Graph Evaluation through Conversation Simulation from Graph Structured DSL Configuration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29971)
*Ram Kulathumani,Regunathan Radhakrishnan,Anupam Tripathi,Xiangbo Mao,Roshanak Omrani,Keshav Somani,Shwet Kamal Mishra,Shayna Lurya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EDGE是一个用于评估基于图结构的智能体系统行为确定性的框架。它利用AgentGraph DSL配置,通过深度优先遍历生成全面的对话路径测试集,系统性地重放这些路径并提出新的确定性度量指标,包括响应一致性、节点/动作轨迹一致性与覆盖率等。实验证明,具有显式受控节点转换的智能体(如复杂版招聘智能体)比无约束转换的智能体具有更高的确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体系统演变为复杂的多智能体编排工作流,亟需系统化框架来衡量智能体的行为一致性和确定性。现有方法(如LangSmith、Arize Phoenix等)主要采用反应式、概率性的事后追踪分析,仅评估实际触发的路径,无法探测智能体逻辑空间的绝大部分,存在"冷启动路径问题"。

Method: EDGE框架包含三个高层步骤:(1)对话模拟——对DSL配置进行深度优先搜索(DFS)遍历生成N条路径,每条路径映射为M个多轮对话,通过LLM扮演用户并变化用户画像、温度、意图表述等;(2)捕获模拟详情——记录用户轮次、助手响应、内部状态转换、动作及参数;(3)计算确定性指标——分为精确重放指标(响应一致性、节点/动作轨迹一致性与覆盖率)和变体重放指标,以及对话收敛率(CCR)、路径完成率(PCR)、节点/边效用等图遍历指标。

Result: 在三个智能体上评估:Honda经销商(LangGraph,4节点,30场景×4次重放)、复杂招聘智能体(AgentGraph,6节点,受控转换,136对话×3次重放)和基线招聘智能体(AgentGraph,6节点,全转换开放)。结果:复杂招聘智能体节点轨迹一致性达98.89%,基线招聘智能体为90.19%,Honda经销商为78.89%。复杂智能体的稀疏拓扑设计显著提升了确定性,但响应一致性(2.92)低于轨迹一致性,说明路径遵守不必然保证语义一致性。

Conclusion: EDGE提供了一个实用且可解释的框架,用于评估基于图的智能体工作流的行为确定性。实验表明,精心设计且具有约束性节点转换的图结构能显著提高智能体的确定性。框架可推广至多种智能体编排框架(如LangGraph、AgentGraph),既适用于设计时验证,也适用于生产环境评估。

Abstract: As agentic systems evolve into complex multi agent orchestration workflows, there is a growing and critical need for systematic frameworks that measures an agent's behavioral consistency and determinism. In this paper, we introduce a formal evaluation methodology that is grounded in AgentGraph, a planner powered by a domain specific language that represents agent reasoning through a dynamically adjustable directed graph. We leverage this structural formalism and utilize graph traversal algorithms that exhaustively enumerate conversational paths, forming a comprehensive evaluation set that captures the agent's complete behavioral space. We then systematically replay these reproducible trajectories to compare observed outputs and state transitions against the intended DSL specification. To quantify reliability, we define novel metrics that measure response and trajectory determinism, structural adherence and semantic consistency across both exact replays and their linguistic variants. Our system's results demonstrate that agents configured using frameworks like AgentGraph and LangGraph with explicitly structured node transitions show superior determinism over agents that are not configured with controlled transitions.

</details>


### [350] [An Open-Source, Event-Driven Pipeline for Cryptocurrency Market Data: Ingestion, Forecasting, and On-Chain Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29973)
*Basil Sajid Shaikh,Melrick Mascarenhas,Nuzhat Faiz Shaikh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套完全开源的数据管道，用于在低成本通用硬件上复刻云端事件驱动架构，处理加密货币高频多源数据；管道基于 Apache Kafka 和文件系统监听机制，将 Gemini 交易所的历史数据切分为小时和分钟粒度文件，经由两组独立的 Kafka 消费者进行异步摄入（分别用于审计日志和 Spark 触发的 ETL），最终落地到 PostgreSQL 数据仓库（含历史表、聚合表及各币种数据集市）。在建模层面，作者使用比特币数据集市对比 seasonal ARIMA 与单层 LSTM 价格预测模型，并在以太坊欺诈检测基准上对比 Random Forest 与 Gradient Boosting 分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密货币市场数据具有高频、多源特性，传统做法依赖商业级流式与仓储基础设施，门槛高、成本大。作者希望证明仅依靠开源组件即可在普通硬件上复现云原生事件驱动系统的行为，从而降低学术和中小团队的研究门槛。

Method: （1）架构层面：采用"文件到达 → 消息 → 计算"的级联触发范式，用文件系统轮询替代云端托管触发器；通过 Kafka 实现异步、解耦的消息传递；设计两组独立的消费者组（审计日志组 + Spark ETL 组）并行处理数据；数据按小时与分钟粒度分区，最终写入 PostgreSQL 的历史模式、聚合模式及按资产划分的数据集市。（2）预测建模：使用比特币数据，构建 seasonal ARIMA 与单层 LSTM 进行价格预测对比。（3）分类建模：在 Farrugia 等人公开的以太坊欺诈检测数据集上，使用 Random Forest 与 Gradient Boosting，并加入额外的工程化特征。

Result: 论文给出了完整的架构设计、建模方法论及相应指标。具体预测与分类结果数值未在所提供文本中给出，需查阅正文实验部分。作者明确指出两点局限性——其一，比较不同预测时间窗（horizon）下发出的预测结果具有内在偏差；其二，在已静态标注的数据集上评估欺诈检测模型存在数据泄漏风险或泛化性不足的问题。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了基于开源栈构建加密货币数据管道与建模分析的可行路径，强调可复现性与低成本，但同时坦承其评估方法在时间窗对比与静态基准测试上的局限，提示后续工作应在统一时间基准与更具挑战性的数据划分上进行更严谨的实验。

Abstract: Cryptocurrency markets generate high-frequency, multi-source data that is expensive to work with unless a team already has commercial-grade streaming and warehousing infrastructure in place. This paper describes a fully open-source pipeline that reproduces the behavior of a cloud-native, event-driven system -- file arrival triggering a message, a message triggering compute -- entirely on commodity hardware, using Apache Kafka and a filesystem-watching poller in place of managed cloud triggers. The pipeline partitions historical Gemini exchange data into hourly and minutely files, ingests them asynchronously through two independently grouped Kafka consumers (one for audit logging, one for Spark-triggered ETL), and lands cleaned output in a PostgreSQL warehouse with historical and aggregated schemas plus asset-specific data marts. We use the resulting Bitcoin data mart to compare a seasonal ARIMA model against a single-layer LSTM network for price forecasting, and separately apply Random Forest and Gradient Boosting classifiers, with additional engineered features, to the public Ethereum fraud detection benchmark introduced by Farrugia et al.
