We report the architecture, the modeling methodology, and the resulting metrics, and we are explicit about the limitations of comparing forecasts issued at different horizons and of evaluating fraud detection on a static, already-labeled dataset.

</details>


### [351] [AutoCRAT: Within-trajectory Joint Control of Stochasticity and Compute for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29988)
*Hanjun Luo,Qiushi Liu,Jingya Zhang,Haihong Pang,Jiaheng Wen,Yifei Ma,Yu Yao,Chengxi Zhang,Hanrong Zhang,Yankai Chen,Hanan Salam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 AutoCRAT：在不修改或读取骨干模型内部状态的前提下，仅利用解码器侧信号，把解码随机性（温度）与推理计算预算（剩余 token 上限）作为两个离散控制维度，并在单条推理轨迹的语义边界处联合更新。它在 6 个基准、4 个不同规模和家族的冻结骨干模型上，以单样本评估取得了更好的准确率—计算量折中：相对推荐的静态配置，平均准确率相对提高约 2.2%–4.0%，同时平均 token 减少 13.8%–52.7%；相对自适应基线 EDT/DEER 的相对准确率优势为 1.5%/4.5%。一个仅用 Qwen3-4B 静态轨迹训练的控制器还能迁移到 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 及两个未见基准，显示了较强的跨骨干和域外泛化能力。核心意义是把“每个请求固定一个配置”推进到“轨迹内按阶段协同控制”：在不确定性高时探索并保留预算，在答案逐步确定后降低温度、缩短预算并转入作答，从而同时抑制过度探索和过度思考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时控制通常预先固定整条请求的温度和计算预算，或只单独调节解码随机性、推理长度。论文指出，单一轨迹不同阶段的最优策略会变化：早期可能需要更广探索，后期则需收敛、验证并生成答案；静态或单轴控制器无法刻画二者在轨迹内的交互。作者因此提出一个更一般的视角：在单轨迹、前向生成、无回滚和模型参数冻结的约束下，所有可行的推理时干预最终都落在“如何塑造下一 token 分布”与“是否继续生成”两类控制上，即随机性与计算量。AutoCRAT 将这一观点实例化为轻量、接口耦合较弱的解码侧控制器。

Method: AutoCRAT 附加于冻结骨干模型，以轻量 MLP 根据解码器侧可观测特征与上一控制状态，在每个语义边界联合选择离散温度级别和离散 token 预算级别。温度取 {0, 0.3, 0.7, 1.0}，预算取 {0, 64, 256, 1024, 4096}；top-p 固定为 0.95。边界包括换行、段落分隔、句末标点、显式步骤标记，以及答案完成、自然 EOS 或预算耗尽；相邻决策点至少间隔 6 token。think 阶段同时控制温度和预算，answer 阶段冻结预算但继续控制温度。控制器只使用熵、top-k 概率质量、EOS 概率、进度、剩余预算和边界类型等表层信号，不访问隐藏状态。训练数据来自 Qwen3-4B 对 4×5 静态动作网格的 19,620 条轨迹，含 981 个问题、312,487 个边界样本和 74,863 个偏好对。轨迹奖励为正确性减 λ 乘问题内归一化 token 成本；控制头采用奖励加权的软目标行为克隆与偏好排序联合训练，λ=0.2。训练一次后直接用于四个骨干及未见任务。评估覆盖 GSM8K、MATH-500、ARC-C、GPQA-D、HumanEval、MBPP，指标为非代码准确率、代码执行通过率 pass@1 和平均完成 token；比较 Base、Recommend、EDT、DEER、AdaReasoner 和 Self-Consistency。

Result: 1. 跨模型：AutoCRAT 在四个骨干、六个基准上均优于推荐静态设置。相对平均准确率提升约 2.2%–4.0%，平均 token 减少 13.8%–52.7%。例如 Qwen3-4B 从 71.2%/1,941 token 提升至 73.2%/982；Qwen3-30B 从 80.1%/2,205 提升至 81.7%/998。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 在 5/6 个基准准确率更高，平均准确率由 63.0% 升至 65.1%，token 由 1,443 降至 1,208。
2. 静态联合配置上界：相较针对每个任务选择的最佳固定“温度—预算”组合，AutoCRAT 在 GSM8K、ARC-C、HumanEval 上平均准确率由 76.9% 升至 78.1%，token 由 1,323 降至 750。每条轨迹平均发生约 2.34–4.17 次控制切换，代码任务通常更多。
3. 自适应基线：在 Qwen3-4B 上，AutoCRAT 平均准确率 73.2%、982 token；EDT 为 72.1%、1,858 token，DEER 为 69.9%、953 token。相对准确率分别提高 1.5% 和 4.5%。
4. 请求级与多轨迹方法：在 MATH-500、ARC-C、GPQA-D 上，AutoCRAT 与 AdaReasoner 平均准确率同为 73.3%，但 token 为 978 对 1,693；与五条轨迹投票的 Self-Consistency 相比，准确率 73.3% 对 73.2%，总 token 为 978 对 8,131。
5. 消融：联合控制同时优于仅调温度和仅调预算；语义边界更新也优于逐 token 更新。说明采样与计算存在交互，且噪声较大的逐 token 信号会破坏局部推理片段。
6. 域外泛化：控制器未在 SVAMP 和 CommonsenseQA 上训练，仍在 Qwen3-4B/8B 上同时提高准确率并减少 36.8%–42.9% token。
7. 稳定性和效率：三组训练种子均在六个基准上同时提高准确率并降低 token。控制器使骨干生成吞吐下降 16%–22%，但因轨迹缩短，A100 batch-1 端到端墙钟时间仍减少 45%–59%。
8. 局限：仅使用温度与绝对 token 预算；离线静态轨迹训练可能与在线自适应策略形成分布偏移；流畅但错误的低熵推导会触发过早收敛；结构不规则任务中的边界检测可能不稳；每边界调用控制头会增加延迟；实验限于英语文本推理。

Conclusion: 论文的主要贡献不只是一个新的推理时控制器，而是提出并形式化“单轨迹内联合控制随机性与计算量”的控制视角。AutoCRAT 表明，将二者离散化并在语义边界协调更新，能够比静态配置、只控制单一维度的自适应方法、请求级联合调参以及多条轨迹采样获得更好的准确率—计算效率折中。其跨骨干、跨任务泛化进一步说明，训练所得控制策略可能捕获了与具体架构无关的阶段性推理动态。不过，结论主要建立在表层解码信号、有限动作网格和离线监督之上；对更强模型、多语言、多模态、代理式任务、在线闭环训练及更丰富控制动作的适用性仍需验证。总体而言，该工作为推理时计算的自适应分配提供了简洁、可迁移且具有明确工程价值的控制范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, which depends critically on inference-time decisions. Yet these decisions are commonly handled by static, one-size-fits-all policies, limiting adaptation to diverse tasks and reasoning stages. Recent adaptive methods partially address this limitation, but they primarily adapt either decoding stochasticity (how the model explores) or reasoning compute (how long the model reasons) in isolation, leaving their interaction within a single reasoning trajectory unmodeled. To address this challenge, we shift toward a within-trajectory joint control view, and instantiate it in AutoCRAT, a decoder-side controller for frozen backbones. Using only signals available during decoding, AutoCRAT jointly adjusts sampling stochasticity and reasoning budget during generation. AutoCRAT operates over a discrete action space and updates control decisions only at semantic boundaries, improving stability while remaining responsive to the evolving reasoning process. Comprehensive evaluation across 6 benchmarks demonstrates that AutoCRAT (I) uses 13.8-52.7% fewer inference tokens on average than recommended static configurations, (II) surpasses recommended static and adaptive baselines by 1.5-4.5% in relative accuracy, and (III) enjoys strong cross-backbone transferability.

</details>


### [352] [Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30022)
*Ashvin Gupta,Denys Prociuk,Alessandra Russo,Brendan C. Delaney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的端到端方法，可将NICE临床指南的自然语言文本自动转换为可执行的计算模型，从而生成可解释的、针对患者的推荐意见，并在胰腺癌和肺癌指南上验证了其可行性与准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NICE临床指南虽然为循证临床实践提供了权威推荐，但主要以非结构化的自然语言形式存在，难以直接计算化执行。现有的计算化方法通常聚焦于单一疾病，依赖大量人工编码，难以扩展到大范围临床场景。大语言模型的兴起为自动化这一转换流程带来了机会，但其在保持指南完整性与可解释性方面的能力尚待验证。

Method: 1) 提出一种端到端、基于LLM的流水线方法，将文本临床指南转化为可执行模型；2) 采用分步骤（stepwise）的LLM转换，并结合上下文示例（in-context examples），生成人可审查的中间产物；3) 将方法应用于NICE胰腺癌和肺癌指南；4) 通过专家审查评估生成规则与源指南的对齐程度；5) 在20个患者情景（vignettes）上对胰腺癌可执行模型进行定量评估。

Result: 1) 专家审查显示源指南与可执行模型之间具有高度一致性；2) 大多数偏差表现为部分遗漏（partial omissions），而非逻辑错误；3) 幻觉或根本性错误的规则极为罕见；4) 在20个患者情景的评估中，可执行模型的F1得分达到82.5%。

Conclusion: LLM能够将自然语言的NICE指南转化为可解释、可执行的模型，既能保留指南的结构，又支持透明的审查与修改，并能生成针对具体患者的推荐。这表明大规模自动化生成可计算临床指南具有可行性，为临床决策支持的扩展应用提供了基础。

Abstract: Introduction: NICE guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations for clinical care but remain largely in unstructured natural language. Existing approaches to converting them into computable representations often focus on individual diseases, require substantial manual encoding, and do not scale. Large language models (LLMs) may enable much of this translation to be automated. Methods: We present an end-to-end approach that converts textual clinical guidelines into executable models capable of generating explainable, patient-specific recommendations. A stepwise LLM-based transformation with in-context examples produces human-inspectable intermediate artifacts. We apply the approach to NICE pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines, use expert review to assess rule alignment, and evaluate the executable pancreatic cancer model on 20 patient vignettes. Results: Expert review showed strong alignment between the source guidelines and generated executable models. Most discrepancies were partial omissions rather than incorrect logic, while hallucinated or fundamentally incorrect rules were rare. On the patient vignettes, the executable model achieved an F1 score of 82.5%. Conclusion: LLMs can transform natural-language NICE guidelines into interpretable, executable models that preserve guideline structure, support transparent inspection and modification, and generate patient-specific recommendations. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable automated generation of computable clinical guidelines.

</details>


### [353] [Interpreting and Steering for Safe and Correct Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30025)
*Hao Yan,Ziyu Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DuoSteer，一种基于机制可解释性的免训练双重引导方法，通过在因果识别的注意力头上同时注入安全方向与正确性方向，显著降低 LLM 生成代码的漏洞率并保持功能正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的代码常含安全漏洞（CWE），现有防御手段（提示工程、安全 SFT）仅作用于输入/输出边界，未触及模型内部计算机制；对"安全 vs. 漏洞"在 LM 内部如何表征与驱动缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 1) 构建 CodeSec-Pairs（9,342 对 Python 安全/漏洞对比样本，基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 五类 CWE）；2) 用线性探针定位"信息编码"位置，用因果头敲除定位"驱动"组件；3) 提出 DuoSteer：在安全因果头与正确性因果头分别注入均值差方向（双向量加性组合），解耦安全-正确性权衡；4) 在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B 上验证，对比 SFT、提示工程、单向量引导。

Result: 在 SecCodePLT 五类 CWE 上，DuoSteer 平均漏洞率下降 26.9%、功能正确率提升 7.5%，在联合指标 C(1−V) 上显著优于 ProbeMD、CausalMD、LayerMD、Hint Prompting 与 SFT 基线（如 CWE-502 V 由 64.7%→0%，C 升至 94.1%）；并通过 2,500 对 Qwen 数据复现。关键发现：探针排名与因果效应 Spearman ρ≤0.072（不相关）；安全与正确性因果头集基本不相交，二者向量在表征空间近似正交。

Conclusion: 探针定位与因果定位指向不同组件，必须以因果头作为干预靶点；将安全与正确性作为两条独立方向施加于各自因果头集的双重引导，能在不重训前提下缓解安全-正确性权衡；该机制在 Llama 与 Qwen 两个模型上均成立，但效果强弱取决于每类 CWE 的安全方向因果牵引力及训练对的修复模式集中度。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate source code containing vulnerabilities, yet little work studies the internal mechanisms that distinguish safe from vulnerable generation in them. In this work, we systematically perform a mechanistic interpretation of LLMs, aiming at both understanding how code safety-vs-vulnerability is represented or driven by components in an LM and turning the insights into actionable steering strategies to encourage safer code generation. To this end, we introduce CodeSec-Pairs, a dataset of 9,342 Python safe-and-vulnerable contrastive code pairs, sampled from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Utilizing the dataset, we explore approaches to localize layers and attention heads that relate to code safety, and further experiment with different steering strategies for inference-time vulnerability reduction. In particular, we propose DuoSteer, a double-steering approach that simultaneously applies safety and code-correctness steering to attention heads. In experiments over five vulnerability types, DuoSteer leads to an average of -26.9% vulnerability rate reduction and +7.5% functional correctness improvement, which outperforms not only other steering variants but also prompting and supervised fine-tuning baselines. The advantage also replicates on Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with another 2,500 contrastive pairs sampled from that model.

</details>


### [354] [Beyond Uncertainty: Multi-Solver Disagreement Rewards for Self-Evolving Reasoning Curricula](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30035)
*Vinoth Selvendran,Zhanming Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种多求解器分歧奖励机制，通过异构求解器集成（包含架构多样性和采样温度多样性）的归一化Shannon熵来替代单一求解器的不确定性奖励，解决了自进化推理框架中奖励坍缩的根本瓶颈，在MATH-500/AMC/Olympiad上相对R-Zero基线平均提升+1.34分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化推理框架（如R-Zero）使用单一求解器的采样不确定性作为Challenger的奖励信号，存在两个根本缺陷：(1)当求解器对Challenger生成的问题分布变得自信时，采样答案收敛一致，奖励坍缩为零，Challenger失去学习信号；(2)单一模型奖励无法区分真正容易的问题与仅符合单个求解器学习偏好的问题。这导致训练后期奖励信号失效，模型性能退化（R-Zero迭代3后性能下降即为例证）。

Method: 核心方法是用多求解器分歧奖励替代单一不确定性奖励。具体设计包括：(1)构建3个异构求解器集成：S_a（Qwen3-4B GRPO训练版，T=0.7）、S_b（同S_a权重，T=1.0）、S_c（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，T=0.7），沿采样温度和模型架构两个轴产生多样性；(2)每个变体独立生成k=10个答案，通过mathruler.symbolic等价检查和Union-Find聚类得到内部多数答案a_i；(3)分歧奖励定义为归一化Shannon熵：r_dis = H(a_Sa, a_Sb, a_Sc) / log|ℰ|，范围[0,1]；(4)组合奖励r(q) = α·r_unc + β·r_dis - r_rep，其中α=1.0，β=0.5，不确定性保留为主信号，分歧作为互补项；(5)系统采用分布式推理架构（3个独立GPU推理引擎），每batch增加约8分钟wall-clock时间和3倍GPU小时开销。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1)基准性能：在MATH-500上达到60.40%（vs R-Zero 59.20%，+1.20），AMC上45.70%（vs 44.38%，+1.32），Olympiad上30.96%（vs 29.48%，+1.48），竞赛数学平均+1.34分；但GSM8K上89.39%（vs 89.99%，-0.60），因课程规模减小导致常规问题覆盖率降低；(2)奖励动态：r_dis从0.609上升到0.718（+18%），标准差从0.336下降到0.278，显示收敛趋势；r_unc保持稳定在约0.20，证实两信号的正交性；(3)BLEU重复惩罚平均仅0.001-0.004，表明分歧信号自然促进问题多样性。

Conclusion: 多求解器分歧奖励为自进化推理框架提供了与单一不确定性正交的难度信号维度，上升的r_dis轨迹和针对性的竞赛数学增益表明模型间分歧捕获了真实的能力边界。该方法是即插即用的奖励函数替代方案，无需修改RL训练框架或数据管道，适用于任何Challenger-Solver协同进化系统。但论文也承认未测试多迭代场景下r_dis是否会避免R-Zero式的性能坍缩。

Abstract: Self-evolving reasoning frameworks train a Challenger to generate questions exposing a Solver's weaknesses, creating adaptive curricula without human data. However, existing approaches use a single solver's sampling uncertainty as the Challenger's reward. This creates a fundamental bottleneck: as the solver grows confident on the Challenger's question distribution, all sampled answers converge identically, collapsing the reward to zero and starving the Challenger of learning signal. Critically, this single-model reward cannot distinguish genuinely easy questions from those that merely align with one solver's learned biases. We propose a multi-solver disagreement reward using a heterogeneous ensemble varying in model capacity and sampling temperature. A normalized Shannon entropy over the ensemble's per-question plurality answers explicitly rewards questions where solvers produce conflicting solutions---capturing difficulty as inter-model divergence rather than intra-model sampling variance. This richer gradient enables the Challenger to discover questions targeting true capability boundaries, producing a curriculum that forces downstream Solvers to develop robust reasoning strategies generalizing across problem types. Our approach is a drop-in reward function replacement requiring no framework modifications or additional data. Experiments with Qwen3-4B show that Solvers trained on disagreement-Challenger questions achieve +1.34 points average improvement on competition-math benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC, Olympiad), suggesting that multi-solver disagreement provides a complementary and scalable signal for curriculum generation in self-play reasoning systems.

</details>


### [355] [Balance of Benchmarks: Semantic Density Reweighting for Benchmark Multiplicity and Task-Conditioned Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30044)
*Jhen-Ke Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Balance of Benchmarks (BoB)，一种基于语义密度的基准测试重加权框架，用于解决大语言模型评估中由于基准列表"自然累积生长"而导致的两个问题：(1) 等权平均使被频繁发表的领域隐式获得过高权重（基准多重性问题）；(2) 单一聚合分数无法反映模型在特定任务上的相对优势。BoB 通过对基准描述进行嵌入、计算语义逆密度权重，并结合特征曲线等值化与查询条件残别场，在保留任务条件化预测能力的同时提升对重复基准的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言模型排行榜普遍采用等权平均聚合各基准分数，但基准列表通常未经显式测量规划即不断累积，这导致两个结构性问题：(1) 被密集发表的领域（如 AIME 系列、Terminal-Bench 系列）隐式获得过高权重，等价于将发表密度转化为能力权重；(2) 单一聚合分数无法识别哪些模型在特定用户任务上具有超出其一般能力的异常优势。现有聚合方法（手工分类、协方差权重、子集选择）均无法同时解决这两个问题。

Method: BoB 包含三个阶段：(1) 分数等值化——使用项目反应理论中的特征曲线 Φ(ai(θm−bi)) 将异构基准分数映射到共同潜在能力尺度，并通过鲁棒单元格权重限制残差异常值影响；(2) 语义逆密度加权——使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 嵌入基准描述为单位球面向量，计算局部密度 ρi = Σj exp(−d²/2h²)，并赋予逆密度权重 ui = 1/ρi，密度带宽设置为中位距离的 0.25 倍，给出有效基准质量 W = 12.5；(3) 查询条件残别场——将用户任务嵌入为查询点 q，使用高斯核加权近邻基准的标准化残别，以 cm(q) = Pm(q)/(Pm(q)+1) 进行支持依赖的正则化，最终得分为 θm + cm(q)·r̂raw(q)，场带宽 h 通过嵌套留一基准验证在 {0.3, 0.45, 0.6} 倍中位距离中选择。三阶段中描述驱动的语义权重与分数驱动的能力估计保持分离。

Result: 在 Artificial Analysis 2026-08-29 快照的 586 个模型与 14 个基准上，BoB 在留一基准预测中达到 0.902 等级相关性与 0.462 剖面相关性（等权仅为 0.877 与 0.049），剖面优势经 Holm 校正后仍统计显著；在四次重复列出测试中保持 Kendall τ = 0.995（等权为 0.936），重复位移仅 0.098 个标准差（等权为 0.973）。消融实验表明：平坦语义权重使剖面几乎不变（0.451）但重复位移激增十倍；随机打乱描述后剖面降至 0.336 ± 0.042 且无一达到 0.462；三种嵌入规模下结果变化不超过 0.02；群体稳定性测试中添加 38–75 个同家族模型后 BoB 排名变化 Spearman > 0.9999。

Conclusion: BoB 将基准列表的组成从评估套件的"偶然属性"转化为测量设计的"显式可控部分"：分数等值化处理异构难度范围，逆密度加权处理基准多重性，残别场提供任务条件化预测。三通道中，逆密度权重主要承担多重性鲁棒性，残别场主要承担任务条件化预测，二者结合为任务感知且多重性鲁棒的模型评估提供了原则化基础。

Abstract: Language models are commonly compared by averaging scores across a benchmark list with equal weight. Such lists grow through publication outside an explicit measurement design, so equal weighting turns the density of published benchmarks into an implicit capability weight: densely benchmarked regions count repeatedly. We introduce Balance of Benchmarks (BoB), which embeds benchmark descriptions and assigns each benchmark an inverse-density semantic weight. Nearby entries share aggregate influence at a disclosed density scale. After equating heterogeneous scores onto a common latent scale, a residual field uses the same geometry to condition model rankings on a task query. The two components serve distinct empirical roles. On a snapshot of 586 models and 14 benchmarks, BoB predicts which models are unusually strong on a held-out task beyond their general ability, reaching a profile correlation of 0.462 compared with 0.049 under equal weighting. It also limits the influence of densely repeated benchmarks on the aggregate. After adding four copies of each benchmark in turn, the resulting rankings retain a Kendall tau of 0.995, compared with 0.936 under equal weighting. The residual field therefore provides task-conditioned prediction, and inverse-density weighting provides robustness to benchmark multiplicity. Together, they turn benchmark-list composition from an incidental property of evaluation suites into an explicit, controllable part of measurement design, providing a principled foundation for task-aware and multiplicity-robust model evaluation.

</details>


### [356] [Can LLM Agents Discover? Evaluating Creativity on ML Engineering Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30047)
*Shitanshu Bhushan,Yunxiang Zhang,Lu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估LLM研究智能体创造力的框架，基于Boden的P-Creativity（心理新颖性）和H-Creativity（历史新颖性）概念，在MLE-Bench的10个Kaggle风格ML任务上评估了AIDE和AIRA-Dojo两个智能体框架。研究发现：LLM-as-a-Judge与人类创造力判断高度相关（r=0.732）；所有智能体的P-Creativity在迭代中持续下降；GPT-5的H-Creativity显著高于金牌人类，但任务表现却更低，表明"新颖性无法转化为有用性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期AI系统声称能自主发现算法和产出研究论文，但其在科学发现中是否真正具备创造力（既新颖又有用的能力）尚不清楚。作者希望填补这一空白，量化评估LLM智能体在多轮迭代中的创造力表现，理解其与人类创造力的区别。

Method: 1. 定义分析单元为"episode"（智能体从提出新计划到成功执行的完整问题解决过程）；2. 基于Boden的创造力框架，将新颖性分为P-Creativity（相对于自身历史）和H-Creativity（相对于人类解决方案库），将有用性分解为可行性（feasibility）和影响力（impact，归一化的性能提升）；3. 评估七种自动指标（含LLM-as-a-Judge、语义距离、概念新颖性）与人类标注的相关性，验证LLM-as-a-Judge（GPT-5）的有效性（Spearman r=0.732）；4. 采用两阶段管道测量H-Creativity：先用语义检索获取人类最近邻，再由GPT-5在六个方法学维度上评判；5. 在MLE-Bench的10个任务上评估AIDE（贪心树搜索）和AIRA-Dojo（贪心/MCTS/进化），比较GPT-5和Qwen3-32B的表现。

Result: RQ1：LLM-as-a-Judge（GPT-5）与人类P-Creativity标注的相关性最强（r=0.732），优于所有嵌入方法和概念方法，且对提示设计、长度、位置、自我偏好等均无系统偏差。RQ2：所有智能体（包括人类）的性能随episode提升，但P-Creativity普遍下降（探索→利用转变），认知行为分析显示战略性探索从早期75%降至末期25%，参数精修从15%升至50%以上；P-Creativity变化与影响力变化基本无相关（|r|≤0.11），不同搜索策略（贪心/MCTS/进化）后期趋于收敛。RQ3：GPT-5的H-Creativity达1.423，近乎金牌人类（0.744）的两倍，显著超越人类基线（p<10^-15），但仅21.25%的运行达到奖牌级性能；交叉任务基线（2.39）高于所有智能体在正确任务上的得分，证明其新颖性反映任务特定的真实探索而非无方向发散；时间分布分析显示最近邻并非集中在早期被人类抛弃的方法；87%的智能体在到达高H-Creativity状态后选择精修而非放弃，但精修导致53.8%后续episode的H-Creativity下降且影响力无变化。

Conclusion: 当前LLM研究智能体能够探索人类解决方案空间中未被记录的新颖区域（GPT-5的H-Creativity超过金牌人类），但缺乏将新颖性转化为性能提升的能力——纯粹的探索或纯粹的利用都无法产生突破性发现；真正的自主科学发现需要创造力，即同时具备新颖性和有用性的能力。该框架验证的P-Creativity指标可作为可操作的优化信号（新颖性奖励、自适应探索调度、效率与多样性双重目标）以指导未来智能体设计。

Abstract: Recent AI systems promise autonomous scientific discovery, claiming to discover algorithms and produce research papers, yet understanding whether they exhibit creativity, the capacity to produce solutions that are both novel and useful, remains an open question. We present a framework for evaluating multi-turn LLM research agents' creativity using ML engineering tasks as a testbed, through three dimensions: P-Creativity (psychological novelty: novel relative to the agent's own prior solutions within a run), H-Creativity (historical novelty: novel relative to the corpus of human solutions), and Usefulness (task performance). Evaluating two agent frameworks, AIDE and AIRA-Dojo, on 10 Kaggle-style machine learning tasks from MLE-Bench, we develop an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline and verify its strong correlation with human creativity judgments, providing a reliable automated metric for P-Creativity evaluation at scale. Applying this pipeline to agent trajectories, we find: (1) all agents exhibit declining P-Creativity as they transition from exploration to exploitation; (2) LLMs exhibit greater H-Creativity than medal-winning humans, yet achieve lower performance. Our findings reveal that current agents can explore novel regions of the solution space but lack the capacity to convert this novelty into improved task performance.

</details>


### [357] [Spec2Twin-Chain: Orchestrating Bi-Level Optimization with LLMs for Blockchain Digital Twin Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30050)
*Haoting Zhang,Haoxian Chen,Jiayuan Sheng,Donglin Zhan,Zeyu Zheng,David D. Yao,Wenpin Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Spec2Twin-Chain提出一个双层优化框架，将区块链数字孪生构建自动化：上层使用大语言模型（LLM）根据系统规范、行为证据和反馈提出架构方案；下层使用基于仿真的优化器（NSGA-II）在架构条件化的参数空间内进行参数标定。两层迭代，通过全局Pareto存档累积评估候选，指导后续架构搜索。框架在六个受控实验中得到验证：BlockSim校准、拥塞/对抗压力分析、MEV风格区块构建策略、发送方包含费策略、以及GSMP风格更新时机策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链数字孪生的构建传统上依赖大量人工建模工作，难以跨系统复用。现有区块链模拟器碎片化，无法覆盖不同架构需求；而纯LLM辅助合成无法保证生成的架构方案结构上合法或能通过可执行验证。因此需要一种自动化方法，将非正式系统描述转化为经过验证且可复用的数字孪生。

Method: 框架将数字孪生构建建模为双层约束优化问题：决策变量为离散架构d（组件拓扑、交互模板、抽象模式）和架构条件化的连续/离散调参变量θ。上层：LLM（Codex）作为架构师，依据系统规范S、行为证据E、目标合约J_R和反馈历史H_{t-1}提出候选架构，经模式（schema）验证后传入下层。下层：使用可行性感知NSGA-II在Θ(d)内进行多目标仿真优化，返回Pareto前沿。非主导候选合并入全局存档A_global，并选代表性子集作为下一轮LLM反馈上下文。Part 2.3下层改用有界随机搜索。整体通过Algorithm 1的迭代循环实现。

Result: Part 1：在BlockSim证据下实现EVM-PoW内存池孪生校准，聚合拟合误差0.0225（阈值0.05），KPI中块计数、交易计数、叔块等指标匹配精确，时间分布指标存在残余误差；反馈恢复消融显示从0.301降至0.022。Part 2.1a拥塞研究：32个提议，0回退，吞吐量拟合误差0，保守崩溃阈值76 TPS。Part 2.1b对抗压力：6个提议，聚合轮廓拟合误差0，但仅2/5严格类别指纹匹配（暴露局限性）。Part 2.2a MEV风格区块构建：24提议，奖励增量1.6575 ETH，4.2秒完成（预算12秒）。Part 2.2b包含策略：24提议，最小包含概率0.8016，总费159.38 gwei。Part 2.3更新策略：8个锁定种子下，LLM引导选择性更新获得最优操作分数0.0924（约1次更新/天），95%置信区间在三种基线对比中均排除零差异。

Conclusion: Spec2Twin-Chain提供了一种结构化工作流，将规范、综合、校准、验证和重用连接在一个优化导向的数字孪生构建过程中。贡献不在于单一区块链模拟器，而在于方法论框架。实验支持框架在受控场景下构建行为准确的孪生、通过迭代反馈改进初始设计、并复用校准孪生支持下游决策。未来工作方向：(1)从受控场景转向更丰富的历史区块链数据验证（特别是MEV/PBS相关）；(2)下层优化器对评估预算和目标结构自适应（如贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES）；(3)将反馈循环从基于存档的离线精化扩展为带不确定性量化的在线重校准。

Abstract: Building a blockchain digital twin largely requires translating domain knowledge and specific system descriptions into a simulator architecture, calibrating its parameters against behavioral evidence, and validating the constructed twin. These steps are commonly performed through application-specific modeling efforts that can be difficult to reuse across systems and downstream decision problems. We consider automating this process through Spec2Twin-Chain, a framework that formulates blockchain digital-twin construction as a bi-level optimization problem. At the upper level, a large language model proposes and revises structurally admissible architectures using system specifications, behavioral evidence, and feedback from evaluated designs. At the lower level, a simulation-based optimizer calibrates the architecture-conditioned parameters under explicit objectives and guardrail constraints. The two levels iterate. The evaluated candidates at lower levels are retained in a global archive and used to guide subsequent proposals at upper levels. We conduct controlled experiments involving twin calibration, feedback-driven recovery, stress analysis, downstream policy optimization, and policy updating. The results demonstrate that the framework can construct behaviorally accurate twins, improve initial designs through iterative feedback, and reuse calibrated twins to support downstream decisions.

</details>


### [358] [Mitigating Over-Optimization in PRM-Guided Search in Mathematical Reasoning by Optimizing the Guide](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30051)
*Taejong Joo,Diego Klabjan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对PRM引导搜索中过度优化问题，提出了一种无需训练的鲁棒过程监督方法——maximin PRM-guided search，通过核惩罚来减轻验证器噪声的影响，在多个数学推理基准上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRM引导的搜索在数学推理等任务中虽能提供密集的步骤级指导，但容易过度优化不完美的过程奖励，导致剪枝有潜力的轨迹并扩展虚假轨迹。需要一种鲁棒的方法来应对验证器的不确定性。

Method: 1. 理论分析：证明了直接利用PRM分数的搜索存在极端值效应，非可行的前缀在推理深度增加时更容易获得虚高的分数。2. 将PRM引导搜索建模为关于合理奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题（maximin PRM-guided search）。3. 使用RBF核定义轨迹间的相似性，通过核惩罚项 $\tilde{B}\sqrt{q^TKq}$ 来惩罚冗余选择，鼓励选择多样性以应对结构化验证器错误。4. 利用变分重构将非可分优化转化为子模最大化问题，通过网格搜索和随机贪心算法近似求解。

Result: 在GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME'24和AIME'25四个数学推理基准上，使用Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B和Phi-3.5-mini-instruct两个生成器，在16个设置中的14个中达到最优或并列最优，相对PRM引导基线（SBS）平均提升17-35%。该方法对验证器噪声具有强鲁棒性，在 $\epsilon=1.0$ 的噪声水平下，SBS相对退化12.7%而maximin仅退化1.4%。运行时开销仅增加约0.27%（N=16时）。

Conclusion: 推理时计算在PRM引导搜索中的有效扩展不仅需要更强的学习评估器，还需要对评估器不确定性具有鲁棒性的搜索算法。Maximin搜索作为一种无需训练的方法，通过将过程监督重新表述为奖励误设定下的鲁棒优化问题，有效缓解了过度优化问题，显著提升了数学推理性能。

Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) provide dense step-level guidance for search-based reasoning, enabling inference-time compute to be allocated toward promising partial solutions. However, recent evidence suggests that PRM-guided search can over-optimize imperfect process rewards, pruning viable trajectories while expanding spurious ones. In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become more likely to receive spuriously high scores as reasoning depth increase. Therefore, we formulate the PRM-guided search as a robust optimization problem over plausible reward perturbations, termed maximin PRM-guided search, leading to a training-free robust process supervision method that preserves promising alternatives when step-level scores are noisy. Maximin PRM-guided search mitigates this failure mode by reducing sensitivity to over-optimized PRM outliers. Without fine-tuning or online adaptation, maximin search consistently improves the PRM-guided search by 17-35\% on average, outperforming outcome- and step-level baselines in 14 out of 16 settings. Our source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [359] [Game-Agnostic Value Functions through Automatic JSON Feature Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30056)
*Dien Nguyen,Diego Perez-Liebana*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出JSON-Bag VF，一种基于JSON Bag-of-Tokens原型的通用游戏价值函数训练方法，结合Random Forest特征选择与游戏阶段分段特征选择，在六款桌游上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的游戏智能体通常依赖手工设计的特征或昂贵的深度学习模型，缺乏一种通用的、与具体游戏解耦的特征提取与价值函数构建方法。JSON-Bag虽已被提出用于表示游戏轨迹，但仅限于玩具问题，未应用于实际的博弈任务。

Method: 1. 将JSON-Bag应用于价值函数训练：通过对完整游戏轨迹进行JSON序列化、分词与归一化，构建每个胜者的JSON-Bag原型；2. 使用Jensen-Shannon距离（JSD）结合原型最近邻搜索（P-NNS）推导价值函数值；3. 采用Random Forest的Mean Decrease in Impurity（MDI）进行特征选择（top-k）；4. 提出游戏阶段分段特征选择方法，将轨迹分成N_S段，分别进行特征选择；5. 在六款桌游上以One-step-look-ahead（OSLA）智能体进行评估，对比基于游戏评分的基线OSLA。

Result: 1. JSON-Bag OSLA在《Dominion》《7 Wonders》《Connect-4》《Can't Stop》四款游戏中显著优于基线OSLA；2. 在《Dots and Boxes》和《Sea Salt and Paper》中表现较差，作者推测原因是这两款游戏仅靠评分就足以构建强智能体，JSON-Bag引入的额外噪声反而损害了性能；3. 特征选择对性能有显著提升，尤其在《Dominion》和《7 Wonders》中；4. 效应量分析（η²）表明，特征选择对智能体得分的解释力远高于原型分词方式，在大多数游戏中η²>0.87。

Conclusion: JSON-Bag VF是一种有效的通用价值函数训练框架，能从游戏JSON描述中自动提取特征，并通过特征选择显著提升性能。特征选择比原型分词策略更关键。但该方法在评分本身已是强信号的游戏中表现欠佳，且当前仅在简单OSLA智能体上验证。未来工作包括与MCTS等更复杂智能体结合、更原则化的k值选择、以及能捕捉token间交互的更复杂分词方法。

Abstract: JSON Bag-of-Tokens (JSON-Bag) is a recently proposed method to generically represent game trajectories by tokenizing their JSON descriptions. We introduce JSON-Bag VF, a game-agnostic approach to training value functions for game-playing agents using JSON-Bag prototypes. We show that this approach can be enhanced with Random Forest-based feature selection and a method to select game-stage-specific features. We evaluate JSON-Bag VF with One-step-look-ahead (JSON-Bag OSLA) on six tabletop games over different combinations of prototype-tokenization and feature selections. JSON-Bag OSLA outperforms baseline OSLA agents in most games. Our analysis also shows that feature selection significantly improves JSON-Bag VF and that feature selection is the most important factor in JSON-Bag VF performance, over prototype-tokenization.

</details>


### [360] [VERA: Authority-Preserving Edge Revocation for Federated AI-Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30091)
*Lifei Liu,Haoran Yu,Xiaochong Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VERA提出了一种面向联邦AI智能体工作流中多父节点有向无环图（DAG）的权威一致性撤销契约。它将撤销目标形式化为边删除后可达集的差集，以暴露树级级联的过度撤销和部署者范围级联的撤销不足，并通过签名证据实现无中心授权服务的验证者本地校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代智能体框架（如LangGraph、AutoGen、CrewAI、A2A、MCP）将规划器、工具智能体、远程服务等组合为运行时委托图，但现有撤销API仍沿用令牌或子树作废机制。当某条委托被撤回时，运行时无法准确判断哪些智能体失去权限而哪些独立授权的智能体应继续工作，存在权威一致性问题。

Method: 1. **形式化模型**：定义SIGNED-DAG委托模型，引入分离式权威（disjunctive authority）语义，将边e的撤销目标定义为T_intent(e,G)=reach(G)\reach(G\{e})，即e支配的节点集合；2. **定理证明**：给出边依赖刻画引理（Lemma 1）证明该集合恰为所有根路径必经e的节点，并证明本地观察前缀精确性（Proposition 1）；3. **批处理非组合性证明**（Proposition 2）：证明批量撤销不能简化为单边撤销目标的并集；4. **原型实现**：基于Python+Ed25519实现VERA API/CLI，包括双边签名入边承诺、回滚可检测撤销日志、带证明的目标集与认证邻接完备性机制；5. **实验验证**：在LangGraph执行轨迹（25单元×20次=500轨迹、2000签名决策）以及A2A、AutoGen、CrewAI可移植性工件上进行回放与攻击矩阵测试。

Result: 1. **失败模式验证**：在共享子DAG见证中树级级联过度撤销2个节点，部署者范围级联在跨域场景中遗漏1个节点；2. **规模压力测试**：Barabasi-Albert DAG中树级级联平均附带撤销5.9-79.7节点，200个随机多父DAG中63.5%-100%边出现过度撤销；3. **批处理失败率**：39991个采样边集中，单边目标并集平均21.25%情况下欠撤销；4. **E16主实验**：500/500目标证明验证通过，160/160跨域场景处理正确，760/760攻击被拒绝，320个可选父节点共享智能体全部被边目标保留而树级级联全部错误撤销；5. **可移植性**：A2A、AutoGen、CrewAI共9轨迹53签名事件通过校验，5个CrewAI可执行工作流全部成功；6. **性能开销**：2000节点DAG目标计算仅2.15ms，证明包大小为完整签名包的64.7%-69.0%。

Conclusion: AI智能体撤销本质上是工作流运行时的权威一致性问题，而非单纯的令牌生命周期问题。VERA将分离式权威下的边撤销目标精确化为reach(G)\reach(G\{e})，使运行时能通过签名证据无中心化地校验权威损失。该契约暴露了树级级联的过度撤销、部署者级联欠撤销及批处理非组合性等系统性失败。实践上建议：智能体适配器应发出签名委托边、撤销API应接受边集、依赖方应获得足够认证图证据以校验所被要求执行的权威损失。

Abstract: Modern agent frameworks compose planners, tool agents, remote services, and shared specialists into runtime delegation graphs, but their revocation APIs still resemble token or subtree invalidation. When one delegation is withdrawn, the runtime must know which agents lose authority while independently authorized agents keep working. We study this authority consistency problem and introduce VERA (Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents), a verifier-checkable revocation contract and API emitted by agent-runtime adapters as signed evidence. Under disjunctive authority, revoking edge e invalidates exactly T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e}), the agents whose every authorizing root path used e. Used as a contract, this target exposes two runtime failures: tree cascades over-revoke shared agents, while deployer-scoped cascades under-revoke cross-domain descendants. In a LangGraph framework-replt cells repeated 20 times yield 500compiled-framework traces and 2,000 valid signed delegation decisions; 13/25 cells contain runtime multi-parsharing and 8/25 contain cross-deployer shies 500/500 target proofs, preserves all320 alternate-parent shared-agent cases that tree cascade revokes, and rejects unauthorized signers and omission attacks. Baseline replay over 1,9that holder/node and tree-style targetscannot express this behavior. We further validate schema portability on A2A, AutoGen, and CrewAI artifacts: nine traces, including five executable Cregned delegation events that pass schema and signature checks.

</details>


### [361] [A.X K2 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30181)
*Cheolseung Baek,Dhammiko Arya,Eunki Kim,Gun Song,Gyoungeun Han,Hyunho Yang,Hyunjun Eun,Jin Kim,Junyoung Park,Juyun Wee,Minki Hong,Minkyung Park,Minsang Kim,Minsoo Kang,SaeRom Kim,Sangjin Kim,Sangyeol Lee,Seojin Lee,Seokhwan Jo,Seokyoung Hong,Seongho Choi,Seonghye Cho,Seongmin Ok,Sereimony Sek,Seungmo Cho,Seungsik Kim,Singon Kim,Sohee Park,Sooyeon Park,Subin Yi,Sungbin Yoon,Sungeun Lee,Sung Jun Cheon,Sungwan Kim,Sunwoo Lee,Tae Yoon Kim,Wonbeom Jang,Yohan Ra,Yong-jin Han,Youngjin Kim,Youngrang Kim,Yujin Kang,Yujin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: A.X K2 是 SK Telecom 发布的 688B 参数（33B 激活）MoE 语言模型，专为智能体（agentic）应用设计。其核心创新包括稀疏门控注意力（SGA）和门控归一化（GN），实现高效长上下文处理（原生 128K，YaRN 扩展至 256K）和低精度部署（NVFP4 保留 FP8 99% 精度）。通过 Think-Fusion SFT 配方支持单一模型中思考与非思考模式切换。在数学和韩语任务上表现领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型能力的发展，前沿越来越由智能体能力（多步推理、工具使用、长期任务执行）定义。然而，将这些能力转化为可部署系统面临挑战：实用基础模型不仅需要广泛知识和强推理能力，还需要在实际数据和硬件预算下实现高效推理、可控的推理时计算和可训练性。此外，作为韩国"Sovereign AI"国家项目的一部分，需要深度理解韩语和韩国文化的模型以减少对外国专有系统的依赖。

Method: A.X K2 采用多项关键技术创新：(1) 总参数 688B、激活参数 33B 的 MoE 架构（256 路由专家，激活 8 个，1 个共享专家），在 512 块 B200 GPU 上训练约 70 天；(2) 稀疏门控注意力（SGA），结合稀疏注意力（每个查询仅读 2048 个位置）与门控注意力，通过稀疏索引器预热（直接基于稀疏 top-k 选择而非密集注意力分布进行优化）大幅降低成本；(3) 门控归一化（GN），抑制隐藏状态中的异常值，支持稳定的低精度（NVFP4）部署；(4) Think-Fusion SFT 配方，在配对的思考/非思考数据上训练单一模型，实现模式切换；(5) 多阶段强化学习（CISPO + GDPO），联合优化指令跟随、人类偏好对齐、智能体工具使用和安全；(6) 端到端块状 FP8 训练-部署一致性，避免精度失配导致的奖励崩溃；(7) 数据并行异步部署流水线（TP1/DP8 vs 默认 TP8/DP1），实现 1.6 倍吞吐量提升。预训练采用 Warmup-Stable-Decay 学习率调度和难度递增课程学习。

Result: A.X K2 在多个基准测试上表现竞争力强劲：(1) 数学方面领先所有对比模型（AIME26: 97.1, Apex: 45.8 vs 第二名 28.1），IMO 2025 得 35/42 达到金牌线；(2) 韩语方面领先（KMMLU-Pro: 80.5, CLIcK: 91.6），韩国数学奥林匹克 2 轮 8 题全部正确；(3) 长上下文：RULER 256K 总体 94.6，每查询仅读 1.6%（128K）或 0.8%（256K）位置，NIAH 完美检索；(4) NVFP4 量化保留 99% FP8 精度（78.19 vs 78.95），最低显存 370GB（仅 A.X K1 BF16 的 36%）；(5) 推理吞吐：在 120K 输入长度下，NVFP4 配置比 A.X K1 快 123.7%（20.3K tok/s），EAGLE3 推测解码带来 23-30% 加速；(6) 比 A.X K1 在多数基准上提升超过 30 个百分点。

Conclusion: A.X K2 展示了在固定计算和时间预算下，通过原则性的 MoE 缩放、系统感知设计和分阶段训练（预训练 8.2T tokens，远少于 A.X K1 的约 10T tokens），可以实现全球竞争力的模型能力。Think-Fusion 配方和稀疏门控架构使推理经济性大幅提升，688B 的 A.X K2 比 519B 的 A.X K1 更大、更快、部署成本更低，消除了模型规模与部署经济性之间的权衡。这为扩展到下一代大模型（包括原生多模态能力和万亿参数级别）奠定了技术和系统基础。

Abstract: We introduce A.X K2, a 688B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance foundation for \emph{agentic} applications. Trained on approximately 8.5T tokens---fewer than its predecessor, A.X K1---on a smaller but higher-quality mixture with substantially expanded agentic and software-engineering data, it nonetheless improves over A.X K1 across the board, by over 30 percentage points on some benchmarks, reflecting large gains in token efficiency. To support long contexts efficiently, we introduce Sparse Gated Attention (SGA), which combines sparse attention with gated attention, and adopt Gated Norm (GN) to stabilize large-scale training. SGA is trained natively at 128K through a \emph{sparse} indexer warmup that optimizes the indexer against its own sparse top-$k$ selection rather than the dense attention distribution, making adaptation markedly cheaper: each query reads only 2,048 positions, yet long-context quality is unchanged and A.X K2 scores 94.6 on RULER out to 256K. The outlier suppression of GN in turn keeps 4-bit NVFP4 serving within one point of FP8 accuracy. A simple yet effective Think-Fusion recipe further lets users switch between thinking and non-thinking modes within a single unified model. Extensive evaluations show that A.X K2 performs competitively against strong open-weight baselines, matching or exceeding them on math and Korean-language benchmarks.

</details>


### [362] [FaVOR: LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Factor Mining via Empirical Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30192)
*Hyeonjin Kim,Minseok Kim,Seunghyeon Jung,Sujin Pyo,Huisu Jang,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FaVOR是一个基于LLM多智能体的因子挖掘框架，通过引入"假设级证据"验证机制而非直接优化收益，解决了现有自动化因子挖掘中数学形式与经济含义脱节的结构性缺陷。该框架在CSI 500和S&P 500上均优于现有基线，并保持跨市场环境的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM多智能体因子挖掘方法直接以收益为优化目标，缺乏对生成因子是否仍反映其原始经济假设的验证，导致数学形式与经济含义之间存在不一致——这是回报导向自动化的结构性失败模式。由此产生的因子模糊了真实信号与伪相关之间的界限，并在市场制度切换时失效。

Method: 提出FaVOR（Factor Validation through Observable Reasoning），一个围绕假设级证据而非回报结果重构因子挖掘的智能体框架。它执行三阶段一致性循环：(1) 分解阶段——将宽泛的经济假设拆解为独立的可观察市场条件；(2) 验证阶段——通过分位数统计剖面（基于OHLCV变量），检验每个因子是否反映其对应条件（四条规则：中心趋势偏移、尾部行为、多统计量一致性、语义一致性）；(3) 整合阶段——将验证通过的因子通过方向选择性（Directional Selectivity）合并为可解释的复合因子。系统使用四个LLM智能体（假设、观察、因子、验证），以GPT-4o为默认骨干。

Result: 在CSI 500（中国A股）和S&P 500（美股）2025年样本外测试中，FaVOR在四个指标（AR、IR、MDD、CR）上均优于ML/DL、RL和LLM基线方法。具体地，CSI 500上AR=0.2067、IR=1.5295、MDD=-0.0853、CR=0.2225；S&P 500上AR=0.1062、IR=1.1315、MDD=-0.0443、CR=0.1123。消融实验表明验证阶段和整合阶段缺一不可。敏感性实验显示该框架对6种不同LLM骨干（包括开源模型Qwen3-235B和Llama-3.3-70B）均保持正收益，跨2015-2025年的纵向测试和49个月度滚动测试也证实了组合的稳健性。

Conclusion: FaVOR证明了以假设为锚的经验验证方法可以产生"构造上即可解释、制度鲁棒、经济忠实"的因子信号。该框架的核心贡献在于将因子一致性验证置于回报优化之前，从结构上解决了自动因子生成中的"假设-公式"脱节问题。其局限在于方向选择性标准不适用于反转类信号，且仅依赖日频OHLCV数据无法捕捉所有经济机制。

Abstract: Traditional finance relies on experts to hand-craft factors through a principled process grounded in economic rationale. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have automated this process, scaling factor mining far beyond manual effort. However, these automated approaches optimize directly for returns and rarely check whether a generated factor still expresses the economic hypothesis that motivated it. We identify this inconsistency between mathematical form and economic meaning as a structural failure mode of return-oriented automation. The resulting factors blur the line between real signals and spurious correlations and break down across regime shifts. We propose FaVOR (Factor Validation through Observable Reasoning), an agentic framework that restructures factor mining around hypothesis-level evidence rather than return outcomes. In place of the standard hypothesis-to-formula leap, FaVOR enforces a three-stage consistency loop tying mathematical form to economic rationale throughout. (1) Decomposition splits a broad economic hypothesis into independent observable conditions. (2) Validation checks whether each factor reflects its intended condition. (3) Integration merges them into a composite whose structure remains interpretable. On the CSI 500 and S&P 500 in 2025, FaVOR outperforms existing baselines while remaining effective across regimes. FaVOR shows that hypothesis-grounded factor discovery produces signals that are interpretable by construction, regime-robust, and economically faithful. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [363] [SPARK: Skeleton-Guided Reasoning Synthesis from Large-Scale Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30214)
*Yu Li,Wei Li,Xin Gao,Mengyuan Sun,Xiaoyang Wang,Qizhi Pei,Lijun Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPARK提出了一种以论文"主张-证据-推导"推理骨架为基本合成单元的科学推理数据生成框架，基于Sci-Base语料库构建了Spark-234K数据集，包含234K实例，涵盖10个学科、4种推理视角（机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准）。该数据集以仅约五分之一的规模在多个科学推理基准上超越现有数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学推理数据集以事实回忆和套路化解题为主，缺乏对机制理解、证据推理和假设评估的覆盖，制约了开源模型科学推理能力。直接基于论文生成QA易产生非自包含、缺失关键假设或破坏推理结构的问题。

Method: 1. 输入归一化与骨架提取：基于标题与摘要定位核心结论，条件化地从全文重建有序证据轨迹；2. 多视角问题生成：机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准，每篇至多每视角生成1题，依据证据不足则跳过；3. 答案生成与骨架一致性质量审核：LLM裁判针对自包含性、来源匹配、推理连贯、证据一致性四维审核；4. 去重与去污染（13-gram精确匹配）。

Result: Spark-234K在Llama3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B/14B三个基座上的平均性能分别超越次优基线+3.10、+4.47、+3.43分；93.28%自动答案一致性，90.3%人类专家正确答案率，98.0%人类判断自包含，87.0%属L4/L5难度级；93%以上为多步或研究级问题，自包含率99.73%；相比百万级数据集（MegaScience 1.2M、OpenScienceReasoning-2 1.6M）数据效率显著。消融显示骨架提取贡献最大（去除骨架性能下降5.63–9.15分），定量推导视角贡献最大（−4.64）。

Conclusion: 将论文的推理骨架作为合成基本单元，能以远低于现有大规模数据集的样本量获得更高难度、更具多样性的科学推理监督信号，显著提升基座模型在通用与领域科学基准上的表现；骨架提取是该框架的核心设计，多视角互补生成进一步增强监督密度。

Abstract: Scientific reasoning remains challenging for open-source models, largely due to the lack of high-quality scientific reasoning data. Existing datasets are often dominated by factual recall or formulaic problem solving, with limited emphasis on mechanism understanding, evidence-grounded reasoning, and hypothesis evaluation. To address this, we introduce SPARK (Scientific Paper Abstracted Reasoning sKeleton), a paper-oriented synthesis framework built on Sci-Base, a large-scale corpus of research papers spanning 10 scientific disciplines. Instead of directly converting papers into question-answer pairs, SPARK treats the claim-evidence-derivation structure of a paper as the fundamental unit of reasoning synthesis. Specifically, SPARK (1) distills each paper into a compact reasoning skeleton capturing its central claims and supporting evidence, enabling self-contained question generation, and (2) synthesizes reasoning tasks from four scientific perspectives: mechanistic reasoning, hypothesis falsification, quantitative derivation, and boundary calibration. A final consistency verification stage further removes unsupported or contradictory outputs. Using this framework, we construct Spark-234K, a scientific reasoning dataset with substantially higher difficulty and diversity than existing resources. Experiments show that Spark-234K consistently outperforms existing scientific reasoning datasets while achieving stronger performance with significantly fewer training samples.

</details>


### [364] [LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30226)
*Mohanad Odema,Jacob Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LaMoC是一种面向大语言模型的损失感知模块化压缩方法，通过将激活统计量与经验Fisher统计量通过梯度-误差对齐进行混合，解决现有模块化压缩方法仅依赖激活统计而忽略损失敏感性的问题，在多个模型上实现了困惑度和下游任务准确性的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合模块化压缩方法（如MoDeGPT、UniQL）主要依赖激活统计量进行模块重要性排序和重建，忽略了损失敏感性信息及其模块级别的特征化。这种损失敏感信息的缺失可能导致压缩决策未能充分考虑对下游任务损失的影响，从而在激进的压缩率下导致较大的性能退化。作者旨在研究如何系统地将损失敏感信息融入模块化压缩流程中。

Method: LaMoC提出了一种梯度-误差对齐的模块化压缩方法：1)定义经验Fisher加权的激活Gram矩阵C_F，通过对角化经验Fisher向量对标准激活Gram C_0进行加权；2)构建有效Gram矩阵C_eff(γ)=γC_0+(1-γ)C_F，通过混合系数γ控制梯度信息的混合程度；3)将联合模块化压缩重新定义为两层优化问题——外层选择每个模块的γ以最小化交叉熵损失变化，内层给定γ最小化模块重建误差；4)使用一阶Taylor展开作为代理函数估计ΔL_CE，并使用参考梯度（在γ=1处计算一次）来高效评估候选γ；5)提出固定（Fixed γ=0.5/0.75）和自适应（Adaptive γ*）两种γ选择策略，分别对所有模块使用固定γ或根据代理预测为每个模块选择最优γ。

Result: 在四个模型家族（Llama-3、Qwen3、Mistral、EXAONE）的八个模型上进行评估，4-8B模型上LaMoC相对现有最优模块化压缩方法平均减少2.5%困惑度，1%的相对任务准确率提升；在33B级别的EXAONE 4.5-33B和Qwen2.5-32B上扩展验证有效；在激进压缩率（50%-70%）下仍能保持优势；消融实验验证了迹缩放、一阶代理近似和自适应γ选择策略的有效性；推理延迟测试显示20%压缩带来约1.1×加速。

Conclusion: LaMoC成功地将损失敏感信息融入模块化压缩流程，通过梯度-误差对齐机制改善了压缩后模型的性能。该方法具有通用性，可与任何依赖激活统计量的压缩框架兼容。未来工作需要探索分析性求解最优γ的方法，并在更大模型规模和新兴架构（混合模型、状态空间模型、线性注意力、MoE）上验证有效性。

Abstract: Modular compression has enabled considerable parameter reduction in LLMs while preserving strong language understanding and downstream task accuracy. However, existing joint modular compression methods primarily rely on activation statistics, leaving loss-sensitivity information and its module-level characterization underexplored. We investigate addressing this gap with LaMoC, a loss-aware modular compression methodology that blends activation and Empirical Fisher statistics through gradient-error alignment. LaMoC improves joint compression by selecting compression statistics that better align local module reconstruction error with the downstream loss. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) We characterize the Empirical Fisher as a module-level loss-aware proxy that can be blended with the activation statistics required for compression. (2) We reformulate joint modular compression as a two-tiered optimization problem that minimizes module reconstruction error while tuning the activation and gradient information blending rate. (3) We implement an empirically driven methodology with statistical validation to solve the resulting compression problem. We evaluate LaMoC across four model families spanning eight models. On the 4-8B models, LaMoC achieves an average 2.5% reduction in perplexity and a 1% relative improvement in task accuracy over state-of-the-art modular compression methods.

</details>


### [365] [Rethinking the Test-Time Prompt Tuning Objective from the Perspective of Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30230)
*Jungwon Choi,Hyeonseo Jang,Kibok Lee,Eunwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了测试时提示调优（TPT）中基于熵最小化（EM）的目标函数，指出其会忽视样本特定不确定性导致过度自信和校准退化，并提出了一种用KL散度替代EM、以交叉熵对齐原始视图预测与增广视图目标分布的不确定性感知目标，结合置信度感知的自适应温度缩放策略，在多个基准上同时提升了准确率和校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准TPT使用熵最小化作为优化目标，但该目标存在两个根本问题：(1) 无论样本不确定性如何都倾向于产生过度自信的预测，导致校准显著退化；(2) EM作用于增广视图的聚合预测，而推理时使用的是原始视图，二者之间存在结构性错位，使得置信度难以被有效控制。现有的校准方法（如C-TPT、O-TPT）仍然保留EM目标，仅通过额外正则项缓解副作用，未能从根本上解决问题。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) 不确定性感知目标函数——用KL散度 D_KL(p_aug‖p) 替代传统EM损失，该目标等价于交叉熵匹配项减去目标分布熵，使模型在增广视图置信时强化对齐、在模糊时保留不确定性；(2) 置信度感知自适应温度缩放——根据每个增广视图的置信度线性插值分配温度，对高置信预测锐化、对低置信预测软化，从而构造更可靠的目标分布。最终通过最小化原始视图预测与该目标分布间的KL散度来更新提示参数。

Result: 在CLIP-ViT-B/16上的10个细粒度分类基准上，该方法以65.71%的平均准确率（超过TPT的64.62%、C-TPT的64.48%和O-TPT的64.12%）和3.65的平均ECE（显著优于TPT的11.67、O-TPT的4.46）同时取得最优准确率与校准；在CoOp和MaPLe初始化、DynaPrompt框架以及ImageNet自然分布偏移场景下均表现一致；消融实验证实温度缩放与KLD目标互补，预测不一致率从EM的20.9%降至4.2%，且对错误样本会主动增加熵（ΔH≈+0.14）。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了基于熵最小化的TPT在结构上与校准目标不匹配这一根本缺陷，通过直接对齐原始视图预测与置信度感知的目标分布，并以不确定性作为自适应调制信号，在不依赖额外正则项的情况下同时提升了模型的准确率与校准性能，为测试时自适应提供了更可靠的目标函数设计范式。

Abstract: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a powerful paradigm, refining prompts for each test sample via entropy minimization (EM) over multiple augmented views. However, we identify a limitation in the standard EM-based adaptation: it inherently drives the model toward overconfident predictions disregarding sample-specific uncertainty, leading to significant calibration degradation. To address these limitations, we propose a new objective that replaces the conventional EM loss by aligning the original-view prediction with a target distribution derived from augmented views via cross-entropy, while adversarially incorporating the entropy of the target distribution to capture sample-specific uncertainty. Furthermore, to better construct this target distribution, we apply confidence-aware temperature scaling to each augmented-view prediction according to its confidence, sharpening confident predictions while softening uncertain ones. This formulation allows the model to increase confidence only when the target distribution is reliable, while preserving uncertainty when it reflects ambiguous or conflicting augmented-view predictions. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also significantly improves model calibration.

</details>


### [366] [CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30234)
*Yihang Cheng,Veronica Liesaputra,Andrew Trotman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CoLa-ICD，一个面向长尾自动医学编码的知识增强框架，通过融合外部术语、共现图神经网络和多头术语注意力机制，结合标签感知对比学习，显著改善罕见ICD代码的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动医学编码面临长文档、长尾标签分布和术语多样性的挑战，尤其罕见代码训练样本少且易与语义相似的常见代码混淆，亟需针对长尾预测的有效方法。

Method: CoLa-ICD包含四个核心模块：(1) 标签知识注入——结合UMLS同义词与Gemini 2.5 Flash生成的术语构建富标签表示；(2) 共现图神经网络——基于PPMI加权的训练集标签共现矩阵，建模代码间结构依赖；(3) 多头术语注意力——以多术语作为查询从临床文本中提取证据；(4) 标签感知对比学习——通过硬负样本挖掘对齐证据与标签语义。整体训练损失为BCE损失与对比损失的加权和。

Result: 在MIMIC-III ICD-9和MIMIC-IV ICD-10数据集上均取得SOTA，AUC、F1、P@k全面领先；在长尾代码（频率1-10）桶中Micro-F1提升尤为显著，ICD-10上从0.127提升至0.204；消融实验证实知识注入、对比学习和共现GNN各组件均贡献关键；跨度移除实验证明模型注意力能精确定位预测相关的临床证据。

Conclusion: CoLa-ICD通过融合外部知识、代码结构关系与证据-标签对齐，有效缓解了自动医学编码中的长尾问题，为罕见代码预测提供了有前景的方向，但仍受限于MIMIC单一中心数据。

Abstract: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [367] [LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Completion Combining Discrete Structural Coding with Similar Entity Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30235)
*Jiaqi Wang,Dongying Lin,Yang Yang,Yinan Liu,Bin Wang,Xiaochun Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoSC 是一种用于 LLM 知识图谱补全（KGC）的方法，将离散结构编码（discrete structural coding）与相似实体信息相结合：先用 LLM 基于离散结构码对候选实体做初始排序，再利用与查询头实体结构相似的实体所提供的关系特定证据来精修排序，从而连接了"结构编码"与"候选重排序"两条研究路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM-based KGC 方法主要分两类：(1) 将 KG 结构编码为离散 token 供 LLM 使用（如 SSQR、ReaLM、GS-Quant）；(2) 在受限候选集合上通过检索/过滤/验证做重排序（如 KICGPT、KGR3、OMNIA）。两类方法各自独立研究，缺少将二者结合以同时利用结构编码表示与候选精修机制的统一框架。

Method: CoSC 包含两个组件：(1) 基于离散结构编码的候选排序——用 AdaProp 检索 N=20 个候选，每个候选用实体名 + L=16 个来自大小 V=2048 的 codebook 的码字 token 表示，在 Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上扩展 tokenizer 并用 LoRA 监督训练，让 LLM 生成至多 P=3 个码序列以重排候选；(2) 基于相似实体信息的精修——在训练图（含逆关系）中找与查询头 h 共享最多关系-尾对的前 M=50 个相似头集合 H_M(h)，定义由相似头经关系 r 连接到候选 e 的加权结构支持度 R_str(e|h,r)，并用 1-exp(-R_str/τ)（τ=5）归一化为 s_str(e)；最终得分 S(e;α)=s_code(e)+α·s_str(e)，α 在验证集上选取，对 top K=10 候选做重排。

Result: 在 FB15k-237 全部 22,850 条测试查询上的链接预测结果：MRR=0.5021，Hits@1=0.3674，Hits@10=0.7434，其中 MRR 与 Hits@10 显著优于包括 SSQR-LLaMA3.1（MRR 0.459，Hits@10 0.597）和 ReaLM（MRR 0.467，Hits@10 0.603）在内的所有基线，Hits@1 与最佳基线（ReaLM 0.402）相比略低但保持竞争力；AdaProp 召回到至少一个正确实体的查询占 79.72%。

Conclusion: CoSC 验证了将离散结构编码与相似实体邻域证据融合用于 LLM-based KGC 的有效性，在 FB15k-237 上取得当前最佳的 MRR 与 Hits@10；未来工作将在更多数据集上评估，并采用完全受控的基线设置。

Abstract: Knowledge graph completion requires models to use both textual descriptions and relational structure. Existing LLM-based methods either encode KG structure as discrete tokens or refine a restricted set of candidate entities, and these two directions have largely been studied separately. We propose CoSC for LLM-based KGC, which combines discrete structural coding with similar entity information. Specifically, an LLM generates an initial candidate entity ranking from discrete structural codes, after which information from entities with structures similar to that of the query entity refines the ranking. Experiments on FB15k-237 show that CoSC outperforms existing baselines on MRR and Hits@10 while remaining competitive on Hits@1.

</details>


### [368] [Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30250)
*Anand Iyer,Bhanu Khetharpal,Srinivas Upadhya,Ramkumar Rajagopal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经-符号分解架构，将自然语言路由规则翻译为工作流DAG：LLM仅负责NL→IR（中间表示），由确定性编译器完成IR→JSON，并通过学习式注册表选择器控制词表规模。该方法让低成本非推理LLM在商用联络中心路由平台上以约一半token成本达到生产级质量，并在统计上匹配推理模型的单提示质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联络中心路由平台依赖"整体式"LLM提示生成工作流JSON，随着注册表（含事件、动作、条件及少样本样例）增长，提示膨胀、注意力稀释、成本攀升；且非推理模型在密集分支规则上质量下降。问题的根源在于"发射密度瓶颈"——LLM擅长理解规则，但在一次发射中正确写出大量相互依赖的图节点（属性与布尔结构）会失败。

Method: 1) IR+编译器：LLM生成YAML格式的中间表示，由确定性编译器产出保证合法的目标JSON（含De Morgan展开、hit-first链、残余分支处理）。2) 学习式注册表选择器：先一步调用LLM选出规则所需的注册表条目，再以精简提示生成IR。3) 计划中的相似度预过滤器（嵌入检索）以应对词表进一步增长。共评估四种配置：Monolithic、Selector→JSON、IR-only、Selector+IR。

Result: 在635条合成规则基准、四种模型（GPT-4.1、GPT-5.3-chat、GPT-5.2、Opus 4.6）上，Selector+IR最高取得约89% LLM-judge有效率、约90% 精确条件匹配率，JSON合法性99-100%；每规则token约为Monolithic的0.55-0.56倍。GPT-5.3-chat的judge有效率提升+24.3pp（McNemar p<10⁻³），并在±5pp等价性检验下与GPT-5.2 monolithic（79.8%）统计等价（p_TOST=0.007）；与Opus 4.6达近等同（仅在±7pp下等价），但与最强推理单元相比仍存约8pp前沿差距。错误分析显示完整性与JSON类错误被基本消除，但DAG边方向（ordering）类错误最顽固。

Conclusion: 结构化生成任务的失败应归因于"发射"而非"理解"——节点选择近乎饱和，错误集中在属性与布尔结构上。把组合性图构建交给确定性编译器、让LLM专注于语言到意图的解读，可使非推理模型达到生产相关质量并显著降低成本；该神经-符号分解范式可推广至业务过程、ETL、agent工具图等NL→图任务。但外部化结构并不能消除瓶颈——拓扑错误成为主要残余。

Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of translating natural-language routing rules written by business administrators into executable workflow graphs for enterprise contact centers. Each target is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of conditional actions with parallel branches, hit-first fallback chains, and per-branch Boolean predicates, encoded in the JSON dialect of a commercial routing platform. We show that neuro-symbolic decomposition enables lower-cost, non-reasoning large language models to generate complex workflow DAGs at production-relevant quality without expensive extended-reasoning models. Our central diagnostic is an emission-density bottleneck: on a 635-rule benchmark of manufactured synthetic data, models select the correct graph nodes with high accuracy but increasingly misconfigure attributes and Boolean grouping as the number of interdependent nodes emitted in one pass grows. We therefore move combinatorial graph construction from the model into a deterministic compiler driven by a compact intermediate representation, with a learned registry-selection front end that focuses generation on relevant vocabulary. Across four models, the full system reaches approximately 89% LLM-judge validity, approximately 90% exact-match condition accuracy, and 99-100% valid JSON while using roughly half the per-rule prompt tokens of a monolithic prompt. On GPT-5.3-chat, the method improves judge validity by 24 percentage points and achieves statistical equivalence to a reasoning model's out-of-the-box quality, although an approximately 8-point frontier gap remains. We also present a deployment path and transferable lessons for structured-generation applications.

</details>


### [369] [SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30277)
*Haoran Wang,Jing Yao,Xu Yang,Zeqing Wang,Yang Zhang,Pedram Ghamisi,Zhengchao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SimCRAFT框架，将遥感（RS）Agent的多步骤工具规划能力蒸馏到7B规模的开源模型中。核心包含两个阶段：(1) 多智能体数据合成引擎配合Mock执行引擎，生成约束验证的SimRS-14k轨迹语料库；(2) 上下文检索增强微调（CRAFT），通过噪声扰动训练使模型学习程序性结构而非机械复制。SimCRAFT-Qwen2.5-7B在PSR（83.2%）、TSA（93.5%）和幻觉率（0.5%）上显著优于同规模开源模型，并可泛化至KnowFlow-Bench和ThinkGeo等独立基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感Agent（如EarthAgent、CangLing-KnowFlow）依赖GPT-4级闭源LLM进行运行时编排，存在计算开销大、网络依赖强、隐私泄露等问题，难以在卫星、UAV或边缘设备部署。同时，直接将RAG或轨迹SFT应用到小模型存在两个失败路径：推理时RAG对7B模型增益有限；轨迹级SFT导致实例记忆而非程序抽象，且RS领域缺少大规模工具调用轨迹语料。

Method: SimCRAFT为模型无关的两阶段框架。<br>**阶段一（多智能体数据合成）**：从162个专家种子任务出发，经双模式用户模拟（Expert/Novice）、四智能体协作（规划、执行、反思、总结），结合Mock执行引擎的三重校验（模式、依赖/路径、传感器兼容性）进行错误检测与重规划，产出SimRS-14k语料（16,200候选→14,003通过）。<br>**阶段二（CRAFT）**：构建程序性知识库（PKB，1008 SOPs），冻结双编码器检索top-k=2的SOP作为上下文先验；训练时施加随机扰动（ϕ_ICI无关上下文注入、ϕ_PM参数突变）以迫使模型学习可迁移的程序结构，损失函数为标准自回归语言建模目标对扰动上下文进行去噪。采用LoRA（r=64, α=128）在Qwen-2.5-7B上微调。

Result: 主要结果（SimRS-14k测试集，500条）：SimCRAFT-Qwen2.5-7B达PSR 83.2%、TSA 93.5%、AEM 79.6%、Hal.Rate 0.5%、Fmt.Err 5.4%，在7B规模上超越DeepSeek-R1（671B）等开源大模型，并与GPT-5（83.8% PSR）、Gemini-3-Flash（84.1% PSR）相当。零微调下，KnowFlow-Bench获79.4% PSR（跨基准下降3.8%，约为vanilla SFT的1/3），ThinkGeo获58.3% PSR。消融实验表明CRAFT在三种7B骨架上一致提升+9.6%~+11.6% PSR，最优扰动概率ε=0.15，新手模式比例50/50时性能最佳。

Conclusion: SimCRAFT-Qwen2.5-7B证明了将约束验证的合成数据与上下文去噪训练目标结合，可使100×更小的开源模型在RS程序性规划任务上对齐闭源前沿模型，并以7B规模在多项指标上超越GPT-4驱动的RS Agent，为边缘部署提供了有竞争力的开源基线。局限性在于Mock执行引擎仅校验模式/依赖/传感器兼容性而非真实GDAL/SNAP/GEE调用，且未评估下游科学产品的物理精度。

Abstract: The unprecedented surge in Earth observation data volume and diversity has exposed a critical bottleneck for traditional manual workflows, catalyzing the emergence of Remote Sensing (RS) Agents. However, the practical deployment of these advanced agents is severely hindered by their heavy reliance on large-scale general-purpose LLMs, which lack deep domain expertise and impose prohibitive infrastructure demands. To resolve this, we propose SimCRAFT, a model-agnostic framework that distills sophisticated RS orchestration capabilities into a compact 7B-scale model. Addressing data scarcity, we first pair a multiagent synthesis engine with a Mock Execution Engine that checks schema correctness, inter-tool dependencies, and sensor/tool compatibility, producing SimRS-14k, a large-scale, constraint-validated workflow planning corpus. Second, we propose Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT) that finetunes the model to reason analogically by adapting retrieved Standard Operating Procedures to novel queries under a noise-robust objective, generalizing RAFT to multi-step RS workflow planning without mechanical copying. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SimCRAFT-7B significantly outperforms openweights LLMs and rivals advanced closedsource models and specialized RS agents, while reproducing across three 7B backbones. This work contributes a competitive open-weights baseline for lightweight RS intelligence, enabling efficient autonomous deployment under resource-constrained or resource-conserving conditions.

</details>


### [370] [Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30322)
*Hanlin Tian,Minhao Li,Yu Mi,Sihan Zhu,Zhao Yang,Yuxiang Wang,Hongquan Zhu,Qiufei Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"知识门控"（knowledge-gated）任务构建协议，通过将任务指令与包含私有约定的紧凑工件（artefact）分离，配合泄漏审计和确定性验证器，使智能体对工件知识的依赖变得可测量和可审计。在15个校准任务上，前沿配置Opus在提供工件时通过率为68.0%，而无工件时为0%；扰动工件控制实验也获得0%，验证了依赖确实源于工件内容的正确性。该协议不进行模型训练，仅作为构造与验证方法发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体任务基准很少控制智能体对领域私有约定的访问权限。如果任务生成器已掌握所有解题规则，则任务难以增添新能力；如果相关规则完全不可得，任务又难以验证。核心矛盾在于：如何在构造阶段使专业知识访问成为可控变量，同时保留对正确答案的精确说明。

Method: 1) 三种构造特权不对称：构造特权（答案在构建时植入）、廉价验证（结构化输出易于检查）、组合式验证（k个命名标准的全通过验证器）。2) 任务/知识分离：每个任务包含指令（说明"做什么"）和工件（说明"领域如何计算"），指令从不提及工件。3) 两种知识门控类型：约定门控（私有不可推导的阈值/别名/规范化表）和操作门控（难以手写的算法库）。4) 静态泄漏审计：扫描指令和环境以检测显式门控内容。5) 配置相对校准筛选：在+A（有工件）和-A（无工件）条件下各进行5次试验，要求前沿配置+A≥60%、-A=0%、中等配置+A≤40%方能保留。6) 确定性验证器（解析结构化输出，使用Python独立实现重新计算参考值）和命名标准评估（用于自由形式交付）。

Result: 在15个校准任务（每个单元5次试验）上：前沿配置Opus在+A条件下汇总通过率为68.0%，在-A条件下为0%，中等配置Qwen在+A条件下为22.7%。扰动工件控制实验（bom-costing任务，三个数值约定改为看似合理但错误的值）也获得0%。配置相对筛选保留了7个任务（legal-clause、paper-index、bom-costing、airline-booking、clinical-variant、mortgage-escrow、dependency-audit）。在paper-index上的附录研究表明，4倍压缩至1078字节的最小工件与完整4379字节工件性能无差异（均为100%），而空工件为0%。外部基准对比显示τ²-bench上技能可用性差异为18-36个百分点，而本协议中工件将性能从绝对零提升至多数成功。

Conclusion: 本文贡献在于将任务构建视为受控程序，使知识访问成为显式、可审计的变量，而非提示的偶然属性。15个校准任务中，紧凑工件在字节相同指令下将前沿配置从完全失败转变为多数成功。配置相对筛选识别满足契约的任务，但并未证明保留的任务是更好的训练数据。该工作是构造和验证知识门控智能体任务的方法学基础，未来工作需要端到端的训练后比较来验证其训练价值。

Abstract: Professional agent tasks often depend on conventions that are absent from public corpora, yet benchmarks rarely control whether an agent has access to those conventions. We introduce a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates a task instruction from a compact artefact containing private conventions, reference tables, and utility operators. Construction-time provenance, byte-identical task instructions across the provided- and withheld-artefact conditions, leak audits, and executable witnesses make dependence on the artefact explicit and testable. Across fifteen calibration tasks, one frontier agent configuration achieves a 68.0% pass rate with the artefact and 0% without it; on one task, a plausible but incorrect artefact also yields 0% across five trials. Deterministic solvers and rule corpora provide exact ground truth for structured tasks, while named criterion-level rubrics support outputs that cannot be checked by a single executable oracle. A configuration-relative calibration screen retains seven tasks satisfying our five-trial empirical knowledge-gating screen. These experiments validate the behavior of the construction protocol; they do not establish that the retained tasks improve post-training. We publicly release part of the task suite and supporting tooling at this https URL .

</details>


### [371] [Answer Probing-Guided Search for Diverse Solution Exploration of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30345)
*Yi Fang,Que Shen,Chengpeng Li,Boyi Deng,Wei Shi,Wenjie Wang,Fuli Feng,Fengli Xu,Dayiheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Answer Probing方法及其引导的树搜索算法APTS，通过探测LLM中间推理路径可能到达的答案及其隐藏状态相似度与困惑度，解决现有语义嵌入方法难以区分语言风格相似但实质不同的解题路径的问题，从而在保持准确性的同时显著提升生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在推理时倾向于收敛到单一高置信度解，限制了多解生成场景的探索能力（如代码测试生成、药物发现）。现有基于树搜索的方法使用response级语义嵌入来剪枝相似分支，但语义嵌入易受语言风格和表面模式的干扰，导致无法真正区分不同的解题路径。

Method: 1. Answer Probing：对每个中间推理路径附加答案诱导提示（如"The final answer is"），强制LLM生成探测答案，用平均池化的探测答案隐藏状态表示该路径；2. 探测答案的隐藏状态相似度作为多样性信号，困惑度（PPL）作为质量信号；3. APTS采用广度优先树搜索，节点值V=(1−α)·(1/PPL)+α·DS，其中DS为与已选节点的最大余弦相似度负值，通过两信号权衡选取高质量且多样的节点。

Result: 在Game of 24、Forward Synthesis、TestCaseGen三个推理任务上，对Qwen3-8B和GPT-OSS-120B进行测试，APTS在所有任务和模型上一致取得最佳多样性（如Cov@16平均提升7%以上），仅损失约0.6%的准确性，并在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B和GPT-o3-mini（含闭源适配版本）上验证了泛化性。预算匹配实验显示APTS（16样本）优于更多样本（29）的重复采样，计算开销仅为1.46×。

Conclusion: Answer Probing通过在中间状态直接探测潜在答案，提供了比response级语义嵌入更具判别力的解题路径表示；APTS利用探测答案的隐藏状态相似度与PPL作为双信号，能够在保持推理质量的同时显著提升LLM生成的多样性，验证了答案层级信号对多样推理路径探索的有效性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Generating multiple diverse and high-quality solutions is valuable for many applications, such as code-test generation and drug discovery. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to converge on a single high-confidence solution during inference, limiting exploration of alternative valid solution paths. Existing test-time methods promote diversity through tree-like search and prune semantically similar branches using response-level semantic embeddings. However, we find that such embeddings are easily confounded by linguistic and stylistic similarities, making it difficult to distinguish genuinely distinct solution paths. To address this, we introduce Answer Probing, which probes the potential answer an LLM would reach from an intermediate reasoning path. We demonstrate that the hidden states of probed answers more effectively differentiate distinct solution paths than semantic embeddings, and the perplexity of probed answers serves as a practical proxy for reasoning correctness. Based on these findings, we propose Answer Probing-Guided Tree Search (APTS), which guides the tree search by the probed answers' hidden state similarity and perplexity. Experiments on three reasoning tasks across two LLMs show that APTS consistently enhances solution diversity, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

</details>


### [372] [Co-Annotator: Expert-Distilled ViT and VLM for Visual and Documentation Guidance in Age-Related Macular Degeneration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30352)
*Ziheng "Leo" Li,Benjamin Freeman,Akshay Raman,Kavin Aravindhan Rajkumar,Xinxin Fang,Rishabh Srivastava,Steven Feiner,Kaveri A. Thakoor*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Co-Annotator 是一个面向眼科住院医师的 OCT 阅片 AI 辅助系统，通过专家蒸馏（注视+口述）训练出注视对齐的 ViT 和本体受限的 VLM，分别提供注视对齐兴趣区域（AOI）热图和可编辑的生物标记物摘要。核心贡献是三项交互设计原则（deferrable/sparse/evidence-anchored）及在三阶段用户研究中验证的协同效应：US1 模型训练，US2 单模态验证，US3 双模态联合部署显示诊断效率提升 40%、注释编辑时间降低 67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床 AI 优化预测性能时未考虑临床医师"看哪里"与"写什么"的实际工作流程；OCT 阅片存在视觉搜索负担和文档记录负担两个独立瓶颈，且住院医师作为关键用户群体面临准确性变异大、培训需求高的问题。

Method: 系统由两部分组成：(1) 注视对齐 ViT 通过专家眼动数据生成的注视密度图作为辅助监督信号，损失函数为分类 BCE + 注视对齐交叉熵（α=0.05 最优）；(2) 基于 MedGemma 的两阶段课程微调 VLM，第一阶段学习诊断和生物标记物判别（VQA 形式），第二阶段加入生物标记物生成任务，受限于 12 项本体词表。三项设计原则：deferrable（首次独立阅片后才显示）、sparse（2-3 个热点）、evidence-anchored（每个生物标记可点击链接到对应 AOI）。三阶段用户研究：US1 专家数据采集与模型训练（8 名视网膜专家，231 只眼，1155 张 OCT）；US2 单模态评估（11 名住院医师）；US3 双机构联合部署（8 名住院医师，含 Columbia 和 Weill Cornell）。

Result: US1：注视对齐将 ViT 诊断 micro-AUC 从 0.95 提升至 0.98（α=0.05 时验证准确率 88.37%，F1=0.8628）；VLM 微调后诊断准确率 0.91（US1 测试集）/0.92（OCT-C8），MedBERTScore F1=0.867。US2 单模态：AOI 在引导期间未提升效率，但引导后每眼时间下降 28%（p<0.001）；VLM 将生物标记物文档数量从 2.3 提升至 5.8 个/AMD 眼（p=8.8×10⁻⁹），保留率 83.1%。US3 联合部署：正确诊断/分钟从 3.40 增至 4.76（+40%，p=0.023），注释编辑时间从 7.2s 降至 2.4s（-67%，p=0.023），生物标记物文档 5.36 个/眼，保留率 85.5%；诊断准确率保持（83.3%→93.3%，p=0.094）；注视-AOI 散度保持稳定（与 US2 单模态的显著上升形成对比）。

Conclusion: 专家蒸馏的多模态引导可同时解决两个独立临床工作流程瓶颈而不损害诊断准确性；AOI 引导产生引导后持久的感知效率迁移，VLM 引导使生物标记物文档广度翻倍；二者协同产生任一单独模态无法实现的引导期效率增益；定性分析得出 deferrable、sparse、evidence-anchored 三项临床 AI 引导设计原则及候选的第四原则（住院医师控制的文档脚手架）。局限：固定区组顺序无法完全分离任务熟悉度影响；仅在 Zeiss Cirrus 单一扫描仪上二分类验证；样本量有限（US3 n=8）。未来工作：多分类扩展、跨扫描仪验证、对接诊医师群体的泛化测试、基于注视的生物标记物定位评估。

Abstract: Clinical AI often optimizes predictive performance without engaging how clinicians decide where to look and what to write. We present Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into two guidance components: a gaze-aligned Vision Transformer producing fixation-aligned areas of interest (AOIs), and an ontology-bounded vision-language model (VLM) that pre-fills editable biomarker summaries for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). We first collect expert gaze and dictations (US1) to train the models, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and biomarker generation. We then deploy the system with ophthalmology residents: a controlled resident study (US2) confirmed each modality is safe and independently beneficial, with AOI guidance producing lasting perceptual efficiency gains through post-guidance carryover and VLM guidance more than doubling biomarker documentation breadth. In a combined deployment across two academic institutions (US3), providing both modalities simultaneously produced efficiency gains that substantially exceeded either modality alone: correct diagnoses per minute increased by 40% and comment editing time fell by 67%, without compromising diagnostic accuracy. Notably, neither modality improved efficiency during guidance in US2, which makes the in-guidance efficiency gain under combined guidance in US3 the more striking result. Expert-distilled multimodal guidance can remove two distinct clinical workflow bottlenecks at once (visual search overhead and documentation burden) without compromising the diagnostic accuracy clinicians already achieve.

</details>


### [373] [Will the User Ever Know? Covert Indirect Prompt Injection on Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30362)
*Yunseok Lee,Yunji Kim,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Covert Success Rate (CSR) 指标，从用户视角重新审视间接提示注入 (IPI) 攻击——即成功注入但用户无法在最终回复中察觉的攻击，并提出 ICoA 攻击方法，通过 RETURN anchor 结构性地诱导隐蔽成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 IPI 攻击评估仅使用 Attack Success Rate (ASR)，衡量注入任务是否被执行，但忽略了用户能否在最终回复中发现攻击痕迹。隐蔽成功对用户安全威胁更大（系统已被入侵但用户继续信任），但 ASR 无法区分隐蔽与公开的成功。

Method: 1) 将 ASR 分解为 Covert Success Rate (CSR) 和 Overt Success Rate (OSR)；2) 通过轨迹分析发现 ReAct 框架下 RETURN vs EXIT 模式决定隐蔽性——注入后若回到用户任务则隐蔽，若终止于注入则公开；3) 提出 ICoA 攻击，包含 user framing (使注入任务被执行) 和 RETURN anchor (ρ_pre ⊕ ρ_post，使执行后回到用户任务) 两个组件；4) 在 AgentDojo 上用四个目标模型 (Qwen3-235B, LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.5-Flash) 和五种防御方法评估。

Result: ICoA 在四个目标模型上均取得最高 CSR，相比最强基线 (Imp. message) 提升 3.79-12.01 个百分点。RETURN anchor 作为模块化组件可附加到任意基线攻击上，最高可提升 CSR 达 23.71 个百分点。在所有防御下 ICoA 保持 CSR 领先。InjecAgent 数据集上验证了方法可泛化。消融实验证实 user framing 负责执行、RETURN anchor 负责回归用户任务。

Conclusion: 隐蔽成功是 ReAct 循环的结构性后果，可被攻击者通过设计诱导。CSR 应作为 IPI 评估的必要补充指标，仅靠 ASR 无法反映用户能否察觉攻击。ICoA 证明了隐蔽攻击可被系统性制造，对 LLM 智能体安全研究具有重要启示。

Abstract: As LLM agents take real-world actions through tools, indirect prompt injection (IPI) has emerged as a serious threat. The standard metric, Attack Success Rate (ASR), counts whether an injection succeeds but ignores what the user notices in the agent's final response. Looking at successful injection traces, we find two distinct outcomes: the agent executes the injection while returning an otherwise normal response, or reports the injected action in its final response, giving the user a chance to notice. We call these covert and overt successes. From the user's perspective, we decompose ASR into the Covert Success Rate (CSR), counting successes leaving no trace in the final response, and the Overt Success Rate (OSR), counting successes the user can detect. To understand what drives the gap, we analyze successful trajectories and find that the agent's behavior after the injection separates covert from overt: covert traces hand control back to the user task before ending, while overt traces end at the attack itself. This split follows from the ReAct format, where the final response summarizes the most recent action. Building on this observation, we propose ICoA (Induced Covert Attack), an IPI attack designed to induce covert outcomes by steering the agent back to the user task after executing the injection. Across four target models on AgentDojo, ICoA achieves the highest CSR, with gains of 3.79-12.01 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [374] [Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30369)
*Ziheng Li,Xichen He,Haoyan Chen,Charlie Zou,Sheng Bai,Benjamin Yang,Mengyuan Wu,Jake Ledner,Yi-Jie Cheng,Akito Yamauchi,Dishita G Turakhia,Steven Feiner,Paul Sajda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OLIVE是一个在线隐变量推理框架，通过融合用户行为（射击）与被动注视锁定EEG信号，在任务执行过程中实时自适应冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM），为注意力受限的XR任务提供AI辅助。该框架通过EM循环联合估计各证据源的可靠性，无需离线训练或人工标注。研究通过三项用户研究证明，融合隐式生理信号与显式行为信号能够Pareto优于现有测试时适应方法，在目标吞吐量、收敛速度及对静默目标切换的快速重新适应方面均取得最佳效果，且效果独立于用户技能水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力受限任务（如空中交通管制、放射科筛查、安全监控）中，操作者的注意力而非计算能力是瓶颈。当候选目标数量超过操作者的实时检查能力时，需要自动化辅助。但传统的静态告警和一次性推荐无法适应任务演变，且无法在不妨碍操作者判断力的前提下协调人机行为。被动脑机接口（BCI）虽能从神经信号中推断任务相关状态，但现有方法要么假设无标签视觉流（测试时适应），要么处理带可靠性权重的标注（众包学习），要么需要大量样本（强化学习），均无法同时实现在线VLM适配与人类相关证据融合的实时学习需求。

Method: OLIVE（Online Latent Inference from Variable Evidence）是一个在线自适应框架，在冻结的CLIP ViT-B/16 VLM上附加可学习的"虚拟提示"，通过EM循环融合三类证据：(1) 视觉证据——质量加权的图像裁剪与虚拟提示的余弦相似度；(2) 显式行为证据——用户射击事件，作为正标签（非射击视为未标记而非负标签），参数化为敏感性α和误报率β；(3) 隐式生理证据——注视锁定EEG的解码器输出软标签，使用等方差高斯似然，参数化为类别条件均值ν+和ν-。E步通过对数几率加法累积计算各项目后验概率，并通过"流行率锚定"（prevalence anchoring）将均值后验固定到先验π以防止零塌缩；M步A通过软加权最大似然估计各通道可靠性参数，并通过有序投影防止极性反转；M步B对虚拟提示执行一步梯度更新。任务平台为XR第一人称射击游戏SpaceShooter，含母舰保护、非对称评分（误击友军惩罚更重）、静默目标切换等特性，设备为Varjo XR-3头显和ABM B-Alert X24 EEG系统（20电极）。

Result: 通过三项用户研究（N=57、46、45名参与者）证明：(1) US1中OLIVE-IE在收敛率×速度空间中Pareto支配所有基线（96.8%引导收敛率，28.3秒），且对认知过载具有鲁棒性，单模态方法在过载下退化；(2) US2实时部署中OLIVE-IE产生最大且可靠的会话内改进（Δ=+0.031 kills/s，p=.003），效果独立于射击技能（r=-0.02）；(3) US3静默目标切换场景下OLIVE-IE引导重新收敛显著快于纯行为代理（53.8s vs 68.5s，p=.008），会话内新目标吞吐量改进最大（Δ=+0.070 kills/s，p=.001）。操作者对EEG增强代理的信任度和依赖度随会话进程持续增长。便携式EEG模拟显示仅需4通道优化条带即可达到接近20通道全阵列的解码性能。

Conclusion: OLIVE证明了被动注视锁定EEG在线融合行为证据可在任务执行的时间预算内自适应VLM，将基础模型转变为任务个性化的辅助代理。在注意力受限任务中，AI代理应通过展示与操作者意图的一致性来赢得信任，而非通过预配置赋予权威。隐式神经生理与显式行为证据的融合为被动神经副驾驶开辟了设计空间，适用于人类注意力是约束瓶颈的任何领域。三项研究证实OLIVE可可靠收敛、带来可衡量的运行收益，并在静默优先切换时实时重新适应。其在线可靠性估计机制使系统天然容忍不完美用户和噪声传感器，将缺陷视为默认状态而非异常。

Abstract: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EEG) to provide timely guidance, continuously adapting a frozen vision-language model's inference on which items are task-relevant by jointly estimating per-source reliability without manual labels or offline training. Through three user studies, including two live deployments of an assistive agent driven by OLIVE in XR, we show that OLIVE Pareto-dominates prior test-time adaptation frameworks, achieving the highest convergence rate at comparable convergence speed. Combining implicit physiological and explicit behavioral signals, the OLIVE agent produces the largest and most reliable within-session improvement to a user's ability to detect and engage targets, largely independent of the individual's skill. When the target switches silently, the agent that uses both behavioral and physiological signals reconverges significantly faster than the behavior-only agent (1.27 times faster on average, p = .008), restoring trustworthy guidance at the moment the task changes, precisely when reliable assistance matters most.

</details>


### [375] [Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30396)
*Zixing Lei,Gengze Zhou,Xiong-Hui Chen,Jiazhao Zhang,Yiyang Huang,Hang Yin,Haoqi Yuan,Qi Wu,Weixin Li,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NavMCP是一个智能体脚手架框架，通过意图、观察、记忆三通道将VLM推理智能体与导航基础模型(NFM)执行器结合，在EQA任务上实现长视野物理世界导航的最优性能，并在真实机器人上验证了随任务视野增长的优势扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基础模型存在能力分裂：VLM擅长高层推理但在重复导航接地中脆弱低效，NFM稳健执行语义目标但缺乏跨轮次的任务级持久推理。如何将这两种互补能力组织为持久的长视野物理世界智能体是核心挑战。

Method: NavMCP采用三通道脚手架设计：(1)意图通道将证据需求翻译为带模式、子目标、预算和约束的语义导航调用；(2)观察通道将完整轨迹rollout转换为带源标注的关键帧证据（journey artifact）；(3)记忆通道维护EQA上下文状态C_t=(H_t,E_t,U_t)，累积证据账本、未解析目标和交互历史。执行器采用Qwen-RobotNav，无需重新训练任何模型。

Result: 在HM-EQA上达到76.7%准确率（超FAST-EQA 7.5点），MT-HM3D达54.4%（超3.9点），EXPRESS-Bench LLM Score达79.27（超10.57点）。匹配条件下超episodic接口14.9点。在Unitree Go2真实机器人上达78.3%成功率，随任务视野从单房间到>20m探索，相对最强基线的优势从10点扩大到45点。消融实验证实三通道各有贡献（观察5.9点、记忆4.6点、意图2.0点）。

Conclusion: 将互补的基础模型脚手架化为长视野物理世界智能体是有效的路径。导航模型对EQA贡献最大时，是当外部智能体能够检查、重用并控制其rollout时。局限在于依赖大型VLM导致推理慢，以及跨视图重复导致计数困难。

Abstract: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.

</details>


### [376] [Dense Clinical Contrasts Enhance Medical Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30405)
*Yangmin Huang,Shu Quan,He Geng,Xin Ye,Qianyun Du,Zhiyang He,Jiaxue Hu,Xiaodong Tao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SEER-Bench（基于最新SEER数据的肿瘤分期评测集），将NCCN指南更新事件渲染为四种监督格式（EMQ、MSQ、FITB、SAQ），在相同训练预算下证明网络化对比结构的EMQ（扩展匹配题）在医学知识更新中迁移性最强，并通过诊断分析揭示其优势源于更密集的临床对比信号和更经济的表征变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学知识持续更新，LLM易依赖过时但临床上看似合理的信息。现有医学评测主要考察教科书级稳定知识，缺乏时间锚定基准来评估针对新指南的更新是否真正被模型吸收。同时，检索增强、参数编辑、持续预训练等更新手段各有差异，但"更新内容以何种监督格式呈现"这一变量在医学时变适配中被低估。

Method: 1) 从NCCN指南构造医学更新事件三元组(当前推荐、基模型旧推荐、临床差异)，并由Gemini 3.1 Pro渲染为SAQ/MSQ/FITB/EMQ四种监督格式；2) 基于最新版SEER Research Data构建SEER-Bench（1,992例覆盖16类癌种），以TNM分期答案为时间锚定评测目标；3) 以Qwen3-4B为主干，采用匹配训练预算的LoRA-SFT在四种格式上分别适配，并在SEER-Bench、HealthBench、MedGUIDE上评估迁移与保留；4) 通过临床实体密度、逐层L2漂移、CKA、线性探针准确率进行诊断分析；5) 引入vignette/token匹配对照、密度匹配MSQ与shuffled-EMQ等消融实验分离结构与密度效应。

Result: 在同预算SFT对比中，EMQ在SEER-Bench上达到64.8%答案准确率与59.6%推理准确率（Qwen3-4B），在HealthBench上得分0.263，均优于MSQ/FITB/SAQ；RAG与知识编辑基线（Base RAG、CARE、RECIPE、AlphaEdit）SEER-Bench迁移有限且显著降低HealthBench保留；诊断分析显示EMQ暴露最多肿瘤相关实体、推理步骤实体占比最高、相关实体间距离最短，同时L2漂移最小、CKA最高，线性探针性能持平最优；密度匹配MSQ与shuffled-EMQ对照表明EMQ优势来自密集实体暴露与临床一致性网络结构的组合而非单纯密度；在1.7B/8B/14B Qwen3与Llama-3.1-8B上EMQ优势跨规模复现，主要SEER-Bench提升经配对bootstrap与Holm-Bonferroni校正后统计显著。

Conclusion: 医学知识更新的成败不仅取决于更新算法，也取决于知识以何种监督结构呈现：网络化、多对诊共享候选空间的EMQ格式通过密集临床对比信号，使模型在最小化表征漂移的同时建立更可迁移的决策边界，因此应被视为医学LLM持续适配的优先监督格式之一；该结论在跨主干、跨规模、跨语言的疫苗指南辅助实验中保持一致。

Abstract: Medical knowledge changes continually, making large language models vulnerable to relying on outdated yet clinically plausible information. We study whether the format of supervision affects medical knowledge updating under a matched training-budget setting. We introduce SEER-Bench, a temporally anchored oncology-staging benchmark curated from the latest versioned SEER Research Data release, and render identical medical update events from NCCN oncology guidelines into four supervision formats: EMQ, MSQ, FITB, and SAQ. Across SEER-Bench and HealthBench Professional, EMQ gives the most stable external transfer and retention among same-budget SFT variants. With EMQ supervision, the updated 4B model produces competitive results on temporally anchored oncology staging, reaching 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on SEER-Bench. Diagnostic analyses suggest that EMQ exposes denser clinical contrast signals while preserving discriminative representations with smaller movement from the base model. These results show that medical knowledge updating depends not only on the update algorithm, but also on how knowledge is structured as supervision.

</details>


### [377] [DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30413)
*Jayanta Sadhu,Sayem Shahad,Kenneth Marino*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeReLab是一个用于评估大语言模型可废止推理（defeasible reasoning）能力的生成式基准框架，从参数化图结构生成多轮信念更新对话，覆盖默认推理和继承推理两种非单调推理范式，并利用该框架系统地揭示了LLM中近乎普遍存在的确认偏倚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可废止推理评估数据集是静态的，存在基准饱和风险，且对非单调推理类别覆盖不足，无法揭示模型失败的根本原因（是真正的推理缺陷还是表层模式匹配），也难以进行受控的认知偏差实验。

Method: 提出DeReLab生成式框架：(1) 从参数化图结构（链长、分支因子、干扰密度、源优先级等）按需生成多轮信念更新对话；(2) 覆盖默认推理（含直接链操纵、源优先级冲突等）和继承推理（线性和树形）两大范式；(3) 使用基于Horty等人继承理论的路径解析器在每轮对话生成形式化验证的ground truth；(4) 使用伪词（logatomes）作为实体以避免预训练数据污染；(5) 嵌入认知科学实验，通过"一致性条件"框架（C1-C5）结合BiasGap和Odds Ratio度量确认偏倚；(6) 评估9个模型（含10种推理配置）共900个对话、18,390个问题轮次，并进行20种随机种子的可复现性验证。

Result: 三大主要发现：(1) 没有任何模型在所有条件下表现强劲，准确性随推理复杂度系统下降；(2) 确认偏倚近乎普遍存在于默认推理中——19个模型-推理类型组合中有17个经Holm-Bonferroni校正后统计显著，GPT-5.1偏差最极端（BiasGap=0.935, OR=891，C2准确率仅3.5%），而Qwen3-32B的扩展思考模式几乎消除了偏倚（Gap=0.008）；(3) 出现"知道但不输出"（know-but-don't-output）的元认知分离现象——多个模型能正确识别削弱性更新却无法修改其蕴涵判断，但反向问题顺序实验表明部分效应标签准确率受后验合理化驱动。附加发现：大多数模型沿推理路径置信度衰减（Gemma-4-31B的ρ=-0.298）；GPT-5.1能积累长链证据（ρ=+0.130）；树继承中GPT-5.1和Qwen3-32B能正确区分相关与无关更新（信号比>1），而Llama-3.1-8B对无关更新错误改动答案超过36%。基准具有高度可复现性（ICC=0.949）。

Conclusion: DeReLab提供了一个可扩展、结构化的可废止推理评估框架，揭示了当前LLM在信念更新条件下普遍存在确认偏倚、随推理路径长度增加置信度退化、且难以可靠追踪结构相关性等缺陷；扩展思考模式（如Qwen3-32B*）能显著缓解确认偏倚。未来工作可扩展更多非单调推理结构并引入更多认知科学驱动的探针，以深化对LLM可废止推理失败机制的理解。

Abstract: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and inheritance reasoning, with formally verified ground truth at every turn, enabling controlled measurement of how models respond to confirming and disconfirming evidence. This controlled generation process creates a testbed for experimental designs that isolate specific reasoning demands. Applying this capability to the study of confirmation bias, we evaluate nine open and proprietary large language models and find that nearly all exhibit a systematic tendency to accept congruent evidence while resisting incongruent updates, with several models correctly identifying a weakening update yet failing to revise their conclusion. We believe our work and findings will facilitate future research on evaluating language models in defeasible reasoning.

</details>


### [378] [From Metaheuristics to Exact Methods: A CP-SAT Approach for Multi-Objective Healthcare Workforce Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30419)
*Vipul Patel,Anirudh Deodhar,Dagnachew Birru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CP-SAT模型，将医疗排班问题从元启发式方法转向精确约束规划方法，通过14条硬约束保证零监管违规，15条软目标优化排班质量，并引入班次窗口分解与网格偏移预处理等创新方法，在18个测试实例上验证了可行性与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗排班方法（遗传算法、整数规划、约束规划）存在三大核心缺陷：①将劳动法规作为惩罚项而非硬约束，无法保证零违规；②约束建模数量有限（约6-12条），缺乏对休息排程、负荷公平、跨午夜班次等关键场景的支持；③元启发式方法生成的排班表在真实生产环境中存在合规风险，威胁患者安全。医疗排班作为NP-hard问题，需要一种能提供严格可行性保证且能表达复杂运营规则的精确方法。

Method: 1. 三变量班次窗口分解（x, w, b）：将单一二元工作变量分解为活跃工作(x)、班次窗口(w)和休息(b)，实现休息排程与中心性优化；2. 网格偏移预处理（Grid-Offset）：将24小时时隙网格重新索引，使跨午夜夜班（如22:00-07:00）映射到单个排班日内，无需修改求解器；3. 硬/软约束严格分离——14条硬约束作为模型不可违反条件，15条软目标通过加权惩罚函数聚合优化；4. 多粒度时间分辨率（13级，从15分钟到1天）；5. 通用CP-SAT建模，使用Google OR-Tools v9.12，16线程并行搜索，11个LNS工作器。

Result: 在18个测试实例（5个合成医院单元10-33护士、10个INRC-II基准5-80护士、3个NRP-23兼容实例10-25护士）上取得：①所有18个实例零硬约束违规；②INRC-II n005w4在班次级粒度下达到证明最优（目标值118，差距0.0%，104秒）；③最大规模扩展到179,800变量和351,425约束（80护士）；④服务质量（f₂）较MOGA提升50-67%；⑤模型规模近线性扩展（约4,400变量/员工）；⑥f₃（员工不满度）在所有测试中为0.0，而MOGA为20.2-117.4。

Conclusion: CP-SAT是首个同时提供休息排程、负荷公平、跨午夜班次支持和形式化可行性保证的医疗排班系统。其核心贡献在于将"监管合规"从可优化的惩罚项提升为不可违反的结构性条件，代价是更高的用工成本（f₁）。在医疗领域，监管违规的潜在代价（患者安全风险、法律责任）远高于增加工时的边际成本，因此该权衡具有运营合理性。未来工作方向包括Benders分解收紧最优性差距、多周滚动时域评估、需求预测集成及多站点扩展。

Abstract: Healthcare workforce scheduling is an NP-hard optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and cost objectives. Existing approaches (genetic algorithms, integer programming, constraint programming) model 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and cannot guarantee regulatory compliance. They also lack support for multi-role, multi-skill heterogeneity, mandatory break scheduling with midpoint control, acuity-weighted workload equity, sub-shift granularity, inter-week stability, and cross-midnight shifts. This paper presents CP-SAT: a Constraint Programming formulation for multi-role, multi-skill healthcare scheduling. CP-SAT enforces 14 hard constraints guaranteeing zero regulatory violations, while optimizing 15 soft objectives via a unified weighted penalty function.
