At many universities and research institutes, moreover, the instruments that generate research data and the high-performance computing systems that analyze it are separated both geographically and organizationally, because each demands its own expertise and installation environment. Connecting the two seamlessly is a pressing challenge for data-driven science. This article presents RED-ONION, a high-speed disk-to-disk transfer system that connects research facilities, on campus and beyond, to a computing center. The system combines data transfer nodes, a dedicated high-bandwidth network, an all-flash parallel file system, and multi-threaded transfer software that parallelizes network transmission and storage access. The design targets the wire rate both along the entire path, from the read on the sender storage to the write on the receiver storage, and for a single file between one pair of nodes rather than only in aggregate over many files or nodes. We describe the end-to-end optimizations across the transfer software, the operating system, and the storage that this requires. We evaluate a prototype deployed over a 100 Gbps transpacific path between Atlanta and Tokyo with a 150 ms round-trip time, on which a single 1 TB file transfer reached 90 Gbps, delivering a terabyte in approximately 95 s. Moving a dataset of this size therefore becomes a routine step, and the computing center serves an instrument as if the two were co-located.

### [473] [CLASP: Chained-Request-Aware Scaling and Operator Placement for Serverless Stream Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29103)
*Tianyu Qi,Maria A. Rodriguez,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Stateful serverless (Function-as-a-Service) environments, whose workers host state servers, are increasingly used for stream processing. A stream application is a pipeline of operators, where each operator forwards intermediate data downstream through a chained request. As input rates fluctuate, the system should adjust operator parallelism and place instances across workers to sustain the incoming rate. Existing approaches do so without fully accounting for chained-request overhead, leading them to misestimate the required number of workers. Too few leave the cluster unable to keep up with the input rate, while too many route a larger fraction of chained requests across worker boundaries, increasing end-to-end latency. We propose CLASP, a scaling and scheduling strategy for stream processing in stateful serverless environments. At runtime, CLASP estimates execution cost and chained-request cost from observed metrics. Under a capacity model that covers the two costs, it adjusts operator parallelism and packs operators onto the fewest workers that can sustain the target input rate. Once a scaling decision is made, CLASP migrates each operator's state together with its instances, thereby minimizing execution pause time. Experiments show that CLASP improves throughput by up to 3.3x and reduces median end-to-end latency by up to 76% compared with state-of-the-art scaling strategies.

### [474] [Bridging Agent Semantics with Spot Capacity: An Elastic and Recoverable Service Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29581)
*Minchen Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: LLM agents increasingly drive long-running cloud inference workloads in which model calls differ in urgency, redundancy, completion semantics, and replay cost. Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platforms expose several service models for trading cost against latency, availability, and capacity commitment. These models operate primarily at request, job, or endpoint scopes and provide limited support for combining transient platform supply with the evolving semantics of an agent task. We present SemSpot, a semantics-aware service model that allows agent applications to leverage the spot capacity of LLM inference platforms. At the request level, SemSpot lets a provider publish short-lived offers over successful price, completion probability, and failure-notification deadline; the agent runtime selects among these offers using the current task state and completion rule. An audit of 1,535 cases from six agent benchmarks identifies four recurring workflow structures and shows how this service model may produce different cost, service-time, and fallback behavior. With specialized MaaS support, token-level SemSpot further preserves provider inference state and runtime-verified semantic segments inside a long request. We develop the service model, economic boundary, and the cross-layer research agenda required to realize SemSpot.

### [475] [A Smallest-Need-First Job Scheduling Framework with Adaptive Optimization of Idle Node Counts for Energy-Efficient HPC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29656)
*Reza Pulungan,Raka Satya Prasasta,Santana Yuda Pradata,Mursalim,Hiroyuki Takizawa,Muhammad Alfian Amrizal*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Power-state management in high-performance computing (HPC) clusters must reduce idle energy without excessive wake-up delays for rigid parallel jobs. This paper presents SNF-ICON, an event-driven controller combining smallest-need-first (SNF) gang scheduling, predictive wake timing, and adaptive warm-spare control. At each scheduler invocation, recent interarrival and completed-service samples are screened for sufficiency, exponential-like variability, low lag-one autocorrelation, and acceptable Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance. Rejected or data-sparse windows use SNF+IPM (Intelligent Power Manager), whereas accepted windows activate release prediction and an exponential next-event model. Warm-spare optimization is applied only when queue, event, and arrival-recency conditions permit, balancing estimated waiting and non-compute energy over a timeout-capped horizon. We evaluate four DAS2 trace segments and a generated Markovian workload on AOBA-derived 64-node models, plus SDSC Blue on an AOBA-derived 1152-node model. SNF-ICON is compared with SNF+IPM and First Come First Served (FCFS) + backfilling with IPM. It reduces average waiting time relative to the FCFS-based baseline in all six cases and remains close to at least one heuristic energy baseline in five. The generated workload spends substantial time in ICON mode, whereas DAS2 workloads operate mainly in fallback. Furthermore, cross-platform results show strong dependence on node-transition and power models. Thus, no single policy or parameter set works best in every case.

### [476] [Projection-Free Bandit Online Optimization for Multi-Agent Systems with Dynamic Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30159)
*Xia Jiang,Lu Liu,Gang Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: This paper investigates distributed online optimization for multi-agent dynamical systems with constrained inputs and time-varying cost functions. While online convex optimization offers a principal framework for sequential decision-making, existing online learning and optimization algorithms typically require accurate system models, limiting their applicability in practical settings. To overcome this challenge, we propose a distributed bandit online feedback optimization algorithm that relies solely on real-time input-output data. The algorithm employs a smoothing zeroth-order one-point estimator to construct local gradient approximations directly from cost evaluations. Additionally, to enforce input constraints effectively, we integrate a projection-free conditional gradient update, making the algorithm well-suited for online and large-scale settings. Furthermore, we establish a sublinear dynamic regret bound that depends on a temporal variation measure of system non-stationarity. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

### [477] [Beating Quadratic Time--Message Trade-off in Distributed Minimum Spanning Tree Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30299)
*Taisuke Izumi,Naoki Kitamura,Toshimitsu Masuzawa*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present a new distributed algorithm for computing a minimum spanning tree (MST) in the \textsf{CONGEST-KT$_{1}$} model, where messages are limited to $O(\log n)$ bits and each vertex initially knows the identifiers of its neighbors. Our algorithm exposes a two-parameter time--message trade-off: for any $0 \leq \lambda \leq \kappa \leq 1/2$, it runs in $\tilde{O}(n^{\lambda}D_G + n^{1 - \kappa - \lambda} + n^{1 - 2\kappa + \lambda} + n^{1/2})$ rounds and uses $\tilde{O}(\min\{m, n^{1 + \kappa}\})$ messages, where $n$, $m$, and $D_G$ are the number of vertices, edges, and thenetwork diameter, respectively. In particular, setting $(\kappa, \lambda) = (1/3, 1/6)$ yields an MST algorithm running in $\tilde{O}(n^{1/2} + n^{1/6}D_G)$ rounds with only $\tilde{O}(n^{4/3})$ messages. Under the mild assumption $D_G = O(n^{1/3})$, this is round-optimal while improving the best known message bound of $\tilde{O}(n^{3/2})$. More broadly, our algorithm breaks the quadratic time--message trade-off barrier $\mathrm{\# rounds} \cdot \mathrm{\# messages} = \tilde{\Omega}(n^2)$, which no previous MST algorithm in the \textsf{CONGEST-KT$_{1}$} model has been able to overcome, and it does so for almost the entire range of the diameter $D_G$. As a byproduct, we also obtain new low-message broadcast, spanning-tree, and leader-election algorithms.

### [478] [Parameterized Complexity of Edge-Constrained Graph Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28767)
*Ajinkya Gaikwad,Jan Pokorný,Tomáš Valla*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the Edge-Constrained Graph Partitioning Problem (ECGP), which asks whether the vertices of a graph can be partitioned into r parts, each inducing at least gamma edges. We also consider a balanced variant (BECGP), requiring equal-sized parts, and signed variants, where the utility of a part is the difference between its numbers of positive and negative edges. We show that ECGP and BECGP remain NP-hard for fixed gamma, while BECGP is also NP-hard for fixed r. For the natural parameterization r+gamma, both problems admit polynomial kernels. We obtain FPT algorithms for ECGP and BECGP parameterized by maximum leaf number, vertex deletion distance to a clique, cluster vertex deletion number plus gamma, and vertex integrity. Furthermore, ECGP is FPT parameterized by vertex deletion distance to stars plus gamma and vertex deletion distance to paths plus gamma. On the negative side, ECGP and BECGP are W[1]-hard when parameterized by r together with several structural parameters. In particular, hardness holds for feedback edge set, vertex deletion distance to stars or paths, and modular width even when the corresponding parameter is zero. The problems are also W[1]-hard parameterized by cluster vertex deletion number plus r, and by clique-width even when gamma=3. For signed graphs, both variants are NP-hard even when r+gamma=3 and the input is a disjoint union of two cliques. Finally, the balanced signed variant is W[1]-hard parameterized by treedepth plus r, even when gamma=0.

### [479] [Parameterized Complexity of Connected Network Microaggregation: The Role of Cluster Size](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28920)
*Ajinkya Gaikwad,Dušan Knop,Tomáš Valla*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Network microaggregation is a fundamental technique in statistical disclosure control, where vertices of a graph are partitioned into clusters satisfying size constraints and admitting a center within bounded distance. We study the parameterized complexity of the \emph{unweighted Connected Network Microaggregation} problem, focusing on structural parameters and natural clustering parameters such as the distance bound $d$ and cluster size gap $u-\ell$. We show that, unlike the weighted variant, the unweighted connected problem is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by neighborhood diversity, and hence by vertex cover. In contrast, it remains $\mathrm{W[1]}$-hard for more general structural parameters, including vertex deletion to paths, stars, and cliques. These hardness results hold even for every $d\ge 2$ and any fixed gap $u-\ell$, showing that these clustering parameters do not overcome the structural hardness. We further show that adding the cluster size bound $u$ restores tractability for structural parameters such as treewidth and cluster vertex deletion. Moreover, $u$ is essential: the problem remains $\mathrm{W[1]}$-hard when these structural parameters are considered alone. For kernelization, we prove that the problem has no polynomial kernel parameterized by vertex cover unless $\mathrm{coNP}\subseteq\mathrm{NP/poly}$, even when the distance constraint is vacuous. Adding $u$ yields a polynomial kernel for vertex cover, while kernelization remains unlikely for more general structural parameters even when combined with $u$. Finally, we show that the problem is NP-hard on graphs of bounded clique-width.

### [480] [A Simplified Analysis of the Good-Bad $3/2$-Approximation Algorithm for Some Minimum-Cost Graph Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29274)
*Shayan Ranjbarzadeh,David P. Williamson,Hannane Yaghoubizade*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper, we consider an easy greedy approximation algorithm, the good-bad algorithm, introduced by Couëtoux for finding a minimum-cost set of edges such that every connected component has at least $k$ vertices. Couëtoux proves that the good-bad algorithm achieves a $3/2$-approximation for this problem. Davis and Williamson extend this result to the more general problem of finding a minimum-cost edge set that contains at least one edge from every cut $S\subseteq V$ satisfying $h(S) = 1$ where $h:2^V \rightarrow \{0,1\}$ is downward monotone; that is, $h(S) = 1$ implies $h(T) = 1$ for every nonempty subset $T \subseteq S$. The original problem corresponds to $h(S) =1$ when $|S|<k$. We give a simplified analysis of the good-bad algorithm for downward monotone functions.

### [481] [Scheduling to Maximize Weighted Throughput with an Active-Time Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29418)
*Susanne Albers,G. Wessel van der Heijden*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the active-time scheduling problem with weighted throughput maximization. In this setting, a set of $n$ jobs $J$ arrive at integer release times, each with an integer processing time and integer deadline. Jobs may be preempted at integer time slot boundaries. A schedule assigns jobs to time slots, with at most $m$ jobs assigned to the same time slot. A slot is called \emph{active} if at least one job is scheduled in it. Instead of scheduling all jobs to minimize the number of active time slots, we consider the more general variant of \emph{weighted throughput} with an active-time budget $K$, where each job $j\in J$ has a weight $w_j$. The objective is to maximize the total weight of \emph{completed} jobs using at most $K$ active time slots. This means that partially scheduled jobs do not count towards the objective. The classical active-time minimization problem is recovered by asking whether all jobs can be completed within a given active-time budget. We give hardness, approximation, and exact algorithmic results. For general intervals with unbounded parallelism, we prove NP-hardness, rule out an FPTAS unless $\mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP}$, and give a pseudo-polynomial time $\Omega(1/\log K)$-approximation. For proper intervals, we prove a canonical structural lemma and obtain an exact $(nK)^{O(m)}$-time algorithm. For laminar intervals, we give an exact $f(K,m)\cdot n^{O(1)}$-time algorithm.

### [482] [FirstFit online coloring in the random order model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29603)
*Xinyu Ye,Yuechuan Xu,Zixuan Wang,Jiaying Zheng,Yaqiao Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The average performance of FirstFit online coloring on trees in the random order model is completely determined in recent works of Frei et al. and Bosek et al., showing $\Theta(\log n /\log\log n)$ number of colors, improving the $\Theta(\log n)$ colors in the adversarial model. We provide a few further results on slightly more general graph classes. Firstly, we extend their method to obtain a simple path-counting principle for sparse graph classes, which immediately yields for example that cactus graphs and uniform hypertrees exhibit a similar improvement. We then show that FirstFit uses only $O(1)$ colors on crown graphs, a standard example where adversarial arrival forces $\Theta(n)$ colors. We further show that density alone (even linear minimum degree) is insufficient to guarantee $O(1)$ colors even on bipartite graphs. Finally, we identify graph classes, including unit interval graphs and some graphs of high chromatic number, for which random arrival provides only limited improvement. We end with some open problems.

### [483] [Socially Fair Clustering: Parameterized Approximation and Local Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30026)
*Aditya Anand,Yury Makarychev,Liren Shan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the Socially Fair Clustering problem introduced by Abbasi, Bhaskara, and Venkatasubramanian (2021) and Ghadiri, Samadi, and Vempala (2021), along with its extension, the $(p,q)$-Socially Fair Clustering problem. This problem generalizes $k$-medians and $k$-means to settings where data points are partitioned into $\ell$ groups, and the goal is to find a fair clustering that is simultaneously good for all groups. We present several algorithms for this problem. For $\ell_p$-Socially Fair Clustering, we give the first constant-factor FPT-approximation parameterized by the number of groups $\ell$, resolving the open question raised by Ghadiri, Singh, and Vempala (2022). Our main ingredient is a new algorithm for closing additional centers in parameterized time inspired by local search. We then turn to the more general $(p,q)$-Socially Fair Clustering problem. The known algorithm for this problem, proposed by Chlamtáč, Makarychev, and Vakilian (2022) achieves a very good approximation but is complex, slow and difficult to implement. We analyze the performance of a simple local search algorithm and show that it provides an $O(q)$ approximation in the worst case. Finally, we design approximation algorithms for the facility location variant of the problem, where the number of facilities (centers) is not fixed in advance, and opening each facility incurs an opening cost. Unlike in previous work, we do not assume these opening costs are the same for all groups.

This problem generalizes $k$-medians and $k$-means to settings where data points are partitioned into $\ell$ groups, and the goal is to find a fair clustering that is simultaneously good for all groups. We present several algorithms for this problem. For $\ell_p$-Socially Fair Clustering, we give the first constant-factor FPT-approximation parameterized by the number of groups $\ell$, resolving the open question raised by Ghadiri, Singh, and Vempala (2022). Our main ingredient is a new algorithm for closing additional centers in parameterized time inspired by local search. We then turn to the more general $(p,q)$-Socially Fair Clustering problem. The known algorithm for this problem, proposed by Chlamtáč, Makarychev, and Vakilian (2022) achieves a very good approximation but is complex, slow and difficult to implement. We analyze the performance of a simple local search algorithm and show that it provides an $O(q)$ approximation in the worst case. Finally, we design approximation algorithms for the facility location variant of the problem, where the number of facilities (centers) is not fixed in advance, and opening each facility incurs an opening cost. Unlike in previous work, we do not assume these opening costs are the same for all groups.

</details>


### [484] [The (Parameterized) Complexity of Ordering a Graph While Avoiding a Forbidden Pattern](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30667)
*Thomas Depian,Simon D. Fink,Alexander Firbas,Robert Ganian,Martin Nöllenburg,Marie Diana Sieper*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper, we study the Pattern Avoidance problem of determining whether a given graph $G$ admits a linear vertex order which avoids a given pattern $P$, i.e., a vertex sequence with some forced and forbidden edges, on every suborder. Such patterns form a natural ordered counterpart to induced subgraphs in the order-invariant setting, and it is known that Pattern Avoidance captures a broad variety of graph problems including Bandwidth, Vertex Coloring, Queue Number, and extends to vertex-deletion problems such as Odd Cycle Transversal. We show that Pattern Avoidance is $\Sigma_2^{\textsf{P}}$-complete and furthermore remains intractable (in both the classical and parameterized sense) even under a variety of severe restrictions to both the pattern $P$ and the graph $G$. As our main contributions, we complement these lower bounds with the following tractability results, which provide a unifying framework for recognizing pattern-definable graph classes: - a fixed-parameter algorithm w.r.t. the vertex integrity of $G$ plus $|V(P)|$, - a fixed-parameter algorithm w.r.t. the neighborhood diversity of $G$ plus $|E(P)|$, and - a polynomial algorithm for Pattern Avoidance on forests for almost all constant-sized patterns.

### [485] [On the maximum weight convex problem for some geometric graph-convexities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30728)
*Fariza Aklouche,Pierre Bergé,Michel Habib*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: For a given geometric graph-convexity on a graph $G$ equipped with a weight function on the vertices with value in $\mathbb{Z}$, the Max Weight Convex Set problem consists in determining the convex set $S$ with maximum weight (sum of the weight of the vertices in $S$). Although the problem is NP-complete in general, it remains polynomial for particular cases. After a survey of known results, our main contribution uses a generalisation of the maximum subsequence problem to laminar trees. Then we derive a linear algorithm for proper interval graphs and a quadratic one for interval graphs. Both improve the state of the art.

### [486] [Test or Run? Scheduling Jobs of Unknown Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30911)
*Václav Rozhoň*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: A machine faces many jobs whose lengths are hidden. Spending one unit of time to inspect a job may reveal a short job that should be finished now, or it may reveal nothing useful while every other job waits. When should the machine keep looking, and when should it start working? We study natural variants of this question and provide optimal algorithms in both the worst-case and instance-optimal frameworks. The resulting algorithms are often quite simple, which may make them useful in practice.

### [487] [Breaking the Exponential Barrier: The First Polynomial-Time Algorithm for the Győri-Lovász Theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30945)
*Mohammad T. Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Alireza Kaviani,Soheil Mohammadkhani*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give the first polynomial-time algorithm, after half a century, for the celebrated Győri-Lovász theorem, which resolved a conjecture of Frank (1975). The theorem, one of the simplest existential theorems to explain, states that every $k$-connected graph can be partitioned into $k$ disjoint connected subgraphs of arbitrary prescribed positive sizes. This is a fundamental structural result with broad applications, such as flexible allocation of connected subnetworks of prescribed sizes in sufficiently connected cloud infrastructures. While Lovász (1977) gave a highly non-constructive proof for a stronger directed version using algebraic topology, Győri's original constructive proof (1976) requires exponential time. Despite more than 50 years of effort, no polynomial-time algorithm was known even for $k>4$. Determining the computational complexity of the Győri-Lovász theorem---whether it admits even a sub-exponential-time algorithm or is computationally hard (in particular, PLS-complete or PPAD)---has remained one of the central open problems in algorithmic graph theory. In this paper, we finally resolve this long-standing problem by a fundamentally new proof of the existential theorem via introducing the novel concept of \emph{flow-essential assignment}, which genuinely marries matching and cut structures and yields the first polynomial-time constructive algorithm for the Győri-Lovász theorem. In fact, we obtain a polynomial-time algorithm for Lovász's stronger directed version, whose proof was non-constructive even for DAGs; for DAGs, we further obtain a near-linear-time algorithm. We also develop polynomial-time algorithms for weighted generalizations where the seminal work of Chen, Kleinberg, Lovász, Rajaraman, Sundaram, and Vetta (JACM'07) on confluent flows established only existential non-constructive results.

### [488] [Structural Corrections to the Bethe Approximation of the Permanent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.31061)
*Ijay Narang,Will Perkins*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study deterministic approximation algorithms for the permanent of a nonnegative matrix through the Bethe permanent, an approximation computable in polynomial time. The tight analysis of Anari and Rezaei gives a universal comparison between the permanent and the Bethe permanent within a factor $(\sqrt 2)^n$. The simple example of the unweighted $4$-cycle $C_4$ (or a union of disjoint $C_4$'s) shows that this bound is tight. We show that such $4$-cycle obstructions can be identified and exploited algorithmically. Given a Bethe optimizer, our algorithm identifies nearly isolated weighted $2\times2$ blocks and peels off a vertex-disjoint family of them. If the total weighted correction is large, we can improve the Bethe approximation; if it is small, we show that the Bethe permanent is within a factor of $(\sqrt2 - \varepsilon)^n$ of the truth. Combining these facts, we obtain a deterministic polynomial time $(\sqrt2-\varepsilon)^n$-approximation algorithm for the permanent of an arbitrary nonnegative $n\times n$ matrix, where $\varepsilon>0$ is some absolute constant.

### [489] [Adaptive KV Retention for LLM Agents at Human-Approval Timescales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30830)
*Minseo Choi,Ananya Joshi*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: Unlike the seconds-scale tool-call pauses targeted by prior agent-serving systems, agentic LLM requests can be suspended for minutes or hours while waiting for human approval. We study how suspension and resumption affect GPU serving performance and develop a retention policy that balances active-serving capacity against future recomputation under uncertain approval waits. The central tension is severe because retaining suspended KV preserves fast resume but can consume enough GPU capacity to reduce active-serving goodput by 41%, while evicting it avoids that residency cost at the expense of nearly $10\times$ higher resume latency when the request returns. We develop a tiered retention controller around GPU opportunity cost, which expresses the serving capacity consumed by preserving or reconstructing a suspended request's KV state in a common GPU-time cost. Within host memory, the controller selects between indefinite retention and load-indexed expiration using calibration wait samples, without requiring per-request wait prediction. On human-scale approval workloads, our controller improves active-request goodput by 23-51% over the vLLM baselines, 22-29% over MORI, and 41-52% over Continuum.

### [490] [Curvature Cryptanalysis of Smooth Transformer Feed-Forward Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28843)
*Munawar Hasan,Apostol Vassilev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对平滑Transformer FFN（GELU/SiLU激活）的黑盒曲率密码分析攻击，通过有限差分估计投影Hessian矩阵并联合分解，恢复隐藏的第一层权重方向，恢复率高且支持高保真功能替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型提取攻击多侧重行为保真度（预测一致性），无法揭示目标模型的内部参数结构。对于Transformer，其FFN包含大量参数，若黑盒接口泄露了隐藏权重的几何结构，则安全性问题更加严重。本文探究黑盒访问能否揭示Transformer FFN的内部参数化方式，并将泄露的结构用于高保真功能提取。

Method: 1. 形式化选择输入原始输出预言机模型；2. 证明平滑FFN的投影Hessian是共享秩一因子（u_j u_j^T）的混合，形式化为偏对称张量分解；3. 建立局部可识别性和稳定性理论（定理1和命题2）；4. 利用中心有限差分估计投影Hessian（2d²+1次查询/探针），利用共享向量输出模板减少16倍查询成本；5. 通过多重启联合Adam优化恢复共享方向字典；6. 可选的固定方向参数化完成剩余FFN参数拟合。

Result: 在CIFAR-10独立训练的Vision Transformer上，使用仅16个投影Hessian（对应8193次黑盒查询）：GELU平均DirRec=0.9644，95.1%方向超过0.90对齐；SiLU平均DirRec=0.9476，91.9%方向超过0.90对齐。恢复在独立训练模型、提取运行、所有Transformer块中均保持高恢复率。固定恢复方向并拟合其他参数后，GELU和SiLU替代品的测试精度分别仅下降0.90和0.62个百分点，Top-1一致性超过93%。输出舍入和高斯噪声在固定步长下显著降低恢复，但自适应调整步长可将平均对齐恢复到0.9603和0.9398。

Conclusion: 平滑Transformer FFN的曲率构成具体的结构性侧信道，黑盒二阶观察可恢复隐藏的第一层方向字典，并用于构建高保真替代模型。有限差分恢复与精确Hessian诊断相当，且通过自适应有限差分步长可大幅削弱舍入和噪声防御。该攻击将模型提取从行为模仿扩展到内部参数几何的恢复，但需要扩展到门控FFN（如SwiGLU）等现代架构。

Abstract: We show that smooth two-layer feed-forward networks (FFNs) expose an additional structural model extraction channel under a chosen-input raw-output oracle at the FFN branch; consider transformer FFN branches with GELU or SiLU activations under chosen-input raw-output access, without access to parameters, gradients, or internal activations; exploit a second-order leakage channel in which projected input Hessians form different mixtures of the same hidden symmetric rank-one factors induced by the FFN input weights. We formalize resulting Hessian collection as a partially symmetric decomposition to establish conditions for local identifiability and stability to exploit vector-output stencil reuse to reduce the structural query cost by a factor of 16. On independently trained CIFAR-10 vision transformers, only 16 projected Hessians, corresponding to 8193 black-box queries, recover the hidden FFN directions with average absolute cosine alignment above 0.94, with 95.1 % of GELU and 91.9 % of SiLU directions exceeding 0.90 alignment. Recovery remains high across independently trained models, repeated extraction runs, and all transformer blocks. The recovered structure supports functional extraction too. Keeping the recovered directions fixed and fitting only the remaining FFN parameters yields high-fidelity substitutes with more than 93 % top-1 agreement, while test accuracy remains within 0.90% and 0.62% of the GELU and SiLU targets. Output rounding and Gaussian noise substantially reduce recovery under a fixed attack configuration, but adapting the finite-difference step restores average alignment to 0.9603 and 0.9398. This is an end-to-end path from black-box second-order observations to hidden FFN-structure recovery and functional replacement. Under the stated oracle model, smooth FFN curvature exposes internal parameter geometry that behavioral fidelity alone cannot reveal.

</details>


### [491] [Equivariant Sheaf Neural Networks: Learning Geometric Transport on Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28853)
*Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Fabrizio Silvestri,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ESNN提出了一种一阶等变Sheaf神经网络，通过在边传输中引入有向矩阵值变换（而非提升特征阶数），在保持精确E(n)等变性的同时增强了向量特征的各向异性交互能力，并在粒子动力学、网格仿真、点云分类和分子属性预测中取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的等变图神经网络中，一阶Cartesian架构（如EGNN）在向量特征传递时受限于各向同性标量加权方式，无法有效建模各向异性几何交互；而提升特征阶数（steerable架构）则带来计算成本增加。需要在保持一阶表示效率的同时丰富边传输的几何表达能力。

Method: ESNN将边传输分解为空间算子S_ij（作用于n维空间轴，需满足O(n)-协变性S' = QSQ^T）与通道算子M_ij（作用于c_v维通道轴，需保持O(n)-不变性）。提出四种传输族：恒等传输、对角传输、正交传输（通过特征交叉矩阵的反对称部分构造SO(n)旋转）和径向-切向传输（沿相对位移方向与正交方向独立变换）。理论结果显示：当仅以相对位移作为协变量条件时，线性O(n)-等变传输必分解为径向与切向两部分。还引入受控对称松弛机制，通过学习系数λ控制偏好方向g的影响，λ=0时恢复完全E(n)等变性。

Result: 带电N-body动力学：ESNN各变体均优于EGNN，最佳（Ortho）MSE从0.0071降至0.0051（约28%改进）。重力增强N-body：受控松弛将MSE从~0.10降至~0.02，学习方向与真实重力轴完全对齐（A_g=1）。DeformingPlate网格仿真：RadTan在一步预测中RMSE从0.25降至0.08，全轨迹从15.1降至5.8。ModelNet40分类：对未见旋转保持84-86%准确率，OOD下降仅0.2-1.1个百分点。QM9：12个性质中9个优于EGNN。

Conclusion: 学习向量特征在边间的传输方式为表达性等变消息传递提供了一条互补路径，无需高阶表示。受控对称松弛机制在偏好方向存在时能有效降低对称性，并在λ=0时精确恢复完全E(n)等变性。当前局限：限于标量与一阶向量特征；完备性定理仅适用于仅以位移为协变量条件的情形；对称松弛假设单一全局偏好方向。未来工作可扩展至更丰富表示、局部/gauge感知传输及更一般的对称破缺场。

Abstract: Equivariant graph neural networks provide a principled way to model geometric systems, but efficient first-order architectures remain limited in how vector information can be transformed as it moves across a graph. We introduce \textsc{ESNN}, an Equivariant Sheaf Neural Network that enriches this interaction by learning directed, matrix-valued transport between neighboring vector features while preserving exact Euclidean equivariance. Rather than increasing the order of the representation, ESNN keeps scalar and vector features first-order and places the additional geometric flexibility in the edge transport itself. We characterize this transport theoretically, showing that when relative displacement is the only covariant geometric input, every linear $O(n)$-equivariant map decomposes into independent radial and tangential components, while learned covariant features enable richer feature-conditioned transformations. We also introduce controlled symmetry relaxation for systems with a preferred ambient direction, which may be prescribed or inferred from data while recovering full $E(n)$-equivariance when the directional pathway is inactive. Across particle dynamics, mesh-based simulation, point-cloud classification, and molecular property prediction, ESNN improves dynamics prediction, recovers the gravity axis when symmetry is broken, yields substantial gains on selected mesh tasks and long-horizon rollouts, and remains robust to unseen rotations. These results show that learning how geometric information is transported across edges offers a complementary route to expressive equivariant message passing without requiring higher-order representations.

</details>


### [492] [The Halt Vector: Internalizing a Causal Steering Intervention for Efficient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28859)
*Dylan Jayabahu,Tinuade Adeleke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"停止向量"(halt vector)方法，将可解释性研究中发现的因果停止方向内化到模型权重中，实现在推理过程中无需额外机制即可自适应停止推理。核心发现是：简单的标量投影目标会破坏与停止方向正交的特征维度，导致模型反而生成更长文本；正确做法是重建完整的第18层激活向量并固定其正交维度。基于24个问题训练，生成的思维链长度减少约24%且精度保持不变，并在五个未见基准测试中验证了跨任务泛化能力，还修复了随难度增加而恶化的非终止问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）存在严重的"过度思考"问题：模型在已得出正确答案后仍继续生成大量冗余推理。基线模型中，模型内部已"知道"答案的时刻（约1,650个思维token）与实际停止时刻（约3,700个思维token）之间存在2.24倍的差距，且这种差距因问题而异，无法通过全局长度惩罚解决。现有方法（结果级强化学习、模仿学习、偏好优化）均失败：要么只能削减尾部冗长输出，要么将长度信号归一化消除，要么以精度换取长度。研究表明，问题根源在于这些方法无法定位"何时停止"的精确决策点。

Method: 方法分三步：第一步，构建停止向量——在模型第18层，使用差分均值方法对比"答案锁定后"与"答案锁定前"的残差流激活，构建方向向量；价值轴（置信度方向）作为正交控制。第二步，将因果干预内化到权重——将网络在第18层分为写入端（0-18层）和读取端（19-27层），仅在写入端训练注意力LoRA，使其第18层输出匹配"基线激活加上停止向量"的完整重建目标。关键发现：标量投影目标会破坏正交维度（off-axis drift达5.22-6.31，而重建目标仅3.66），导致模型生成更长更差的文本；只有完整向量重建并固定正交维度才能成功。第三步，使用"强制回答点"（B_end，即思维链前缀中已能强制给出正确答案的最早位置）作为训练锚点，采用保持型调度在B_end之后持续注入停止方向。

Result: 核心结果：基于24个问题的训练适配器在五个未见基准测试（MATH500、AMC、AIME24/25及独立压缩保持集）上实现20-24%的思维token削减，同时精度保持在基线2个百分点以内（交叉种子噪声范围内）。问题级自适应能力显著：实际削减量与每个问题自身可压缩空间的Pearson相关系数为0.70（95% CI: 0.25-0.85），远超常数削减对照的0.11。方向特异性得到验证：相同训练流程下，替换为价值轴或随机方向均无法安装停止机制。终止问题得到解决：基线模型在AIME24/25上31-38%的非终止率降至6-9%。效率前沿竞争性：相较DEER解码时方法在AIME24上以-24%压缩比对应-2.0精度损失，DEER的-26%压缩对应-6.7精度损失。权重空间突发合并（burst-merge）支持数据扩展至144个问题而不损失效果。局限性：不优于精心调优的长度惩罚RL或解码时早退方法，且仅在单模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B）上验证。

Conclusion: 本文将因果可解释性发现转化为已安装的行为：通过第18层的差分均值停止向量并将其内化到权重中，实现无需运行时机制且无需强化学习的可调每题自适应自停止。核心贡献在于机制本身——完整向量重建并固定正交维度是内化转向干预的通用配方，其中心失败模式（正交维度破坏）最可能在技术复用时重现。该方法在压缩-精度权衡上具有竞争力而非领先，但提供了独特的部署配置文件。

Abstract: Reasoning models do not stop when they know the answer. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B the chain of thought runs about twice as long as the model's own answer probability takes to settle, and how much of that excess is removable varies from problem to problem, so a global length penalty cannot take it out. We take it out by internalizing a causal interpretability finding into the weights. The mechanism is a halt vector: a difference-of-means direction at layer 18 of this model whose steering strength controls how long it thinks, while a replicated value axis does nothing. Installing that intervention in the weights is harder than it looks. Maximizing the scalar projection onto the direction corrupts the off-axis dimensions a frozen downstream reader depends on, and generation gets longer instead of shorter; what works is reconstructing the whole steered activation with those dimensions pinned to their natural values. Fit from 24 problems and no reinforcement learning, the halt removes about a quarter of the thinking at held accuracy across five unseen benchmarks, and the cut tracks each problem's own removable slack at 0.70. It also closes a non-termination pathology that grows with difficulty and that a decoding-time confidence hook makes worse. We do not claim to beat a well-tuned length penalty or decoding-time early exit on the raw trade-off; the contribution is how the halt is obtained.

</details>


### [493] [From the Loss Landscape to Diverse Feature Learning in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28948)
*David Aram Yunis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇博士论文，研究神经网络损失景观的结构（特别是线性模式连接LMC现象），提出通过权重谱动力学（奇异值/向量动态）来统一解释多种深度学习现象，包括泛化、grokking、彩票假设和LMC，并基于此提出克服简单性偏差的多样化特征学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管神经网络已大规模部署并影响社会各领域，但对其优化过程的理解仍然粗浅。论文聚焦于"模式连接"这一令人困惑的损失景观现象，试图通过理解损失景观的特殊结构来解释神经网络的优化行为，并最终改善实际网络的训练。核心动机是：是否可以用更少的资源获得更好的模型，而非仅依赖暴力扩展（scaling）？

Method: 论文采用三阶段方法：(1) 扩展线性模式连接(LMC)为凸模式连接(CMC)，发现高维低损失的凸包；(2) 提出通过追踪权重矩阵的奇异值/向量动态（谱动力学）作为分析框架；(3) 基于谱动力学定义简单性偏差，利用投影梯度下降(PGD)和CKA多样性损失等方法促进多样化特征学习。实验涵盖图像分类(VGG/ResNet)、图像生成(UNet)、语音识别(LSTM)和语言建模(Transformer)等多种架构和任务。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 神经网络在高维空间存在多个多样性凸模式，远端点函数差异显著但仍可线性插值；(2) 谱动力学在不同架构中表现一致：大奇异值增长更快，顶部奇异向量提前稳定，权重衰减促进低秩化；(3) 谱动力学统一解释了grokking、随机标签记忆、彩票假设和LMC等现象；(4) 基于顶部奇异向量的PGD方法可解决MNIST-CIFAR简单性偏差问题；(5) CKA多样性损失在图像分类中显著优于随机集成，但未能推广到语言建模。

Conclusion: 论文表明神经网络优化普遍存在低秩偏差，谱动力学提供了一个统一的视角来理解看似无关的现象。这一理解不仅具有理论价值，还为改善低数据场景下的训练提供了实用方法。虽然语言建模中的多样化特征学习仍是开放问题，但论文提出了一条不同于纯扩展（scaling）的路径，倡导深入理解而非暴力计算。

Abstract: Over the course of the last decade, neural networks have grown from an academic curiosity to moving the markets of nations. Despite this explosion in both research and deployment, relatively little is understood about how they achieve the solutions they do. This is both scientifically relevant, and pressing for society. When neural networks make decisions across self-driving, construction, law, hiring and health, there have been and will continue to be unintended consequences. However, attempting to generalize the failures of the largest and most important production systems makes for a very difficult task. Yet signs of these failures exist at all scales of neural networks, so we should be able to study a much more tractable setting. All neural networks must undergo an optimization process, called training, to be useful. To a great degree, understanding neural networks is understanding their optimization: through what process and exposure to which data did they arrive at their results. Yet our knowledge on this topic as a field is quite imprecise. In particular, a curious phenomenon called mode connectivity, the ability to connect neural networks in the loss surface, defies explanation entirely. This dissertation elucidates, explains and exploits this special structure in the loss landscape...

</details>


### [494] [Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29029)
*Yanchen Huo,Ziying Song,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA) 提出了一种基于条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）的潜在动力学模型，用于替换 LeWorldModel（LeWM）中确定性的自回归预测器。该方法在保持重建无关（reconstruction-free）JEPA 框架的同时，将逐点转移回归替换为随机轨迹级预测。F-JEPA 以高斯分布为流源，学习将扰动后的潜在轨迹传输到干净的未来表示。在四个控制环境中，F-JEPA 在干净条件下的平均成功率从 86% 提升到 92%，在噪声条件下从 67% 提升到 86%，显著增强了模型对任务无关视觉扰动的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeWM 的 JEPA 世界模型存在两个主要局限：1）确定性自回归预测器通过递归的单步转移生成未来状态，导致误差累积；2）逐点对齐的训练目标未能在潜在表示受到扰动时为动力学模型提供恢复机制。因此，尽管 JEPA 旨在抽象掉无关视觉信息，但其学习到的动力学仍可能对任务无关的视觉扰动敏感。

Method: F-JEPA 将多步潜在动力学建模为条件流匹配：给定当前潜在状态和动作序列，从高斯分布中采样源轨迹，通过学习时间相关的向量场将其传输到目标未来潜在轨迹。所有未来时间步的预测在每个积分步骤中联合更新，而非自回归式地递归生成。保留 SIGReg 防止表示崩溃。预测器采用 6 个 Transformer 块，通过 AdaLN 注入流时间条件 τ，使用交叉注意力以当前潜在状态和动作序列为上下文。推理时使用显式 Euler 积分（8 步）。

Result: 在 Two-Room、Reacher、Push-T 和 OGBench-Cube 四个环境中：1）干净观测下平均成功率从 86% 提升至 92%；2）视觉扰动下平均成功率从 67% 提升至 86%，平均提升 19 个百分点；3）从干净到噪声的性能下降从 19 个百分点减少至 6 个百分点；4）在扰动半径和噪声幅度的消融实验中，F-JEPA 在所有测试配置下均优于或匹配 LeWM；5）8 步 Euler 积分在准确性和效率之间提供了最佳平衡；6）F-JEPA 推理时间约为 LeWM 的 3.8 倍，但端到端评估时间仅增加 1.6 倍，因为 F-JEPA 减少了重规划次数。

Conclusion: 条件流匹配为 JEPA 世界模型中的确定性自回归动力学提供了一个有前景的替代方案。F-JEPA 通过随机轨迹级预测改善了平均规划性能，并显著降低了对任务无关视觉扰动的性能退化。该方法在不同的扰动强度和空间尺度下均保持了鲁棒性优势，且不需要更精细的数值积分或更大的 CEM 规划预算。局限在于实验聚焦于较短视野任务，推理时需要多次向量场演化。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown strong potential for learning compact predictive representations, and LeWorldModel (LeWM) extends this paradigm to reconstruction-free latent world modeling from pixels. However, its deterministic autoregressive predictor generates future states through repeated one-step transitions, which can accumulate errors and remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations. In this work, we propose Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a conditional flow matching dynamics model that jointly generates a sequence of future latent states conditioned on the current observation and actions. A Gaussian distribution serves as the flow source, exposing the vector field to perturbed latent trajectories as it learns to transport them toward clean future representations. This formulation retains the reconstruction-free JEPA framework while replacing point-wise transition regression with stochastic trajectory-level prediction. F-JEPA raises mean success from $86\%$ to $92\%$ under clean observations and from $67\%$ to $86\%$ under noisy conditions, suggesting that conditional flow matching provides a promising alternative to deterministic autoregressive dynamics in JEPA world models.

</details>


### [495] [Development of an Autonomous AI Coding Agent using Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Gemini LLM Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29096)
*Pravin Game,Vipin Ramakrishnan,Prathamesh Wagh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的自主AI编码代理，结合Gemini 2.5 Flash API，将代码生成任务建模为搜索问题，通过自批评评估器筛选最优方案，并配备Flask Web界面实现交互，在复杂逻辑提示上达到92%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程需求不断演变，需要从自然语言自动生成安全可靠的源代码；传统LLM的"一次性"生成模式在处理复杂任务时易出现逻辑幻觉、算法性能下降等问题，难以直接产出生产级代码。

Method: 1) 以Gemini 2.5 Flash API作为底层推理引擎；2) 设计定制化蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)算法，将代码生成建模为决策树搜索过程；3) 引入"Self-Critic"自批评评估器，对候选实现方案按准确性与难度进行排序；4) 通过反向传播机制持续优化运行框架；5) 基于Flask构建Web交互界面，提供实时反馈与语法高亮。

Result: 在复杂逻辑提示的代码生成任务上，该MCTS方法取得92%的成功率，显著优于标准零样本(zero-shot)生成模型。

Conclusion: 将LLM与MCTS搜索机制结合，并辅以自批评评估与Flask交互层，能够有效缓解LLM一次性生成的逻辑幻觉问题，提升复杂代码生成任务的可靠性与性能，为自动化代码生产提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: The ongoing changes in software engineering requirements have created a substantial need for automated tools which can create secure source code from natural language input. The performance of traditional Large Language Models (LLMs) becomes limited by their "one-shot" capability which results in logical hallucinations together with reduced algorithmic performance during complicated operations. The research presents an autonomous AI Coding Agent which establishes a connection between LLM-generated content and production-ready software through its organized methodology for decision making. Our framework uses the Gemini 2.5 Flash API for essential reasoning capabilities while employing a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) method to solve code generation challenges as a search operation. The agent uses a "Self-Critic" evaluator system to test different implementation methods which it ranks according to their accuracy and difficulty level before it improves its operational framework through backpropagation. The system operates through a Flask-based web interface which delivers instant feedback together with syntax highlighting features. Our experimental results show that the MCTS-based method achieves a 92% success rate on complex logical prompts while surpassing standard zero-shot generation models.

</details>


### [496] [Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29188)
*Qiancheng Zhou,Ruizhe Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示RLVR训练导致的解空间收窄是一种"访问失败"而非"执行失败"：推理多样性丧失主要发生在解题轨迹的入口处（首次算术操作之前），而非下游计算阶段。基于Countdown任务的可穷举解空间分解框架，作者证明通过针对性干预（如层间参数插值、检查点采样、入口分配）可在不损失单样本准确率的前提下恢复高达37%的解空间覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）显著提升大语言模型的单样本准确率（pass@1），但会收缩策略的解空间，削弱测试时扩展的收益。现有研究将此现象归因于多样性损失，但未能区分两种本质不同的失败模式：策略未能"访问"有效的解题家族（入口选择失败），还是未能"执行"已发起的计算（下游推理失败）。澄清这一机制对于设计有效的恢复策略至关重要。

Method: 核心方法论是在Countdown任务上构建可穷举枚举的解空间，并按"入口家族"（由首个操作数和运算符定义）进行划分，将解题概率分解为访问阶段（π(B=b|x)）与执行阶段（π(有效完成|x, B=b)）。具体诊断工具包括：(1) 教师强制似然度分段归因（按首个运算符切分轨迹）；(2) 入口钳制生成（注入极简入口前缀后测量条件完成率）；(3) 跨检查点配对分析；(4) 干预手段对比（表面提示、温度缩放、对数混合、层间参数插值、检查点采样）。在6个标准数学基准上使用首次计算熵和同轨迹似然度分布作为结构性代理指标，并验证7B/14B规模以及SFT→DPO→RLVR多阶段管线的泛化性。

Result: 实验覆盖PPO（Qwen2.5-3B）和公开GRPO（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）两条独立管线：(1) 准确率-广度权衡显著——PPO中pass@1提升超50倍而解覆盖率下降67%（0.337→0.111），GRPO中准确率翻三倍而覆盖率下降43%；(2) 似然度偏移集中于入口——入口段每token NLL增量为4.50/8.08（PPO/GRPO），执行段仅0.28/0.71，比值达16×和11×；(3) 注入未选入口可恢复完成率超一个数量级（PPO中0.018→0.212）；(4) 表层提示和温度缩放无法有效恢复广度，但层20-28的参数插值在保持pass@1的前提下将覆盖率提升37%；(5) 早期步骤熵坍缩在7B/14B规模、6个数学基准上一致出现；(6) SFT基线在相近pass@1下保持2.6倍以上的解覆盖率，多解监督呈现严格单调的剂量-响应关系；(7) OLMo-3的SFT→DPO→RLVR阶梯在提升准确率的同时保留早期计算熵。

Conclusion: RLVR诱导的解空间收窄本质上是一种"访问失败"而非"执行崩溃"：概率质量几乎完全从入口处流失，而潜在执行能力保持完整。入口处似然度偏移是执行段的11-16倍，但条件执行能力在训练中实际上有所提升。这表明表面级提示无效，而针对入口的干预（晚层参数插值、结构化入口分配、检查点组合）可在保持pass@1的同时恢复高达37%的解空间覆盖率。早期步骤的多样性丧失在多步数学基准和更大模型规模上复现，但通过多解监督微调与多阶段对齐管线（SFT+DPO+RLVR）可规避此权衡。有效推理不仅需要执行选定路径，还需在初始决策边界保持备选解的可达性——即"门需敞开"。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves single-sample accuracy (pass@1) but causes the policy's solution space to contract, diminishing the returns of test-time scaling. In this work, we investigate where inside a reasoning trajectory this breadth is lost: does the policy fail to access a valid solution family, or does it fail to execute computation once initiated? To disentangle access from execution, we analyze the Countdown task, whose solution space can be exhaustively enumerated into discrete entrance families defined by the first operand and operator, across PPO on Qwen2.5-3B and GRPO on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Across both training setups, solution coverage falls by up to 67%, halving even on problems solved across all checkpoints. We show that this contraction is heavily concentrated at the entrance: per-token likelihood shifts are 11x--16x larger prior to the first arithmetic operation than during downstream reasoning. Supplying only an unselected entrance prefix restores completion rates in low-access families by over an order of magnitude (0.018 -> 0.212 under PPO), demonstrating that alternative solutions remain executable but are no longer initiated. Guided by this localization, we find that while surface prompting fails to recover diversity, entrance-targeted interventions succeed: late-layer parameter interpolation with early checkpoints increases solution coverage by 37% at no loss in pass@1. Finally, we show that early-step entropy collapse recurs across six math benchmarks with 7B and 14B models, but is not an inevitable byproduct of reasoning optimization: an SFT baseline preserves more than double the coverage, and staged SFT--DPO--RLVR pipelines retain early-step entropy. In summary, reasoning breadth is lost at the door, not inside the room. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [497] [PokaiTrainer: Scaling Belief-State Search to Competitive Pokémon VGC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29197)
*Max Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PokaiTrainer是首个将决策时均衡搜索（belief-state equilibrium search）成功扩展到官方宝可梦VGC双打格式的AI系统。它通过Rust编写的PokaiEngine精确枚举所有概率分支，并基于Student of Games框架在公共信念状态上求解贝叶斯矩阵博弈，最终在Showdown天梯上达到约1350-1400 Elo水平（人类业余到中段水平），胜率达59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现存的均衡搜索算法（如ReBeL、Student of Games）只在"易处理"子博弈中取得了超人表现——动作数量少、随机性仅限于发牌、玩家轮流行动。但官方VGC双打格式同时打破这三个假设：（1）双方玩家同时行动，组合动作空间达10^4；（2）每个联合动作有10^2-10^3个概率结果；（3）对手的保留宝可梦和能力值分配（stat spreads）隐藏。先前的宝可梦AI都依赖策略网络或启发式方法，从未进行过决策时均衡搜索。本文探索信念状态搜索是否能扩展到这种全新的领域。

Method: 系统包含两大组件：（1）**PokaiEngine**——一个Rust战斗引擎，原生支持概率分支，能在一次遍历中枚举联合动作的完整加权结果分布，与官方Pokémon Showdown达到~99%行为一致性，单时间线模拟速度比Showdown快26倍；（2）**PokaiTrainer**——基于Student of Games改编的搜索智能体，将每个决策视为公共信念状态上的贝叶斯矩阵博弈，在显式计算预算下增量扩展子博弈。关键改编包括：使用交替更新线性CFR求解同时行动矩阵博弈；按计算成本而非节点数定价扩展；对隐藏能力分配通过引擎本身的分支重新加权进行推断；引入三种训练行（grounding、interior supervision、hypothetical augmentation）。网络架构为5.4M参数的6层8头transformer trunk，先用12.3万条人类回放做行为克隆初始化，再通过32轮自博弈训练。

Result: 在Showdown最佳三局制天梯上，智能体在150组对局中赢了59%（44-31和45-30两组实验），对手平均Elo约1320。账户稳定在1350-1400 Elo区间，峰值短暂进入格式前500名。内部评估显示：（1）策略网络单独使用弱于浅层启发式搜索（greedy以71%胜率击败所有裸策略网络），而搜索智能体始终击败自身策略网络——搜索是真正的推力；（2）训练回报急剧递减，第32轮后的延伸未能超越；（3）部署时增加预算和子解深度可提升胜率（如B=128、own=32、iters=200的配置达63.7%），但宽度无益；（4）早局价值网络存在系统性乐观偏差，深求解可掩盖但无法修正该缺陷；（5）评估集eval16属于中等强度队伍（Bradley-Terry排名中位数217/648），强队伍天梯表现并无显著优势。

Conclusion: 信念状态均衡搜索确实可以扩展到同时行动、宽概率节点和隐藏信息三者并存的博弈。给定一个能枚举概率的引擎和一个能为子博弈预算求解器，掌握扑克的算法配方在十块GPU集群下可在人类VGC对战中稳定维持1350-1400 Elo。主要遗留问题：（1）封闭队伍表（隐藏完整配招/道具/特性）仍未解决；（2）价值网络对早局的乐观偏差源于自博弈覆盖不足，需更多数据与算力解决；（3）当前算力规模（250 L40S小时+15 A100小时训练）比ReBeL等里程碑低2-3个数量级，瓶颈可能仅是数据量。系统将协调Showdown管理员择机发布代码，但训练检查点在当前格式活跃期间不会公开。

Abstract: Decision-time equilibrium search carried poker to superhuman play, but it has so far relied on tractable subgames: a handful of actions per decision, chance confined to card deals, one player moving at a time. Competitive Pokémon in its official doubles format (VGC) breaks all three assumptions at once. Both players act simultaneously from joint menus in the hundreds, each joint action resolves to hundreds of stochastic outcomes, and the opponent's reserves and stat allocations are hidden. We set out to build a strong VGC agent and report what that took. PokaiEngine, our Rust battle engine, enumerates a joint action's full weighted outcome distribution in one pass, at ${\sim}99\%$ parity with Pokémon Showdown and a fraction of the cost of sampling it. On top of the engine, PokaiTrainer adapts Student of Games to this scale, solving every decision as a Bayesian matrix game over public belief states and growing subgames under an explicit compute budget. On the live Showdown best-of-three ladder, the agent wins 59% of 150 sets against a human field averaging ${\sim}1320$ Elo. It settles into a 1350-1400 Elo band, and at its peak briefly entered the format's top 500.

</details>


### [498] [Adaptive Multi-Branching for Shallow Decision Tree Induction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29262)
*Hanul Park,Jeonghoon Choi,Juseong Kim,Sanghun Sel,Giltae Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MBNDT（Multi-Branch Neural Decision Tree with Adaptive Pruning），一种端到端可微的多路分裂轴对齐决策树，在严格浅深度约束（D≤4）下，通过在每个内部节点学习有序多阈值多路分裂并配合可学习的分支掩码与训练后剪枝，提升分类准确率，同时以更多的叶子数换取更短的决策路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在严格的深度预算下，传统二叉树每个内部节点仅做一次阈值决策，表达能力受限（即"浅深度下的表达力瓶颈"）。论文希望在保持根到叶路径短的前提下提高预测准确率，研究浅深度树归纳（shallow-depth tree induction）问题。

Method: 1) 特征选择：每个内部节点通过 entmax_{1.5} + straight-through 估计器选择单一特征，保证 axis-aligned 分裂；2) 多路路由：学习 B−1 个有序阈值（通过 softplus 累积间距保证严格递增），用累积 logistic 概率构造可微的 B 路区间软路由；3) 自适应剪枝：引入 sigmoid 分支掩码 m_j 对路由概率做乘性偏置后再做 hard routing，从而允许节点自适应调整有效分支数；4) 复杂度控制：以"软有效叶子数"L_soft 为可微代理，使用增广拉格朗日式的叶子预算正则；5) 训练后剪枝：保留训练路径上实际到达的分支，未到达分支重定向到最近存活分支，输出确定性单路径树用于推理。

Result: 在 21 个 OpenML 二分类基准上，MBNDT 在深度受限单树方法中获得最佳平均秩 1.48、最多胜场 15/21，以及最高平均平衡准确率 0.832（CART 0.822、SPLIT 0.790、GradTree 0.762），Friedman 检验 p=2.37×10^{-6}，Wilcoxon 配对检验对每个基线均显著。消融显示：B 从 2 升到 3 平衡准确率从 0.820 升到 0.833、叶子从 9.5 增到 16.0；分支掩码贡献小但一致的精度提升（0.823→0.827）；训练后剪枝是主要的压缩机制，将叶子数从 60.7 降至 22.9 而精度不变；叶子预算 K 在 4→64 区间单调提升精度至 0.836。代价：MBNDT 平均 20.6 片叶（远多于 SPLIT 6.1、CART 10.3、GradTree 11.5），平均路径 2.95（短于 CART/GradTree，长于 SPLIT）。

Conclusion: 通过在每个节点提升"局部分区容量"而非加深树，MBNDT 在浅深度约束下以更多叶子数为代价获得了最高的精度，验证了多路分裂是关键增益来源。其最适合的场景是优先考虑短决策路径下准确率、而非最小全局树规模的应用。未来工作包括扩展到多分类/回归，以及引入更细粒度的解释复杂度和以人为中心的可解释性研究。

Abstract: Decision trees are attractive for tabular prediction tasks because each prediction follows an interpretable sequence of feature-threshold tests. Under a strict maximum-depth budget, however, conventional binary trees can be under-expressive, since each internal node makes only a single threshold decision. We study shallow-depth tree induction, where the goal is to improve accuracy while keeping root-to-leaf paths short. We propose the Multi-Branch Neural Decision Tree with Adaptive Pruning (MBNDT), a single axis-aligned tree trained end-to-end with differentiable multi-way splits. Each internal node learns ordered thresholds over a selected feature and a branch mask that adapts its effective arity, and the trained model is converted to a deterministic single-path tree for inference. Across 21 OpenML binary-classification benchmarks, MBNDT achieves the best average rank and mean balanced accuracy among depth-constrained single-tree baselines; a controlled ablation isolates multi-way splitting as the source of the gain. These gains come with an explicit trade-off: MBNDT realizes more leaves than the other single-tree baselines, making it best suited when accuracy under short, bounded decision paths is prioritized over minimal global tree size.

</details>


### [499] [When Do Larger Batches Help Scale LLM Reinforcement Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29296)
*Ziniu Li,Jinbo Wang,Guanhua Huang,Feiyuan Zhang,Pengbo Li,Alex Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）中，何时增大训练批量（batch size）能够在固定硬件条件下真正缩短达到目标性能所需的实际墙钟时间。作者通过分解学习效率与系统吞吐量的贡献，提出了一个清晰的判断准则，并在 GRPO 与 PPO 两种主流算法上进行了系统验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大模型 RL 训练中，增大 batch 被普遍认为是提升训练速度的有效手段，因为它能够降低随机梯度的方差并提高硬件利用率。然而，这种统计学上的优势是否能转化为实际训练时间的缩短并不明确——更大的 batch 意味着每次更新消耗更多样本，且单步执行时间可能更长。在固定硬件预算下，这一权衡问题尤为关键却缺乏系统研究。

Method: 作者提出了一个两层分解框架：将墙钟学习进度率 dJ/dt 分解为样本效率（dJ/dN，每样本学习进展）与系统效率（dN/dt，吞吐量）的乘积。核心判断准则为：增大 batch 仅当其吞吐量增益超过样本代价惩罚（r_N = N₂*/N₁*）时才能缩短到达目标的时间。在算法层面，定义并实证检验"batch-size 不变性"——通过平方根学习率缩放（Adam 优化器下的 η(B) = η₀√(B/B₀)）在有界范围内实现样本索引的学习曲线对齐。在系统层面，利用自回归生成的内存带宽瓶颈特性，建立生成-训练不对称性的 Roofline 分析模型，量化大 batch 对生成吞吐量的亚线性加速效应。

Result: 算法层面：GRPO（Qwen3-30B-A3B）与 PPO（混元 3B 激活参数 MoE）实验显示，在 P=64–1024（GRPO）与 B=256–2048（PPO）范围内，经平方根学习率缩放后不同 batch 配置的样本索引学习曲线近似对齐。超过该范围（如 GRPO 的 P=2048/4096、PPO 的 B=4096），不变性开始失效。固定学习率对照实验（GRPO P=256）将样本代价增加 67%。系统层面：固定硬件上 PPO 将 B 从 256 增至 1024 带来 2.29× 的生成吞吐量提升，GRPO 中 P 从 128 增至 512 带来 1.36× 提升，而训练更新时间近似与 batch 成线性关系。综合效果：GRPO 中结合吞吐量提升与学习率调优使到达 77% 目标的时间最多缩短 29%，而固定学习率的大 batch 配置反而更慢。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：在大模型 RL 的固定硬件训练中，增大 batch 能否加速训练取决于两个条件的同时满足——一是经批量相关超参数（特别是学习率）重调后，样本效率应保持近似不变（即处于"临界训练 batch"以下的统计高效区间）；二是系统吞吐量增益必须超过样本代价惩罚。论文提出了"先对齐，后加速"（Align, then Accelerate）的两阶段调优原则，并给出了实用的批量选择算法。PPO 中 actor 与 critic 可能具有不同的临界 batch 大小，这为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Larger batches reduce the variance of stochastic gradients per update and are therefore often expected to accelerate training. Yet whether this statistical benefit translates into lower wall-clock time-to-target remains unclear, because each update consumes more samples and may take longer to execute. We study this tradeoff in reinforcement learning for large language models. We separate its algorithmic and systems effects by comparing learning and execution along their natural axes. At the algorithmic level, we compare configurations at equal cumulative sample counts while retuning batch-dependent hyperparameters. Over a bounded range of batch sizes, this procedure yields an approximately batch-size-invariant family whose members follow similar sample-indexed learning trajectories. At the systems level, we exploit the computational asymmetry between rollout generation and training: autoregressive generation is often memory-bandwidth-bound at low concurrency, whereas training work scales approximately with the number of processed tokens. Combining these two views yields a direct decision rule: a larger-batch configuration reduces time-to-target only when its throughput gain exceeds its samples-to-target penalty. Experiments with GRPO and PPO support both sides of this decomposition. At the algorithmic level, square-root learning-rate scaling with Adam produces approximately batch-size-invariant learning curves over a bounded range of batch sizes. At the systems level, larger batches improve generation throughput by up to 2.29x on fixed hardware. In GRPO, combining higher throughput with learning-rate retuning reduces time-to-target by up to 29%, whereas increasing the batch without retuning is slower despite its higher throughput.

</details>


### [500] [Fully Distributed GNE Algorithms for Multi-Robot Placement without Consensus on Multipliers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29388)
*Shao-An Yin,Mingyi Hong,Nicola Elia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对广义纳什均衡问题（GNEP），提出了一种完全分布式连续时间算法，在无需智能体间交换拉格朗日乘子的情况下即可收敛到广义纳什均衡（GNE），并给出了离散化方案，通过多机器人放置任务验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布式GNEP求解方法（如基于算子分裂或连续时间的方法）仅限于求解变分GNE（v-GNE），且要求智能体在共享约束上对拉格朗日乘子达成共识。这隐含了一个不现实的中心化协调机构假设，并且每轮迭代需要交换乘子和辅助变量，通信开销大、隐私性差。因此，亟需一种能够在不交换乘子的情况下收敛到一般GNE的分布式算法。

Method: 1. **问题建模**：将GNEP建模为包含个体凸约束和共享线性等式约束的非合作博弈，每个智能体仅知道本地代价函数、个体约束和共享约束的局部分量。2. **算法设计（Algorithm 1）**：提出完全分布式的连续时间原始-对偶动力学：原始变量沿局部拉格朗日梯度下降，更新个体不等式约束对应的乘子采用投影动力学（保持非负），更新共享约束对应的局部乘子沿共享约束残差上升。智能体间仅交换决策变量，不交换乘子。3. **理论分析**：将算法视为投影动力学系统（PDS），利用Lyapunov函数和李导数证明Lie导数非正，得到所有轨迹收敛到GNE的全局稳定性结论（Theorem 1）。4. **离散化**：提出两种离散方案——前向Euler离散（Algorithm 2，使用递减步长）和前向-后向混合分裂（Algorithm 3，类Runge-Kutta，使用常步长），并在各自附加条件下证明收敛性。5. **应用**：将多机器人协同放置任务建模为GNEP，其中机器人在共享任务中心约束下围绕锚点定位。

Result: 1. **理论结果**：在强单调博弈假设下，Algorithm 1的平衡点集全局稳定，每条轨迹收敛到一个GNE（Theorem 1）；通过相同乘子初始化可恢复v-GNE作为特例。2. **通信效率**：当代价函数图与约束图相同时，相比共识方法，每轮迭代通信量减少至原来的三分之一。3. **实验验证**：在12个机器人、4个任务的放置实验中，从六种随机初始条件下获得不同GNE，验证了GNE的非唯一性。前向-后向离散方案与现有共识方法收敛速度相近，但通信开销显著降低。

Conclusion: 本文提出了首个在分布式设置下无需拉格朗日乘子共识即可收敛到一般GNE（而非仅限于v-GNE）的算法，适用于强单调博弈和共享线性等式约束。该方法显著降低了每轮迭代的通信开销（降至共识方法的三分之一），同时提高了隐私性。离散化方案的提出使算法可实际部署。未来的研究方向包括将分析扩展到全局不等式约束情形，以及探索通信图的稀疏性设计，特别是在动态网络中如何选择最稀疏的可行通信图。

Abstract: Recent machine learning research has increasingly focused on equilibrium analysis in non-cooperative games rather than solely on optimal solutions. Many such problems involve shared constraints and can be formulated as Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems (GNEPs). For strongly monotone games, existing methods compute consensus-based variational GNEs (v-GNEs) by exchanging Lagrange multipliers. We propose a fully distributed continuous-time algorithm for shared linear equality constraints that converges without multiplier exchange and reaches any GNE, reducing communication overhead and improving privacy. Discrete-time schemes are also provided, and the method is validated on a multi-robot placement task.

</details>


### [501] [Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29419)
*Asra Aslam,Volodymyr Chapman,Maurice M. O'Connell,Aseel S. Abuzour,Michael Abaho,Danushka Bollegala,Gary Leeming,Eduard Shantsila,Andrew Clegg,Lauren E. Walker,Iain Edward Buchan,Samuel D. Relton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于英国CPRD Aurum初级保健数据库,针对65岁及以上多病共存(MLTCs)老年患者,构建了可扩展的患者时间线数据基础设施,系统比较了时序图卷积神经网络(TG-CNN)与LASSO逻辑回归、随机森林在预测12个月全因急诊住院风险上的表现。研究发现LASSO在测试集上判别性能最高(AUC-ROC=0.733),且校准良好,最适合临床部署;而复杂模型并未带来显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度学习在EHR患者轨迹建模中应用日益增多,但其在真实临床场景中相对简单可解释模型的优势缺乏严格实证检验,尤其在初级保健这种稀疏、长跨度、高维数据环境中。临床决策支持需要兼顾判别性能、概率校准和可解释性,过度依赖AUC-ROC可能导致选择不适用于临床部署的模型。

Method: 1) 数据基础设施:使用GCAF框架构建260种临床条件的三级自动分类体系(简单/中等/复杂),其中17种复杂疾病采用基于临床指南阈值的专用检测逻辑(如高血压基于NICE NG136、慢性肾病基于KDIGO等);2) 建模方法:将患者事件序列编码为带指数衰减时间权重的3D张量,送入TG-CNN(含LSTM、GELU/ReLU激活、稀疏张量表示、逆频类加权);3) 基线模型:LASSO逻辑回归和随机森林均通过5折分层交叉验证调参;4) 评估指标:除AUC-ROC外,引入Platt校准斜率、Brier分数、ECE、校准曲线及GP分层分析,采用三准则评估框架(判别+校准+可解释性)。

Result: 5折交叉验证中,随机森林AUC-ROC最高(0.734),TG-CNN次之(0.712),LASSO第三(0.705);但在独立测试集(N=63,347)上,LASSO判别性能反超(AUC-ROC=0.733,RF=0.710,TG-CNN=0.702);校准方面,LASSO校准斜率0.817(唯一可接受),RF为0.759,TG-CNN仅0.391(严重失校准);TG-CNN还存在等渗回归在高概率区间不稳定、42.1%GP诊所C统计量低于0.5等问题;事件顺序打乱消融实验证实TG-CNN确实利用了时序信息,但未能缩小与静态基线的差距。

Conclusion: 研究得出"复杂度不等于优越性"的核心结论:在稀疏、长跨度、高维的初级保健EHR数据上,LASSO逻辑回归凭借最高的判别性能、良好的概率校准和完全可解释性(548个非零系数),成为最适合直接临床部署的模型;TG-CNN等复杂时序架构未带来实质性收益,其时序衰减机制可能因UK初级保健"一次性编码"惯例而系统性低估早期重要诊断;研究强调AUC-ROC不应作为临床模型选择的唯一标准,校准和可解释性在医疗AI高风险决策中具有同等重要地位,并呼吁未来研究采用三准则评估框架。

Abstract: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.

</details>


### [502] [Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29434)
*Fabio F. Oberweger,Michael Schwingshackl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JEPA world models make latent-space planning a practical route to control, but they are built almost exclusively on images. Whether latent prediction survives geometric observations is unclear: point clouds are sparse, unordered, and self-occluded, and with 0.3-15% of scene points moving, the slow-feature optimum of latent prediction compounds with the geometric shortcut of 3D self-supervision. We lift three canonical JEPA designs to point clouds, frozen-encoder, distribution-prior, and action-sensitive, and re-sense the stable-worldmodel benchmark so that only the observation differs from the image baselines. All three plan without collapse: the distribution-prior model is statistically equivalent to its re-evaluated image counterpart on every benchmark, and the action-sensitive model attains the strongest result in our controlled comparison where the most geometry moves. Probing explains why: object positions are almost perfectly linearly decodable and attention falls on the few moving points. Planning withstands heavy dropout never seen in training, though range noise defeats the thinnest scene. Geometry finally makes a commanded 3D target a natural goal interface: we construct the goal latent from the target and the current latent, at no cost in success rate, without a goal observation.

We lift three canonical JEPA designs to point clouds, frozen-encoder, distribution-prior, and action-sensitive, and re-sense the stable-worldmodel benchmark so that only the observation differs from the image baselines. All three plan without collapse: the distribution-prior model is statistically equivalent to its re-evaluated image counterpart on every benchmark, and the action-sensitive model attains the strongest result in our controlled comparison where the most geometry moves. Probing explains why: object positions are almost perfectly linearly decodable and attention falls on the few moving points. ### [503] [SS-ESOAP: Self-Scaled Adaptive Preconditioning for Physics-Informed Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29448)
*Guangyuan Wang,Mads Toftrup,Sebastian Loeschcke,Yixuan Wang,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SS-eSOAP，一种基于Kronecker分解的自适应预条件优化器，用于高精度物理信息神经网络(PINN)训练。该方法结合了标量割线能量修正、自适应基更新和方差状态缩减策略，在八个PDE基准测试中的六个上取得最低最终残差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练中的病态目标函数限制了在高精度区域的收敛。一阶方法(如Adam)常出现平台效应，而密集准Newton方法状态开销过大，SOAP类Kronecker分解方法依赖周期性基更新，无法匹配训练过程中曲率统计量的演化速率。

Method: 在SOAP风格预条件基础上引入三项关键机制：(1)Kronecker几何适配的标量割线能量修正因子τ_k，确保预条件器的尺度与最近位移方向的曲率匹配；(2)基于非对角质量比ρ的自适应基更新触发器，避免固定周期更新；(3)基更新后的方差状态软重置V←γV策略，替代不稳定的重投影操作。理论分析包括Kronecker割线能量匹配定理和方差状态稳定性界限。

Result: 在八个PDE基准测试中的六个上获得最低最终残差（包括Wave、Burgers、Boussinesq等），最大改进达约3.9个数量级。在2D Boussinesq上达到10^-5残差仅需4.1小时（峰值VRAM 9.2GB），而Adam在14小时内无法达到目标。三种子的L²和H¹物理误差分析证实了低残差与解精度提升的相关性。但方法在Gray-Scott和Ginzburg-Landau问题上不如Purifying Shampoo和SOAP。

Conclusion: SS-eSOAP是一种可扩展的、专门针对刚性和高精度PINN训练场景的优化器，而非现有优化器的通用替代品。其核心价值在于通过自缩放曲率校正和自适应基管理，在不牺牲内存效率的前提下恢复了部分密集准Newton方法的步长调节优势。未来工作需解决三次方基检测成本、状态转换参数选择以及向Transformer类PINN架构的迁移问题。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often face ill-conditioned objectives that limit high-accuracy training. Dense quasi-Newton methods improve local conditioning but require expensive optimizer state, while Kronecker-factored methods such as SOAP scale to larger networks but rely on periodic basis updates. We introduce \method, which augments SOAP-style preconditioning with a scalar secant-energy correction adapted to Kronecker geometry and an adaptive basis update followed by variance-state downscaling. We characterize the directional secant matching induced by the scalar correction and give a bound on variance-state mismatch across basis changes. Across eight PDE benchmarks, \method attains the lowest final residual on six, including Burgers and Boussinesq, while SOAP-family baselines perform better on Gray-Scott and Ginzburg-Landau. On Boussinesq, \method reaches a residual of $10^{-5}$ in 4.1 hours with 9.2 GB peak VRAM, while Adam does not reach this target within 14 hours. Three-seed $L^2$ and $H^1$ errors on four representative PDEs support the link between lower residuals and improved solution accuracy. These results position \method as a scalable option for stiff, high-accuracy physics-informed training, rather than a uniform replacement for existing optimizers.

</details>


### [504] [Reference-Grafting Matches Fine-Tuning at Eliciting Sandbagged Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29458)
*Linh Le,Hong Kiat Tan,David Williams-King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"参考嫁接"（reference-grafting）方法，通过在少量由主动学习选中的电路中将激活沿对比方向设为诚实参考值，成功恢复了被"压分"（sandbagging）模型隐藏的能力。该方法在11个密码锁定的微调模型（1.5–32B参数）上恢复了94–101%的能力差距，无需权重更新或训练标签，并发现微调锁是一种阈值门控机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型治理依赖能力评估来确保安全性，而"压分"（sandbagging）——模型在评估中故意表现不佳却保留底层能力——威胁了这一逻辑。Hofstätter等人（2025）的"Elicitation Game"得出结论：微调可以激发隐藏能力，而加性激活引导（steering）则失败。本文重新审视这一结论，质疑激活引导是否真的无效。

Method: 核心方法"参考嫁接"是沿对比方向v将激活的坐标设为诚实参考值t*（公式：h ↦ h − (h⊤v)v + t*v）。该操作是一个方向性反事实激活补丁。对于每一层，通过诚实/压分激活的差值均值构建对比方向（无需稀疏自编码器），并通过主动学习（AL）选择最少的电路进行嫁接（默认贪心-KL方法）。关键发现是微调锁是一个阈值门控：沿v方向，锁定和解锁状态处于两个特定坐标，只有当嫁接坐标越过接近诚实参考的阈值时，才能解锁能力。

Result: 1. 在11个密码锁定的微调模型上（1.5–32B，三种架构谱系），嫁接恢复了94–101%的诚实-压分差距，与微调激发的能力相当，无需权重更新或训练标签；2–5个配对样本足以拟合方向。2. 对RL诱导的压分和密码锁定代码生成同样有效。3. 主动学习比随机层选择和全带嫁接更优（提升17–55个百分点）。4. 同一机制内，对比方向在不同数据集间可迁移（如ARC上拟合可激发WMDP中隐藏的危险知识），但在不同机制间（提示诱导vs微调vs RL）不可迁移。5. 电路打断（circuit-breaking）标记了静态锁假设的边界，因为它在每次前向传播时重新路由激活，使固定编辑失效。

Conclusion: 在静态锁假设下，嫁接其坐标到诚实参考这一单一操作可以恢复压分隐藏的能力，与微调效果相当，但具有前向传播成本和门控定位的优势。"steering失败"的结论对操作（设为参考而非加性）和选择（AL最小叠加电路而非手动选择）都很敏感。开放问题包括野外诚实参考的获取和击败电路打断的方法。

Abstract: Sandbagging, in which a model deliberately underperforms on an evaluation despite retaining the underlying capability, threatens the safety evaluations that frontier-model governance depends on. The Elicitation Game found that fine-tuning elicits hidden capability from sandbagging model organisms whereas additive activation steering fails. We revisit that verdict with reference-grafting, which sets an activation's coordinate along a contrast direction to the value it takes in an honest reference, at a small set of circuits chosen by active learning. Across eleven fine-tuned password-locked models (1.5-32B, three architecture lineages), it recovers +94 to +101% of the honest-sandbagging gap, matching fine-tuning elicitation without weight updates or training labels; two to five paired examples suffice to fit the direction. Similar recovery holds for reinforcement-learning-induced sandbagging and for password-locked code generation. Grafting works because the fine-tuned lock is a thresholded gate: held-out accuracy stays at the sandbagged level until the grafted coordinate crosses a threshold near the honest reference, which is why additive steering and zeroing the coordinate often fail. The direction tracks how the sandbagging was induced rather than what is withheld -- fit on grade-school science (ARC) it elicits withheld hazardous knowledge (WMDP), yet prompting, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning each carry a different direction. Circuit-breaking marks the boundary: it reroutes activations on every forward pass, so the fixed edits we test are re-broken downstream and do not restore coherent generation.

</details>


### [505] [Knowledge Distillation under Teacher Misspecification: An Order-Parameter Analysis of the Gap between Teacher Mimicry and Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29472)
*Kazuyuki Hara,Hideitsu Hino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究知识蒸馏中"教师模仿"与"真实任务性能"之间的差距。通过软委员会机(SCM)三方模型(真实教师-教师-学生),引入受标量参数δ_miss控制的共享潜在因子U₃作为教师缺失结构,证明蒸馏误差E_ts对δ_miss严格不变,而真实误差E_t₀s和间隙Δ=E_t₀s−E_ts关于δ_miss严格递增,递增速率被真实教师复杂度M₀线性放大。相图分析验证了教师失配区域随δ_miss扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏实践中广泛使用蒸馏损失(即师生差异)作为评估指标,但该指标衡量的是教师模仿精度而非学生在真实任务上的性能。当教师自身未能捕获真实任务的结构时(教师失配/teacher-miss),学生可能完美模仿教师却无法提升真实性能。本文旨在从统计力学角度分离这两种失败模式,提供理论诊断工具。

Method: 采用最小三方模型:真实教师t₀(生成模型)、教师t(不含潜在因子U₃)、学生s,均为软委员会机(SCM)加erf激活函数。通过对称约简将学习动力学降维到每组的三个序参数(r,g,q_d,g,q_o,g)。在高维极限N→∞下,序参数遵循常微分方程(ODE),借鉴Saad-Solla框架。关键设计:真实教师包含共享潜在因子U₃(强度为√δ_miss),而教师不含。利用Price定理和反正弦闭式表达(引理4)计算所有误差,并证明E_ts和ODE不依赖于δ_miss,而E_t₀s严格递增。数值上用Monte Carlo估计ODE右端,用闭式公式评估误差,实现精确公共随机数(CRN)扫描δ_miss。

Result: 理论结果:(i)定理6:ODE右端和E_ts完全独立于δ_miss;(ii)E_t₀s和Δ= E_t₀s−E_ts关于δ_miss严格递增;(iii)推论7:∂Δ/∂δ_miss被真实教师复杂度M₀线性放大。实验结果:在(M₀, K_tot)平面相图中,δ_miss=0时E_ts与E_t₀s等值线完全重合;随δ_miss增大,E_ts等值线完全不动,但E_t₀s热图系统性地抬升,Δ>0区域从大M₀侧扩大,Δ≈0.27(δ_miss=0.15, M₀=12)。教师失配区域随δ_miss扩大,且Δ沿K_tot方向近似平坦,说明增加学生容量无法缓解教师失配。n_samp敏感性测试验证了数值稳健性。间隙分解:Δ= E_t₀t + E[(t₀−t)(t−s)],完全模仿极限下Δ= E_t₀t。

Conclusion: 本文提供了知识蒸馏中"模仿成功≠任务成功"现象的理论量化与相图可视化。研究表明:(1)用蒸馏误差单独评估蒸馏会系统性地掩盖教师失配导致的真实性能退化;(2)间隙Δ= E_t₀s−E_ts可作为区分教师失配与容量受限失败的最小诊断指标;(3)在教师失配主导区,增大K_tot几乎无益于真实误差,应优先改善教师侧;(4)在容量受限区,提升学生容量/教师质量可有效提升真实性能。实际设计需联合外部教师质量评估,避免将教师模仿度量等同于任务成功。未来工作包括多维潜在因子失配、解耦教师容量M的3D相图、含噪设置以及解析ODE右端等。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation trains a small student model to reproduce the outputs of a large teacher model, and its progress is typically monitored through the teacher--student discrepancy. The quantity of ultimate interest, however, is the student's error with respect to the true task. We study the relation between these two objectives in a minimal three-party model, a true teacher (generative model), a teacher, and a student, all soft committee machines, in which the true teacher contains a shared latent factor that the teacher cannot represent, with mismatch strength controlled by a single scalar $\dmiss$. Within an order-parameter description of online distillation, and exploiting closed-form (arcsine-type) expressions for all errors under error-function activations, we prove that the learning dynamics and the distillation error $\Ets$ are exactly invariant to $\dmiss$, whereas the true error $\Etzs$ and the gap $\Delta=\Etzs-\Ets$ are strictly increasing in $\dmiss$, with a rate that is amplified linearly by the complexity $M_0$ of the true teacher. Numerical phase diagrams over the plane spanned by true-teacher complexity and student capacity confirm the predicted deformation: the contours of $\Ets$ do not move while the landscape of $\Etzs$ rises systematically, and a teacher-miss regime, where mimicry succeeds but the task fails, expands with $\dmiss$. The results give a quantitative warning against evaluating distillation solely through teacher-mimicry metrics and identify the gap $\Delta$ as a minimal diagnostic for distinguishing teacher-miss from capacity-limited failure.

</details>


### [506] [Denoising as Projection: Constrained Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29507)
*Runyu Zhang,Jiawei Zhang,Gioele Zardini,Saurabh Amin,Asuman Ozdaglar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对梯度引导扩散模型在结构化可行集上易破坏数据几何的问题，提出了一种简单推理时方法 Denoising-Corrected Gradient (DCG) Guidance，将目标梯度步置于去噪器内部，从而利用 Stein 后验均值去噪算子作为近似投影，实现了一种时变非精确投影梯度方法。理论上分别在线性高斯、强凸与光滑非凸紧凸集、以及紧 C² 黎曼子流形三类几何下证明了下降性与有限时间收敛保证，数值实验在合成约束优化、轨迹跟踪与 D4RL 基准上验证了其在目标下降与可行性之间的优越权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有梯度引导扩散方法在数据分布集中在流形或约束集上时，梯度方向可能偏离可行几何，导致可行性破坏与样本质量下降；而现有几何感知方法往往依赖分数雅可比、批采样或模型微调，计算与实现成本高。本文旨在寻找一种极简的推理时方法，仅需一次目标梯度评估与一次预训练去噪器调用，即可获得约束优化保证。

Method: 核心思路是将 DDIM 反向去噪更新中的目标梯度步放在去噪器内部：先沿目标负梯度方向做一步，然后调用 Stein 后验均值去噪算子 π̂_t 对该点去噪。在几何噪声计划 σ_{t-1}/σ_t = 1-ε 与常数步长 η 下，更新近似为 (1-ε)x_t + ε π̂_t(x_t - η∇f(x_t))。利用 Tweedie–Miyasawa 恒等式将 π̂_t 表示为 x + σ_t²∇log P_t(x)，从而在三类几何（线性高斯子空间、紧凸集、紧 C² 嵌入子流形）下分别证明其与真投影 π_X 的近似界，并建立时变非精确投影梯度方法的下降与有限步收敛分析。

Result: 线性高斯：对强凸 f，几何收敛至全局最优，且法向分量几何收缩；强凸目标下紧凸集：几何收敛至全局最优；光滑非凸目标下紧凸集：min ‖𝒢_η(p_t)‖² ≤ O(1/T)；紧 C² 子流形：‖grad_M f(p_{t*})‖² ≤ O(1/T)，且法向距离同步收缩；投影近似误差分别为 O(σ)（凸集）与 O(σ|log σ|)（流形，略优于之前 O(σ|log σ|³)）。数值上在双积分器跟踪、10维凸约束合成问题、非线性独轮车轨迹规划以及 D4RL Hopper/Walker/HalfCheetah-medium 上，DCG 在目标下降与可行性之间取得比 PDG 更优的权衡，且优于或匹配 GGDM、DRGD 等优化导向扩散基线。

Conclusion: DCG 将去噪视为投影的视角在统一框架中覆盖了线性子空间、紧凸集与光滑子流形三类隐式可行几何，并给出标准的一阶收敛保证；其仅依赖预训练去噪器与目标梯度，无需分数雅可比、批采样或模型微调，是一类简单、可即插即用的推理时约束优化方法。未来工作包括将理论扩展到随机采样器、其他扩散参数化与噪声调度，以及处理学习分数误差与模型错配问题。

Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used not only for sampling from learned data distributions, but also for generating samples that optimize task-specific objectives. A common approach is to guide the reverse diffusion process using gradients of an external objective. However, when the data distribution is supported on a structured feasible set, such as a manifold or a constraint set, gradient guidance can move samples away from the learned data geometry. In this paper, we study a simple projected-gradient-guided diffusion update based on the observation that the Stein denoising operator can act as an approximate projection onto the data geometry. The proposed update incorporates the objective gradient inside the denoising step, yielding an inference-time method that uses only a pretrained denoiser and gradient evaluations. We analyze this update as an inexact projected-gradient method for constrained optimization over learned feasible geometries. Our theory covers three settings: linear manifolds, compact convex feasible sets, and compact Riemannian submanifolds. In all these settings, we prove descent and finite-time convergence guarantees. Numerical experiments support the theoretical interpretation and illustrate how the proposed update balances objective descent with preservation of the learned geometry.

</details>


### [507] [On the Plasticity Collapse in Continual Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29513)
*Yingdan Shi,Xiang Xu,Kaize Ding,Alfred O. Hero,Ren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对持续机器遗忘（continual machine unlearning）场景，识别并系统表征了一种称为"塑性崩溃"（plasticity collapse）的根本性局限：在连续遗忘过程中，模型逐步丧失有效遗忘的能力，表现为前向失效（遗忘质量下降）和后向失效（已遗忘信息自发再记忆）。论文通过线性模型和NTK框架下的理论分析，证明连续遗忘操作在参数空间中累积几何约束，导致共享子空间饱和，进而限制了未来的参数更新；并通过多种架构、数据集和遗忘方法的大量实验验证了这一现象的普遍性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究主要集中在单次遗忘请求，但实际系统需要处理随时间顺序到达的多个遗忘请求。作者旨在揭示这一持续遗忘场景下被忽视的根本性局限，挑战当前遗忘方法的长期可靠性。

Method: 1）将主流遗忘方法统一为一个两分量优化框架（遗忘损失+保留损失），推导出参数更新的仿射递推关系；2）在线性模型设定下证明：当存在共享子空间W且遗忘曲率占优时，时序算子乘积A_{t:s}在W上呈指数增长（定理1和定理2）；3）通过NTK线性化将结论推广到神经网络（定理3）；4）提出两个诊断量：能量比（ER）和投影系数（CO），分别用于检测前向和后向失效；5）在Tiny-ImageNet和CIFAR-100上，使用VGG-16-BN和PreResNet-110，对FT、NegGrad+、RL、SalUn、MUNBa五种方法在随机遗忘和类遗忘两种场景下进行系统实验验证。

Result: 所有五种方法在两种场景中均表现出塑性崩溃现象：随机遗忘下所有方法均出现前向失效；类遗忘下FT、NegGrad+、MUNBa出现前向失效，RL和SalUn出现后向失效；遗忘准确率在持续设置下平均比单次设置高33.2%。L2范数显示参数更新幅度随任务增加而单调递减；ER指标在前向失效中衰减至零，CO指标在后向失效中呈现符号振荡，验证了理论预测。

Conclusion: 塑性崩溃是持续遗忘场景中固有的结构性现象，而非特定方法的实现缺陷。它揭示了当前遗忘方法在长期可靠性方面的严重障碍，呼吁开发保持塑性的新型遗忘算法。作者提出的ER和CO可作为轻量级在线监控工具，也可自然地整合到现有的基于梯度的遗忘目标中作为正则化信号。该工作为理解更广泛场景（如生成模型和LLM）中的塑性崩溃奠定了理论和诊断基础。

Abstract: Machine unlearning enables deep neural networks to selectively remove the influence of specific data in response to privacy and regulatory requirements. While prior work largely studies single-shot unlearning, real-world systems must accommodate continual unlearning, where multiple unlearning requests occur sequentially over time. In this work, we identify a fundamental limitation of this setting: plasticity collapse, a progressive breakdown in a model's ability to effectively forget. Through theoretical analysis of continual unlearning dynamics, we show that continual unlearning operations accumulate geometric constraints in parameter space, leading to saturated subspaces that restrict future updates. This structural effect induces two distinct failure modes: (1) Forward failure -- diminishing forgetting quality for subsequent tasks, and (2) Backward failure -- spontaneous re-memorization of previously forgotten information. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures, datasets, and methods in image classification confirm that plasticity collapse is not an artifact of specific implementations, but a pervasive phenomenon inherent to continual unlearning. Our findings reveal a critical barrier to the long-term reliability of machine unlearning systems and motivate the development of plasticity-preserving unlearning algorithms. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [508] [HoopMind: A Real-Time Neural Game-Tree System for Opponent-Aware Possession Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29563)
*Yibo Gong,Cong Guo,Jiacheng Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HoopMind是一个基于公开数据的实时神经博弈树系统，专为篮球进攻战术规划设计。它通过融合5个公开数据源构建了包含423万次投篮的数据集，开发了ShotNet模型预测投篮命中率，并利用深度受限的expectimax搜索算法实时求解最优进攻决策。所有模型离线训练，在浏览器中实时运行，配套提供侦察规划器和可交互模拟器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学校教练在准备对手时缺乏专业球队可用的分析工具，只能依赖比赛录像、直觉和白板。现有的专业篮球分析系统需要私有追踪数据，对基层教练来说遥不可及。本文旨在探索仅使用公开数据能在多大程度上弥合这一差距，为学校级别的篮球教练提供数据驱动的、对手感知的实时战术规划工具。

Method: 1) 数据融合：整合5个公开数据源（投篮位置、两套play-by-play、官方对位追踪、球员生物特征），按(game, player, quarter, min, sec)键连接，覆盖21个赛季423万次投篮，对齐率99.5%-100%。
2) ShotNet模型：嵌入多层感知机(MLP)，包含射手(16维)、防守队(8维)、区域(6维)、动作组(6维)四类嵌入，加上9个数值特征(x、y、距离、3分标志、节次、剩余秒数、预shot分差、身高体重)，96-64-1架构，约46k参数。
3) 对手建模：三层配置——按队按区域(ρ)、按防守球员(δ)、按节次(ι)，均采用经验贝叶斯收缩估计。
4) 规划算法：将半场比赛视为序贯博弈，采用深度受限(d=2)的expectimax搜索，结合分支限界剪枝(beam k=6, ε=0.02)，平均评估43.0片叶节点，相比穷举搜索减少43.4%节点，97%状态下选择相同最佳动作。
5) 终端期望值：EP(s) = (1-β_block) × p_make × pts，p_make来自ShotNet前向传播并根据开放度和对抗距离调整。
6) 模拟器：采用商业游戏AI栈（感知延迟、转向行为、受限加速度、人盯人或协防），所有参数来自学习到的估计，每0.25秒重新求解博弈树。

Result: 1) 数据对齐：21赛季423万次投篮，匹配率99.54%-100%，匹配结果99.9%一致。
2) 发现两个数据陷阱：(a) 2016-17前play-by-play中0-0表示缺失，导致"关键球"比例从4%虚增到7.5%；(b) 后shot分差泄漏造成虚假15.2pp效应，预shot分差修正后归一化到46.9%-48.6%。
3) ShotNet性能（2023-24保留集）：AUC=0.646，log-loss=0.648，优于区域基线(0.631/0.663)和逻辑回归基线(0.639/0.666)，10-bin ECE=0.016，良好校准。
4) 剪枝效果：k=6, ε=0.02配置下减少43.4%节点，97%状态下与穷举搜索动作一致，平均EP差距0.001。
5) 浏览器性能：ShotNet导出362KB JSON，每帧一次前向传播，博弈树重解在1毫秒内完成。
6) 战术发现：2023-24关键球三分命中率从36.9%降至31.7%；底角三分96-97%助攻，中距离仅46%；中距离占比从35.6%降至11.2%，三分占比从18.7%翻倍至39.5%。

Conclusion: HoopMind证明仅使用公开数据即可构建接近专业水平的对手感知战术规划系统。核心贡献在于：(1) 高质量的多源公开数据融合管道及两个易被忽视的数据陷阱报告；(2) ShotNet作为校准良好的投篮概率模型，可直接用于终端估值；(3) 剪枝深度受限expectimax在浏览器中实时求解进攻决策树，计算成本降低43%且保持97%动作一致性。框架具有跨运动可移植性，下一步将扩展到足球(StatsBomb)和冰球。该系统让基层教练能获得原本只有职业球队才有的数据驱动战术分析能力。
